column4:
"The handwriting is from a page that has fallen
out of a new diary."

column3:
これほどに醜く、滑稽な姿の魔物は見た事が無い
変な話だが――自分があの魔物として
生まれなかった事に、感謝を覚えてすらいる
column4:
It's strange that I have never previously seen
demons of such an ugly,
comical figure like this...I should remember to
be thankful, to have not been born into
this world as one of those demons.

column3:
戦いを重ねるごとに、憎めなく思えてきたが――
愛着が湧く前に、希少素材が入手できて良かった
column4:
Whenever I had fought a battle, my mind was clear
of hatred...
It was good that rare materials made themselves
available before I got too
hot-headed.

column3:
さらに、戦いの中でこの地の魔物が
使っていた武器を入手する事もできた
故郷で流通していた物よりも
高度に鍛えられている
column4:
In addition, by battling the demon that laid
claim to
this place, I was able to get the weapon I had
been using forged to a
higher quality than those circulating around my
hometown.

column3:
新たに訪れたこの地で、まだまだ知らない事は多い
素材だけでなく、多くの知識も
持ち帰る事ができそうだ
column4:
There are many things still unknown to me about
this
new place. Perhaps I may not only bring materials
home, but also a
wealth of knowledge.

column3: 起こるのは良い事ばかり――心配は杞憂だったのだ
column4:
Only good things have occurred...I was needlessly
worried.

column3: "筆跡が新しい日記のページが落ちている"
column4:
"Bad fate"
...Aah, have you been creeping up on me without a
sound?

column3:
数多の魔物を打ち倒し、
実力をつけていく手応えは確かに感じていた――
だからこそ、慢心があったのかもしれない
column4:
I certainly felt the way to put my skills to the
test,
was to defeat a multitude of monsters...
Perhaps I was too overconfident in my ability.

column3:
先の戦いで手負いだとしても、油断があったとしても
こうも簡単に囲まれるとは情けない――
column4:
Even if you purposely throw the previous battle,
and even if you
were unprepared, it is pitiful to be surrounded
as easily as this...

column3:
暗闇の先から、盗賊たちの息遣いが聞こえる
この緊張を破るきっかけがあれば、
飢えた狼のように一斉に飛びかかる気なのだろう
column4:
From the darkness, you can hear the thieves
breathing as
they wait for a chance to break the tension in
the air.
Perhaps they're going to jump out and strike in
unison like starving wolves.

column3:
全てを塔に置いてきたことだけが、唯一の救いだ
あの妖しき宝は、盗賊ごときに渡すのは惜しいからな
column4:
Putting everything into the tower, may prove to
be my salvation.
That bewitching treasure, it would be regrettable
to hand it over to someone such as a thief.

column3:
"良くない運命"
――あぁ、音も無く忍び寄られていたのか
column4:
"Bad fate"
...Aah, have you been creeping up on me without a
sound?

column3: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

column3:
遺跡の奥底に坐していたあの魔物――
レスタニアに生息しているそれと姿形は似ているけど
より凶暴で、俊敏だったように感じます
column4:
That demon dwelling within the depths of the
ruins...
It looks similar to those that inhabit Lestania,
but feels far more
ferocious and agile.

column3:
それとは別に、見知った魔物も見かけました
同様の進化を遂げたのか、何らかの手段で
向こうからこちらへ渡って来たのか――
column4:
That aside, I also saw a monster I recognized.
Have you evolved in a similar way by some means?
Did you cross over to here from there...?

column3:
しかし、我々の知っていた倒し方が通用したせいか
ベンジャミン様は少し興奮しておられるようでした
column4:
However, it seemed that Benjamin was a bit excited
because the method of killing we knew had worked.

column3:
ベンジャミン様の命でこの日記をつけるように
なってから、心の機微と出来事のつながりが
整理でき、人の感情が推測できるように
なってきた気がします――
column4:
Since I had begun to record Benjamin's life in
this diary,
I feel it is now possible to organize the link
between the subtleties of the mind,
and the events of one's life to better understand
how they feel...

column3:
この調子で、もう少し――
主人の心に寄り添えるポーンになりたいものです
column4:
In this manner, just a little further...
I'll become a pawn that is closer to my master's
heart.

column3: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

column3:
本当にこのモロー樹林の侵食は、深刻なようです
侵食の治療はなんとか可能であるものの
根本的な原因が何か判明していない以上――
かからないに越したことはありません
column4:
It seems that the corruption of the "Morrow
Forest" has gotten
serious. Although the treatment of corruption is
somehow possible, I do not know
what has initially caused it to form...
It's best that I don't take anything from here.

column3:
今回の探索で、侵食には重度なものになると
より凶暴化し、感染力が上がる事が分かりました
相貌も変化し、正視に耐えられぬ姿になることも――
column4:
During this investigation, I've learned that the
corruption
seems to become more of an issue when it reaches
a severe level. Upon which,
the infectivity increases, and the appearance
changes to form a figure that one
could not bear to look at...

column3:
レスタニアとフィンダムの迷宮を巡り
希少素材を回収する旅も、もう長くなりますが――
column4:
Adventures through the labyrinths of Lestania
and Phindym to collect rare materials, have only
gotten longer...

column3:
ベンジャミン様は集めた素材を
すべて装備品に変え、ご友人が滞在していた地
滞在したであろう地の最奥に
納めていくことを続けておられます
column4:
Master Benjamin gathered all of the materials
collected thus far,
and used them to form equipment here in the land
where your friend had stayed.
In the most remote parts of this place, he
continuously offers up what he has created.

column3:
4部位それぞれで行う――
ということは、残るはあと2ヶ所
真意は分かりかねますが、我々は付き従うのみです
column4:
"Do this in each of the four sites"...
That means there are two sites still remaining.
We may not understand the intention behind this,
but we tag along regardless.

column3: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

column3:
この大陸は、その気候や生態、文化など
全てにおいて異なる点が多く見られます
column4:
On this continent, the climate, ecology, culture,
and etc,
are all so different than everything we knew.

column3:
特に、この水路で見たあのサルのような魔物――
姿形はレスタニアに生息しているものに
似ていますが、決定的に違うのは、そのトゲ――
column4:
Particularly, monsters like the ape we had seen
in this waterway..
Its appearance is similar to those inhabiting
Lestania,
but decisively different, because of those
thorns...

column3:
しかしこの魔物からも、レスタニアでは見る事の無い
希少な素材を回収できました
これで、水路に降りた目的を達成したはずです
column4:
However, from this demon we were able to recover
one of the rare materials that did not exist in
Lestania.
With this, we should have achieved the purpose of
why we came into this waterway.

column3:
――ベンジャミン様は
ご友人の遺体と日記を発見してから
以前にも増して寡黙になられたようです――
column4:
...Master Benjamin seems to become more withdrawn
the more we stumble upon the diaries of his
acquaintances who have likely
fallen...

column3:
時折、酷く悔しそうな表情をされます――
しかしその真意までは
ポーンの私には判らないのです
column4:
Occasionally, I will have a look of chagrin on my
face...
but the intention behind it, is one that my pawn
can't understand.

column3: "誰かの日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page of someone's diary has fallen"

column3:
あの話は本当だったのか――
氷魔がごく稀に落とすという
強力な希少素材――
column4:
Was the story true?
The one about the ice demon that drops a powerful
rare material?

column3:
村の情報屋が言うことには
今までその姿かたちを見た者はいないらしい
column4:
The information broker in the village said that
there has been nobody that has seen the figure
until just now.

column3:
ならばなぜ、情報屋がその存在を知っているのか？
そんな怪しい話、どうせ戯言に違いないと
たかをくくっていたが――
column4:
So pray tell, how does the information broker
know of its existence?
Such a suspicious story, it must be a load of
crap...

column3:
まさか本当に存在していたとはな！
ああ、触れているだけで
手のひらがピリピリと痛むほどの冷気を感じる
どれほどの魔力を秘めているのか――
column4:
It certainly did exist, and must've existed for a
while now!
Oh, just touching it has made a painful tingling
chill linger in my palm.
Just how much magical power is hidden within
it...?

column3:
他にもこういった物が無いか
調べてみる価値はあるな――
column4:
Are there others like this?
It may be worth investigating further...

column3: "誰かの日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page of someone's diary has fallen"

column3:
危ない所だった――
ただでさえ怪力で厄介なサイクロプスが
侵食によって、およそ生物とは
思えない力を発揮していた
column4:
It was a dangerous place...
Even a simple Cyclops, already troublesome due to
its sturdiness,
was demonstrating an unexpected strength when
corrupted by these strange
organisms.

column3:
まともに相手をしていたら、今頃命は無かっただろう
今こうして日記を書いている手も、震えが止まらない
column4:
If I did not have a decent partner, I would not
currently be alive.
Even as I write this, my hands cannot stop
trembling.

column3:
なんとか手に入れたこのおぞましい貴重素材――
見た目はひどいものだが、
祈祷師や好事家あたりが見れば大喜びするだろう
column4:
I did manage to acquire this valuable and hideous
material somehow...
Although it's a terrible sight to behold, you
would be delighted to see the prices the
shamans and dilettantes have offered for it.

column3:
しかし、金にするのが本当に正しい用途なのか？
もっと集めることで、何か作り出せるのかもしれない
column4:
But, is this really the right way to use it;
making money?
Perhaps by gathering more, something useful might
be made from it.

column3:
例えば、それが武器だとしたら――
大きな力を持つはずだ
column4:
For example, if formed into a weapon...it should
be imbued with great power.

column3: "誰かの日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page of someone's diary has fallen"

column3:
俺も腕には自信があるつもりだが、
正直言って今回はヒヤリとさせられた――
侵食されたグリフィンとは、これほど凶暴なものか
column4:
I am confident in my weapons, but if I am honest,
this time I may have made a mistake...
Is this Infected Griffin as ferocious as they say?

column3:
さすがに今回ばかりは、落命すら覚悟した
まだ命がある事、感謝せねば――
column4:
As one would expect, even though I was prepared
to die,
I still live, and I must not take that for
granted...

column3:
ともあれ、そろそろ収集物も増えてきた――
持ち歩くにも動きづらいため
ひとまとまりにして保管しておくことにしよう
column4:
Anyway, my collection has recently grown in
size...
I've decided to keep it all in one place, as it
is getting hard
to carry it around everywhere with me.

column3:
魔物の巣になるばかりの
うち捨てられた建物があった
村に置き去るよりは、そこの方が安心だろう
column4:
There was an abandoned building nearby.
It would be much more secure to put it there,
than to leave it
in the village, only for it to become some
monster's nest.

column3:
印象的なその姿――
我がアジトを『塔』と名付けよう
column4:
What an impressive figure...
My own secret hideout, I'll call it the "Tower".

column3: "古い日記のページが落ちている"
column4: "A page from an old diary has fallen down."

column3:
ベヘモットを倒し、宝を入手できたのは良かったが
それを塔まで持ち帰るのに苦労した――
column4:
It was satisfying to beat that behemoth and get
treasure from it,
but I had a hard time bringing it back to the
tower...

column3:
戦いの最中だけでなく、
帰り道にすらアイツに苦労させられるとは――
苦労した分、この素材が何に
使えるのかという期待は高まる一方だ
column4:
Not only during the battles,
but even on the way back to that guy I have
suffered hardships...
Due to these struggles, the expectations I have
for what this
material can be used for are rising.

column3:
ここしばらくの収穫は
我ながら好調すぎるほどだ
日頃の感謝もあり、例の情報屋に話してみたが――
column4:
The harvest here has been great for a while and
I've felt the need to show gratitude because of
it.
For example, I spoke to the information broker...

column3:
青い顔になって、そんなものを集めるのは
すぐ止めるようにと強く言われた
なんでも、"良くない運命"を引き寄せるとか――
嘘をついている表情ではないが――
にわかに信じがたい
column4:
They became pale in the face, and said that
collecting
such things must be stopped at once.
Doing anything else, would be inviting "bad
fate"...
By the look on their face, they weren't lying...
It's still hard to believe though.

column3: 向かう所敵無し、これほどの絶好調だと言うのに――
column4:
I'm unbeatable though, and would say this is
going to go perfectly well...

column3: "筆跡が新しい日記のページが落ちている"
column4:
"The handwriting is from a page that has fallen
out of a new diary."

column3:
見た目は何ともおぞましく
邪悪な魔法は強力だったが
叩き落としてしまえば、たやすいものだった――
column4:
What a horrible sight.
Dark magic worked incredibly well against it,
and when it was knocked down, it was easy to slay
it...

column3:
こんな魔物に、数多の人々が言葉無き姿に
変えられたかと思うと、何ともやるせない
column4:
To think that many people were changed into
speechless statues
by such a demon, is deeply depressing...

column3:
ともあれ、希少素材は入手した
せめてメドゥーサの犠牲となった人々に
安らかな眠りが与えられるよう――祈るしかない
column4:
Anyway, as soon as we collect the rare material
from it,
we have to say a prayer for the souls that have
fell victim at the hands of the Medusa...
I have no choice but to pray...

column3:
この素材に、どれだけの
人間の怨念が込められているか
いや――今まで集めてきた全てが
同じ宿因にあるのだろう
column4:
This material...
Are there remnants of human grudges is trapped
within?
It's unpleasant...but it seems to be used for the
same purpose as
everything else we've collected up until now in
the inn.

column3:
――それを考えれば、集めると
"良くない運命"を引き寄せるという
いつか聞いた話も頷けるように思う
column4:
...Given that, if one collects things like these
they say it will invite a "bad fate".
I think the stories I've heard will someday
become true...

column3: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

column3:
侵食の進んだ、危険な土地ではありましたが――
退治した大型魔物に侵食の気配は無く
今まで同様強敵だったものの、少し安心しました
column4:
Although the land was highly corrupted and
dangerous -
there was no sign of infestation in the large
demons that we eliminated.
And although they were as powerful as ever, we
were a bit relieved.

column3:
しかし、このような土地で侵食されず生息するとは
移り住んだばかりなのか、抗体があるのか――
column4:
However, to live in a land like this without
being infected...
Is it because they just moved in, or do they have
antibodies?

column3:
ベンジャミン様はその美しい魔物からも素材を
回収すると、装備品をまた一つ作成されました
この装備もまた――塔に納めるおつもりなのでしょう
column4:
Master Benjamin collected materials from that
beautiful demon and created another piece of
equipment.
This equipment also intended to be stored in the
tower.

column3:
先日立ち寄った拠点で耳に入って来たのですが――
フィンダムには、偉大な人物が亡くなった際
装具や装飾品を副葬品として埋葬する文化が
あるそうなのです
column4:
I overheard at a stopover the other day-- that
there is a tradition in Phindym where when great
men die, they are buried with ornaments and
ornaments as burial accessories.

column3:
ベンジャミン様がご友人の足跡を巡りながら
作成した装備品を埋葬していくのは――
フィンダムの流儀に則った弔い、なのかもしれません
column4:
Perhaps Master Benjamin, while tracing the
footsteps of his friend, is burying the equipment
he created—an homage following the Phindym
tradition.

column3: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

column3:
驚くべき発見です！
ピクシーが、これほど高度な社会的序列を築いて
いたとは――しかも、その強固さは
比較対象にされることの多いゴブリン以上です
column4:
It is a surprising discovery!
I had no idea that Pixies had built such a high
level of social hierarchy - and moreover, its
strength is greater than that of the commonly
compared Goblin.

column3:
ベンジャミン様はいつになくご機嫌が良いようで
なんと――ご自分のことを
少し話してくださいました！
column4:
Mr. Benjamin seemed to be in an unusually good
mood and, by golly--he told us a little about
himself!

column3:
まず、亡きご友人について
フィンダム人唯一の友人であること――
彼の志に敬意を表し、弔いの旅を続けていること――
column4:
First and foremost, I pay my respects to my late
comrade, the only friend of a Phindymian. I
continue my journey in tribute to his aspirations
and in mourning.

column3:
さらに、旅が終わったら二度と
このようなことが起きないよう
冒険者の集いを作り、助け合えるように
したいということ
column4:
Furthermore, once our journey concludes, I wish
to establish a gathering of adventurers to ensure
that such events never happen again, and to foster
mutual assistance.

column3:
そして最も感動したのは、我々にも
その一端を担わせてくださるということ――
ポーンでありながら、仲間として
認められたような気さえしました
column4:
And what moved me the most was that we were
allowed to play a part in it as well. Even as
pawns, it felt like we were recognized as
companions.

column3: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

column3:
この森の最奥で待ち構えていた魔物は
一度対峙した記憶のある魔物――
その腕力は相変わらず脅威でしたが
危なげなく突破することができました
column4:
The creature that lay in wait at the deepest part
of this forest was a creature I had once faced
before. Its strength remained as formidable as
ever, but we were able to overcome it without much
trouble.

column3:
癒しの力を当てることで
あの奇妙な触手の威力を
一定時間抑えることができるようなのです
column4:
It seems that applying the power of healing can
temporarily suppress the strange tentacles' power.

column3:
ところで――
最近は侵食されている魔物と対峙することが多く
ベンジャミン様はよく咳き込み
どこか苦しそうなご様子です
column4:
By the way -
Recently, Master Benjamin has been facing many
infected enemies, and often coughs with a somewhat
painful appearance.

column3:
覚者は竜の力を得ているとはいえ
病には罹りますし、ごくゆっくりと老衰もする――
一言で申し上げるならば、心配です
column4:
While Arisen possess the power of the dragon,
they can still fall ill, and age gradually as
well. In a word, it is a cause for concern.

column3:
どうも、後ろ向きなことばかり考えてしまいます
「弔い」という目的を果たした時
あの方はどうなってしまわれるのでしょう
最悪の場合を想像してしまう私を、お許しください
column4:
I find myself constantly dwelling on negative
thoughts. When we achieve the "mourning" purpose,
I wonder what will become of that person. Please
forgive me for imagining the worst-case scenario.

column3: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

column3:
侵食されている魔物の行動には、
いくつかのパターンが見られます
column4:
There are several patterns observed in the
behavior of the infected creatures.

column3:
とにかく凶暴性が助長されるもの
侵食前と変わらない行動サイクルを持つもの
そしてこの魔物のように侵食から逃れようと
もがき苦しむもの――
column4:
There are those whose aggressiveness is
exacerbated, those that maintain the same
behavioral cycle as before infection, and those
like this creature, who struggle in agony, trying
to escape from the corruption.

column3:
その姿は哀れを誘いますが――
侵食によって箍の外れた力は、一瞬でも
気を緩めればこちらが命を落とすほどです
column4:
Their appearance evokes pity, but the power
unleashed by Corruption is so dangerous that even
a momentary lapse in concentration could cost us
our lives.

column3:
この度の魔物は強敵でしたが
それ以上に苦戦しました
ベンジャミン様の動きが鈍く、我々が
それを庇っていたためです
column4:
The creatures we faced this time were formidable
foes, but what made it even more challenging was
that Master Benjamin's movements were slow, and we
were protecting him.

column3:
このままでは、ベンジャミン様のご友人を弔うはずが
我々自身の弔い旅になってしまうかもしれません
帰還し、ゆっくり休養いただけるまであと少し――
column4:
If this continues, our journey to mourn Master
Benjamin's late friend might turn into our own
mourning journey. We'll have to return and rest a
little while longer until Master Benjamin can
recuperate.

column3: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
column4: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

column3:
最後の戦いは、壮絶を極めました
侵食の悪魔――
相手はまさに、その言葉にふさわしい怪物でした
column4:
The final battle was truly epic. The demon of
infection—our adversary was undoubtedly a monster
befitting those words.

column3:
最後の力を振り絞り、何とか止めを刺したものの――
我々従者は深手を負ってしまったのです
column4:
We mustered our last ounce of strength and
managed to strike the finishing blow, but as a
result, we, the servants, sustained serious
injuries.

column3:
傷つき、動けない我々を残し
ベンジャミン様は一人、行ってしまわれました
目的を達するためには足手まといは不要――
そういうことなのでしょう
column4:
Leaving us wounded and immobilized behind, Master
Benjamin went on alone. To achieve the objective,
we can't have anything slowing us down—perhaps
that was the reason.

column3:
導きを失った私たちは
ただ愚直に、主の帰りを待つことしかできません
最後の魔窟殿へ独りで向かった、傷だらけの主を――
column4:
We, who have lost our guidance, can do nothing
but earnestly await the return of our master. Our
master, who ventured alone to the final demon's
lair, battered and bruised.

column3:
戻られたあの方を暖かく迎えるため
一体何をすべきか、ベンジャミン様と交わした言葉を
思い起こしながら考えてみようと思います
column4:
I will think about what we should do to warmly
welcome them back based on the words exchanged
with Master Benjamin, with the aim of greeting
them upon their return.

column3: "手記と思われる紙の切れ端が落ちている"
column4: "Scraps of a paper note seem to have fallen down."

column3: "塔"とは一体、どこにあるのだろう？
column4: This "Tower" of his, where the heck is it?

column3:
用心深い彼のことだ、たやすく見つかる場所に
あるとは思っていないが――
日記によると、全てをそこに置いてきたのだとか
column4:
He's very cautious, so I don't think he's in a
place
that can be easily found...
According to the diary, he says everything has
been placed there?

column3:
「全て」がすなわち宝を意味するならば
盗賊を警戒して巧妙に隠す意図も理解できる
――物に執着があるとは、少々意外だったが
column4:
If by everyhing he means "treasure",
you can understand his intention to hide it from
any would-be thieves.
...It's still a bit surprising that there is an
obsessed with such
things though.

column3:
とはいえ、彼の足取りを順に追っていけば
いつかは"塔"に辿り着くだろう
column4:
Nevertheless, if we retrace his steps
we will arrive at the tower in due time.

column3:
彼が命尽きる時まで追い求めた宝――
その遺志を継ぎ、形にして納めることで
彼と私、お互いにとって良い弔いになるはずだ
column4:
The treasure that he had chased after until the
time of his death...
By carrying on his will, and shaping it, both he
and I, will have lavish funerals.

column3: "手記と思われる紙の切れ端が落ちている"
column4: "Scraps of a paper note seem to have fallen down."

column3:
魔物を狩り、呪われた宝から
鎧を造りだす時間を除けば
一時も休むことなく進み、彼の痕跡を追っている
column4:
Between hunting demons, and putting aside time to
craft armor from the cursed treasure...
I have no time to take breaks, and must carefully
retrace his steps.

column3:
だが、フィンダムでの無理が祟り
咳は酷くなる一方で、従者どもに心配された
column4:
However, this cursed land of Phindym has given me
an unnatural cough, which has made my pawns
worried.

column3:
いや、正しくは「そう見える」と言うべきか
彼らがまるで人間のような仕草を見せるたび
怖気と虚しさを感じるのだ
column4:
No, I should say they "look like they are".
Everytime they show a gesture or expression like
a human being,
it feels unnerving and empty.

column3:
家族も故郷も失い、救いを求めて心臓を捧げ
得たものがこんな傀儡だったとは――
工作や戦いの腕が優れているとはいえ
当時は愕然としたものだ
column4:
To lose my family and hometown, seeking salvation
and dedicating my heart,
only to receive a puppet such as this...
Although their inherent skill in crafting and
combat are outstanding, at the time,
I was appalled.

column3:
弔いをしてやれるような――
生涯で友と言える相手は、彼くらいだろう
column4:
I'm going to mourn...
The partner that would be known as a friend in
his life, they would not be able to.

column3: "手記と思われる紙の切れ端が落ちている"
column4: "Scraps of a paper note seem to have fallen down."

column3:
従者が時たま、本当に人の心を
持っているのではないかと錯覚するような
表情を見せるようになってきた――
column4: Occasionally, a follower has a truly human heart.

column3:
今までろくに話もしなかったことを後悔しそうだ
身体がひどく弱っているせいで
精神が落ち込みやすくなっているのだろうか
column4:
I'm starting to regret not having spoken much
until now. Could it be that my spirit is easily
downcast because my body is in such a weakened
state?

column3:
心の奥底で、凶暴な衝動が
揺らめくのも感じるのだ
今まで見てきたおぞましい魔物のように
私も変わってしまうのだろうか――
column4:
Deep in my heart, I can feel the flickering of a
violent impulse. Just like the hideous enemies I
have seen before, will I also end up
changing—transforming into something horrifying?

column3:
長く関わりすぎたのだ
大きな力を持つ物は人を強く引きつけるが
それが淀み――侵されていれば、悲劇を呼ぶ
column4:
It is because they possess great power that they
strongly attract people, but if that power
stagnates or is invaded, it will bring tragedy.

column3:
残すは遙かに見える塔のみ
頼もしき従者と共に
どうか、辿り着かせてくれ――竜よ
column4:
All that remains is the tower in the distance.
Please, with my reliable attendants, guide me to
reach it, oh, Dragon.

column3:
押収した小型のナイフ
刃が鈍いため殺傷能力は低いと思われる
柄に文字が刻んであり、B-A-S-I-Tと読める
column4:
Seized small knife.
The blade appears to be dull, so its killing
power is likely low.
The handle has the characters engraved, and it
can be read as B-A-S-I-T.

column3:
メガドのゴロツキリーダーが
自警のため自主的に作成した市民名簿
一般市民だけでなく、闇に生きる
はみ出し者たちまでが網羅されている
本人の超記憶能力と照らし合わせているため
正確性は高いらしい
column4:
Megado's Thug Leader created a citizen register
voluntarily for self-defense.
Not only regular citizens, but also those who
live in the dark, including outcasts, are
included.
Due to their extraordinary memory abilities, the
accuracy of the register is said to be high.

column3:
メガドを縄張りにする子供から聞いた目撃証言
" <NPC 691>は数度にわたって彼らの縄張りに
　踏み込み、覚者たちを尾行するための
　事前調査を行っていた "
という旨の内容
column4:
Approximate eyewitness testimony from a child in
the Megado's territory:
"<NPC 691> trespassed into their territory
several times, conducting preliminary
investigations to tail the Arisen Corps members."

column3:
汚い字でメモが書き込んである
" ＜20時　対象を確認＞
　　場所：メガド居住区侯爵邸前
　　人数：2名
　　報告：ターゲットがレジスタンスと接触
　　　　　隠れ家へ向かうと思われるため
　　　　　引き続き、追跡監視の任務続行 "
以下、同じような記録が淡々と続いている
column4:
The memo is written in messy handwriting.
"<20:00 Target Confirmation>
Location: In front of the Megado Residential
District Marquis Mansion
Number of People: 2
Report: Target has made contact with the
Resistance and is believed to be heading towards
their hideout. The mission of tracking and
surveillance will continue."
Similar records continue in a matter-of-fact
manner.

column3:
憲兵が落とした日々の巡回記録
複数の憲兵により異なる筆跡で書かれているが
どれも書式は共通している
" ＜22時　対象を確認＞
　　場所：メガド居住区東小門前
　　人数：5名
　　報告：通報のあった結社集会の現場を発見
　　　　　構成員は全て市民のため
　　　　　その場で拘束・連行し、任務完了 "
以下、同じような記録が淡々と続いている
column4:
Daily Patrol Records Dropped by the Military
Police.
Written in different handwriting by multiple
military policemen,
but all the formats are the same.
"<22:00 Confirm target>
Location: Megado Residential Area, East Gate
Number of people: 5
Report: Discovered the site of a reported
association gathering
All members are citizens
Arrested and taken into custody on the spot,
mission complete"
Following that, similar records continue in a
steady manner.

column3:
元憲兵の男が、獄中で書いた手記
" 任務で小さなミスを犯し、侯爵の怒りを
　買ったために投獄された "
という内容で、獄中の苦しい状況などが
克明に描写されている
ところどころがシミで汚れており読みづらい
column4:
Memoirs Written by a Former Military Police
Officer in Prison
The handwritten memoirs of a former military
police officer, who was imprisoned after
committing a minor mistake on a mission and
incurring the wrath of a nobleman.
The memoirs vividly depict the harsh conditions
experienced in prison, although some parts are
difficult to read due to stains.

column3:
連絡が途絶えた一人息子を想う父の
愛情が詰まった手作りのお守り
息子を憲兵隊に送り出す際に
渡し損ねたことを悔やむ日々が
傷だらけの表面に現れている
column4:
A handmade amulet filled with a father's love,
yearning for his son who he lost contact with. The
days of regret for not being able to hand it over
when sending his son off to the Military Police
are evident on its scarred surface.

column3:
<NPC 586>と密通していたオークが
持っていた文書
オークの暗号文字で書かれており
読むことはできない
column4:
The document was in the possession of an Orc who
was in secret communication with <NPC 586>.
It is written in Orc code letters and cannot be
read.

column3:
オークの専門家が人語に翻訳してくれた
オーク軍の密通文書
" オーク軍は要請に応え、
　メガドに援軍を手配した "
という旨の内容
column4:
The Orc specialist has translated the
confidential communication documents of the Orc
army into human language.
"Orc Forces responded to the request and arranged
for reinforcements to be sent to Megado."

column3:
オークの被害を受けた少女から聞いた
街に増加するオークについての目撃証言
" 近頃急速に街中で目撃数が増加している
　オークたちは何かを探している様子
　人なのか物なのか、任務なのかは不明 "
という旨の内容で、出没し始めた時期は
<NPC 586>の死亡・オークの尋問開始と
重なっている模様
column4:
From a girl who was affected by the Orcs'
rampage, an eyewitness account about the
increasing number of sightings of Orcs in the
city.
"The number of sightings in the city has been
rapidly increasing lately. The Orcs seem to be
looking for something. Whether it's a person or an
object, or if it's a mission, is unknown."
It seems that their appearance coincides with the
death of <NPC 586> and the start of Orc
interrogations.

column3:
<NPC 681>侯爵が描かれた肖像画
高価な貴族画ではなく
個人が安価に所有できる量産品である
雑な取扱いによる傷みはあるが、
顔かたちは十分に確認できる状態
column4:
Portrait depicting <NPC 681>, a marquis.
Not an expensive aristocratic painting, but a
mass-produced item that individuals can afford.
There may be some damage due to rough handling,
but the facial features are clearly discernible.

column3:
ある兵士から聞いた、メガド占領時に
<NPC 681>が行った英雄的行為の証言
" ナヴィド侯爵は死の危険を冒し、果敢にも
  人間への残虐な仕打ちを止めるよう
  オーク軍と交渉した
  その後も市民の統率者として、オーク側との
  橋渡しを行い、犠牲者を抑える功績を残す "
という旨の内容
column4:
Testimony of the heroic deeds performed by <NPC
681> during the Megado occupation, as told by a
soldier:
"Lord Navido bravely risked his life and daringly
negotiated with the Orc army to put an end to
their cruel treatment of humans. Even after that,
as a leader of the citizens, he acted as a bridge
between the Orc side, leaving behind the
achievement of minimizing casualties."

column3:
侯爵家を出入りしていた戦士が
偶然入手した謎の帳簿
かなり使い込まれているようで
几帳面な字で文字と数字が羅列されている
"オーク"という言葉が頻出している
column4:
A soldier who frequented the Marquis' household
happened to come across a mysterious ledger.
It appears to have been heavily used, with neat
handwriting and a series of characters and numbers
listed.
The word "Orc" is frequently mentioned.

column3:
捕えたオークから尋問によって全てを吐かせた
<NPC 681>とオーク軍の機密についての証言
" メガド陥落は、悲観した<NPC 681>侯爵の
  手引きによって引き起こされた事件であり
  陥落後も彼はオーク軍と取引し
  捕虜の統括に対する報酬を受け取っていた "
という旨の内容となっている
column4:
The capture of <NPC 681> and interrogation of the
orc revealed the following confidential
information:
'Megado's fall was an event instigated through
the guidance of the despairing Marquis <NPC 681>.
Even after the fall, he continued to deal with the
Orc army and received rewards for overseeing the
prisoners.'

column3:
監修ガクシャ・制作セリンで捏造した
オーク軍の手配書
" 人間に寝返った伝令兵を捜索中 "
という旨の内容になっており
尋問で使用すれば
裏切りに対する報復を恐れるオークを
騙すことが出来るかもしれない
column4:
A fabricated wanted poster created by Supervisor
Raksha and produced by Selin,
"Searching for a defected messenger soldier"
It contains a message that may deceive the Orcs,
who fear retaliation for their betrayal, when used
for interrogation.

size.

contributions to the White Dragon Temple.

dark magic, capable of opening a door leading to a
different continent.

core tree.

column3:

do Templo do Dragão Branco.

column3:

異国から渡ったとも、人の手による作ではないとも
いわれている
column4:
Material de Criação Diversos.
Uma corrente de prata adornada com intrincado
artesanato, dizem ter vindo de uma terra estrangeira
ou ser obra de mãos não humanas.

column3:

column3:

column3:

column4:

Um metal que produz um tom bonito quando
atingido.
Manuseie com cuidado.

column3:

column4:

Barro habitado por espíritos.

estourando, sons como vozes podem ser ouvidos.

column3:

Does not activate if your health is low. <COL

column3:

column4:
When an enemy strikes, attacking the part used by
the attack will increase the "Spirit Dragon
Counterattack Gauge". When the gauge is full,
damage to destructible parts is greatly increased.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases bonus
damage.</COL>

column3:
闇炎の状態異常にかかった際に回復までの時間を短縮する

<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に回復までの時間がさらに短縮</COL>
column4:
Shorten the recovery time of Dark Flame
debilitation. The time needed slightly increases
or decreases each time this is triggered. <COL
ffdc78>LV UP Further shortens the recovery
time.</COL>

column3:
敵の＜魔法攻撃力上昇＞に合わせて
魔法攻撃のダメージを無効化するバリアを展開する

column4:

barrier, Strength/Magick/Chance Attack/Exhaust

taken. <COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases the
stat bonus and duration of the barrier.</COL>

Lestania.

『堅き砦となり、わたしを守ってくれ』
『秩序をなくしたこの地を――』
『理の内に押し戻さねば――』
そののちの３００有余年――
白竜はひとり、またひとりと覚者を増やした

column4:

column3:
『たったひとりの人間の野心が世界のありようを

column4: 'Porque a ambição de um homem mudou a forma como o mundo é.'

column4:
When I was a child, there was an epidemic...
But, there was no cure in Phindym.

column4:
Originally, illness was thought of as retribution
or punishment.

column3:
ただ死を待つだけの日々――
人がバタバタと死んでいった
column4:
Just waiting for death every day, people died one
after another.

怯えて死を待つだけの時代に、父が終止符を
打ったのです

In an era where people merely awaited death in
fear, my father put an end to it.

column3:

フィンダムの未来は明るい――そう信じています
column4:
Now, my father is struggling to save the "Core
Tree".
I believe that the future of Phindym is bright -
what I truly believe.

the dragons to become sick?

father...

This person is the Arisen of the White Dragon,

Lestania.

Far beyond, there is the land of Lestania where
the white dragon and its people live.

bond with the White Dragon...

The world is much larger and more diverse
than we can imagine.

Upon becoming an Arisen, they disappeared at the
same time - it's as if they vanished.
Then, when they returned, it was a story of a
foreign land and a new Arisen.

column4:

please show us the proof that will convince us.

Demonstrate your power and its righteousness
through the methods passed down since ancient
times.

I won't stand for my revenge being ruined!

腐った"芯なる樹"とともに
皆、朽ち果ててしまえ！
column4:
With the rotten "Core Tree", everyone, wither
away!

あなたが"芯なる樹"を――

column4:
When our hometown is invaded by the disease,
everyone turned their backs, believing it to be
the order of fate.

column4: Even the dragons did not come to help.

column3:
悲しいが、歯を食いしばるしかなかった
このフィンダムで育てば誰もがそうなる
column4:
It's sad, but we had no choice but to grit our
teeth.
Everyone in Phindym goes through the same.

背を向けた人々が憎くなった
column4:
However, as I watched my suffering parents, I
began to despise those who turned their backs.

column3: 何もしない竜に失望した
column4: I was disappointed in the dragon that did nothing.

Before long, my father lost his sanity—
Leaving behind words cursing the world, he died.

hands.

column4:
Ah...
I implanted toxins into the "Core Tree".

死は理ではないのか？　運命ではなかったのか？

In your efforts to save the "Core Tree," you are
all in a state of confusion.
Is death not part of the order? Was it not meant
to be our destiny?

column3:
わかるぞ？
自分たちの命だけは惜しいんだろう？
column4:
Do you understand?
Are you only concerned about your own lives?

column3:
"理"など方便
身勝手な奴らめ
column4:
"Justice" and such are all just excuses, you
self-centered lot!

column3: ロイグ、レスタニアを思い出して？
フィンダムも、あんなふうになれるかもしれない
column4: Phindym, too, could perhaps become like that.

column3: 無理だね
わたしが全力で阻止するからな！
column4: I will do everything I can to stop you!

column3: ウォーウ、ウォウ、ウォウォウォーウ

魔物と化してもなおわたしを慕う
かわいいケモノたちよ――
column4:
Cute little creatures who still adore me even
when I've become a monster...

column3: さあ行け！

――なぜだ！　どういうことだ！？
黒騎士よ！　どこにいる！
column4:
Why! What is happening!?
Black Knight! Where are you?

column3: 今さらわたしを見捨てるのか！
column4: Are you abandoning me now, of all times!

column3:
ロイグが？
黒い霧に――！！
おい、近づくな！
そこ！　足元に――
《原始の雫》！
まだ希望は消えていない――
これで――フィンダムは救われます！
column4: With this, Phindym will be saved!

column3: 時が来たようだ
column4: It seems the time has come.

column3:
長く閉ざされていた"精霊の地"
芯なる樹の樹内へ通じる聖門を――
column4:
"The Spirit Land" that has long been sealed is a
sacred gate that leads into the inner part of the
"Core Tree"...

column3: その、選ばれし者が解き開く時が来たのだ
column4: The time has come for the chosen one to unlock it.

column3:
選ばれし者、即ち、覚者！
覚者、即ち、セシリー！
column4:
Chosen one, that is, Arisen!
Arisen, that is, Cecily!

column4:
The future of the land, dragons, and humanity is
entrusted to you.

column3:
わたしに――
できるでしょうか
できるとも
おまえには、心強い友がいるではないか
column4: You have a strong friend by your side, don't you?

column3:
精霊竜にも、わたしにもなかったものを
おまえは手に入れたのだ
column4:
You have obtained something that neither the
Spirit Dragon, nor I, have ever had.

column3: 隊長、そしてみなさん――

このフィンダムを救うため
力を貸してください
column4: Please lend us your strength to save Phindym.

column3:
わたしと共に――
この大地に、最後の希望を灯すために――
column4:
With me—
To kindle the final hope in this land—

column3: どうか、よろしくお願いします

フィンダムは毒に侵され――
病に倒れかけた大地だった
column4:
Phindym was poisoned, the land on the verge of
falling ill.

column3:
レスタニアから渡った覚者たちは
フィンダムの覚者を助け、戦い――
column4:
Arisen who ventured from Lestania came to fight
alongside Arisen of Phindym.

column3: ついに、大地を癒やす手段を手に入れた
column4: Finally, they obtained a means to heal the land.

column3: そしてフィンダムの未来を託されし覚者――
column4:
And thus, the Arisen entrusted with the future of
Phindym—

column3:
セシリーは《原始の雫》について学び
やがて来る、治療の時を待った
column4:
Cecily learned about the "Primeval Drops" and
waited for the moment of healing to come.

column3:
我々が"精霊の地"と呼んでいるこの先の
土地について説明しておこう
column4:
Let me describe the land beyond, that we call
"The Spirit Land".

column3:
"精霊の地"とは芯なる樹へと続く、樹層一帯
自由に出入りできるのは竜だけだ
column4:
The "Spirit Land" is the area around the
surrounding the Core Tree, which extends to the
canopy.
Only dragons can enter and leave freely.

column3:
我々が出入りするあの門も
普段は、固く閉じてある
column4:
That gate where we enter and exit is usually
tightly sealed.

column3: 知っての通り――

芯なる樹は、いまやフィンダム全域に
毒素を送り出す病巣――
column4:
The Core Tree has become an infected hive that
sends toxins throughout Phindym.

column3:
治療のためには樹の中心まで
行かねばならない
column4:
In order to cure it, we must go to the center of
the Tree.

column3:
毒によって侵された根は
この《原始の雫》で浄化できるだろう
column4:
The roots that have been infested with poison can
be purified with these "Primeval Drops."

column3:
おそらく樹内は
魔物の巣窟となっているはず――
column4: Perhaps the tree is a nest of monsters.

column3:
隊長、あなたは先行して魔物を排除し
樹の中心を目指して欲しい
column4:
Captain, I want you to go ahead and eliminate the
enemies and head for the center of the Tree.

column3: 道中の安全を確保する大切な役割ですね
column4:
Ensuring safety along the way is an important
role.

column3: 掃除かあ、嫌いなんだけどなあ

わたしも、後を追い
樹内での手助けをいたそう
column4: I'll follow after and assist you inside the tree.

column3:
《原始の雫》 が手に入ることは二度とない
頼り続けで心苦しいが、よろしく頼む
column4:
We may never get another chance to obtain the
"Primeval Drops."
I'm sorry I keep asking you for help, but I'm
counting on you.

column3: 精霊竜ウィルミアだ

竜はもう、かつての竜ではない
残念ながら――
column4:
The Dragon isn't what it used to be...
Unfortunately--

column3: 我々は間に合わなかったのだ
column4: We didn't make it in time.

column3: 覚者よ、白竜の覚者よ
column4: Oh, Arisen, Arisen of the White Dragon.

column3: 頼もしくなりましたね
column4: You have become reliable, haven't you?

column3: 精霊竜の継承、大変にごくろうさまでした
column4:
Thank you very much for your hard work in
inheriting the Spirit Dragon.

column3:
精霊竜が、竜としての理を取り戻したことで
レスタニアの危機は回避されました
column4:
The Spirit Dragon, regaining its draconic
essence, averted the crisis in Lestania.

column3:
しかし、白竜がまだ回復の途上にあることを
思うと――油断は禁物です
column4:
However, I think that the White Dragon is still
in the process of recovering - you can never let
your guard down!

column3:
世界は五大竜と呼ばれる竜たちによって
守られています
column4:
The world is protected by the dragons known as
the Five Great Dragons.

column3: 白竜、精霊竜、そして黒竜――
column4:
The White Dragon, the Spirit Dragon, and the
Black Dragon...

column3:
黒き竜の、闇で蠢く思惑の断片に
あなたも、触れたはずです
column4:
You, too, must have been touched by the fragments
of the black dragon's thoughts stirring in the
darkness.

column3:
残りの二竜も
ほどなく、あなたは知ることになるでしょう
column4:
The remaining two dragons will also soon become
known to you.

column3: レスタニアの、本当の危機はこれからです
column4: The true crisis of Lestania is yet to come.

column3:
強くなりなさい
そう、レオのように――
交わることを禁じられた大陸が――
column4: The continents that were forbidden to intersect...

column3: ――異なる竜の大陸がレスタニアで交差した
column4:
...the continents of different dragons
intersected in Lestania.

column3: 竜たちですら気づいていなかったが――
column4: Even the dragons didn't realize it, but--

column3:
世界は、その瞬間、理という鋳型から
取り出されたのだ
column4:
The world was taken out of the mold of reason at
that moment.

column3:
はて――それはいったい誰の仕業だろうか
何を望んだ結果なのだろうか
column4:
Huh... who could have done such a thing?
And what did they want to achieve?

column3:
時にレスタニア歴、３２４年
竜の理を解く、物語は動きだした
column4:
In the year 324 of the Lestania Era, the tale of
unraveling the dragon's order began to unfold.

column3: 見て、あそこ！　空に黒い渦ができてる！
column4:
Look, over there! A black vortex is forming in
the sky!

column3:
何かが――ああ、大地の竜力が
吸い上げられているようです！
column4:
Something... oh, the very Dragon Force of the
land seems to be being drained!

column3: おいおいおい！
急いでガラダの元へ向かうぞ！
column4: Hurry, let's head to Gearóid's location!

column3: 敵襲！　戦闘態勢！
みんな、こっちだ！
おい、時間を稼ぐぞ！

やはり以前より状況は悪化しているようだ
魔物がより凶暴になっている
column4:
The situation is getting worse than before.
The monsters seem even more ferocious.

column3: この森のどこかに、礎があるはずなんだ
column4:
There should be a portcrystal somewhere in this
forest.

column3:
レスタニアの礎と同じ力を持つものだ
手分けして探そう
column4:
They possess the same power as that of the
Portcrystal of Lestania.
Let's split up and search.

column3: あれ、礎じゃない？
column4: Oh, is that not a Portcrystal?

column3: これこれ、いつもの、この感じ！
column4: This is it, the usual, this feeling!

column3: リムを使って行き来できるってことだよね？
column4:
Using Rift Crystals allows us to travel back and
forth, right?

column3: 隊長、あそこに入り口が！
column4: Captain, there's an entrance over there!

column3:
セシリー！？
ああ、無事で良かった！
column4:
Cecily!?
Ah, I'm glad you're safe!

column3: どこにいたんだ！？
心配かけてごめんなさい

――お父さんはどこですか？
ロイグは戻ってる？
column4:
Where is your father?
Is Loeg back?

column3: ロイグの行方はわからないが――
column4: We don't know Loeg's whereabouts, but――

column3:
ガラダは"芯なる樹"の治療薬、《原始の雫》を求め
三人の戦士とともに、魔の峡谷へと旅立った
column4:
Gearóid and three soldiers set out for the demons
canyon in search of the "Primeval Drop", the cure
for the "Core Tree".

column3: たった四人で！？
わたしも行かなくちゃ！
気持ちはわかるぞ、セシリー
column4: I understand how you feel, Cecily.

column3:
だが、ガラダに同行したのは屈強の戦士たち
もう少し、信頼してやれ
column4:
But the soldiers who accompanied Gearóid are
strong and reliable.
Trust them a bit more.

column4:
From what I can see, it seems like your companion
is also tired, Ser.

column3:
故郷を素通りさせてしまってはガラダに
会わせる顔がない
column4:
I can't face letting Gearóid
see me if I let her pass by my hometown unnoticed.

column3:
わたし――
ここからの眺めが、大好きなんです
column4:
This view from here...
I just love it.

column3:
夜明け前、朝、雨の日、夕方、月明かりの夜――
色々な姿を見せてくれます
column4:
Before dawn, in the morning, on a rainy day, in
the evening, on a moonlit night...
The view changes to show many forms.

覚者に選ばれた時
誇らしくもあったけど、本当は不安でした
column4:
When I was chosen to be Arisen, I felt proud, but
really anxious.

column3:
託された期待や希望に応えられるのかな？
もう――押し潰されそうでした
column4:
Would I be able to live up to the expectations
and hopes entrusted to me?
I was already--I was about to be crushed.

column3: でも、レスタニアであなたたちと過ごすうちに――
column4:
But, while spending time with all of you in
Lestania...

覚者の生き方が
ひとつじゃないことを知りました
column4:
I realized that being Arisen doesn't mean having
just one way of life.

column3:
みんなが、それぞれの大切なものを守るため
がんばって、歩いている
column4:
Everyone is doing their best to protect what is
important to each of us.

column3: しっかり、一歩、一歩
わたしも、それでいいんだって
column4: I realized, that's enough for me.

わたし
もう迷いません
大地が侵食されたせいなのか――
column4: Is it because the land has been corrupted...

column4:
There are a lot of hostile creatures around here,
aren't there?

column4: Ah, it felt like that earlier too.

あれ！
やばくない！？
あれがダナ村に突っ込んだら――
column4: If that thing charges into Dana Village—

column4: It will be a huge disaster!!

column3:
おい、隊長とダナ村に連絡だ！
それとセシリーの親父さんにもな
column4:
Hey, contact the captain and Dana Village!
Also, let Cecily's father know!

隊長ぉ――！　こっち！
暴走が始まりやがった
column4: It's starting to go out of control.

column3:
リズ、エリオット！
雑魚は俺たちで相手するぞ
column4:
Lise, Elliot!
We'll take care of the weaker enemies.

column4: Captain, take care of that one!

column3: え？　ええっ！？
し、死んでますよ、大勢死んでます

column4:
Which battlefield? Everything is already over,
isn't it?

column3: オーク戦争に逆戻り！？

落ち着こう
わたしたち、オークならお手のもの
column4:
Calm down.
We can handle the Orcs.

column4: From over there, too!　The numbers are growing!

column3: おい隊長、指示はねえのか！
column4: Hey, Captain, what are the orders?!

column3: こっち
だ、だれ！？
今、重要？　死にたい？
column4: Is it important right now? Do you want to die?

column3: どこへ行くの？
いいから走って！
ここで迎撃！
ふんっ（リアクションボイス）
よし！（リアクションボイス）
ふぅ――（リアクションボイス）
うまくいったみたい
column4: It seems to have gone well.

わたしはジリアン
ジリアン、急げ！
見つかれば次はない！
column4: If found, there will be no next time!

付いてきて

おい、そろそろ教えろ
ここはどこだ？　どこへ行く？
column4:
Hey, it's about time you told me.
Where are we?　Where are we going?

column3: 質問されるのって、うれしいものだね
column4: Being asked a question is a happy thing.

column3: 最近は、誰も――何も訊いてくれない
column4: Recently, no one - no one asks anything anymore.

column3:
答えを知っても、この世の中が
変わるわけじゃないから――
column4: Knowing the answer won't change the world, so...

column3: 顔を上げて、前を見つめる力を――
column4: The power to lift one's head and gaze ahead――

column3: あの山で燃える炎が焼き尽くしてしまったんだ
column4:
The flames that burned on that mountain have
completely consumed it.

column3: これで信じてもらえた？
全員が覚者だってことだけは信じてもいい
column4: It's fine to believe that everyone is an Arisen.

column3:
じゃあ、次はこっちの番
この世界のこと、教えてくれる？
column4:
Okay, now it's our turn.
Can you tell me about this world?

column3:
ここはアッカーシェラン大陸
火竜様とアッカー王家が統べる地――
column4:
This is the continent of Acre Selund, where the
Fire Dragon and the Acre Royal Family reign...

column3: なぜオークと戦っている？　戦争か？
column4: Why fight against the Orcs? Is it a war?

column3:
戦争――
いや、もっと一方的だ、狩りに近い
column4:
War...
No, it's more one-sided, like a hunt.

column3: ある日突然黒き竜が現れ、火竜様に襲いかかった
column4:
One day, a black dragon suddenly appeared and
attacked the Fire Dragon.

column3:
覚者だったクレス女王は火竜様となって
まだ間もなく――
column4:
Queen Cress, previously an Arisen, took on the
form of the Fire Dragon and, not long after...

column4:
In no time, the battle was settled, and the Fire

column3: 代わりに悪しき竜が生まれた

鋼で武装したオーク達により
王国は蹂躙された
column4: The kingdom was ravaged by Orcs, armed with steel.

column3:
人々は、生きのびても
もう希望はないと思っている――
column4:
Even if some of the people survive, they feel
that there's no hope left.

column4: Despair is what covers this land.

俺たちにできることが何かあるかもしれません
column4:
Captain, why don't we go back to Lestania and
discuss this?
Maybe there is something we can do.

column3: 残念だが――
それは出来ない
なに！？

悪しき竜は、レスタニアにも現れ
あなたたちをここへ連れてきた――
column4:
The evil dragon also appeared in Lestania and
brought you all here--

column3:
もしかして疑ってる？
わたしたちが悪しき竜に送り込まれたとか？
column4:
Do you suspect that we were sent by The Evil
Dragon?

column3: うん

人質を残せば、帰還を認めよう
column4:
Well then.

return.

俺が――残ります

隊長、行ってください
神殿の様子も気になりますよね？
column4:
Captain, please go ahead. You're also wondering
about the situation at the Temple, right?

column3: 俺なら大丈夫ですから

覚者が大勢いるということは
ひとりひとりの価値は下がるよね
column4:
The fact that there are so many Arisen means that
each one is worth less.

column3: そんなことはないけど――何が言いたいの？
column4: I don't think so, but - what's your point?

column4: That captain, he might abandon you, you know?

column3: それはない
即答なんだ
俺は隊長を知ってるからね

他人への期待や信頼は自分を傷つけるよ
深く、深くね
column4:
Your expectations and trust in others will hurt
you deeply.

column3: ――何があったの？
ジリアン、朗報だ

オークどもに捕まった仲間の居場所を突き止めた！
どうする！？
column4:
We have located our friends who were captured by
the orcs!
What are we going to do?!

column3:
どうするって、決まってるでしょ
部隊の人選は任せて
column4:
What are you going to do? It's obvious.
I'll pick out the guys for the unit.

column3: 隊長！
わたしたちも行く
ま、その代わり、そいつは返してもらうぜ
column4:
Well, in exchange, I'm going to ask you to give
it back.

column3: 分かった――
あれ？　意外とあっさり
勘違いしないで

あなたたちを残しておきたくないだけ
column4:
There are non-combatants here, so I just don't
want to leave you all behind.

俺たち、やりましたね！
column4:
Captain, the one we just faced is the last enemy
soldier!
We did it!

column4: Thanks to that, my comrades are safe.

解放されたからと言って未来があるわけじゃないもの
column4:
Just because we're liberated, it doesn't mean
there's a future.

column3:
敵の増援が来るかもしれないから
あなたたち、よく見ていてね
column4:
Enemy reinforcements may be on the way.
You guys keep a close watch.

column3: ジリアン！？
ケガをしている人は、治療を受けて
column4: Anyone who's injured, get treated immediately.

column3: すぐに移動するからね、それまで休んでおいて
column4: We'll be moving soon, so rest until then.

column3: ここにはいない――か――
column4: He's not here... or... is he?

column3: 誰か探してるのか？

column4: What I'm looking for is hope...

column4:
Enemy troops, they're coming! Tanks are coming
too!

ダメだ、みんな疲れ切っている
急いで引き上げよう
column4:
It's not good, we're all exhausted.
Let's hurry up and pull out.

column4: Gahaha! Are there no more humans here?

column3: オークの声だ――気をつけて
column4: It's the voice of the orcs... be careful.

column3: 火竜が死んでから、ヒトはフヌケ
column4:
Ever since the Fire Dragon died, people became
complacent.

column3: 死ぬまで使うだけ
ヒトどもは感謝――
グワッ！（リアクションボイス）
将軍！

偽りの竜の手先となったオークども！
荒野の覇者の誇りはどうした
column4:
Orcs are pawns of a false dragon!
Where is the pride of the champion of the
wilderness?

column3: 焚き火にくべて燃やしてしまったか！
column4: Did you burn it in the bonfire!?

column3: キサマァ！
ヒトの分際で――
メイロワ将軍だ、加勢する
column4: I am General Meirova, I will assist you.

column3: ふぅ、全て片付いたな
column4: Phew, everything is taken care of.

column3: 無事で良かった
そちらの屈強な戦士たちは――
はじめましてメイロワ将軍、俺たちは――
column4: Nice to meet you, General Meirova. We are--

column3: ほう――

おぬしたちが、なぜ悪しき竜により
この地へ招かれたのか
column4:
Why were you invited to this land by the evil
dragon?

column3: その真意を探りたいというわけか
column4: So you want to know the truth behind it, huh?

column3: あんたは事の目撃者だって聞いている
column4: I'm told you're a witness to this.

column3:
――親愛なる女王陛下が竜力を継承し
火竜様となってほどなく、あの黒い竜が現れた
column4:
—Shortly after our beloved Queen inherited the
dragon's power and became the Fire Dragon, that
black dragon appeared.

column3:
竜となって間もない火竜様は
反撃も空しく、倒れてしまった
column4:
The Fire Dragon, who had only recently become a
dragon, was powerless to counterattack and fell.

column3:
あたりは暗い闇に包まれ
やがてその闇が消え去ると――
column4:
The area was shrouded in dark shadows,
and then, when the darkness faded away—

column3: そこにはあの悪しき竜がいた

火竜様はおろか黒い竜の姿さえ
どこにもない
column4:
There is no sign of the Fire Dragon, let alone a
black dragon.

column3:
わしは、悪しき竜は火竜様の血肉によって
作られたと信じている
column4:
I believe that the Evil Dragon was created
through the flesh and blood of the Fire Dragon.

column3:
悪しき竜がこの人たちを連れてきた理由は？
心当たりはないの？
column4:
Why did the Evil Dragon bring these people here?
Do you have any idea?

column3:
竜の心などわしにはわからん
それより、王子の行方は？
column4:
I don't understand the heart of a dragon.
But more importantly, where is the prince?

column3: 何か報せはないのか？
王子様がいるの？
火竜様であったクレス女王の御一子ネド王子
column4:
Prince Nedo, the only son of Queen Cress, who was
once the Fire Dragon.

column3: 当年１２歳
column4: He was 12 years old at the time.

column3: 混乱する城下ではぐれてそれっきりだが――
column4:
They got separated in the chaotic castle town and
that was the end of it...

column3: ネド様はわしらの希望だ

おお、来たか
ここが城壁の村ロスギルだ
column4:
Oh, you have come.
This is the village of Rothgill, surrounded by
castle walls.

column3:
世話人にして領主のイェルハルドは
長く王家とともに歩んだ地方豪族
column4:
Lord Gerhard, who has been a steward to the local
nobleman, has been a faithful companion to the
royal family for a long time.

column3:
悪い人間ではないが、猜疑心強く
加えて偏屈な頑固者
column4: Not a bad person, but a suspicious and stubborn.

column3:
何かと面倒な男だからうまく扱わないと
話が進まんから――
column4:
He's a pain in the ass, and if you don't handle
him well,
you're not going to get the story...

column3: （咳払い）
メイロワ将軍、遠路はるばる良くいらっしゃいました
column4:
General Meirova, thank you for coming all the way
here.

column3:
おお、イェルハルド！
さあ、中へ入れてくれ！　開門だ！
column4:
Oh, Gerhard!
Now, let me inside! Open the gate!

column3:
旧知のあなたのために門を開くのは
やぶさかでありませんが、はて、その用向きは？
column4:
I would be happy to open the gate for you, my old
friend, but what is the purpose?

column3:
ひとつはネド王子の行方――
盗賊と行動を共にしているとの情報を得た
column4:
One matter is the whereabouts of Prince Nedo...
We have information that he joined the bandits.

column3:
もうひとつはジリアン――
昨日から盗賊の地を目指し、単独行動をとっておる
column4:
The other is Gillian...
She has been on her own since yesterday, heading
for the land of the bandits.

column3:
盗賊が隠れ住む西方のことは
おまえさんたちの方が詳しかろう
column4:
You guys know more about the west where the
bandits hide than I do.

column3:
となればイェルハルド
ここはおまえさんに頭を下げて力を借りるのが得策
column4:
Then Gerhard, we would be wise to bow down to you
and ask for your help.

column3: 得策――たとえ思っても口にしないものですよ
column4:
Prudent... even if you think it, it's something
you don't say aloud.

column3:
しかしまあ、事情はわかりました
そういうことであればさっそく開門――
column4:
Well, I understand the situation.
In that case, I'll get on opening the gates right
away...

column3:
と、したいところですが、実はここよりそう遠くない
場所に、魔物の巣窟ができてしまいましてな
column4:
Well, I would like to do that but the truth is,
not far from here, a den of monsters has appeared.

column3:
開門すれば魔物どもまで入り込んでくるのではと
戦々恐々としているのです
column4:
I'm afraid that if we open the gate, the monsters
will push their way inside.

column3: 回りくどい――回りくどいぞイェルハルド！
魔物を倒せというのだな！
column4: Just defeat the monsters, is that it!?

column3:
そうは申しませんが、倒して頂ければ
中にお招きして、熱いお茶でもお出ししましょう
column4:
I wouldn't say that, but if you defeat them, I
will invite you in and offer you a hot cup of tea.

column3: 待っておれ！
ネド王子！　よくぞご無事で
column4: Prince Nedo! I'm glad you're safe

column3: イェルハルド殿、ひさしいですね
column4: Lord Gerhard, it's been a while.

column3: はっ
辺境暮らしとはいえ、長き無沙汰をお許し下さい
column4:
Although I live in the frontier, please forgive
me for my long absence.

column3:
気にしないでください
あなたの忠信、城にも届いていました
column4:
Please don't worry.
Your loyalty has reached the castle as well.

column3:
積もる話もあるだろうが
どうだイェルハルド、こうして王子も戻られた
column4:
There must be a lot to catch up on, but how about
it, Gerhard? The prince has returned.

column3: 一緒に戦ってくれるな？
申し上げにくいのですが――
column4: I'm sorry to say this, but--

column3: 王子は、すでに覚者でいらっしゃいますか？
column4: Has the prince already become an Arisen?

column3:
王子は立派な覚者だ
正統なる王家の跡取りにして、竜の器！
column4:
The prince is a fine Arisen.
Rightful heir to the royal family and vessel of
the dragon!

column3: では、王家の秘蹟を見せて頂きたい
column4:
Then, I would like to see The Royal Family
Sacrament.

column3: 疑うのか！

王子をお慕いする心情があるからこそ
民にも証を示す必要があるのです――
column4:
It is precisely because of our deep affection for
the prince that we must show proof to the people—

column3:
我らにない力を持つからこそ
民は王子を慕い命さえも捧げます
column4:
It is precisely because he possesses powers that
we do not, that the people revere the prince and
would even lay down their lives for him.

column3:
わかりました
何をしましょうか？
癒しの泉を復活させて頂きたい
column4: I wish to restore the Spring of Healing.

column3: それはどうやれば――
ああ、それも僕が考えるわけか
column4: Ah, so I am the one who will come up with a plan.

column3:
いいか、ロスギルの湖畔を南へと下り
険しき岩肌を抜けたその先に――
column4:
Listen, just south down the shores of Lake
Rothgill through a steep rock face, at the end of
which...

column3:
この地を終焉に導いた忌々しき戦車が
繋がれている
column4:
This cursed tank is chained up, the one that
drove this land to its doom.

column3: 魔軍戦車カトブレパス――
column4: The demonic war machine called Catoblepas...

column3:
ヤツは死肉をたらふく食らうまでは動かねえが
ひとたび動き出せば、大地は絶望と惨劇に包まれる
column4:
He will not move until he has had his fill of
dead flesh.
Once he moves, the land will be enveloped in
despair and misery.

column3: まさに魔軍の持つ最強の兵器だ
column4:
Truly, it is the strongest weapon possessed by
the demon army.

column3: 初めに言っておくがひとりで挑むにはあまりに無謀
column4:
Let me say this from the start: it is far too
reckless to challenge this alone.

column3:
それでもと言うなら、僅かながら
解放軍も協力させてもらおう
column4:
If you still insist, let's try to get some help
from the Liberation Army.

column3: なるほど――
この場所なら奇襲にうってつけですね
column4: This location is perfect for a surprise attack.

column3: おい、リズ

戻って、戦力になりそうなのを連れて来い
少数精鋭たって、この人数じゃあな
column4:
Go back and bring me some guys who might be able
to help.
Even if we're the elite few, we're still a small
group.

column3: 了解！　って、ちょっと待った！
ほら見て！　もう来てる！
どうしましょう！？

仕方ねえ――
隊長、やるんだろ？
column4:
Well, there's no going back now, is there,
Captain?

column3: ふう
奇襲作戦成功ですね
皆さん、静かに！
どうした？
悪しき竜が――来ます
え！？　隠れなきゃ！
王子、こっち！
王子！
王子よ――
おまえなど取るに足りん――
column4: You're not even worth my time.

column3:
悪しき竜よ
その言葉――そっくりお返ししましょう
column4:
Evil Dragon...
I shall return those words to you in full.

column3: それがおまえの最後の言葉かぁ！
ウクククク――（漏れる笑い）
レスタニアの覚者よ――
あがけ
もぉがけぇ！
だが結末は動かん――
column4: But the outcome will not change――

column3:
この絶望の大陸を――
せいぜい楽しむがいい！
column4:
Enjoy this Land of Despair to your heart's
content!

column3: そろそろ撤退しよう
砦には攻め込まないの？
column4: You're not going to attack the fort?

column3: あわよくばやるって言ってたよね
column4: You said you'd do it if the chance arose, right?

column3:
あれは意気込み
現実じゃ、落としても維持できないもの
column4:
That is mere fervor. In reality, it's something
you can't maintain even if you manage to seize it.

column3:
途中で断念したと思わせて
再度攻撃をしかけた方が陽動は効果的
column4:
It is more effective to make them think you have
given up halfway and then attack again as a
diversion.

column3: なるほど～

ここはもういいから
あなたたちは奇襲部隊に参加して
column4:
We're good here.
You guys can join the ambush unit.

column3:
ジリアンは残るの？
次はもっといっぱいオークが来るんじゃない？
column4:
Will Gillian stay?
Won't more Orcs come next time?

column3: それが目的だから、望むところだよ
column4: That's exactly my objective; it's what I desire.

column3:
やっと着いたよ――
ほら、あれが――
column4:
Finally, we're here.
Hey, look, over there...

column3: 王都メガド――
わあーー（リアクションボイス）
わーー（リアクションボイス）
ほおーー（リアクションボイス）
で？　メガドは今、どんな状態なんだ？
column4: So, what's the current situation in Megado?

column3:
敵の本拠地になっている――
それ以上は分からない
column4:
It has become the enemy's stronghold ――
I don't know anything more than that.

column3:
わたしの父もメガドの防衛部隊だった――
真っ先に逃げたみたいだけれどね
column4:
My father was also a member of Megado's defense
force ――
It seems he was one of the first to flee.

column3:
そうなんだ――
お父さんには会えてないの？
column4:
I see--
You haven't seen your father?

column3:
父は逃げた――
それ以上の興味なんてない――
column4:
My father ran away--
I'm not interested in anything more than that--

column3: もしやネド王子！
王子、よくぞご無事で
column4: Prince Nedo! I'm glad you're safe.

column3: 彼らはメガドの守護兵です
column4: They are the guardians of Megado.

column3: どうか顔をあげてください

僕を逃がすために戦ってくれた
あなたたちの勇姿はけっして忘れません
column4:
I will never forget the bravery of those who
fought to set me free!

column3:
なんとありがたいお言葉
亡き同僚たちにも聞かせてやりたかった――
column4:
What kind words!
I wish my fallen comrades could hear them.

column3:
メガド陥落後――なんとか神殿だけはと
粉骨砕身して参りましたが
column4:
After the fall of Megado...
I somehow made it to the temple.

column3:
オークと異なる、恐ろしき者が現れ
一同は総崩れに――
column4:
A ferocious one appeared, different from the
orcs,
and we all scattered in fear...

column3: 恐ろしき者――とは？
真っ黒な鎧に身を包んだ恐ろしい騎士です
column4: A fearsome knight dressed in pitch-black armor.

column3: あん！？　真っ黒な鎧だあ？

黒い鎧は珍しくもないでしょうけど
ひとりで戦況を変えるほどの騎士は――
column4:
Black armor is not uncommon, but a knight capable
of changing the course of a battle by himself
is...

column3:
あの、フィンダムを乱した黒騎士ってこと？
闇に送り返したのに？
column4:
Is that the Black Knight who disrupted Phindym?
Wasn't he sent back into the darkness?

column3:
本格的に俺たちの出番になりそうだな――
なあ隊長
column4:
Looks like we're in for a real treat...
Hey captain!

column3: 時に、そこにいるのはジリアンか？
column4: At times, is Gillian present there?

column3:
父上は我々をここへ寄越すために戦い、散った
誠に立派な最期であった
column4:
Father fought and died to bring us here, and it
was a truly honorable end.

column3: 辛い報せだが――伝えておこう――
column4:
I know this is hard news, but I'm here to tell
you...

column3: ほう、ウワサは本当だったか
column4: Oh, so the rumors were true.

column3:
キサマがここへ来たといこうコトは
王子はこの先だというアカシ！
column4:
Your coming here is proof that the prince is
ahead!

column3:
王子の前に、まずはキサマから
なぶり殺してくれるわ！
column4:
Before the prince, I'll make sure to beat you to
a pulp first!

column3: 見ろ！　墓所の入り口が秘蹟で開かれている！
column4:
Look! The entrance to the graveyard is opened by
mysterious power!

column3: 王子が通ったのだ
仮に――

王子がひとりで竜と会って
笛を吹いて力を継承したとする
column4:
Imagine the prince meeting the dragon alone and
played the flute to inherit its power.

column3:
すると、どうなる？
悪しき竜の姿をした魔物は残るんだよね？
column4:
Then what happens?
The enemy in the form of the Evil Dragon will
remain, right?

column3: 魔物は王子を襲うだろうな
column4: The enemy will surely attack the prince.

column3:
竜の力を継承したばかりで
王子は勝てるのか？
column4:
After the Prince inherited the Dragon Force,
won't he be able to win?

column3: そう、それ！

王子はすぐに竜になって
敵を倒せると思い込んでいるやも知れぬ――
column4:
The prince might think that as soon as he obtains
the Dragon Force, he will be able to defeat the
enemies.

column3:
故に皆を巻きこまず
ひとりで戦おうと覚悟してしまったのか――
column4:
He may have decided to face the enemy alone and
fight without involving others.

column3: そう――なのかな？

んなこたあ、王子の首根っこをひっつかんで
聞き出せばいいだろが！　ほら、行くぞ！
column4:
We just need to grab the prince by the scruff of
the neck and interrogate him! Come on, let's go!

column3: あっ、隊長！

ケッ、なんてことだ
――おまえが救世主に見えるぜ
column4:
H-hey, what the hell...
You do look like a Savior, though.

column3: この先にいるんですよ手強いのが――
column4: There's a formidable one up ahead...

column3:
実はね、わたしたちじゃあ
手も足も出なくて隊長を待っていたの
column4:
Actually, to tell you the truth, we were all
waiting for the Captain, and we couldn't do much
ourselves.

column3:
不甲斐ない我が身を嘆いていても仕方がない
この一戦、あなたに託すよ
column4:
There's no point in lamenting my unworthiness.
I'll leave this one to you.

column3: やった！
うわっ！！（リアクションボイス）
エリオット！
んっ――うっ――（リアクションボイス）

俺はいいから
早くネド王子のところ――
column4:
It's fine with me.
Let's go to meet Prince Nedo right away.

column3: 放ってはおけない

俺はね、こういう時が来たら潔く諦めようと
常々思っていたんだ
column4:
I, uh... I always thought that when a time like
this comes, I should surrender gracefully.

column3: そういうの、似合わないよ
――あはは――厳しいね
隊長、エリオットは私たちが運ぶから
ああ、隊長は俺たちの後ろを頼むぜ
column4: Yeah, the captain's got our backs.

column3: 今日、私たちはついに、この地まで敵を追い込んだ
column4:
Today, we have finally cornered the enemy to this
land.

column3: さあ、みんな！
絶望の雲を打ち払って希望の光を取り戻そう
column4:
Let's strike away the clouds of despair and
reclaim the light of hope.

column3: 全隊、突撃せよ！

アッカー家の方々は優れた王そして覚者であり
素晴らしい竜となられました
column4:
Os membros da Família Real Acre têm sido
excelentes reis e Arisen e, portanto, se tornaram
grandes dragões!

column3:
しかし、全ての方がそうであったわけではないのです
中には力に呑まれ、異形と堕ちた存在も――
column4:
Mas nem todos foram iguais.
Entre eles, também houve alguns que foram
devorados pelo poder e transformados em seres estranhos,
que então caíram na depravação.

column3:
忌むべき異形は常に正しき竜によって
封じられ、その存在を知るのはごく限られた者のみ
column4:
Essas abominações repulsivas foram seladas pelo
Dragão justo, e apenas um pequeno número de
pessoas estão cientes de sua existência.

column3: しかし、今は彼の存在を封じる竜が不在
column4:
No entanto, não há dragão para selar sua existência
agora.

column3:
さらに悪しき竜の干渉により、その力が不安定に
なっているという報告も入ってきております
column4:
Também recebemos relatos de que a interferência
do dragão maligno desestabilizou seu poder.

column3:
この地を――
そしてアッカー王家の威信を守るため
column4:
Para proteger esta terra—
E para defender a honra da família real Acre.

column3:
何としても彼の存在を
表に出すわけにはいかないのです
column4:
Não importa o que aconteça, sua existência não pode ser revelada
ao público.

column3: 今日、私たちはついに、この地まで敵を追い込んだ
column4: Hoje, finalmente encurralamos o inimigo nesta terra.

column3: さあ、みんな！
絶望の雲を打ち払って希望の光を取り戻そう
column4:
Vamos afastar as nuvens de desespero e recuperar
a luz da esperança.

column3: 全隊、突撃せよ！
よう、砦はどうだった？
column4: E aí, como foi a fortaleza?

column3:
まあ、レオたちも戻っているわけだから
なんとかなったんだろうな
column4:
Bem, Leo e os outros voltaram, então
algo deve ter dado certo.

column3: さて――俺の名はファビオだ

ここに立って、初陣を生きのびた覚者に
声をかけている
column4:
Parado aqui, chamando o Arisen que
sobreviveu à sua primeira batalha.

column3: ほら、あそこ――白竜が眠る《謁見の間》だ
column4:
Olhe, ali—a Sala de Audiência onde o
Dragão Branco dorme.

column3:
外から戻ったらまずあそこへ
顔を出した方がいい
column4:
Ao retornar de outro lugar, seria sensato
primeiro fazer uma aparição lá.

column3: 行かなくてもいいが、行った方がいいぞ
column4: Você não precisa ir, mas é melhor se for.

column3:
《謁見の間》の雰囲気は独特だからな
時々行っておかないと顔を出しづらくなる
column4:
A Sala de Audiência tem uma atmosfera única, então
é fácil se sentir desconfortável se você não for
lá de vez em quando.

column3: ――この俺みたいによ

じゃあ、行ってこい
また、あとでな
