column3:
では、俺はすぐにでも出発する
攻撃部隊はアークで合流しよう
column4:
Então, eu partirei imediatamente. A força de ataque
se reunirá na Arca.

column3:
くそっ――
このゲルト、一生の不覚
column4:
Droga—
Essa falha me assombrará por toda a vida, Gerd.

column3: ――申し開きのしようがない

貴殿らの留守中
下に魔物どもが侵入してな
column4: Enquanto vocês estavam fora, monstros invadiram por baixo.

column3:
すぐに撃退したのだが
空をまたアークが横切ったのだ
column4:
Nós os repelimos rapidamente, mas outra Arca cruzou
o céu.

column3:
第三のアークが、この上を飛んで行った
その間に、あの女がぬけぬけと――
column4:
A terceira Arca voou sobre este lugar e, durante
esse tempo, aquela mulher, sem se importar com nada no
mundo――

column3:
ゲルト、おまえの責任ではない
魔物と新アークの飛来で混乱の中
column4:
Gerd, não é sua culpa. É o caos causado pela
chegada de monstros e da nova Arca.

column3:
見知った顔との再会にミシアルも
油断したのだろう
column4:
Mysial deve ter baixado a guarda quando ela
se reencontrou com um rosto familiar.

column3: ジョゼフさま！　早くミシアル様を
column4:
Mestre Joseph! Por favor, se apresse e traga de volta a Srta.
Mysial.

column3: ミシアルがどうしたというのだ
ミシアル様が！

ミシアル様がわたしの代わりに！
連れていかれちゃった！
column4:
Mysial tomou meu lugar!
Ele a levou!

column3: なんだと！？

"メルゴダの深淵"まで
ズールの命を持って来いって
column4: Traga a vida de Zuhl para o Abismo de Mergoda.

column3: 誰が言った

イリスだよ――
イリスが来たの

そうか――こうなってしまっては
覚悟を決めるしかないようだな
column4:
Parece que não tenho escolha a não ser fortalecer minha determinação
agora que chegou a isto.

column3: さあメルゴダの深淵での出来事を教えてくれ
column4: Agora, me diga o que aconteceu no Abismo de Mergoda.

column3:
――嗚呼、ミシアル
なんということを――
column4: Ah, Mysial, o que você fez...

column3:
ジョゼフ様、もうこうしてはいられません
ミシアルの覚悟に報いることを考えましょう
column4:
Mestre Joseph, não podemos mais ficar parados. Vamos
considerar como honrar a determinação de Mysial.

column3:
ふむ――そうかもしれんな
我々に残された魔物の命
column4:
Hmmm--talvez seja.
As vidas de demônios que nos restam.

column3:
その命で白竜がまた羽ばたいてくれるのであれば
すべての犠牲は報われる――
column4:
Se essas vidas puderem fazer o Dragão Branco voar
mais uma vez, então todos os sacrifícios serão
recompensados...

column3:
違うんです！
その命は第三のアークに捧げるんです
column4:
Você está errado! Essa vida deve ser dedicada
à Terceira Arca.

column3:
ズールは死ぬ間際に
「ゲートを開く」と言ったとか
column4: Antes de morrer, Zuhl disse "Abra o portão".

column3:
おそらく、そのゲートの向こうに
ディアマンテスがいるのでしょう
column4: Provavelmente, Diamantes está além desse portão.

column3:
ならば、こちらから行ってやろうでは
ありませんか
column4: Bem, então, não devemos ir lá nós mesmos?

column3:
馬鹿なことを言うな！
今後のことは――
column4: Não diga tolices! Quanto ao que vem depois—

column3:
会議などで時間を浪費している
場合ではありません！
column4: Não temos tempo a perder em reuniões!

column3:
クラウスよ、落ち着け
せめてレオの意見を聞いてからでも遅くはない
column4:
Klaus, acalme-se. Não seria tarde demais
mesmo se ouvíssemos a opinião de Leo primeiro.

column3: ――なんだと？　レオが姿を消した！？

命の器はレオが持っているんだね？
だったらレオは僕と同じことを――
column4:
Leo tem o Vaso da Vida, não é? Se for esse o
caso, então ele deve estar fazendo a mesma coisa que
eu...

column3:
クラウス、忘れたのか？
イリスの身に起こったことをもう忘れたか
column4:
Klaus, have you already forgotten what befell
Iris?

column3:
レオに限って――
いや、早くレオを見つけなくちゃ！
column4:
Not Leo of all people—
No, I must find Leo quickly!

column3: 作戦の概要はジョゼフ殿から聞いた
column4:
I heard the outline of the operation from Master
Joseph.

column3:
我々騎士団はメルゴダ周辺を
跋扈する魔物を引き受ける
column4:
Our order of knights will take care of the
monsters that roam around Mergoda.

column3:
貴殿らが背後を気にすることなく
ディアマンテスに向かえるようにな
column4:
So that you may head towards Diamantes without
having to watch your back.

column3: さあ、いざ、メルゴダへ！
column4: Come, let us head to Mergoda!

column3:
わたしからはもう何も言うことはない
無事の帰還を祈る
column4:
I have nothing more to say.
I pray for your safe return.

column3:
行ってらっしゃい！
わたしは白竜様にお祈りします
column4:
Take care!
I will pray to the White Dragon.

column3:
ディアマンテス――
これはディアマンテスの命――
column4: Diamantes— This is the will of Diamantes—

column3: そうか――

親愛なる覚者たちよ――
よくやった
レスタニアの善き民たちよ――

我は汝らを誇りに思い――
そして、感謝を捧げる――
column4:
I take pride in you all—
And thus, I offer my gratitude—

column3:
こうして目覚めてなお、我の復活には
今しばらくの時間が必要だ――
column4:
Even after awakening like this, it will take a
little more time for my revival -

column3:
しかし、必ずかつての力を取り戻し――
天空を舞ってみせよう――
column4:
However, I will definitely regain my former
power— And soar through the skies—

column3:
それまで――
今日の喜びを忘れるな
column4:
Until then--
Remember the joy of today.

column3: もちろんです！　けっして忘れません！
column4: Yes, of course! I will never forget!

column3:
白竜の世よ、永遠なれ！
さあ、白竜とともに歩もうではないか！
column4:
May the era of the White Dragon be eternal!
Come, let us walk alongside the White Dragon!

column3:
ふむ――実は、お前にぜひとも調べてもらいたい
ことがあってな
column4:
Hmm—actually, there's something I really need you
to investigate.

column3:
"竜王の指輪"――
その魔器の名を聞いたことがあるか？
column4:
Have you heard of the magic artifact known as the
Wyrmking's Ring?

column3:
かつて、大陸に覚者が一人だった時代――
代々受け継いできた強い竜力を秘めた指輪だ
column4:
In an era when there was but a single Arisen on
the continent—
It is a ring that conceals a potent Dragon Force,
passed down through generations.

column3:
それは３００年以上前、邪なる者により失われた
はずだった
column4:
It should have been lost to the evil one over 300
years ago!

column3:
だがその指輪の存在について、ミシアルは懸念を
持っていたようでな
column4:
However, it seemed that Mysial had concerns about
the existence of that ring.

column3: その存在を、幽かに感じると――
column4: And to faintly sense its presence...

column3:
どうも嫌な予感が拭えん
そこで、お前に調査を頼みたいのだ
column4:
I can't shake a bad feeling about this.
So, I need you to do some research for me.

column3:
指輪にかつて力を注がれた３つの地
"竜力の渦"と呼ばれる場所を
column4:
There are three places where the power was once
poured into the ring, called the "Whirls of Dragon
Force."

column3:
ただし、指輪の力を察知するには
各地で力を示す必要があるという
column4:
However, to sense the power of the ring, it is
said that one must demonstrate their strength in
various places.

column3: 難しい頼みだが、どうか引き受けてくれ
column4: It's a difficult request, but please take it.

column3:
覚者よ――
厄災の兆しがある
column4: Arisen... There are signs of disaster.

column3:
忌まわしき力の証――
《竜王の指輪》の波動を感じるのだ――
column4:
A testament to a detestable power—I sense the
pulsation of the Wyrmking's Ring—

column3:
あの指輪を最後に持ちえたのは
３００有余年前の、ひとりの覚者――
column4:
The last to possess that ring was an Arisen, over
300 years ago—

column3:
指輪はその者とともにレスタニアの大地から
消えたはずだが――
column4:
The ring should have vanished from the land of
Lestania along with its bearer—

column3: 混乱の時代に再び震えだしたようだ
column4: It seems to tremble once more in the age of chaos.

column3:
覚者よ――《竜王の指輪》を探し出し
破壊してしまうのだ
column4: Arisen, seek out and destroy the Wyrmking's Ring.

column3:
過ぎたる力は世を乱す
これ以上の混乱は手に余ろうからな
column4:
Excessive power disrupts the world. We cannot
afford any more chaos.

column3: 孤島に現れし黒き鎧の騎士――
column4:
The Black Knight who appeared on the solitary
island—

column3:
あやつは――
レスタニアの災いとなる闇を背負いし者
column4:
That person... carries the darkness that will
become the calamity of Lestania.

column3:
覚者よ――
我が目となり、兜に隠された素顔を探れ
column4:
Arisen―― become my Eyes and seek out the true
face hidden beneath the helm.

column3:
わたしは――少しばかり、力を使いすぎた
しばし――休む
column4:
I have... used a bit too much power. I shall rest
for a while.

column3: これもひとつの縁
column4: This too is a form of fate.

column3:
白竜直々の、特別な使命に相応しい者は
おまえしかいないだろう
column4:
There is no one more suitable for the special
mission bestowed by the White Dragon than you.

column3:
もちろん、ひとりでとは言わん
配下には――
column4:
Of course, you won't be alone. Under your
command...

column3: おい、エリオット！　エリオットはいるか！？
はい、ジョゼフ様！　ただいま！
覚者エリオット

わたしの下働きをさせていたが
外を知る良い機会だ
column4:
I had them laboring for me, but it's a good
opportunity for them to learn about the outside
world.

column3: 後ろにいるリズは――おそらく顔見知りのはず
column4: Lise in the back--probably a familiar face.

column3: 覚者人生をやり直したいとのことだ
column4:
They said they want to start their life as an
Arisen over.

column3:
こんにちは
いよいよ、わたしたちの時代が来たって感じ？
column4:
Hello.
Do you feel like our era has finally arrived?

column3:
これを機会に新しい覚者人生を行こうって
思ってるんで、よろしく
column4:
I'm thinking of taking this opportunity to start
a new life as an Arisen, so I'm counting on your
support.

column3:
生まれ変わった気でやるから
期待してね～！
column4:
I'll tackle this with the vigor of being reborn,
so keep your expectations high!

column3:
生まれ変わるって――
覚者はそう簡単に死にませんよね
column4:
To be reborn... Arisen do not die so easily, do
they?

column3: 俺はエリオットです

ジョゼフ様のお側にいましたから
精神修行だけはたっぷり積んでいます
column4:
Having been by Master Joseph's side, I have
indeed devoted much time to spiritual training.

column3: ふん――

この二人に加えてガルドリンをつけよう
今しがたまでここにいたのだが――
column4:
In addition to these two, let's bring Gurdolin
with us. He was just here a moment ago...

column3: ガルドリンかぁ
性格に疑問ありですね
column4: I have doubts about your character.

column3:
何事も経験だ
何しろ、我々が求めているのは――
column4:
Experience is everything. After all, what we are
seeking is...

column3:
レオの後任として覚者をまとめる
重責の担い手だからな
column4:
As the successor to Leo, they bear the heavy
responsibility of leading the Arisen.

column3:
レオ統率は、やっぱり戻らないんですか？
やれやれ
column4:
Is Commander Leo not coming back after all?
Oh dear.

column3:
このような事態でも姿を見せないとなれば
我々とともに歩む気は、もう、ないのだろう
column4:
If they do not show themselves even in such a
crisis, it must mean they no longer wish to walk
alongside us.

column3: となれば、おまえが頼りだ
column4: If that's the case, I'm counting on you.

column3: 一隊の長として、すぐさま任務にあたってくれ
column4:
As the leader of the squad, please attend to your
mission at once.

column3: レスタニア歴、３２３年
column4: In the year 323 of the Lestania calendar

column3: 後に「侵食の大災」と呼ばれる戦いは幕を開けた
column4:
The battle later known as the "Great Plague of
Corruption" began.

column3: これは、時代と竜に翻弄される覚者たちの物語である
column4:
This is the story of the Arisen who are
manipulated by the era and the dragon

column3: ほう――
セシリーよ――

おまえから、大きな力を感じる
善とも悪ともつかぬが――
column4:
I feel great power from you.
Neither good nor evil, but...

column3: その力、我がレスタニアに及ぼす影響は大きい
column4:
That power has a significant impact on our
Lestania.

column3:
この地の行く末を変えてしまうほどの力が
おまえには宿っているようだ
column4:
It seems that you possess a power capable of
altering the fate of this land.

column3: おそらく――竜の力であろう
column4: Most likely... it is the power of a dragon.

column3:
本来交わることなき竜と竜の力が交わった
言わば、おまえはその交点
column4:
The power of the dragon and the dragon's power
that never originally intersected have
intersected.
You are the intersection, so to speak.

column3: 黒騎士がわたしを求めるのはそのせいですか？
column4: Is that why the Black Knight seeks me?

column3: ――知らぬ

白竜様――その深き叡智で
わたしの進むべき道をお教えください
column4:
Lord White Dragon, with your profound wisdom,
please teach me the path I should take.

column3: わたしは――ここにいてはいけないのです

魔物を呼び寄せ、みなさんを危険に
さらしてしまいます
column4:
By calling these monsters, all are exposed to
danger.

column3:
おまえを追う者どもが竜に連なる者ならば
このレスタニアに安全な地など存在せぬ
column4:
If those who pursue you are connected to the
dragon,
then there is no safe place in Lestania for you.

column3: そんな気がしてましたよ
column4: I had a feeling that was the case.

column3:
神殿に集う者たちよ
この娘――命を賭して守るのだ
column4:
Ye who gather at the Temple,
protect this maiden with your lives.

column3: 異国の娘、セシリーよ
column4: Cecily, the girl from a foreign land.

column3:
この者たちを信じ、ともに歩み
おまえの内から失われた真実を取り戻せ
column4:
Believe in these people, walk together with them,
and regain the truth that was lost within you.

column3: ありがとうございます！
隊長さん――相談があります
column4: Captain, I have something to discuss.

column3: わたしの記憶は、まだ戻りそうにありません
column4:
My memories still seem unlikely to return, as of
yet.

column3: 黒騎士に追われる理由――
column4:
The reason why I am being chased by the Black
Knight—

column3:
せめてそれだけでも思い出せないものかと
努力しているのですが――
column4:
I am doing my best to at least remember that
much...

column3: やはり時間がかかりそうです
column4: It seems it will still take some time.

column3:
それなのに、ここにこうしていると――
居場所を黒騎士やズールに知られたら――
column4:
And yet, if my whereabouts were to be known by
the Black Knight or Zuhl...

column3:
みなさんをまた危険な目に
あわせてしまうことになります
column4: It would put all of you in danger again.

column3:
わたしはどこか遠くへ行かねばなりません
みなさんを巻きこまずにすむ、遠い、どこかへ
column4:
I must go somewhere far away. Somewhere distant
where I won't involve everyone.

column3:
このレスタニアに安全な場所などない
白竜様のお言葉、覚えてるよね？
column4:
There is no safe place in Lestania. Do you
remember the words of the White Dragon?

column3: 力を――試してみます
column4: I will try testing my strength.

column3:
隊長を、どこかの島へ飛ばしてしまった力――
あの力を自分に使ってみたいのです
column4:
The power that sent the Captain to some unknown
island...
I want to use that power for myself.

column3: セシリーよ、ならぬ

見極めなきままに力を放てば
おまえはその力に呑まれてしまうだろう
column4:
If you unleash your power without discernment,
You will surely be consumed by that power.

column3:
人は弱い
時にその弱さは世界を危うくする
column4:
People are weak.
At times, that weakness can endanger the world.

column3: 他に方法がないのです！

ならば、おまえの記憶が戻ったなら
力の解放を許そう
column4:
If your memories have returned, then I shall
allow the release of your power.

column3:
記憶を取り戻し、それでも尚
力が必要だと信じるならば一度だけ
column4:
If you're determined to recover your memories and
still believe you need power, then just this once.

column3: それまでは、けして、ならぬ
column4: Until then, it is absolutely forbidden.

column3:
悔しまぎれの捨て台詞であればと願っていたが
ズールめ、真実を言い残していたらしい
column4:
I had hoped it was just a desperate parting
remark, but it seems Zuhl spoke the truth.

column3:
各地からの報告によると
侵食魔による被害はこれまで以上に深刻だ
column4:
According to reports from various regions, the
damage caused by the Corruption is more serious
than ever before.

column3:
かくなる上は騎士団、覚者隊の区別なく
一丸となって事に当たろうではないか！
column4:
Given the circumstances, let us unite as one,
regardless of whether we are knights or Arisen!

column3:
貴殿らは、少数精鋭の利を活かし
遊撃隊として戦場（いくさば）を駆け巡るがいい
column4:
You should make use of your small elite force and
roam the battlefield as a strike team.

column3:
転戦に次ぐ転戦ということになろうが
貴殿ならやれるはずだ
column4:
Even if it means constantly changing
battlefields, you should be able to do it.

column3:
今、セシリーたちが出て行きました
リズもやけに張り切っていて――
column4:
Cecily and the others have already left. Lise
seems unusually eager as well...

column3:
次は南の集落を回るつもりらしいです
俺は、隊長が戻る頃かと思って――
column4:
It seems they plan to visit the southern village
next. I thought they would return when the captain
comes back...

column3:
大変です！
メルゴダに侵食魔が現れたとの報せです！
column4:
It's urgent! There's a report that an infected
has appeared in Mergoda!

column3: メルゴダか――住民たちでなんとかならんのか？
column4: Can't the residents of Mergoda handle it somehow?

column3: 彼らが錬金術師だからですか？
column4: Is it because they are alchemists?

column3: 錬金術師がどうなろうと構いませんか！？
column4:
Are you that indifferent to the fate of the
alchemists!?

column3:
メルゴダもレスタニアの一部です
他の地域と同じに扱わねばなりません！
column4:
Mergoda is also part of Lestania. It must be
treated the same as other regions!

column3:
区別することが
彼らの心に闇を作るのです
column4:
Making a distinction creates darkness in their
hearts.

column3:
クラウスの言うとおりだ
貴殿はメルゴダへ行くがよい
column4: Klaus is right. You should go to Mergoda.

column3:
親交の深い貴殿が行けば
かの地の連中も心強いだろう
column4:
If someone with a close relationship like you
goes, it will give them courage.

column3: 他は我々騎士団に任せてくれ！
column4: Leave the rest to our order of knights!

column3:
じゃ、俺は騎士団を手伝いますよ
隊長は安心してメルゴダへ行ってください
column4:
Well then, I'll assist the knights. Captain,
please go to Mergoda without worry.

column3: 無事の帰還、なによりだ
column4: A safe return is the most important thing.

column3: 騎士団の戦果は上々！
column4: The knight order's achievements are excellent!

column3:
加えて、グリッテン砦の大掃除完了との
報告がたった今入った
column4:
In addition, a report has just come in that the
cleaning of Fort Gritten has been completed.

column3: 隊長、ほら――

隊長！　南は完全制圧！
わたしとセシリーの手柄だからね！
column4:
Captain! The south has been completely subdued!
It's all thanks to me and Cecily's
accomplishments!

column3: ひぃひぃ言ってたぜ、こいつ
メルゴダに黒騎士が現れたと聞きました
column4: I heard that the Black Knight appeared in Mergoda.

column3: ご無事で――なによりです
column4: I'm glad you're safe—above all else.

column3:
さて――皆の尽力で
最悪の状況からは脱したというところだな
column4:
Now, with everyone's efforts, we have managed to
escape from the worst conditions.

column3: だが、侵食魔がゼロになったわけじゃねえ
column4:
However, it doesn't mean that the corruption has
been reduced to zero.

column3: 黒騎士も相変わらずです
column4: The Black Knight is still the same as ever.

column3: みんな、もう少し前向きになろう？
column4: Everyone, let's try to be a little more positive.

column3: セシリーの記憶が戻ればなあ
column4: If only Cecily could regain her memories.

column3: 焦ることはない

おまえの記憶がどうあろうと
敵がいる限り我々は戦い続ける
column4:
No matter what your memories may be, as long as
there are enemies, we will continue to fight.

column3:
それは白竜の御前に集う者の責務であり――
戦いの果てにある世界は夢であり、希望だ
column4:
It is the duty of those who gather before the
White Dragon's presence—
The world that lies at the end of the battle is a
dream, and a hope.

column3: 嵐とともに始まったレスタニアの危機
column4: The crisis of Lestania began with the storm.

column3:
人々は、怖れ、おののいたが
騎士団の活躍に明日を見いだし――
column4:
The people, filled with fear and trembling, find
hope in the actions of the Knight's Order, and
look towards a brighter tomorrow.

column3: 覚者の奮闘に、白竜の加護を感じた
column4:
They felt the blessings of the White Dragon
through the efforts of the Arisen.

column3: 黒騎士とその配下のズール――
column4: The Black Knight and their subordinate, Zuhl...

column3:
渡来してきた魔物たちの暗躍に
不安な日々は続くだろう
column4:
The days of unease continue as the enemy
creatures brought forth from afar conspire in the
shadows.

column3:
しかし、レスタニアの人々は今――
自分たちは無力ではないことを感じ始めていた
column4:
However, the people of Lestania now... were
beginning to feel that they were not powerless.

column3: さて、あれからの侵食魔と島の状況だが――
column4:
Now, regarding the situation of the Infected and
the island...

column3:
その時々で対処しているとはいえ
侵食魔どもが押し寄せる動きは相変わらずだ
column4:
Although we are dealing with them accordingly
each time, the movements of the encroaching demons
remain unchanged.

column3:
加えて、セシリーを狙う黒騎士――
島の調査もまだまだこれから
column4:
Moreover, with the black knight targeting
Cecily—there's still a lot of investigation left
to do on the island.

column3:
セシリーか、せめてレオのところの
ロイグの記憶が少しでも戻れば――
column4:
If only some of Loeg's memories could return,
even if it's just about Cecily or Leo...

column3:
隊長、急いで島へ！
ガルドリンが死んじゃいます！
column4:
Captain, hurry to the island!
Gurdolin is about to die!

column3:
魔赤島の調査で
見たこともない魔物が――
column4:
During the investigation of Bloodbane Isle,
we encountered enemies that we have never seen
before.

column3:
そいつが強すぎて――
出直そうとしたら退路を断たれて
column4:
They're too strong—when I tried to retreat, my
escape route was cut off.

column3: 俺を逃がすためにあの人――

エリオット、もういい
傷の手当てをしなさい
column4:
Elliot, that's enough.
Please get your wounds tended to.

column3: 島へ渡ってくれ――ガルドリンを頼む
column4:
Please, make your way to the island— I'm counting
on you, Gurdolin.

column3:
隊長さん――白竜様、ジョゼフ様、皆様――
お話があります
column4:
Captain... Lord White Dragon, Master Joseph,
everyone... I have something to discuss.

column3:
ロイグとわたしの記憶を突き合わせたのですが
新しいことは何も思い出せませんでした
column4:
After comparing Loeg's and my memories, I
couldn't recall anything new.

column3:
ただ、ロイグはあの島の光――
光源を間近で見たそうです
column4:
However, Loeg saw the light of that island up
close.

column3: みなさん、一緒に島へ渡りませんか？
column4:
Everyone, why don't you come across to the island
with us?

column3:
俺が黒騎士ならあそこで待ち伏せる
敵の思うつぼだろうよ
column4:
If I were the Black Knight, I'd ambush them over
there.
That's what the enemy wants.

column3: 今のままじゃ勝てないよね
column4: We can't win as we are now, can we?

column3:
何か新しい――武器とか魔法とか作戦とかが
必要じゃない？
column4:
Do we need something new - like weapons, magic,
or tactics?

column3: もしもの時は、わたしを置いて逃げてください
column4:
If something happens, please leave me behind and
escape.

column3:
わたしを手に入れるか――あるいは亡き者にすれば
黒騎士はこの地を去るに違いありません
column4:
If you capture me—or if you kill me—the black
knight will surely leave this land.

column3: 逃げる！？　君を置いて！？

逃げる、逃げねえで揉めてる間に
全滅――ああ、目に浮かぶぜ
column4:
Running away, arguing instead of fleeing—total
annihilation while we're at odds. Ah, I can see it
now.

column3: あの島は我が加護の外――
column4: That island is beyond my protection――

column3: ――それを忘れるな
精霊竜の覚者セシリーよ――
column4: Cecily, Arisen of the Spirit Dragon--

column3:
おまえが継承を受けた竜力はごくわずか――
フィンダムの習わしか？
column4:
The Dragon Force you have inherited is only a
small amount...
Is it a tradition of Phindym?

column3: 継承の最中に黒騎士が現れました
column4:
The Black Knight appeared during the inheritance
process.

column3:
そこで精霊竜は、大地の一部と一緒に
転移させることで――
column4:
There, the Spirit Dragon, along with a portion of
the land, would be transposed...

column3: わたしを、襲いかかる黒騎士から守ったのです
column4:
They defended me against the attacking black
knight.

column3:
わたしは巻きこまれただけらしい
特別な理由があるのではないかと期待したが
column4:
It appears I was just drawn into it. I hoped
there might be some special reason.

column3: 結局――何もなかったな
column4: In the end... there was nothing.

column3:
自分と同じ境遇の人がいてくれて
どれほど心強かったか――
column4:
Having someone in the same situation as me was
such a source of strength—

column3: 一緒に、帰りましょう？
帰り方、わかった？
column4: Did you figure out how to get home?

column3:
フィンダムへの道を切り開く力なら
すでに精霊竜から授かっています
column4:
If it's the power to carve a path to Phindym, I
have already received it from the Spirit Dragon.

column3:
でも、黒騎士を倒さねば、どこにいても同じ
――何度でも同じことが起こるでしょう
column4:
However, if we do not defeat the Black Knight,
the same thing will happen no matter where we are,
over and over again.

column3:
白竜様が、帰還をお許しにならなかったのは
そのことにお気づきだったからですね？
column4:
The White Dragon didn't permit your return
because they were aware of that, correct?

column3: で、黒騎士って、何者？
column4: So, what exactly is the Black Knight?

column3:
ズールが黒騎士のポーンなら
黒騎士はどっかの竜の覚者ってことだろうよ
column4:
If Zuhl is the Black Knight's Pawn, then the
Black Knight must be an Arisen of some dragon.

column3:
あの甲冑の下にどんな素顔があるのか――
わたしにもわかりません
column4:
What kind of face is there under that armor --
-- I don't know what it is.

column3:
正体なんて、後まわしでいい
とにかく黒騎士を倒さねえと、先が見えねえ
column4:
We can postpone uncovering the identity for now.
The main thing is to defeat the black knight, or
we can't see what lies ahead.

column3: ふむ――
二竜の覚者が共闘するこの戦いは――
column4:
A battle where two Arisen of different dragons
join forces...

column3: 両大陸への侵略者たる黒騎士との決戦
column4:
The decisive battle against the Black Knight, the
invader of both continents.

column3:
その命運を握るのは、おまえたちだ
――心して、頼むぞ
column4:
The destiny is within your hands.
― I ask you sincerely, proceed with caution.

column3: そうか――レオが黒騎士を――
column4: I see ―― Leo is the Black Knight...

column3:
神殿を離れ、新たな力を求めたのは
レスタニアの未来を見据えてのことだった――
column4:
Leaving the temple, they sought a new power,
looking towards the future of Lestania.

column3: それならそうと――
column4: If that's the case ――If that's the case, then...

column3:
――時に、セシリーはどうした
島の、歪んだ空間はどうなったのだ
column4:
―― What happened to Cecily in the meantime?
And what about the distorted space on the island?

column3: あれは今、"ゲート"と呼ばれている

その"ゲート"を通り、忌々しい侵食魔どもが
相も変わらず飛んでくる
column4:
Through that Gate, the detestable Infected
creatures continue to fly in without fail.

column3: 黒騎士は倒したのだろう？
直接の関係はなかったのかもしれん
うむ――どうしたものか
column4: Hmmm... I don't know what to do.

column3:
今しがた島のゲートが開通したと
使者が伝えてきた
column4:
Just now, a messenger came and informed us that
the island's Gate has opened.

column3:
懸念されたセシリーの消耗は、さほどではない
とのことだ
column4:
It seems that Cecily's exhaustion is not as
severe as feared.

column3: だが、ゲートが安定し続ける保証はない
column4:
However, there is no guarantee that the gate will
remain stable.

column3:
セシリーはすぐにでもフィンダムへ、渡りたいと
主張しているらしいが
column4:
Cecily seems to be insisting on crossing over to
Phindym as soon as possible.

column3:
向こうで万が一のことが起これば
我々への影響は計り知れない
column4:
If anything were to happen over there, the impact
on us would be immeasurable.

column3: そこで――

セシリーたちとフィンダムへ渡り、護衛し
状況の把握――実地の調査を行う者が必要だ
column4:
We need someone to cross over with Cecily and the
others to Phindym, provide protection, and gather
information through on-site investigation.

column3: もちろん、おまえ以上の適任はいない
column4:
Of course, there is no one better qualified than
you.

column3:
すでに第一次調査隊――おまえの部下たちは
ゲートの前で待っている
column4:
Your subordinates from the first survey team are
already waiting in front of the Gate.

column3:
幾多の危機を乗り越えたレスタニア育ちの目で
状況を見極めてくれ
column4:
With the eyes of a Lestania-raised individual who
has overcome countless crises, please assess the
situation.

column3:
ここ連日、探索から戻らぬ隊員が
増えているとのことだ
column4:
Every day now, more and more members of the squad
are not returning from the search.

column3:
どうも嫌な予感がしてたまらん
老人の思い過ごしであればいいのだが
column4:
I can't shake this dreadful feeling. I hope it's
just an old man's imagination.

column3:
ともかく事の真相を確かめるために
調査に協力して欲しい
column4:
Anyway, to get to the bottom of this, I need your
help with an investigation.

column3:
段取りについての詳細は神殿にいる
情報に長けた覚者、アイザックを尋ねてくれ
column4:
For detailed information about the arrangements,
please consult Isaac, a knowledgeable Arisen who
resides in the Temple.

column3: よろしく頼んだぞ
ヴァネッサから、かような報告が来ようとは――
column4: To receive such a report from Vanessa—

column3: 覚者よ――

禊の神殿深くに封じられていたかの場所は
既に永き眠りから目覚めている
column4:
The location that was sealed deep within the
Purification Temple has already stirred from its
long slumber.

column3:
そして今、混沌とした竜力を再び呼び込まんと
動きだした
column4:
And now, they have begun to move to summon the
chaotic dragon force once more.

column3:
あれを地上に出してはならぬ
かの場所に押しとどめよ
column4:
It must not be released onto the surface. Keep it
contained in there.

column3:
ふむ、神殿にいるアイザックを訪れ
すぐさま準備にとりかかってくれ
column4:
Very well, visit Isaac at the temple and start
making preparations right away.

column3: 待っていたぞ
いましがた使いの者から連絡がきた
column4: I received word from the messenger just now.

column3:
フィンダムの各族長の結託により
"精霊の地"の封印が解かれたようだ
column4:
The unification of the chieftains in Phindym
seems to have led to the release of the seal on
the "Spirit Land".

column3:
もちろん、芯なる樹の奥深くにある
汚染原因を絶つのがその目的だ
column4:
Of course, the purpose is to cut off the cause of
pollution deep within the core of the sacred tree.

column3:
さあ、行きなさい
セシリーが待っているだろう
column4:
Now go.
Cecily will be waiting for you.

column3: 最後まで、強き意志を持って戦うんだ
column4:
Maintain a strong resolve and fight until the
very end.

column3: ふむ――これでは「覚者に理を説く」だな
column4:
I see—this is what it means to "try to reason
with the enlightened."
Like talking to a brick wall...

column3: うーむ

どうしました？
何か俺たちに頼みたげな顔ですが
column4:
What's wrong?
You look like you want to ask us something.

column3:
ああ、各地の村々から盗賊の被害を訴える声が
増えてな――
column4:
Yes, more and more villages around the land are
complaining of banditry.

column3: 盗賊を探し出し、村人の財産を取り戻さねばならん
column4:
We must find the bandits and recover the
villagers' property.

column3:
おまえたちを送るほどのことではないと
思っていたが、頼らせてもらうとしよう
column4:
I didn't think it was something worthy of sending
all of you off, but I'll allow myself to rely on
you.

column3: もうエリオット、余計な仕事を！

いいよ、リズは休んでいて
隊長と、隊長の右腕の俺で片付けるから
column4:
Sure, Lise. Take a rest.
The captain and I, his right-hand man, will take
care of it.

column3: ほう――

今、聞き捨てならないこと、言ったよね
隊長の右腕がどうのこうの――
column4:
Now, you just said something that can't be
ignored, right?
About the captain's right-hand man...

column3:
まあまあ！
言い争うなら、ほれ、大階段の下でな
column4:
Well, well! If you want to argue, then come on,
under the grand staircase.

column3:
わたしの望みは、村人が安心して
眠れること――ただ、それだけだ
column4:
My wish is for the villagers to be able to sleep
peacefully—that's all.

column3: ごくろうだったな
被害にあった村からは感謝の言葉が――
column4:
We received words of gratitude from the affected
village...

column3:
それで？
一番手柄はエリオットだって聞いたけど
column4:
And?
--I heard that Elliot was the one who did the
most impressive job.

column3: ――まあ、今回はね
.ふん、手柄なんざ欲しい奴にくれてやる
column4:
Hmph, I'll leave the credit to someone who wants
it.

column3: 素直に認めてくださいよ
column4: Just be honest and admit it.

column3: 日々の努力が実を結んだということです
column4: It means that our daily efforts have paid off.

column3:
これで俺が隊長の右腕ですね！
ですよね！
column4:
With this, I am the Captain's right hand, right?
Right!

column3: 神殿のみんなにも教えてあげなくちゃ
column4: I have to tell everyone at the temple too.

column3: ィヤッホーイッ！
エリオットの野郎、浮かれ過ぎじゃねえか
column4:
You bastard Elliot, aren't you getting too
carried away?

column3: ちょっと今回いいカンジだからって――
column4: Just because things seem good this time—

column3:
まあまあ――
許してやってくれ

あの子は幼い頃に家族を失い、わしが引き取って
育てたのだが、わしはこの通り多忙だ
column4:
That child lost their family at a young age, and
I took them in and raised them.
But as you can see, I am very busy.

column3:
教育だけは完璧に叩き込んだものの
 寂しい思いをさせることも多かったようだ
column4:
Although I drilled them perfectly in education,
it seems I caused them much loneliness.

column3:
だから、誰かに認められることが
うれしくてたまらないのだろう
column4:
That's why being acknowledged by someone makes
them incredibly happy.

column3:
そんな重そうなもん
抱えているようには見えなかったが――
column4:
Although it didn't look like they were carrying
such a heavy burden...

column3:
普段は気取られないよう自分を作っているところが
あるのだろう
column4:
They probably have a side to them that they
carefully craft to avoid coming off as pompous.

column3:
へぇ～、何よ
ちょっとはかわいいとこあるんじゃない
column4:
Oh, really? What's that about?
Don't you have a cute side to you?

column3: おいおい、上から目線かよ
column4: Hey, hey, don't look down on me like that.

column3: ふん、聞こえていたぞ
フィンダムの民が薬を作るという話だろう？
column4: Is it about the people of Phindym making medicine?

column3: わたしの考えはこうだ
フィンダムの問題はほぼ解決した
column4: The problem in Phindym has been mostly resolved.

column3:
精霊竜セシリーが目覚めて
竜が復活すれば何も問題はない
column4:
Should the Spirit Dragon Cecily awaken and the
dragon be revived, there would be no problem at
all.

column3:
となれば、これ以上、我々が干渉する必要は
どこにある？
column4:
If that's the case, where's the need for us to
intervene any further?

column3: 聞き捨てなりませんよジョゼフ様
column4: We can't turn a blind eye to it, Master Joseph.

column3:
ジョゼフ様もご存知でしょう？
フィンダムは変わろうとしている
column4:
Master Joseph, you must also be aware, right?
Phindym is about to change.

column3:
ちょっとやそっとの病気にかかっても
もう生きることをあきらめたりしない――
column4:
Even if you get a little bit sick,
you don't give up on life anymore--you just keep
on living.

column3:
これは大いなる意識の変革です
手を貸してあげなくては！
column4:
This is a monumental shift in awareness. We must
offer our help!

column3: 急かすと、ろくなことにならん
column4: If we rush, nothing good will come of it.

column3: 正しい指導があれば大丈夫ですよ
column4: With proper guidance, everything will be fine.

column3: 誰がやるんだ
もちろん僕です
ふん！　勝手にせい

ふん――
フィンダムに骨を埋めるんじゃなかったのか？
column4:
Hmph... I thought I was going to put down my
roots in Phindym.

column3: そんな言い方、やめてください
人の気も知らんで
column4: That's true, people can be unpredictable.

column3:
それはともかく、薬の精製は
順調に進んでいます
column4:
Anyway, the medicine refinement is progressing
smoothly.

column3:
何の心配もいりませんから
それと――
column4: You don't need to worry about anything, and...

column3: これをどうぞ

フィンダムの植物とレスタニアの知恵が
生んだかつてない滋養薬です
column4:
A nourishing elixir like no other, born from the
plants of Phindym and the wisdom of Lestania.

column3:
ジョゼフ様には、まだまだ元気で
僕たちを指導してほしいですからね
column4:
We still want Joseph, full of energy, to continue
guiding us.

column3: クラウス――
わしで実験するつもりか！
column4: You plan to experiment on me, don't you!

column3: え！？　そう来ますか！
column4: Huh!? Is that how it's going to be?

column3: 素直じゃないねえ、ジョゼフ様
column4: You're not very straightforward, Master Joseph.

column3: でも、元気になったんじゃない？
あんなに優れなかったのに不思議ですね
column4:
It's strange, considering you weren't that great
before.

column3: そっか！
ジョゼフの一番の薬はクラウスだったのね
column4: Joseph's best medicine was Klaus, huh?

column3: うわっ！！（リアクションボイス）
なんだ！！
これは一体――
見て、魔物の目！
column4: Look, the eye of a monster!

column3: ――いや、竜の目だ
気を放ち、この地を探り当てたか
column4: You have released your power and found this place.

column3: 精霊竜を討った覚者はおまえか
column4: Are you the Arisen who defeated the Spirit Dragon?

column3: おまえか――
不遜な竜よ、名乗れ！
アハァ！？　死にゆく竜に、告げる名などない
column4: Ah!?! I, a dying dragon, have no name to give.

column3: ヴァ――（炎を受けるリアクション）
column4: Va—(Reaction to being engulfed in flames)

避けては通れんのだが
column4:
Recapturing the Lookout Castle is necessary to
open the path, there is no way around it.

column3: 幾分、敵の兵力が多すぎる――
column4: But it seems the enemy forces are quite numerous.

column3: オークの部隊が集結しているらしいね
column4: An orc unit has gathered there, it seems.

column3:
そこで提案です
わたしはロスギルへ戻り――
column4: So here's my proposal: I'll return to Rothgill—

column3: 兵をまとめて"嘆きの湿原"へ進軍します
column4:
We will gather troops and march together to the
"Wailing Wetland".

column3:
そして湿原の、敵の野営地に攻撃を
しかけてやるのです、となれば――
column4:
And if we were to launch an attack on the enemy's
camp in the marshlands...

column3:
展望城の戦いに飢えたオークどもは
勇んで戦場へと向かうはずです
column4:
The orcs, eager for a fight, should head to the
battlefield.

column3:
おそらく、城の守りは手薄になりますから
その隙に奇襲部隊が侵入すれば――
column4:
With the castle's defenses likely weakened during
that time, our surprise attack squad can enter—

column3: イェルハルド、素晴らしい！
わたしもイェルハルドと行くよ

おぬしたちも行ってもらえぬか？
派手に暴れて愚かなオークどもを騙してやるのだ
column4:
Could we go too?
We'll make a spectacle and deceive those foolish
orcs.

column3:
イェルハルドたちが動いたよ
戦力をジリアンと二分して暴れているらしい
column4:
Gerhard and his team have already moved out,
dividing the forces with Gillian and wreaking
havoc.

column3:
エリオットが陽動部隊に加わってくれたから
さぞ心強いことだろうよ
column4:
Eliott joined the diversion squad, so they should
be quite powerful.

column3: 報告ッ――！

展望城に集結していたオーク達が
ついに、嘆きの湿原へと向かいました！
column4:
The orcs that had gathered at Lookout Castle have
finally headed to the Wailing Wetland!

column3:
おお――陽動は成功
つまり、城は今、がら空きだ！
column4:
Great— the diversion was a success, which means
the castle is now empty!

column3: 時は満ちたぞ

あんな大きなお城――
本当に陥とせるかな
column4: Such a big castle... Can we really capture it?

column3: あの城の先にしか、未来も、希望も無い
column4: Beyond that castle, there is no future, no hope.

column3:
レスタニアの覚者たちよ
ここまで来れたのも、おぬしらの力添えあってこそだ
column4:
Arisen of Lestania, we've made it this far
because of your support.

column3:
隊長さん、王家の通路からの侵入が成功すれば
一気に城壁の内側に出られるはずです――
column4:
Captain, if the intrusion from the royal passage
succeeds, we should be able to reach the inside of
the city walls in one go—

column3: 僕たちも急ぎ出陣しましょう
ネド王子の姿が見えん！　どこだ！？
column4: I can't see Prince Nedo! Where is he?!

column3: あ！　ほら、あそこ！
勝手な行動は慎んでもらわないと～！
column4: I won't tolerate any reckless actions!

column3: でも、王子の良いところでしょ？　さあ、隊長！
column4:
But that's one of the prince's charms, isn't it?
Now, Captain!

column3: フゥッ！！（リアクションボイス、唸り声）
天晴れ、レスタニアの覚者隊！
ネド王子と解放軍もね
column4: Prince Nedo and the Liberation Army, too.

column3: わたしの出番はなしだね
column4: I have no role left, huh?

column3: 遅いわ！　して、各地の状況は？
column4:
Too late! So, how's the situation in various
places?

column3:
敵の動きが活発になっているの
ロスギルの村、ベルタのアジトあたりも危ない
column4:
The enemy is getting more active. The village of
Rothgill and Bertha's hideout are in danger.

column3: 何か対策を考えないと――
column4: We need to come up with a plan...

column3:
僕が赴くことで状況が変わるなら
行かせてください
column4:
If my presence can make a difference in the
situation, please let me go.

column3:
皆の苦労の時に、砦でジッとしているわけには
いきません
column4:
We can't just sit back in our forts when everyone
else is struggling.
I can't.

column3: 王子――

いやはや――王位を継承するということは
こういうことなんですねえ
column4:
Well, that's it— inheriting the throne is a tough
job, but also a rewarding one, isn't it?

column3: もう、ますます応援しちゃう！
column4: It's the people's trust that carries us forward.

column3: 今、未来は私たちの手中にある
column4: Now, the future is in our hands.

column3: ここを落とし、またひとつ
column4: Let's capture this place, and another one falls.

column3: 新たな希望を積み上げよう
column4:
Let us stack up new hope and build another layer
of hope.

column3: さあ、いくぞ！
鼻歌（ごきげん）
笑う
よし！

オークの将よ！
ここまでだ！
シュワアッ！　小賢しい！
嘆きの湿原は囮だったというわけか――
column4:
So, it seems that the Wailing Wetland 
was a decoy after all...

column3: 王家アッカーの名のもと
column4: In the name of the Royal House of Acre.

column3: この城とこの国の民を返して貰います！
column4:
I will reclaim this castle and 
the people of this land!

column3: いくぞ！！
――ゴハァッ、ギ様のガオォ、忘れんぞォ！
column4: Gah! I won't forget that roar!

column3:
骸の将を、討ち破ったぞ！
皆勝ちどきを上げよ！
column4:
We've defeated the Necro Master!
Everyone, raise your victory cries!

column3: オオーー！！（リアクションボイス）
オオーー！！（リアクションボイス）
オオーー！！（リアクションボイス）

オークが――オークたちが
次から次へと城を出て行きます！
column4:
- Orcs keep pouring out of the castle, 
one after another!

column3:
見せてもらったよ
凄いとは聞いていたけどまったくその通りだ
column4:
Ser, I've seen it now.
I had heard it was amazing, 
but it's exactly as they said.

column3:
この国にもまだ希望が残っている
それが実感できたわ
column4:
There's still hope left in this country.
That is the feeling I have come to grasp.

column3:
隊長、皆さん――
ありがとうございます

あとは陽動に出てた奴らが
生きてるといいがな――
column4:
I hope those guys who went out as a 
diversion are still alive.

column3:
エリオットとジリアンがいるんだもん
うまくやってるんじゃない？
column4:
With Elliot and Gillian here, 
they're probably doing well, right?

column3: すぐに部隊を回収させましょう
次に目指すのは、いよいよ王都メガドです
column4:
What we're aiming for next is 
finally the Royal Capital, Megado.

column3:
レスタニア勢の活躍で、ネド王子と解放軍は
展望城を取り戻すことに成功した
column4:
The Lestanian forces' heroic efforts enabled 
Prince Nedo and the Liberation Army to 
successfully reclaim Lookout Castle.

column3:
士気上がる人々の間から、砦から城へ
拠点を移すべきだという声があがり――
column4:
With the boost in morale, there's talk of shifting
our base from the fort to the castle—

column3:
ネド王子が承認すると同時に人々は
せわしげに働き始めた
column4:
As soon as Prince Ned approved, 
the people set to work.

column3:
勝利への道はまだ半ばであることを知っていたが
以前と比べて人々の顔は明るい
column4:
Although I knew we were only halfway to victory,
the people's faces are brighter than before.

column3:
ひとりひとりの胸の中に
しっかりと、希望が根付いていたのだ
column4:
Within each person's heart, 
hope had firmly taken root.

column3: 王子の姿をした仮初めの希望ではなく
column4: Not a fleeting hope in the guise of a prince,

column3:
それぞれが思い描く、それぞれの未来の姿が
希望になったのだ
column4:
but hopes are now shaped by the futures
 they each envision.

column3: これから先のことは、将軍から聞いてる？
column4:
Has the General told you what's 
going to happen from here on out?

column3:
この使役獣で、人の足では越えられない
切り立つ岩山を強行して北の大地へ入る
column4:
With this beast of burden, 
we will force our way over sheer rock mountains 
that cannot be crossed on foot,
entering the northern lands.

column3:
街道の関所は敵の制圧下にあるので
過酷な道を選ぶことになってしまいました
column4:
The checkpoint on the path is under enemy control,
so we've been forced to choose a harsher route.

column3:
毎度毎度――
もう慣れてきたぜ
column4:
Over and over—
I'm starting to get used to it.

column3: この獣、突然暴れたりしないんですか？
column4: Isn't there a risk of this beast going berserk?

column3:
大人しいヤツを選んでみたつもり
保証はないけどね――
column4:
I selected a quiet one, thinking it through. 
There's no guarantee though...

column3: さあ、準備が出来たのなら出発するよ
column4: Now, if you're ready, we're off.

column3:
隊長、ジリアン
どうかお気をつけて
皆さん揃いましたね
column4: It looks like everyone is here.

column3:
それでは、将軍
王都メガド奪還作戦の説明をお願いします
column4:
Then, General,
Please explain the operation to reclaim 
the Royal Capital of Megado.

column3:
まず――
神殿を脱出した兵たちを救出して、我が軍に加える
column4:
Firstly—
Rescue the soldiers who escaped from 
the temple and add them to our army.

column3:
助け出した彼らを、城周辺に配備して
メガド突入時の陽動を任せる予定だ
column4:
I plan to deploy those we rescued 
around the castle to create a diversion 
during the invasion of Megado.

column3: それ、いい！

先の石塔にいた守護兵たちのように
逃げ延びた兵は、案外いるかも知れませんね
column4:
Just like the guardians at the stone tower before,
there may be quite a few soldiers 
who managed to escape.

column3:
そして――
北の地の盗賊たちに、王都潜入の協力を要請する
column4:
Next, I'll ask the northern bandits 
to help me infiltrate the royal capital.

column3:
北の盗賊とは面倒だね
でも、あたしらより王都への侵入には長けている
column4:
The Northern bandits are troublesome, 
but they're more adept at breaching the capital 
than we are.

column3:
王家を悩ませた悪党どもを頼るのはシャクだが
背に腹はかえられない
column4:
It's unpleasant to rely on the scoundrels who 
troubled the royal family,
but desperate times call for desperate measures.

column3:
ふん、交渉が心配だ
――いいだろう、あたしが行くよ
column4:
Hmph, I'm uneasy about the talks.
—Very well, I'll go myself.

column3:
んじゃ、さっさと動こうぜ
俺たちの動きもいつまで隠せるか分からねぇ
column4:
Well then, let's move quickly. 
We don't know how long we can keep our 
movements hidden.

column3:
それでは一度解散としよう
隊長、ジリアンとともに、頼んだぞ
column4:
Let's disband for now.
Captain, Gillian, I'm counting on you.

column3: 外の音、臭いがわかるだろうか
column4: Can you recognize the sounds and smells outside?

column3:
メガドでの敗戦の後――これを機にと
オークどもが大挙し攻め寄せてきたのだ
column4:
After the defeat at Megado, 
taking this opportunity, 
the Orc horde launched a full-scale attack.

column3: 控え目に言っても劣勢
column4: To put it mildly, we are outnumbered.

column3:
でも――
軍を率いてるのは、あの"戦の将"
column4:
But... the person leading the
army is that "War Master"

column3: 見方を変えれば絶好の好機
column4:
From a different perspective, 
it's a great opportunity.

column3:
うむ、奴を仕留めることができれば
メガドは将を失うことになる
column4:
Mm, if we can take him down, 
Megado will be leaderless.

column3:
あんたたちは、まず、遊軍として
城内の敵を掃討しておくれ
column4:
Begin by clearing the castle of enemies as a
reconnaissance unit.

column3: 王子はあたしとメイロワで守ってみせるよ
column4: I'll protect the prince with Meirova.

column3: わたしも遊軍として動くね
column4: I'll be part of the reconnaissance unit too.

column3:
この展望城――再びオークには渡せません
皆さん、よろしくお願いします
column4:
Lookout Castle—
We cannot let it fall to the orcs again.
Everyone, I count on you.

column3: こっちにはいない

いいか、ジリアン
王子の行方不明は他言無用だ
column4:
Listen, Gillian,
don't tell anyone else the prince is missing.

column3:
まだ横たわる闇は大きく
結末の見えない戦いが控えてはいたが――
column4:
The darkness still looms large,
and a battle with no clear end is ahead, but—

column3:
今はただ白竜の復活を喜ぶ時とばかりに
レスタニアの人々は歌い、踊った
column4:
For now, the people of Lestania sang and danced,
rejoicing in the revival of the White Dragon.

column3: しかし、彼らはまだ知らなかった

アッカーシェランの覚者であるネド王子の
秘めたる計画を
column4:
... The secret plans of Prince Nedo, 
the Arisen of Acre Selund.

column3: こっちにはいない

いいか、ジリアン
王子の行方不明は他言無用だ
column4:
Listen, Gillian,
don't tell anyone else the prince is missing.

column3:
まだ横たわる闇は大きく
結末の見えない戦いが控えてはいたが――
column4:
The darkness still looms large,
and a battle with no clear end is ahead, but—

column3:
今はただ白竜の復活を喜ぶ時とばかりに
レスタニアの人々は歌い、踊った
column4:
For now, the people of Lestania sang and danced,
rejoicing in the revival of the White Dragon.

column3: しかし、彼らはまだ知らなかった

アッカーシェランの覚者であるネド王子の
秘めたる計画を
column4:
... The secret plans of Prince Nedo, 
the Arisen of Acre Selund.

column3: エリオット――いいのか？

心配かけちゃいましたね
それで、王子はやっぱり――
column4:
I'm sorry for causing concern.
So, the prince is indeed—

column3: ああ、戻らない

王子のことは気掛かりだが――
これ以上、事態を引き伸ばすことも叶わぬ
column4:
I'm concerned about the prince, but—
we can no longer afford to delay the situation.

column3:
王子の足の運びを考えると、あと少しで
悪しき竜の元へ辿り着くはずだよ
column4:
Considering the prince's pace, he should be
reaching the Evil Dragon soon.

column3:
全てが予定通りという訳にはいかなかったが
我らと大陸の未来は決することになろう
column4:
While things didn't go exactly as planned, 
our fate, and that of the continent 
will be decided.

column3:
ずっと、悪しき竜に踏み潰されるか
焼き殺されることばかり考えていたんだ
column4:
I've been constantly thinking about either being
crushed or burned alive by the Evil Dragon.

column3:
ほら、エリオットを残して隊長たちが
レスタニアに帰って――
column4:
Look, with Elliot left behind and the captain
and others returning to Lestania—

column3:
また戻ってきた、あの日までね
あの日、わたしは、本気で希望を信じることにした
column4:
I came back again, up until that day.
On that day, 
I resolved to genuinely believe in hope.

column3:
あなたたちがいなかったら
わたしはここまで戦えなかった
column4:
Without you all, 
I couldn't have fought to this point.

column3: ――ありがとう

レスタニアじゃあな、事が終わる前に
礼を言うのはひどく縁起が悪いんだ
column4:
In Lestania, thanking someone before
things are finished is considered bad luck.

column3: そうなの？　じゃあ、取り消すよ
column4: Really?　Then I take it back.

column3:
では隊長、いよいよですね
精一杯、王子の力になってあげましょう
column4:
Well then, Captain, it's finally time.
Let's do our best to help the prince!

column3:
きっと、うまくいくよ
理由はわからないんだけど――
column4:
I'm sure it'll work out.
I don't know why--

column3:
近くに隊長を感じると、勇気とか力が
湧いてくるんだよね
column4:
When the captain is near, I feel my courage and
strength growing.

column3: ああ、まるで竜の加護の如くってやつだな
column4: Ah, it's like the dragon's blessing, isn't it?

column3: 隊長は不思議な人だね
column4: The Captain is a strange person.

column3: 本当に

さあ、思い残すことがなくなったんなら――
出発するぞ
column4:
Now, if you've got nothing left to think about--
we're off!

column3:
フィンダムで起こったことは
レスタニアの使者の方から聞いています
column4:
The Lestanian emissaries have told me what
happened in Phindym.

column3:
これがどれほど深刻な事態なのか
わかっているつもりです
column4:
I believe I grasp the severity
of this situation.

column3:
火竜の竜力は今、僕の中にあります
黒竜を倒すということであれば――
column4:
The Fire Dragon's power now resides within me.
If it's to defeat the Black Dragon—

column3: 何事ですか！?
大陸の各地に闇の魔物が現れました！！
column4: Dark beasts have emerged throughout the continent!

column3:
すでにメイロワ将軍が中心となって
対応に当たっていますが――
column4:
General Meirova is already leading the response efforts,
but—

column3:
同時にメガド上空に大きな黒い渦が出現し
このままでは王都が闇に呑まれてしまいます！
column4:
At the same time, 
a large black vortex has appeared above Megado, 
and if things continue like this,
the royal capital will be engulfed in darkness!

column3: わかりました、すぐに向かいます
隊長、皆さん――
ああ、わかってる、任せろ！

王子、大丈夫
やっつけてから、話の続きをしよう
column4:
Prince, everything will be fine. 
After we handle this,
we can continue talking.

column3: さぁ、行きましょう、隊長！
城内の敵がやけに少ない
column4: There are awfully few enemies in the castle.

column3: 陽動の効果？
それにしても少ねえぞ
column4: Even so, there are fewer than expected.

column3: 隊長、黒騎士はいったいどこに――
column4: Captain, where the hell is the Black Knight...

column3: 迷うな！　将の首を目指すぞ！
column4:
Don't get lost! 
We're going for the general's head!

column3:
もうひと押し――
離れずに固まって動くよ！
column4:
One more push—
stay close and move together!

column3: ウッ！
ああっ？
これ――なに？
力が――
気分も悪いかも――
column4: I might not be feeling well either—

column3: あれは――

ガハハハ！　愚かなヤツラめ
まんまとかかりおったわ！
column4:
Gahaha! You fools,
you fell for it completely!

column3: 敵の姦計――！！
黒き騎士の力を思い知るがいい！
column4:
You will come to understand the power of 
the Black Knight!

column3: まずい、囲まれる――

無念――！！
引き上げるぞ！

退路を失えば全滅するぞ！
全員、来た道を戻れ！　退却だ！
column4:
If we lose our way out, we're done for!
Everyone, return the way you came! Fall back!

column3: 隊長！
ジリアン、状況を！

見ての通り、このあたりのオークは追い払った
戦の将を討ったお陰で、メガドの戦力は落ちている
column4:
As you can see, the Orcs around here are gone.
Taking down the War Master 
has weakened Megado's forces.

column3: ジリアンの獅子奮迅の活躍に心が震えました
column4: Gillian's heroic efforts moved me deeply.

column3:
そこに隊長たちが参戦してくれるのですから
我々の勝利は確実
column4:
Now that you captains are joining the battle,
our triumph is certain.

column3: ここは一気に押し込むべきと思いますが
column4:
I believe now is the time 
for a decisive push forward.

column3: 仰せの通り
さあ、ネド王子！
集いし我が臣民、いや同志たちよ
column4: Gather together, my subjects, nay, comrades.

column3:
皆の知る通り、この地は絶望の沼に
沈みかけていました
column4:
As we all know, this land
was about to sink into a swamp of despair.

column3:
僕らは敗北と死に慣れてしまって
心を奮い立たせる術を忘れてしまっていた
column4:
We became so used to loss and death,
we forgot how to stir our hearts.

column3:
でも、そんな日々はもう終わります
活気と笑顔でいっぱいの王都メガドを思いだそう！
column4:
But those days are coming to an end.
Let's remember Megado, full of life and smiles!

column3:
それはすぐそこにあるんだ
少し手を伸ばせば、取り戻すことができるんだ
column4:
It's right there.
If we just stretch out a bit, we can reclaim it.

column3:
僕らのメガドにやつらの居場所はない！
さあ、皆で追いだしてやろう！
column4:
There's no place for them in our Megado!
Come, let's drive them out together!

脅してさらなる情報を引き出したり
諜報で新たな《証拠》を探すのもいい

column4:
You can threaten them to extract more information 
or search for new evidence using intelligence
— think about it again.

column3:
――は？

column4:
- Huh?
What are you talking about?

column3:
とぼけているようには見えない――
その選択は、事実と異なっているようだ
column4:
It doesn't seem like he's playing dumb-- 
That choice appears to be incorrect.

column3: もう一度、良く考えてみろ
もう沢山だ！！

のんびりとお喋りするつもりはない
一度痛い目を見ないと、どうやら
この男には分かってもらえないらしいな
column4:
I'm not here to have a leisurely chat. 
It seems this man won't understand 
until he experiences some pain.

column3:
覚者、少しあっちを向いていろ
お前に見せるには
少し刺激が強いからな――
column4:
Arisen, look away for a moment.
What I'm about to do is a bit too intense for 
you to see.

column3:
まったく、手こずらせやがって
明日はもう少し喋る気になるだろう――
column4:
You're a real hassle.
By tomorrow, you'll be more willing to talk.

column3: さぁ、何について尋ねようか？
column4: Now, what shall I ask about?

column3: 身元について
《証拠》を確認する
――今日はやめる

さて、<NPC 691>――
一体何者なのか教えてもらおうか
column4:
Now then, <NPC 691>—
it's time you tell us who you really are.

column3:
名乗るほどのモンじゃねえよ――
字も書けなきゃ、宿も無し
その日暮らしの無頼漢さ
column4:
Not worth introducing—
no writing skills, no home,
just a vagabond scraping by.

column3:
ふざけるな！
お前はナヴィドの屋敷から出た俺達を尾行していた
――ヤツの手の者か？
column4:
Cut the crap!
You were tracking us after we left Navido's place.
—Are you one of his lackeys?

column3:
ナヴィドって――<NPC 681>・クルト侯爵のことか？
おいおい、何の話か知らねえが面倒事はごめんだぞ！
column4:
Navido? As in Marquis Kurt <NPC 681>?
Hey, whatever this is, 
count me out of your problems!

column3:
チッ――おとなしく答えてはくれないか
コイツが<COL ff2600>ただのゴロツキではない可能性を示す
《証拠》</COL>があればいいんだが――
column4:
Tch... He won't talk easily.
We need some 
<COL ff2600>evidence to show he's more than just a thug...</COL>

column3: さぁ、どうする？
column4: So what are we going to do?

column3: 脅す

ちゃんと挨拶したのか？
column4:
The one in charge of your gang around here 
seems to have changed.
Have you introduced yourself yet?

column3:
は――あ、当たり前だろ
急になんだよ
column4:
Ah, of course I did.
What's with the sudden question?

column3:
そのリーダーはある特技があるらしくてな
なんと――縄張りにいる奴ら全員の顔と名前を
記憶しているんだそうだ
column4:
Apparently, the leader has a special skill
- he remembers the faces and names
of everyone in his territory!

column3:
さっき俺は、「挨拶をしたか？」と聞いた
――それにお前は「当たり前だ」と答えた
column4:
Earlier I asked you, "Did you say hello?"
-- to which you replied, "Of course."

column3:
ならば、当然リーダーは
お前のことを知っているはずだろうな？
column4:
If so, of course the leader
should know about you, right?

column3:
だが、アイツははっきりと
「<NPC 691>なんか知らない」と言っていた
column4:
However, he clearly said
"I don't know anything about<NPC 691>"

column3:
そ、そんな――
たまたま忘れていただけって可能性もあるだろ！
column4:
W-well, that's just—
It's possible he just happened to forget!

column3:
それはない――このリストを見ろ
これには、メガドの宿無したちが全員記されている
column4:
That's not possible— 
Look at this list. 
It includes everyone without a home in Megado.

column3: なんだと――！？

最近は、憲兵の取り締まりやらオークの襲撃やら
物騒なことが増えているから――ということらしいが
column4:
Lately, 
with increased patrols by the Military Police and 
attacks by orcs, 
it seems there's been more unrest.

column3:
ご立派なことに、自警団ヅラして
水面下でこんなモンを作成していた
column4:
Impressive, 
pretending to be a noble vigilante while secretly 
making something like this.

column3:
当然、このリストにお前の名前はない
――お前は一体何者だ？
column4:
Of course, your name is not on this list
--who the hell are you?

column3: く、くそぉ――

よし、言い逃れできないところまで追いつめたぞ
別の《話題》も聞いてみるか
column4:
Got you cornered with no way out now. 
Let's ask about another topic.

column3:
この男――<NPC 691>の身元か
結局分からず仕舞いだったな
column4: We still haven't figured out this man's identity—<NPC 691>.

column3: ――ただのゴロツキだって

少なくともただのゴロツキではないことは判明した
――この"証言"でな
column4:
At least we've confirmed 
he's not just a common thug—
thanks to this "testimony."

column3:
コイツから引き出せる情報はまだあるはずだ
尋問を続けよう
column4:
There must be more information we can extract from this guy.
Let's keep interrogating him.

column3: さぁ、何について尋ねようか？
column4: Now, what shall I ask about?

column3: Ａ、身元について
Ｂ、尾行の目的
Ｃ、本当の正体
《証拠》を確認する
――今日はやめる

ところで――
尾行の目的はなんなんだ？
column4:
By the way--
what's the purpose of the tail?

column3:
尾行？
ハッ――もっと可愛いもんだろ

ちょーっと――
後をついて行っただけじゃねえか

何の目的で？
一目惚れでもしたってのか？
column4:
For what purpose?
Love at first sight?

column3: ハッ、惜しいな

そこで眺めてるヤツが、メガドを解放した
張本人だってのは一目見て気付いた
そして思ったのさ――相当懐も温かいはずだ、とね
column4:
The person watching from that spot is clearly the 
one who freed Megado. 
It was obvious just by looking. 
I figured they must be quite wealthy.

column3: なるほどな、そりゃ納得だ

オーク軍を壊滅させた戦士を
一介のゴロツキでしかないお前が追い剥ぎか
column4:
Is someone as insignificant as you, 
just a common thug, 
really going to rob the warrior who wiped 
out the Orc army?

column3:
お――俺達には失うモノなんて無いからな
一攫千金を常に狙ってんだよ、文句あんのか？
column4:
W-We've got nothing to lose, 
so we're always aiming for a big score. 
Got a problem with that?

column3:
そうか――
覚者とやり合って、勝てる勝算はあったんだな？
column4:
I see—
so you thought you had a chance of winning 
against the Arisen?

column3:
そんなのいちいち計算しねーよ
ひらめいて、体が勝手に動いちまった
column4:
I don't calculate that every single time.
I got inspired, and my body moved on its own.

column3:
――なぁ
頼むよ、ほんの出来心なんだよ、許してくれ
column4:
Look, it was just a lapse in judgment. 
Please, forgive me.

column3:
――だ、そうだ
なんとかこの話を覆せる《証拠》はないものか――
column4:
--So.
Is there any way to counter this with 
some evidence?

column3: 脅す

あの辺り――
ずいぶんと子供が多いようだな？
column4:
In that area―― 
It looks like there are a lot of children, 
doesn't it?

column3:
あ？　ああ――
みんな戦争で親とはぐれたり、失ったりで
身を寄せ合って暮らしてるのさ
column4:
What? Oh―― 
They've lost their parents or been separated from 
them because of the war, 
so they're sticking together.

column3:
お前が衝動的に、俺達を追い剥ぎしようと
尾行したあの時も――傍に子供がいたみたいだな
column4:
When you followed us impulsively to rob us, 
it seems there were children nearby as well.

column3:
あの辺りは毎日彼らが見回りをしているそうだ
――もちろん知っているな？
column4:
Apparently, 
they keep watch over that area every day—
I'm sure you know that, right?

column3:
その子は、お前の顔を見たことがあるそうだ
しかも、何度も――な
column4:
That kid has seen your face before.
And more than once--yeah.

column3:
その子の話によると、お前――
コソコソしながらずいぶんと熱心に
何かを書き付けていたそうじゃないか
column4:
According to the boy, you--
were sneaking around and writing
something down with a lot of enthusiasm!

column3:
お前――
「字も書けなきゃ宿も無い」んじゃなかったのか？
column4:
You--
I thought you said "no writing skills, no home"?

column3:
あの日も、お前が物陰でせっせと
メモしていた姿を目撃したそうだ
column4:
That day, too, it seems that they saw you busily 
taking notes in the shadows.

column3:
ずいぶんと――
"用意周到な追い剥ぎ" だな？
column4: Seems like you're a "well-prepared mugger," huh?

column3:
ここまで《証拠》は揃っているんだ
いい加減に――――
column4:
Evidence has been gathered up to this point. 
It's about time to――――

column3: なっ――！

それで勝ったつもりか？
バカバカしい！
column4:
And you think you've won?
That's ridiculous!

column3:
《証拠》なんて物で追い詰めたつもりだろうが――
憲兵の取り調べごっこはもう終わりだ！
column4:
You thought you could corner me with this 
"evidence," but―― 
The charade of the 
Military Police interrogation is finished!

column3:
俺がお前たちを尾行してメモしていたって？
それを子供が見ていたって？
――それを確固たる《証拠》だと言い張るのか？
column4:
I was following you guys and taking notes?
A kid was watching it?
— Are you arguing that's solid "proof"?

column3:
子供がなんと言おうと、身体検査された時に
そのメモが出てこなかった――
column4:
Even if the child says otherwise, 
that note wasn't found during the body check.

column3:
それこそが動かぬ事実だ
そうだろう、覚者さんよぉ――
column4:
That is the irrefutable truth. 
Isn't that so, Arisen--

column3:
――やれやれ
"<NPC 691>が書いていたメモ"――
その現物を見せるまで一歩も譲らないつもりか
column4:
--Well then. 
Are you set on not giving in until you see the 
actual note written by <NPC 691>?

column3:
覚者、この勝ち誇った腹立たしいツラに
そのメモとやらを突きつけてやろう
column4:
Arisen, let's shove that note into 
this smug, infuriating face.

column3: 脅す
《証拠》を突きつける
もどる
――それで勝ったつもりか？
――なに？

お前が言っているそのメモ――
もしかして、この汚い紙束のことか？
column4:
That note you're talking about--
Could you possibly be talking about this 
dirty stack of papers?

column3:
字が汚くて読みづらいが――どうやら
覚者がとった行動が事細かに書かれているようだな
column4:
The writing is sloppy and difficult to decipher, 
but it appears to describe the Arisen's actions 
in meticulous detail.

column3: い、いったい――
一体どこで手に入れたかって？
column4: Where the hell did you get it?

column3:
上手く隠したつもりかもしれないが――
子供ってのは、見つけちゃいけないものを
うっかり掘り返す天才なのさ
column4:
You may think you've hidden it well--
Kids are geniuses at accidentally digging
up things they shouldn't find.

column3: くそ――くそ！！

さて――こいつが俺達を尾行して
行動を探っていたということは
尾行メモの存在によって判明したな
column4:
Well--we know that this guy was following us and 
probing our activities because of the existence of
the tailing notes.

column3:
だが、ただの熱狂的ファンというにはあまりに――
内容が隙を突くことに特化しすぎている
まるで――暗殺を狙っているかのようにな
column4:
However, it's too focused on exploiting 
vulnerabilities to be merely that of an 
enthusiastic fan. 

It's almost as if they're aiming for 
assassination.

column3:
やったな、新しい情報を入手したぞ
やはり、この男の背後には
大きな影が動いているようだ
column4:
Well done, we've acquired new information. 
It appears that a significant force is at work 
behind this man.

column3:
俺はそれが――<NPC 681>だという確信がある
だが、まだ証拠が弱い
column4:
I'm reasonably sure it's <NPC 681>,
but the evidence is still weak.

column3:
――さぁ、尋問を続けよう
必ずヤツの尻尾を掴んでやる！
column4:
Let's resume the interrogation. 
We're going to get to the bottom of this!

column3:
<NPC 691>が書いたメモの発見によって
やはり俺達を複数回に渡って尾行していたことが
判明したな
column4:
The memo written by <NPC 691> reveals that we 
were tracked on several occasions.

column3:
だがその動機――
そしてこいつがただのゴロツキでないのなら
一体何者か、それはまだ謎のままだ
column4:
But the motive--
and if this guy isn't just a thug,
who the hell is he? 

That remains a mystery.

column3:
初めての尋問にしては良い調子だぞ
その調子で、さらなる情報を引き出すんだ
column4:
This is a good start for a first interrogation. 
Keep this pace to get more information.

column3:
そろそろ、お前の正体を
教えてくれてもいいんじゃないか？
column4:
Isn't it about time 
you tell me who you really are?

column3:
だーかーら、何度も言っているだろ
俺はメガド生まれメガド育ち、生粋の風来坊さ
column4:
I keep saying it—I'm from Megado, born and raised. 
I'm a genuine drifter.

column3: 全く――埒が明かないな

一体俺に何の恨みがあってそこまで言い張るんだ？
本当の正体を現せ、なんて
column4:
What grudge do you have against me to insist 
so much? 
Just reveal your true identity already.

column3:
大体、そこまで言うなら《証拠》が
あるんだろうな？
決定的な "俺の正体を示す《証拠》"が――
column4:
If you're going to insist so much, 
then you must have "evidence," right? 
Concrete "proof" of my true identity――

column3: それを見せない限り、俺はもう一言も喋らないぜ
column4:
I'm not saying another word 
unless you show that to me.

column3:
やれやれ――縛られてるってのにずいぶん強気だな
覚者、今持っている《証拠》をもう一度
よく見直してみるんだ
column4:
Good grief―― 
Even though you're tied up, 
you're quite confident. 

Arisen, take another close look 
at the "evidence" you have.

column3:
その中に、コイツの正体を絞り込めそうな――

可能性でもいい、それらを<COL ff2600>連続で突きつけてやれ！</COL>
column4:
Is there any evidence among those that could help 
narrow down this guy's identity―― 
for example, any <COL ff2600>"Commonalities"</COL> 
that could be significant?

<COL ff2600>Present them one after another!</COL>

もどる

なるほど、これだな
それから？
column4:
Understood, this is it. 
What's next?

column3:
確かに、《薄汚れたメモの束》と
《憲兵の警ら日誌》――
この二つには "共通した書き方" があるみたいだな
column4:
Certainly, "Bundle of Dirty Notes" and
"Military Police Patrol Log" —
seem to have a "common writing style".

column3:
この事実から考えられる、<NPC 691>の正体――
それは一体何だと言うんだ？
column4:
From this fact, 
the possible identity of <NPC 691>--
what the heck would you say that is?

column3: 解放軍兵士
メガドのゴロツキ
憲兵
あああああ、くそ！！！

ああそうだよ！
潜入諜報任務中だったのに、ターゲットに
あっさり捕えられちまった間抜けな憲兵さ！！
column4:
Yeah, that's it! 
I was a fool of a Military Police officer who got 
caught by the target during a covert mission!

column3:
でかしたぞ、覚者
大当たりだ！
column4: Good job, Arisen. You hit the jackpot!

column3:
やはり<NPC 681>から、俺達を尾行するよう
命令を受けていたのか？
column4:
So, you were indeed 
ordered by <NPC 681> to follow us?

column3:
さぁ――どうだかな
俺は上官から命令を受けて動いているだけだ
誰が元締めだかなんて、興味ねえよ
column4:
It's not my concern.
I'm just following the orders I was given.
Who's actually in charge doesn't matter to me.

column3:
それよりも、だ――
本当にマズいのはお前らの方だぞ
column4:
More importantly, though—
You're the ones who are really in trouble.

column3: ――どういう意味だ？

憲兵を捕まえて、監禁と尋問なんか――
イタズラで済むような内容じゃないぜ
column4:
Capturing a military police officer, 
locking him up and interrogating him--
This isn't just some prank.

column3: ハッ、そんな脅しでいまさら怖がると思うのか？
column4: Ha, you think such threats will scare me now?

column3:
いいや、それだけじゃない
お前ら――侯爵様に楯突いているとかいう
レジスタンスだろ？
column4:
That's not the whole story.
You're—
resistance members who are opposing 
the Marquis, aren't you?

column3:
このメガドを護っているのは
侯爵様や、俺たち憲兵隊――それが常識だ
column4:
It's understood that the marquis and our 
military police are the ones protecting Megado.

column3:
もし口封じに俺を殺しでもしてみろ
死体が上がれば犯人はお前たちだとすぐに分かる
column4:
If you kill me to cover this up, it will be clear 
that you're the ones responsible as soon as 
my body is discovered.

column3:
そうなれば、レジスタンスは市民の敵と化すだろう
オーク騒ぎがやっと落ち着いた後での、すぐだ
気の立った市民たちはどうすると思う？
column4:
If that happens, the resistance will become the 
enemy of the people. 
It will be right after the orc disturbances 
finally settle down. 

What do you think the angry citizens will do?

column3:
――レジスタンス狩りが始まるだろうな
無駄な血が流れることになるぜ、お前らのせいでな
column4:
--The resistance hunt will start.
There will be a lot of unnecessary bloodshed, 
because of you guys.

column3: 勝手なこと言いやがるぜ

だが怪我をしたのはこちらだけじゃない――
コイツも、下手を打って俺たちに囚われているという
ボロを出してるんだ
column4:
But it's not just us who are hurt—
he's also shown his weakness by getting 
captured by us.

column3:
さぁ、調子に乗っているその口に
《証拠》をねじ込んでやれ
column4:
Now, 
shove that evidence right into his cocky mouth.

column3:
自分の状況を思い出し――
行く末に震え上がる、決定的な《証拠》をな！
column4:
Think about your own situation —
the conclusive evidence that leaves you 
quaking about what's to come!

column3: 脅す
《証拠》を突きつける
もどる

フン、なんだその汚い紙束は――
そんなもんで許しを請おうってか？
column4:
Hmph, what's with that pile of filthy papers? 
Are you trying to beg for mercy with that?

column3:
これは、元は憲兵として活躍していた男が
獄中で書いた手記だ
column4:
This is a diary written by a former 
military police officer during his time in prison.

column3:
そ、それがなんだってんだよ
騎士だろうが憲兵だろうが全員が善人って訳じゃねえ
column4:
Well, so what?
Whether you're a knight or a 
military police officer, 
not all of us are good guys.

column3:
――いいやこの男は善人だった
ただ少し、任務に失敗しちまったんだ
column4:
No, this man was a good person. 
He just failed a mission.

column3:
よく聞けよ、<NPC 691>
手が使えないお前の為に読み上げてやる
column4:
Listen carefully,<NPC 691>.
I'll read it aloud for you 
since your hands are bound.

column3:
"それからすぐ同僚の憲兵たちが家に押しかけてきた
  昨日まで背中を預けた相手に縛り上げられるなんて
  一体誰が予想できる？"
column4:
"Soon after, my fellow military police officers 
came barging into my home. 
Who could have predicted being bound by those 
I trusted just yesterday?"

column3:
"獄中の暮らしは、外界から完全に断絶されていて
  残してきた病気のお袋が心配だ"
column4:
"In prison, there's a complete disconnection from 
the outside, and I'm anxious about my sick 
mother whom I left behind."

column3:
"ネド王子の安否は？　オーク軍はどうなった？
  くそ、あんな小さなミス一つでこんな仕打ち！
  もう許せない、俺は出るぞ" ――
column4:
"What about Prince Nedo's safety? 
What happened to the Orc army? 
Damn it, 
to be treated like this over such a small mistake!
 I can't forgive this—I'm getting out of here!"

この手記を俺たちに手渡してすぐ絶命した
column4:
After he escaped from prison, 
he couldn't withstand being chased by the 
military police and died right after handing over 
this note to us.

column3:
さて――お前は今、任務に失敗して敵に捕らえられ
あまつさえ秘匿情報も漏らしている
column4:
Now then-- 
you've failed your mission, 
been captured by the enemy, 
and even leaked confidential information.

column3:
本当に許しを請うべきなのはどちらか――
わかるな？
column4:
You should understand which of us 
should truly be asking for forgiveness.

column3:
そう落ち込むな
お前にはひとつ、道がある
column4:
Don't be so depressed.
There is a single path for you.

column3:
俺たちに協力し、知る情報を全て提供してくれ

望むものを与えてやる
column4:
Help us and give us all the information you know
and we'll give you either 
personal safety or a way out--
whatever you want.

column3:
お、俺に憲兵隊と侯爵様を裏切って
レジスタンスに入れって言うのか？
column4:
Oh, you want me to betray 
the Military Police and the Marquis
and join the resistance?

column3:
おかしいとは思わないか？
オークの脅威が去って、平和になったはずの街で
今度は憲兵の横暴に脅かされている――
column4:
Don't you think it's strange?
A city that was supposed to be at peace after the 
orc threat was over is now threatened by the 
brutality of the military police--

column3: ――無理だ

諸悪の根源である侯爵――
<NPC 681>を打ち倒してこそ真の平和が訪れる
そうは思わないか
column4:
True peace will come only when the root of all evil, the Marquis--
<NPC 681> is defeated.
Don't you think so?

column3:
――何と言われようと無理なものは無理だ
投獄だろうと処刑だろうと甘んじて受け入れる
column4:
No matter what they say, the impossible is impossible.
I'll accept whatever it is - be it prison or execution.

column3:
くそ！
一体何が、ヤツをここまで頑なにさせる！？
column4:
Damn!
What the hell is making him so stubborn?

column3:
コイツは間もなく堕ちる――
あと一押し、何か《証拠》は無いのか！
column4:
This guy is going to give up shortly...
One more push, is there any more evidence we can use?

column3: 脅す
《証拠》を突きつける
もどる

ある老人から預かったものだ
彼は息子を亡くしたと話していた
column4:
I got this from an old man;
he told me he lost his son.

column3:
男手一つで育てた息子を憲兵隊に送り出した後

column4:
After sending out his son, who he raised himself, to the military police;
he lost contact and assumed his son was killed in the line of duty.

column3: お、親父―――

ほう、やはりお前の親父さんか
なぜ連絡してやらない？
column4:
I knew it; he's your father.
Why didn't you contact him?

column3:
家族と連絡を取れば、危険が及ぶからと――
上官に忠告を受けて――
column4:
My superiors told me not to contact my family 
because it might put them in danger...

column3:
なるほど、そうやって反乱の芽を
摘みやすい環境を作っている訳だな
繋がりを絶たせておけば、切り捨てるのも容易――
column4:
I see, that's how they make it easier to nip rebellion in the bud.
It's easier to eliminate them if you keep them disconnected from others.

column3:
<NPC 691>――頼む
親父さん、そしてお前自身のために
レジスタンスに協力してはくれないか？
column4:
<NPC 691>--Please
for the sake of you and your father;
Will you help the resistance?

column3:
――――わかった、俺の負けだ
あんたらに協力するよ
column4:
---- Okay, I give up.
I'll help you guys out.

column3:
俺の知っていることを話せばいいんだな

column4:

-- but since I'm a bad person, I don't think you guys know much about what you'd expect from

column3:

column4:
Oh, that's fine!
Please let me hear it!

column3:
覚者、よくやったな
<NPC 691>は完全に落ちた――尋問成功だ！
column4:
Well done, Arisen. 
<NPC 691> has fully broken down—
interrogation successful!

column3:
さぁ、コイツの持つ情報を全て聞き出そう
これで<NPC 681>のヤツに大きく近付けるぞ！
column4:
Now, 
let's find out all the information this guy has.

With this we'll get a lot closer to <NPC 681>!

column3:
さぁ、あとは持っている情報を全て聞き出すだけだ
何から聞こうか？
column4:
Next, we need to get all the details. 
What will you start with?

column4:
The Military Police?
Well, again, it's hard to explain..

column3:
侯爵家直属の兵隊だな
オーク撤退後のメガドにおいて
強権統治の実働隊として動いている
column4:
It's a soldier directly under the Marquess's family, isn't it
in Megado after the Orc retreat, and
is operating as a working force for powerful rule

column3:
あー、つまり――
過激な治安維持部隊ってところだ
column4:
Ah, I mean... it's a
radical security maintenance force

column3:
正直言うと、市民はみんな憲兵に怯えてる
反抗的な態度や怪しい行動は
取締りの対象になるからな
column4:
To be honest, all citizens are afraid of military police
because any rebellious attitudes and suspicious behavior are subject to
enforcement.

column3:
そうと分かっていながら
なぜ所属していたんだ？
column4:
Knowing that,
why were you a part of it?

column3:
実は――
金が良いんだわ、これが
column4:
As a matter of fact...
The pay is good - it really is.

column3:
まぁ、稀に今回のような息の詰まる
特別任務が与えられることもあるが――
column4:
Well, in rare cases, you'll be given a breathtaking
special mission like this one...

column3:
良い給料で、市民に大きな顔できる上
オークとも戦わなくて済む
――最高の仕事だろ？
column4:
A good salary, a big impression on the citizens
and not having to fight against orcs
— best job ever, right?

column3: オークと戦わなくて済む――だと？
column4: You don't have to fight against orcs?

column3:
"オークとの戦闘は、王国兵士に任せておけ
  憲兵隊は、人間の相手をするのが仕事"
――ってことらしい
column4:
"Leave the orc fighting to the soldiers of the kingdom.
The Military Police are supposed to deal with humans."
That's what they said.

column3: ま、俺が知っているのはこれくらいかな――
column4: Well, I think that's all I know.

column3: ナヴィド・クルト侯爵ねぇ――

一応憲兵隊の指揮権を持ってるって話だけど
俺らみたいな下っ端じゃ
そうそうお目にかかれないぜ
column4:
He supposedly has command over 
the military police, 
but someone like us low-ranking folks won't get 
to see him very often.

column3:
むしろ覚者さん
あんたの方が詳しいんじゃないのかい？
column4: In fact, aren't you more familiar with it, Arisen?

憲兵隊を創設したのは<NPC 681>様だったな
column4:

column3:
先代侯爵が亡くなって、爵位を継いだ<NPC 681>様が

column4:
After the previous marquis passed away, 
<NPC 681> inherited the title and 
apparently made various improvements. 

I don't remember the details, though—

column3:
まぁ、なんだかんだでメガドがここまで
発展してきたのは、<NPC 681>様の功績も
大きいって訳よ
column4:
Ultimately, <NPC 681>'s accomplishments are 
a major reason for how far Megado has come.

column3:
おいおい、そんな怖い顔すんなって！
俺が知っているのはこれくらいだな
column4:
Hey hey, don't make such a scary face!
That's all I know.

column3:
レジスタンスぅ？

なってるぜ
だが――
column4: Mephis, you're on the wanted list for sure. But—

俺の知る限り、レジスタンスを大々的に
どうこうするって話はまだ聞いてねえなあ

plans to deal with the resistance yet.

column3:
まだ、そこまで危険視は

column4:
So, the resistance isn't 
considered a major threat yet?

column3:
だな

侯爵側の持っている情報が少なすぎるってのもある
column4:

information about the Resistance 
on the Marquis's side.

column3:
――あるいは、全て筒抜けだからこそ
軽んじられているのか――
column4:
--Or maybe it's being downplayed precisely 
because everything is leaked?

column3:
いずれにせよ、侯爵様のご関心はレジスタンスより

column4:
In any case, the Marquis seems to be interested in
the Arisen rather than the Resistance -- you

After all, what was the mission you were 
given this time around?

column3:
そりゃあもちろん、覚者さんの尾行・行動監視だ
それを逐一メモして、上官に提出する
column4:
Well, of course, it's tracking and 
behavior monitoring on the Arisen.
Write it down one by one and submit it.

column3: 一体指令は誰が出している？

直接の伝令は上官からだよ
で、任務についての詳しい質問や詮索は
許可されていない
column4:
The orders are given by the superior officer. 
Detailed questions or probing about the 
mission are not allowed.

column3:
だが噂では――指揮しているのは
侯爵家の家令、<NPC 586>さんだとか
column4:
But according to rumors, the one in command is 
<NPC 586>, 
the steward of the marquis' household.

column3:
<NPC 586>――か
覚者、お前は顔を見たことがあるかもしれんな
column4:
<NPC 586>—I see. 
Arisen, you might recognize their face.

column3:
まぁ、あくまで噂だぜ
<NPC 586>さんが独断で指揮しているのか
さらに上から命令を受けているのかは定かじゃない
column4:
Well, it's just a rumor. 
I'm not sure if <NPC 586> is directing this 
on his own or if he's taking orders from
further up the chain.

column3: あぁ、分かっている

この先は<NPC 586>とかいう侯爵家の家令が
鍵となりそうだな――
column4:
In any case, this information is 
quite useful, Arisen! 
The steward of the Marquis, 
<NPC 586>, 
seems to be the key moving forward.

column3:
――これで、俺が知っていることは
全て話したぞ
column4:
--That's it.
I've told you everything I know.

column3:
――覚者、次のターゲットは<NPC 586>だ

それとなく身辺を探ってくれ
column4:
Arisen, the next target is <NPC 586>. 
When you head to 
<NPC 681>'s estate next time, 
subtly investigate the surroundings.

column3:
なぁ、他に道も無いんだし
最後までレジスタンスに付き合うからさぁ――
column4:
Look, there's no turning back now, 
so I'll see this through with the Resistance.

column3: そろそろ解いてくれねえか？
column4: Isn't it about time you untied me?

column3:
――ヤツもこう言っていることだし
そろそろこの尋問を終えようか
column4:
――Given what he's said, 
we should bring this interrogation to a close.

column3:
フフ――正直、お前がここまでやるとは予想外だ
よく頑張ったな、覚者
column4:
Huh - honestly, 
I didn't expect you to make it this far.
Good job, Arisen!

column3:
<NPC 691>を落とせたのはお前の力だ
次もよろしく頼むぞ、相棒――
column4:
It was your skill that took down <NPC 691>. 
Let's work together again, partner.

おい！　
自分がどういう状況か分かっているのか！？
column4:
Hey!

column3:
おい、急になんだよ！
ただのゴロツキだって言ってるだろ！
column4:
Hey, what's going on!? 
I've already said, I'm just a lowlife!

column3:
そうか、ならばそれを証明できる
人物はいるんだな？
column4:
Well, then there's a
person who can prove it, right?

column3:
あ、あぁ――！
もちろんだ！

覚者、ゴロツキの身分を証明できるという
人物を探してみよう
あるいは――証明できないという証明でもいい
column4:
Arisen, let's try to find someone who can vouch 
for this thug's identity.

can't back up his story will suffice.

一体どういうつもりで尾行した！？
column4:
Hey, come on!
What the hell were you thinking following me?

わっ――なんだよ驚かすな
衝動的な追い剥ぎだって言ってるだろ
column4:
Hey—what's going on?

I'm just a spur-of-the-moment bandit!

衝動的な、か――
ならば、衝動的じゃない《証拠》があれば
認めるんだな？
column4:
Impulsive, huh--
So if we have "proof" that it's not impulsive,
you'll admit it?

column3: ハッ、そんなもんある訳ないだろ

――目撃者がいてもおかしくないな
column4:
If he was really following us, 
he would have surveyed the nearby terrain and
our movements in advance.
--I wouldn't be surprised if there were witnesses.

column3:
俺達の尾行時につけていたメモを出してみろ

column4:
You want me to hand over the notes I took 
while tailing you—huh?

column3:
どこにあるかお前が一番よく知ってんだろうが！
隠したんだろう？
場所を言え！！
column4:
You know best where it is!
You hid it, didn't you?
Tell me where it is!

column3:
し、知らねえよ！
そもそもあんな、何もない場所で隠しても

column4:
I-I don't know! 
Hiding something in a place like that, 
it'd be found right away!

column3:
――覚者、<NPC 691>は確保されるまで

column4:
Arisen, <NPC 691> must have had that note 
until they were captured.

moment of their capture.

いずれにせよ、現場から離れていないはずだ

覚者、行ってみよう
column4:
—In any case, it shouldn't be far from the scene.

to our meeting place. Let's head over, Arisen.

column3:
おい、いい加減時間稼ぎは止めろ！
痛めつけられたいのか？
column4:
Hey, come on, stop stalling!
You want to get hurt?

column3:
な、何か他の《証拠》でもあるってのか！？

あんまりじゃねえか！
column4:
—Do you have any other "evidence"

based on just one strange note!

column3:
少し外で頭でも冷やしてきたらどうだ？
冷静になって
自分の馬鹿な行いを見つめなおして来いよ！
column4:
—Why don't you go outside and cool 
your head a bit?

at your foolish actions!

column3:
――コイツの言うことも一理ある

column4:
—There's some truth to what this guy is saying.

reconnaissance mission, explore places you 
haven't been to yet, 
and fight enemies you haven't faced.

column3:

evidence closely against that memo.

憲兵めが、自分の状況をわかっているのか？

column4:

I could end them whenever I choose!

column3:
フン――今さらそんな脅しが通じるか
捕まった失態は、貴様らの逮捕で
挽回してやるからな
column4:
Hmph—
do you really think those threats will 
scare me now? 
I'll redeem myself for getting captured 
by taking you down!

column3:
――あの無慈悲な侯爵が、こんな大失敗を

column4:
――Do you think the unforgiving marquis will 
let a failure this big slide for a simple 
accomplishment like that?

column3:

column3:

column4:

military police in the alleys of Megado...

column3:

思わない――というより
思いたくても、思ってはいけないんだ
所属している限りはな
column4:

column4:

column4:
You will all be killed!
After the capture of Megado, 
it's time once more to be soaked in human blood!!

Have you been in Megado since it 
was under Orc occupation?

column3:

常ニ最前線ニ、在ルコトコソ戦士ノ証
column4:
Well, of course! 
Always being on the front lines is the mark of a warrior.

column3:

一体誰ガ事態ヲ伝達スル！
column4:
If the humans start a foolish rebellion, 
who will report the situation if 
there are no messengers?

column3: ――覚者、聞いたか？

どうやらこのオークは

column4:
It appears this orc is knowledgeable 
about Megado during its occupation.

街に増えるオークどもの真意も気になるが――
column4:
We might be able to gather 
evidence of Navido's wrongdoings. 

I'm also curious by the true motives of the 
growing number of orcs in the city.

column3:
まずは上機嫌で口が軽くなっている今
占領下の<NPC 681>の情報を聞き出そう
column4:
Since he's in high spirits and more 
inclined to talk, 
let's extract information about <NPC 681> 
during the occupation period.

column3:
このオークは繰り返していた――
"今にオークの仲間が、体勢を立て直し

column4:
The Orc repeatedly said—
"Soon, my fellow Orcs will recover, re-attack 
Megado, and come to rescue me."

column3:
グアハハ！　ソウダ！
ヤット命乞イヲスル準備ガデキタカ！
column4:
Guahaha!　That's right!
I'm ready for you to beg for your life!

column3:
確かに、街にはオークが増えている
目撃者の証言によると
"奴らは何かを探しているようだ"――だとさ
column4:
The orcs are indeed increasing in the city. 
Witnesses say, 
"They seem to be searching for something."

column3:
その《証拠》を突きつけたせいでヤツは今

column4:
Confronting him with that "evidence" has put him 
in a surprisingly good mood—giving us a chance. 
He should be more forthcoming 
about other "topics" now.

column3:
伝令兵なのに、前線で動いていたなんて

column4:
You're a messenger and you've been 
working on the front lines.
You've been on some pretty dangerous missions, 
haven't you?

column3:
グァッハッハッハ！ 
当然ダ

column4:
Guhahaha! 
Of course,
it's dangerous, an honorable mission!

Being on the front line meant that there were 
many opportunities to interact with humans, right?

column4:
Navi - what?
I can't remember every single human name!

column3:

column4:
You should be able to recognize a messenger if 
you've interacted with them multiple times. 
Is the name not enough?

column4:

let's make him reveal everything he knows

そうだな――まずはメガドで

column4:
Indeed――first, let's verify the truth of the 
legend of <NPC 681>, 
which is becoming common knowledge in Megado.

It seems that Navido was the human leader during 
the occupation of Megado.

人間達をまとめ、オーク達との間を

column4:

and mediated with the orcs—can you confirm that?

column3:

column4:
Ugh...

and manage the slaves...

column3:
市民たちの話は事実だった、のか？

column4:
So the citizens were telling the truth?
So he really was innocent--

column3:
ケッパク――潔白――？
グフ――グッフッフ――

――なんだ

column4:
Is there more about <NPC 681>'s 
behavior you haven't mentioned?

column3: フン――

――オークよ
俺たちはナヴィドがどんな裏切りをしたか知り
罰を与えたいだけだ
column4:
—Orc, 
we seek only to uncover Navido's treachery 
and see him punished.

column3:
さぁ、聞かせてくれ――
人間の分際で、ナヴィドは
どんなことをしたか教えてくれ
column4:
So, tell us—
what did Navido do, despite being just a human?

column3:
――ガッハッハ！
人間ノ罰ナド、何ノ面白味モ無イガ
受ケルノガ、アノ人間ナラバ――面白ソウダ
column4:
Gahahaha! 
A human punishment is dull,
but if it's that man, it could be entertaining.

column3:
ヨク聞ケ！
アノ人間ハ、モウヒトツ取引シテイタ
column4:
Listen to me!
That human being is a deal breaker.

column3:
<COL ff2600>めがどヲ自ラ

column4:
<COL ff2600>Megado opened its gates to our Orc army
in exchange for supplies and spoils!</COL>

column3:
――メガドの功労者ナヴィド侯爵の
明るみになっていない事実
column4:
――The hidden truths
about Marquis Navido, the hero of Megado.

column3:
ナヴィドとオークの癒着――
ついに、決定的な悪事を突き止めたぞ
column4:
Navido and Orc collusion--
Finally, we've pinpointed the definitive evil!

column3: さぁ、詳しく聞き出さないとな
column4: Come on. We've got to get the details.

column3:
《証拠》のおかげでオークはやっと
<NPC 681>のことを思い出したようだな
そして――
column4:
Thanks to the evidence, the orc has finally
recalled <NPC 681>. And now――

column3:
奴は、自らメガドをオークに明け渡したこと――
オーク軍と交渉し、人間の統率を行う代わりに

column4:
It was revealed that he himself had
surrendered Megado to the orcs—
that he negotiated with the orc army
and received rewards from them in return
for managing the humans.

column3: 人間ノ分際デ――！
column4: For someone of his lowly human status—!

column3:
まさか、下っ端と思われたオークの口から
核心を聞き出すことができるとはな――
さぁ、さらに話を聞いて行こう
column4:
Who would have thought we'd get essential info 
from a lowly orc—
Let's keep probing for more.

column3:
メガドがあまりにも早く陥落したのは
ナヴィドの手引きがあったからか――
column4:
The reason Megado fell so quickly was 
because of Navido's assistance--

人間ガ――人間ノ分際デ

column4: A human—striking deals with orcs, of all things!

column3: そんな取引をオーク軍が許したのか？
column4: Did the orc army actually permit such a deal?

column3: グルァァ！！

落ち着け、お前がなぜ怒るのか――教えてくれ
その取引に応じたのは――
column4:
Relax. 
Why does this anger you? 
Who made the deal?

column3: 俺ナラ！　許サナカッタ！
column4: It was me! I didn't approve!

column3:
ならば、応じたのは――お前の上官なんだな？
お前の意志ではなかったと
column4:
So, 
it was your superior who agreed to it, not you?

column3: ガァァァ！！！

オーク軍にも酔狂な奴がいるもんだな
あるいは――その時にはまだ
人間と取引をする心の余裕があったのか
column4:
The Orc army has its own oddities. 
Alternatively――
maybe they still had some tolerance for 
negotiating with humans at that time.

column3: ウガァァァァ！！

まずいぞ、オークが興奮してきた――
だが話は繋がってきたな
column4:
This is bad, the Orc is getting agitated―― 
but the story is coming together.

column3:
ナヴィドはオークと取引し
降伏してメガドを明け渡した
column4:
Navido made a deal with the Orcs, 
surrendered, and handed over Megado.

column3:
そして占領下の市民たちを指揮し
まるで英雄のように振る舞っているが――
裏ではオークと癒着し私腹を肥やしていた
column4:
And while he leads the citizens under occupation 
and acts like a hero, behind the scenes he was 
colluding with the Orcs and enriching himself.

column3:
――とはいえ
オークの証言だけでは糾弾する証拠として
あまりにも弱い
column4:
-- Nevertheless, the orc's testimony alone 
is too flimsy to be considered solid 
evidence for an indictment.

column3:
何か、<NPC 681>が私腹を肥やしていたことの

column4:
Unless you have some
concrete "proof" that <NPC 681>
was lining his own pockets...

日付や数字のリストのようだが――

-- what's this?

よくやったぞ、覚者！
column4:
I see.

orc army's supply and expenditure records—! 

Well done, Arisen!

column4:
Well— 
we've gotten quite close to the core of the matter. 
But there's still more to uncover from this orc. 
Stay sharp and focused until the end, partner.

column3:
まさか、オーク軍が<NPC 681>の取引に
応じるとはな――
<NPC 681>とオーク軍はズブズブの関係だった訳だ
column4:
It's surprising that the orc army would agree to 
<NPC 681>'s terms.

had a close relationship.

column3:
そしてこの "侯爵家の出納帳"という《証拠》――
これはその不正を暴くカギとなるだろう
column4:
And this "Marquise's Treasurer's Ledger" -
- will be the key to uncovering that fraud.

column3:
この帳簿を、オーク側の証拠と照らし合わせられれば
――確実に<NPC 681>の悪事を証明できるぞ
column4:
If we can match this ledger with 
the evidence on the orc side

-- we can certainly prove 
<NPC 681>'s wrongdoing!

column3:
さぁ、後はオーク軍側の証拠の在処さえ
聞きだせれば、すべて終わりだ
尋問は残すところあとわずか――頼んだぞ
column4:
Now, we just need to find out where the 
orc army's evidence is stored, 
and it will be all over. 

The interrogation is almost done—
give it your best effort.

column3: ナヴィドとオーク軍の癒着の証拠――
column4: Evidence of collusion between Navido and the orc forces--

運んだ伝令文書などは

column4:
Are the messenger documents you carried
still there?

column4:
Hmph, what's the point now--
Yet, staying silent at such a 
critical moment is troublesome.

column3:

column4:

column3:

column4:
Arisen, start by seeking out the man

column3:
このオークを落とす最後の《証拠》――
それさえ手に入れてくれれば

column4:
The last piece of "evidence" to bring 
this orc down-- If you can get that,
I'll definitely take care of the rest.

column4:
Even if you try to be loyal--
it looks like it's too late for you, man.

column4:
Look-- it was dropped by the
orcs that were hanging around Megado.

column3:
お前を探す、オーク軍の指名手配書だ

column4:
This is a wanted poster from the Orc army, 
searching for you.

looking for allies, but for fugitives like you.

column3:
人間との取引後に突然姿を消したんだ

column4:
After the deal with the humans, 
he vanished without a trace.

would suspect betrayal.

column3:

俺ハ裏切ッテナイ――
column4:

I haven't betrayed anyone--

column3:
まだ悪あがきするつもりか？
もうお前にオーク軍へ戻る道はない
column4:
Are you still trying to make a valiant stand?
There is no way for you to 
return to the Orc army now.

column3:
なぜなら――
もう多くのことを喋り過ぎちまったからな
column4:
Because--
I've already said too much.

column3: 脅す

お前は興奮して
よく覚えていないかもしれんが――
column4:
You may not recall everything due to your 
excitement, but—

column3:
メガド陥落以降のオーク軍内部情報を

column4:
You've blurted out all the internal details of 
the Orc army since Megado's fall.

column4: If captured, you'd certainly face execution.

column4:

The documents on internal communications――

As long as we get the documents,

Collect evidence and information on the main

to bring them to justice.

column4:
The orc is already defeated—
after getting all the information,
