細長くうねった川と切り立った崖で構成された峡谷
古代からの遺跡が多くのこる地域であり、文化的に
重要な地帯である。この辺りに住む人々も、伝承や
習慣などを重視した生活を送る傾向にある
column4:
An area composed of a narrow, winding river and
steep cliffs, forming a gorge.
It is a region with many ancient ruins remaining,
making it culturally significant.
The people living in this area tend to prioritize
traditions and customs in their way of life.

column3:
キンガル峡谷に位置する村
近くに多数のこる遺跡や神殿などの古代文明に
畏怖の念を抱き、古くからの伝統や伝承などを
現在に伝え継いできた一族が住んでいる
村の掟として、村人が遺跡に近づくことを禁じている
column4:
Village located in Kingal Canyon.
Nearby are numerous ancient ruins and temples
that belong to a long-lost civilization.
The villagers, who have lived here since ancient
times, hold a deep reverence for these sites and
their traditions and legends.
As a village rule, the villagers are forbidden
from approaching the ruins.

column3:
キンガル峡谷北部に位置する小塔
通常の拠点ではなく塔の中で暮らすことを
選んだ一族が暮らしている。住人は独自の
文化を継承しているらしく、殆ど小塔の外に
出ないように生活している
column4:
There is a small tower located in the northern
part of Kingal Canyon.
There, a clan has chosen to live inside the tower
instead of a regular settlement.
The residents seem to have inherited their own
culture and live their lives mostly without
venturing outside the tower.

column3:
キンガル峡谷西部にある川岸
《芯なる樹》を非常に近くから眺められるほか
崖に近寄ることで、その根元を見ることすら
可能。ただし、現在は獣の死骸を目当てに
寄ってくる魔物に注意が必要である
column4:
On the riverbank in the western part of Kingal
Canyon, you can admire the "Core Tree" from a very
close distance.
By approaching the cliffs, you can even see its
roots.
However, caution is necessary as there are
currently monsters that come near in search of
animal carcasses.

column3:
グリンデュア対岸にあたる拓けた河岸
以前はこの河岸から河に出るための船が
出ていたが、ある頃から人や積み荷の
上げ降ろし中に魔物に襲われることが
増えたため、現在は使われていない
column4:
On the opposite bank of Glyndwr, there is a wide
riverbank.
In the past, boats would leave from this bank to
go out onto the river.
However, at some point, the number of attacks by
enemies during the loading and unloading of people
and cargo increased, so the boats are no longer in
use.

column3:
キンガル峡谷中央部、遠浅の川岸が続く一帯
この周囲は人が歩いて渡れるほどに浅い岸が
広がっている。また、魔物が食い散らかしたと
見られる魚や動物の死肉が大量に流れ着いており
風向きによっては悪臭が漂う日もあるようだ
column4:
In the central part of Kingal Canyon, there is an
area where the riverbank is shallow enough for
people to walk across.
The surrounding area is extensive, with what
seems to be a large amount of dead fish and
animals that have been devoured by enemies.
Depending on the wind direction, there are days
when a foul smell lingers in the air.

column3:
《シェドレアン大神殿》の門前にある広場
荘厳な神殿を臨むこの場に似合わず、辺りには
獣の死骸が散らばり、死臭が立ち込めている
魔族の影を見たという報告もあるため、通行時には
十分な警戒が必要である
column4:
In front of the gate of the "Shadolean Great
Temple", there is a plaza.
Despite its majestic temple, there are animal
carcasses scattered around, and the stench of
death fills the air.
There have also been reports of sightings of
fiendish creatures, so caution is necessary when
passing through.

column3:
グリンメル遺跡の近くにある川岸
以前は遺跡への参道だったが、土が水に削られてゆき
現在は完全に川の中に沈んでしまっている
見かけより水深はないため、子供でも歩いて
渡ることが可能である
column4:
A riverside near the Grinmel Ruins.
It used to be a pathway to the ruins, but the
soil was eroded by water and now it has completely
sunk into the river.
Despite appearing treacherous, the water depth is
not significant, so even children can walk across
it.

column3:
キンガル峡谷西部にある拠点跡地
この村が滅んだ理由は明らかになっていないが
周辺の状況から、局所的な飢饉に襲われ
抵抗する力が落ちていたところへ魔物の襲撃を受け
全滅したのではないかと言われている
column4:
Village ruins located in the western part of
Kingal Canyon.
The reason for the village's demise is still
unclear, but it is said that it was attacked by
monsters when its resistance was weakened by a
localized famine.
It is believed that the village was completely
wiped out.

column3:
元々はフィンダムの大地へ、そして竜のために季節
ごとの舞踊が奉納されていた広場。侵食によって
フィンダム全域での危険度が増したことでこれらの
行事は中止され、以来本来の使い方をされることは
無くなった
column4:
A square originally dedicated to seasonal dances
dedicated to the dragon.
Due to the increase in danger throughout Phindym
caused by the Corruption, these events were
canceled and have since ceased to be used for
their original purpose.

column3:
グリンデュア対岸に位置する古代神殿の遺跡
内部は活性化したデーモンが多数巣食っている
ところどころにそう古くはない書籍などが
散乱しているところから、最近まで何らかの
施設として利用されていた様子が垣間見える
column4:
Situated across from Glyndwr, there are the
remains of an ancient temple.
The interior is inhabited by numerous active
demons.
Scattered throughout are relatively new books and
materials, indicating that it was recently used as
some kind of facility.

column3:
<COL ffdc78>【宝飾】の扉あり</COL>
キンガル峡谷にある遺跡
当時の覚者を導いたとされる巫女が祀られている遺跡
周りを山脈に囲まれているせいか、元は大地を巡る
竜力の恩恵を受けやすい立地であった
column4:
<COL ffdc78>【Jewelry】 Door</COL>
An Arisen is said to have been guided by a maiden
who is enshrined in the ruins of Kingal Canyon.
The ruins are surrounded by mountains, making it
a location that was easily influenced by the
blessings of Dragon Force, which once circulated
the land.

column3:
キンガル峡谷に悠然と佇む古代神殿
数百年前に遺棄されたものの、当時満ち満ちていた
竜力によって未だ壮麗な姿をそのままにしている
遺棄された理由は、恐らく精霊竜自身が神殿よりも
《芯なる樹》の傍にあることを好んだためだろう
column4:
Standing gracefully in the Kingal Canyon, the
ancient temple remains magnificent, even after
being abandoned hundreds of years ago.
It still retains its grandeur, thanks to the
Dragon Force that once thrived here.
The reason for its abandonment was likely because
the Spirit Dragon preferred to be near the "Core
Tree" rather than the temple itself.

column3:
《イヴァノスの塔》付近にある大遺跡
倒壊はしているものの入口付近には飾柱も
多数のこっており、豪華な造りだったことが
うかがえる。壁面には何らかの呪印が刻まれて
いるらしく強い魔力の痕跡がある
column4:
Near the "Tower of Ivanos" there is a large
ancient ruin.
Although it has collapsed, there are numerous
decorative columns near the entrance, suggesting
that it was once splendidly built.
The walls are engraved with some kind spell,
leaving traces of intense magic power.

column3:
<COL ffdc78>【竜力】の扉あり</COL>
以前は旅商人たちが頻繁に利用していたらしいが
少し前からピクシーたちに乗っ取られた状態にある
奥へ行くほど侵食が進んでいるため、内部に
入り込もうとした者も途中で引き返してきたという
column4:
<COL ffdc78>【Dragon Force】Door</COL>
It seems that in the past, it was frequently used
by traveling merchants, but for a while now, it
has been taken over by Pixies.
The further you go inside, the more the
corruption is apparent.
Those who tried to enter have turned back halfway.

column3:
侵食が拡がっているほか、それ以前からも盗賊に
よってひどく荒らされた形跡が生々しく残る
活性化したデーモンが巣食っており、侵食によって
さらに凶暴化した状態で跋扈している
column4:
The corruption is spreading, and there are clear
signs of extensive damage caused by bandits even
before that.
Demons have taken up residence and are rampaging
in a more aggressive state due to the corruption.

column3:
多彩な獣が棲息し、アッカーシェランにおいて
国内有数の狩場となっている山麓
まっすぐに伸びる良質な木材にも恵まれており
近隣に棲む人々の多くは狩猟、もしくは林業で
生計を立てて暮らしている
column4:
Various animals inhabit the foothills and it has
become one of the top hunting grounds in the
country.
The foothills are also blessed with high-quality
timber that stretches straight.
Many of the nearby residents make a living
through hunting or forestry.

column3:
西部にはアッカーシェラン最大の湖《翡翠湖》が
広がっているのが最大の特徴。
その大きな湖からもたらされる恵みの一つが
大振りで上品な味の魚であり、地域の村や
集落には独自の魚料理が発達している
column4:
In the western region, the largest lake in Acre
Selund, known as "Emerald Lake," spreads out,
which is its main feature of area. One of the
blessings brought by this large lake is the large
and elegant-tasting fish, which has led to the
development of unique fish cuisine in the local
villages and settlements.

column3:
解放軍が拠点として使っている小さな集落
元はきこりが使っていたらしき空き家を中心に、
逃げ延びた人たちがテントを張って暮らしているが
いつオークに攻め込まれるかわからない状況にある
column4:
The small settlement used as a base by the
Liberation Army.
It originally consisted of vacant houses,
seemingly once occupied by lumberjacks.
Now, people who managed to escape have pitched
tents and are living there, constantly facing the
uncertainty of when they will be attacked by Orcs.

column3:
600年ほど前に建造された砦
アッカー家が並み居る地方豪族を倒して
大陸統一を果たした後に、対オーク用に強化されて
現在に至る。長く役目を果たしていたが"悪しき竜"
出現直後にオーク軍に占拠された
column4:
A fort that was built about 600 years ago.
After the Acre family defeated the local feudal
lords, they strengthened it to fend off the Orcs
and it has remained that way to this day.
It had served its purpose for a long time, but
was occupied by the Orc army shortly after the
appearance of the "Evil Dragon."

column3:
翡翠湖を臨む、長くロスギル家が治める地方の中心地
魔物が多い地帯ならではの重装家屋が見られる
王族アッカー家から一帯の守護を任されてきた
ロスギル家の末裔を長に頂き、忠誠心に篤い人々が
暮らしている
column4:
Overlooking Emerald Lake, in the heart of a
region long ruled by the Rothgill family.
One can see the sturdy houses characteristic of
this land abundant in enemies.
Tasked with protecting the entire area by the
noble Acre family, descendants of the Rothgill
family serve as its leaders, with loyal and
devoted individuals living here.

column3:
一部では"南の盗賊"と呼ばれる大盗賊ベルタ
率いる盗賊団の隠れ里。湖に流れ込む川に
よって浸食されてできた洞窟でもある
並の人間では辿り着くことができない場所に
あるといわれている
column4:
A hidden village of a notorious bandit group led
by the great bandit Bertha, also known as the
"Bandit of the South."
It is said to be located in a cave formed by
erosion from a river that flows into the lake, in
a place that cannot be reached by ordinary people.

column3:
隠れ村ピレモス付近にあるグリムゴブリンたちの
縄張り。見よう見まねで作ったらしき、オークや
人間の作るものに似た構造物が散見される
どうやらゴブリンたちもここを拠点とし
人間の動向を見張っているつもりのようだ
column4:
The territory of the Grim Goblins near Hidden
Village Piremoth.
Structures resembling those made by orcs and
humans can be seen, apparently made by mimicking.
It seems that the goblins consider this place
their base and are keeping an eye on the movements
of humans.

column3:
ロスギルにほど近い開けた高台
まだ拠点として使われている様子は
見られないが、魔狼たちがなわばりとして
警戒し続けていることから、ロスギルへ
攻め込む際の足掛かりとされる可能性がある
column4:
An open plateau, not far from Rothgill.
Although it doesn't appear to be currently used
as a base, there is a possibility that it serves
as a stepping stone for an attack on Rothgill, as
the demon wolves continue to guard it
territorially.

column3:
魔軍の襲撃により抵抗虚しく潰えた村
周囲の小さな集落を繋ぐ役割を果たしていた中心的な
山村だったが、それ故に早期に魔軍の襲撃を受けた
建物は一つ残らず破壊され、放たれた火が未だ燻り
続ける様には生々しい痛ましさが漂う
column4:
The village, which served as the central mountain
village connecting the surrounding small
settlements, was completely crushed by the raid of
the Demon Army.
Every building was destroyed without exception,
and the lingering fire still smolders, carrying a
raw and painful sensation.

column3:
解放軍が休憩をとるために設営した小さな小屋
オークたちの襲撃を受けた際に母屋以外は全て
破壊されてしまった。そればかりか、現在は
魔軍が利用している形跡すらみられる
column4:
The small hut set up by the Liberation Army for
rest was completely destroyed during the Orc
attack, except for the main house.
Not only that, but there are even signs that the
Demon Army is currently using it.

column3:
魔軍が休息地として利用している岩洞
入口からは想像がつかないほど大きく開けた内部
空間は一見休むに最適かと思えるが、じめじめと
しており、スライムなども発生しやすい。魔物ならば
いざ知らず人間はここで休む気にはなれないだろう
column4:
The demon army is using the cave as a resting
place.
The interior, which is much larger than one would
imagine from the entrance, seems like an ideal
place to rest at first glance. However, it is damp
and prone to slime and other creatures.
While demons may not mind, humans would not feel
inclined to rest here.

column3:
関所を守るように魔軍の大隊が留まっている拠点
設置された多数の大砲は解放軍の戦力を大幅に削いだ
運良く砲弾を逃れた兵もいたようだが、敵陣の
中で寡兵での戦いを強いられることとなったのは
寧ろ悲劇であった
column4:
The demon army's battalion is stationed at the
stronghold, as if guarding a checkpoint.
The numerous cannons that were set up
significantly depleted the liberation army's
forces.
Some fortunate soldiers managed to dodge the
cannonballs, but they were forced into a battle
with few troops within enemy lines.
It was a tragedy.

column3:
魔軍戦車《カトブレパス》が留められている広場
巨大且つ凶暴、全てを踏み砕きながら進む
カトブレパスだが、魔軍はそれをさらに武装させた
ものを"戦車"として使役している
column4:
The plaza where the demon army's tank,
Catoblepas, is stationed.
Gigantic and fierce, it crushes everything in its
path.
The demon army has further armed and prepared it
as a "tank" for their use.

column3:
他の拠点とは異なり、施設や柵の類が極端に少ない
魔軍拠点。何らかの理由で本来意図しなかった
場所に拠点を急造しなければならなかったのか、
あるいは柵を立てられない状況にあったのかは
偵察からの情報だけでは判断できない
column4:
Unlike other bases, this Demon Army stronghold
has extremely few facilities and fences.
It is unclear whether the base had to be hastily
constructed in an unintended location due to some
reason, or if they were unable to erect fences in
their current situation.
This cannot be determined based solely on
reconnaissance information.

column3:
オーク軍の将軍《獣の将》が支配する魔獣を
放している危険な区画が発見された
うろついている魔獣は獣の将が特に気に入って
いる個体であるとも、強化実験のために何らかの
特別な処理を施された個体だとも推測されている
column4:
A dangerous zone where the Beast Master of the
Orc army controls the beasts has been discovered.
It is speculated that the roaming demon beasts
are individuals that the Beast Master particularly
favors or individuals that have undergone some
special treatment for strengthening experiments.

column3:
一見よくある洞窟だが高低差が激しい
箇所があったり、より奥へ進んだ者がことごとく
戻らなかったという経緯から、近辺で育った
者はこの洞穴に近寄らないよう厳しく教え
込まれるという
column4:
At first glance, it appears to be a typical cave,
but there are steep variations in height, and
those who venture further inside never return.
People who grew up in the vicinity are strictly
instructed not to approach this cave.

column3:
廃村デニスィルの裏手にある古い地下水路
魔軍のオークが見張りについていることから
内部に何かが隠されているか、あるいは重要な
通路の一つとして見なされていると推測される
また、ティネス砦に繋がっているという説もある
column4:
Behind the deserted village of Denisyr, there is
an old underground waterway.
The fact that orc soldiers from the Demon Army
are stationed there suggests that something is
hidden inside or that it is considered an
important passage.
There is also a theory that it connects to Fort
Thines.

column3:
野生動物が棲みついている洞窟
特にめぼしい資源があるわけでもない場所
だったが、なぜか近年にわかに「奥に宝物が
隠されている」という噂が流れた
column4:
The cave where wild animals reside is not
particularly known for any valuable resources.
However, for some reason, a rumor has recently
spread saying that treasure is hidden deep within.

column3:
ダクレイム砦付近にある岩山の中に造られた遺跡
砦の付近という格好の場所にあるため、魔軍・人間
両勢力がこの遺跡を拠点として利用しようとしたが
共に最深部まで辿り着くことはできなかった
誰一人として生還者がいないため、その原因も不明
column4:
Ruins built inside a rocky mountain near Dacreim
Fortress.
It was a prime location, so both the Demon Army
and the humans tried to use this ruin as their
base.
However, neither of them were able to reach the
deepest part.
There were no survivors, and the cause is also
unknown.

column3:
ベルタ盗賊団のアジト近くに流れる地下水路
武装した魔獣が徘徊しているが、それを御す
オークの姿は確認されていない。盗賊団の
アジトを探すために放たれた魔獣が迷い込み、
そのまま帰還せず棲みついてしまったようだ
column4:
Near the hideout of Bertha's Bandit Group, there
is an underground waterway flowing.
Armed beasts roam around, but they are tamed.
No orcs have been spotted.
A magical creature that was unleashed to search
for the bandit group's hideout got lost and ended
up settling there.

column3:
アッカーシェラン王家に連なる者、または王家の
ためにその力を尽くした英雄たちが眠る祠
王家の治める地の中でもラスニテ山麓との
縁が深い英雄たちが祀られ、死した後も
人々を見守っているという
column4:
Shrine where the descendants of the Acre Selund
royal family, or the heroes who devoted their
power to the royal family, rest. Among the lands
ruled by the royal family, it is said that the
heroes who have a deep connection with the
Rathnite Foothills are enshrined and continue to
watch over the people even after their death.

column3:
本人が生前に希望、もしくは身寄りがないなど
特殊な事情を背負って散った戦士たちが葬られている
集団墓地。国が乱れる前までは専属の衛士によって
警備されていたが、現在は封鎖。内部がどのような状況
かもわからず、不気味な噂のみが広まっている
column4:
A collective graveyard where warriors who
perished under special circumstances, such as
having no kin, or expressing their desire for it
before their death, are buried.
Before the country fell into chaos, it was
guarded by dedicated soldiers, but now it is
sealed off.
The interior's condition is unknown, and only
eerie rumors have spread.

column3:
北東部には、アッカーシェラン王国にとっての要衝
である《展望城》が存在する。通常、王族が居留
することはなく、兵士たちによる防衛拠点として機能
していた。水脈が豊富である一方で水はけの悪い地質
であり、ぬかるみや滝が多いため足元には注意が必要
column4:
In the northeastern region, there is a critical
stronghold for the Kingdom of Acre Selund, called
"Lookout Castle."
It usually functions as a defensive base for the
soldiers and is not typically inhabited by the
royal family.
The area has abundant water veins, but due to its
poor drainage, there are many muddy areas and
waterfalls, requiring caution when walking.

column3:
戦禍を逃れてきた人たちが、森の中で
息を潜めるように、しかししたたかに支え合って
暮らしている非常に小さな集落
避難民の中に統率力に優れる者がいるらしく
今のところ比較的安定した生活を送っている
column4:
A very small settlement where people who have
escaped from the ravages of war live hidden in the
forest.
They support each other cunningly yet quietly,
living together.
Among the refugees, there seems to be someone
with exceptional leadership skills, and they are
currently leading a relatively stable life.

column3:
かつては蛮族の地と呼ばれた南部地方に睨みを
きかせる要衝として建造された
アッカーシェラン大陸ではメガド離宮、王都メガドに
次いで古い建造物。城主はアッカー家の当主だが
実質的な管理者である"城番"は兵士が就くことが
できる最高位とされている
column4:
In the southern region, which was once called the
land of barbarians, a strategic point was built to
intimidate the surrounding area.
It is the third oldest structure in the Acre
Selund continent, following the Megado Detached
Palace and the Royal Capital Megado.
While the lord of the Acre family is the castle
owner, the "Castle Sentinel", who is the actual
administrator, is considered the highest position
that soldiers can hold.

column3:
河の流れによって様々なものが漂着する河岸
上流から流されてきたものの中には、解放軍の戦士
たちだけでなく魔軍の獣の死骸も多数存在する
流れ着いた骸から出でたものか、死臭に惹かれて
きたものか、骨になっても徘徊する魔物が徘徊する
column4:
By the flow of the river, various things drift
and accumulate on the riverbank.
Among the things carried downstream, there are
not only soldiers of the Liberation Army, but also
many carcasses of the enemy's animals.
Whether they emerged from the washed-up corpses
or were attracted by the stench of death,
wandering monsters continue to wander even in
their skeletal forms.

column3:
丘の上を縄張りとするゴブリン族の住処
一際凶暴なグレーターゴブリン《小鬼殺しのオジナ》
がリーダーとなっている。オジナは仲間をも攻撃
する残虐さで群れを支配しており、手下たちは
恐怖からか異常なまでの興奮状態にある
column4:
Goblin territory on top of the hill.
Led by the exceptionally vicious Greater Goblin,
Ogina, known as the "Kobold Killer".
Ogina dominates the pack with his cruelness,
attacking even his own allies, and his
subordinates are in an abnormally excited state,
perhaps out of fear.

column3:
魔軍が進軍する際に通過する中継地
ここで一旦の補給や、オークたちが使役する
魔物の装甲を手入れしてから目的地へ出発
しているとの情報が寄せられている
column4:
Intermediate point through which the demon army
passes when advancing.
It has been reported that they temporarily
replenish supplies here and Orcs maintain their
armor before departing for their destination.

column3:
アッカーシェラン大陸の西域に広がる大湿地帯
その広さ故に、古来から戦場になることが多い
傷を負って死を待つばかりの兵たちの嘆きが
絶えることがなかったと伝えられている
column4:
The vast swamp spreads to the western region of
Acre Selund Continent.
Due to its size, it has often been a battlefield
since ancient times.
It is said that the lament of soldiers who were
only waiting for death while wounded never ceased.

column3:
フェルヤナ地方の外れにある門。そこを抜けると
魔軍の拠点に繋がるらしく、魔軍側も警戒を
強める最近では大門の前にまで野営地が拡がり
見張りの魔物が日夜目を光らせている
column4:
Gate located at the outskirts of Feryana region.
It seems to connect to the demon army's base, and
recently, the demon army has been increasing their
vigilance.
The encampment has expanded all the way to the
front of the main gate, and the guarding monsters
keep their eyes shining day and night.

column3:
年老いた奇面獣《ブルータルハーミット》の住処
人々の間ではその恐ろしさが代々語り継がれる
ほどであり、周囲に近寄ろうとする者はまずいない
しかし、魔軍はこの強力な奇面獣をなんとか利用
しようと捕獲を目論んでいるようだ
column4:
The lair of the aged beast, Brutal Hermit.
Its terror has been passed down through
generations, so much so that few dare to approach
it.
However, the Demon Army seems intent on capturing
and somehow harnessing the power of this
formidable creature.

column3:
森を抜けて展望城へと向かう兵士たちが
ことごとくこの周辺にて魔物の襲撃を受けている
どうやら人間を待ち伏せするに格好の場所
として魔軍に認識されているようだ
column4:
Soldiers heading towards Lookout Castle after
passing through the forest have all been attacked
by monsters in this area.
It seems that this place has been recognized by
the Demon Army as a perfect location to ambush
humans.

column3:
展望城の目前に広がる湿地帯全域を監視
している魔軍拠点。監視対象としている範囲が
広いため、魔軍に使役されるナイトメアが空からも
目を光らせる。要衝である展望城に近いせいか
数多くの兵器が配備されていることがわかっている
column4:
This is a base for the Demon Army that monitors
the entire marshy area that stretches in front of
the observatory castle. Because the area being
monitored is wide, nightmares are used by the
Demon Army keep an eye on it from the sky. It is
known that a large number of weapons are deployed
in the area due to its proximity to the Lookout
Castle, which is a key
point.

column3:
王家の次期当主がその力を示すために
代々使われてきた地下道。内部には強力な
守護者が配置されているとみられるが、これまで
王家の者以外が足を踏み入れられることは
無かったため、情報に乏しい
column4:
The underground passage that has been used by the
next head of the royal family to demonstrate his
power.
It is believed that powerful guardians are placed
inside, but there is little information as no one
other than the royal family has ever set foot in
there.

column3:
《森の隠れ村》にほど近い古い祠
アッカーシェランの大地に満ちた炎の気が滞留し
内部に足を踏み入れるとじっとりとした熱さを感じる
悪意を秘めたままに落命した者は、その悪意
を忘れ去るまで魂を焼かれながら祠を徘徊するという
column4:
An old shrine near the "Forest's Hidden Village".
It is filled with the lingering flame in the land
of Acre Selund.
Once you step inside, you can feel the damp heat.
It is said that those who died with malice in
their hearts will roam the shrine, their souls
burning until they forget their malice.

column3:
王族のみが知りえた隠れ道
有事の際は隠れ家としても使えるよう工夫されて
おり、最低限の施設は整っている
王家の統治が行き届くようになってからは
使われることもなくなり、忘れ去られていた
column4:
The hidden passage that only the royal family
knew about was designed to also serve as a hiding
place in times of emergency.
It had the minimum necessary facilities.
Since the governance of the royal family became
more meticulous, it was no longer used and
forgotten.

column3:
遺跡をそのまま活用した魔軍の拠点
しばらく出入りが途絶えた後も本拠点から
魔軍が進行するなどの様子から、一時的な
滞在ではなく、この場で一通りの生活が
できるように設計されているものと思われる
column4:
The demon army's base, which has been constructed
by utilizing ruins as is.
From the fact that the demon army continues to
advance even after there has been no activity for
a while, it is believed that this base is designed
for not just temporary stays, but for living a
complete life here after all.

column3:
古くより放棄されたままとなっていた地下水道
既に水はほぼ枯れたものと思われていたが
何者かが侵入した形跡が発見され、調査される
こととなった。内部にはおびただしいほどの不死者や
思念体がはびこっているが、発生の原因は不明
column4:
Long abandoned, the underground sewage system was
thought to have already dried up.
However, evidence of someone's intrusion was
discovered and further investigation was
initiated.
Inside, an overwhelming number of undead beings
were rampant, but the cause of their emergence
remains unknown.

column3:
アッカーシェラン王家に連なる者、または王家の
ためにその力を尽くした英雄たちが眠る遺跡
英霊は王家に危機が迫る時あらば再び
呼び声に応じ、その力を貸すといわれる
column4:
The royal descendants of the Acre Selund family,
or the heroes who exerted their power for the sake
of the royal family, rest in this shrine.
When the royal family is in imminent danger, it
is said that the heroic spirits respond to the
call and lend their power.

column3:
この大陸にアッカー王家が誕生する遥か昔から
大地を蝕む強大な魔物が棲息していた――という
話は、アッカーシェランの国民ならば一度は
聞いたことがある昔話である。物語の結末は
「魔物は王によって地下深く封印された」となる
column4:
Since ancient times, there has been a tale that
tells of powerful monsters residing in this land,
where the Acre royal family was born.
If you are a citizen of Acre Selund, you have
surely heard this story once before.
The conclusion of the tale is that "the monsters
were sealed deep underground by the king."

column3:
フェルヤナ荒原南部、多数のオークが出入りする洞窟
自然の洞窟を利用した拠点のように偽装しているが
内部が強力な兵器を集めた武器庫として使われている
ことは、時折洞窟の奥から響く轟音から明らかである
column4:
In the southern area of the Feryana Wilderness,
there is a cave where numerous orcs come and go.
It is disguised as a natural cave, but it is
evident from the occasional roar that echoes from
the depths of the cave that it is actually being
used as an arsenal gathering powerful weapons.

column3:
アッカーシェラン大陸のほぼ中央に位置する地域
荒涼とした風景が広がるこの地域には竜の神殿があり、
その神殿に寄り添うように王都メガドが建造された
要塞を思わせる王都はアッカー家三代目当主キリークの
治世に計画され、完成は十四代目当主ドラフの
即位目前であった
column4:
Located almost in the centre of Acre Selund, this
area is characterized by a barren landscape.
In this region, there is a dragon temple, and
adjacent to the temple, the royal capital of
Megado was built, resembling a fortress.
The construction of this royal capital was
planned during the reign of Kilik, the third head
of the Acre family, and it was completed just
before the coronation of Doraf, the fourteenth
head.

column3:
メガドシスの土地に焼きついた歴史の世界
悪しき竜が現れたことにより、各地を巡る竜力にも
異変が起きた。その結果、土地の持っている"記憶"
というべきものにすら歪みが生じているようだ
column4:
The world of history engraved into the land of
Megado.
Various anomalies have occurred in the Dragon
Force that travel across the land, due to the
appearance of the evil dragon.
As a result, even the "memories" that the land
holds seem to have become distorted.

column3:
メガド周辺を警備する目的で使われる監視塔
すでに地上階は魔軍により占拠されているが
魔物たちは地下階の存在には気付かなかったようだ
地下階には、メガド陥落の折に逃げ延びた兵士たちが
救援を信じ、息を殺すように潜んでいる
column4:
A surveillance tower is used to secure the
surroundings of Megado.
The ground floors have already been occupied by
the demon army, but it seems like they were
unaware of the existence of the underground
floors.
Soldiers who managed to escape during the fall of
Megado are hiding in the underground floors,
holding their breath as they believe in the
possibility of rescue.

column3:
王家に仕えるハイセプター、キルスティが住む小屋
魔物によって民が苦しむアッカーシェランを憂い
秘術であるハイセプターの戦闘術を世に広めんと
慣れぬあばら家で暮らしているらしい
column4:
The cottage where Kirsty, serving the royal
family, lives.
She worries about Acre Selund, where the people
suffer due to monsters.
Thus, she endeavors to spread the combat
techniques of the High Scepter, a secret art.
It seems that she lives in an unfamiliar, rundown
house.

column3:
城塞都市メガドにて一般市民が住まう居住層
メガド全体から見ると下層にあたり、大陸の人口の
過半数が暮らしていた
長きに渡り繁栄を誇っていたが、魔軍の急襲に
よって蹂躙され、多くの住民が命を落とした
column4:
Na camada residencial da Cidade-Fortaleza Megado,
onde cidadãos comuns residem, é conhecida como o
nível inferior e onde mais da metade da população
do continente vivia.
Prosperou por muito tempo, mas foi devastada por
um ataque repentino do Exército Demoníaco, e
muitos residentes perderam suas vidas.

column3:
白い木で作られた簡易な柵は、アンセスターオークが
縄張りを誇示する際に多用されるもの
賢明な旅人であれば忌避すべき"危険"の標である
column4:
The simple fence made of white wood is often used
by Ancestor Orcs to showcase their territory, and
it serves as a "danger" sign that wise travelers
should avoid.

column3:
火垂れ山から飛来した巨大な噴石とその周辺
岩は鳥が羽根を休め、獣が身を隠すのに
ちょうどよかったらしく様々な獣たちが住処として
いるようだ
column4:
A huge volcanic rock from the Firefall Mountain
and its surrounding rocks were perfect for birds
to rest their feathers and for animals to hide.
It seems that various animals have made this
place their habitat.

column3:
水辺に面した小さな洞穴
霧の森から漏れ出でたものが留まりやすい
風の音が何事かを囁いているように聞こえる
ことから、以前より不気味な噂が立っている
column4:
A small cave facing the water's edge where things
leaking out of the Forest of Mist tend to stay.
The sound of the wind seems to whisper something,
which has led to eerie rumors for some time now.

column3:
霧の森の中にある焼け野原
忌まわしい考えに取り付かれたある女が
多数の犠牲者を洗脳し、自ら炎の中へと
飛び込ませたという事件が起こった場所
事件から何十年と経過しているが、未だに
土は焼けたままであり草木も回復していない
column4:
A burnt field in the Forest of Mist.
This is where a woman obsessed with abominable
thoughts brainwashed numerous victims and forced
them to jump
into the flames themselves.
Decades have passed since the incident, yet the
soil remains burned and the grass and trees have
not recovered.

column3:
城塞都市メガドの城門外に設えられた詰所
元は商人らが優先的にメガドへ入るための手続きを
受けていた場であるが、現在は出撃の令を待つ
ドワーフオークや、軍属の獣たちがひしめいている
column4:
Outside the gates of the fortress city Megado,
there is a guard post set up.
Originally, it was a place where merchants would
go through the necessary procedures to enter
Megado.
However, it is now crowded with dwarf orcs and
military animals waiting for the order to march
out.

column3:
メガド居住層の奥に造られた野ざらしの牢屋
魔軍の襲撃から逃げられず、また不幸にも生け捕りに
された人々がドワーフオークから無残な拷問を受けた
であろうことは、その場に生々しく残る痕跡から容易
に察することができる
column4:
Hidden prison exposed beyond the depths of the
Megado residential layer; it is easy to deduce
from the vivid traces left behind that the
unfortunate individuals who were unable to escape
the onslaught of the Demon Army have fallen into
the hands of the Orcs and likely suffered gruesome
torture.

column3:
王家の命により封鎖されている地下道
王族関連施設に繋がるであろうという
推測以外、情報が無い場所でもある
何らかの意図を持って隠されている場で
あることは確かだ
column4:
The underground passage is sealed off by the
royal family's orders.
It is a place where there is no information other
than speculation that it may be connected to
facilities related to the royal family.
It is certain that it is hidden with some
intention.

column3:
城塞都市メガドの防衛の要となるニルビリス大橋と
その上に建つ関所。魔軍側も本関所の重要性は
理解しているらしく、防衛のために随時戦力を
割いている。関所の開閉については、魔軍の
集結具合と連動しているらしい
column4:
The Nilviris Bridge, which serves as a crucial
defense point for the fortress city of Megado,
accompanied by a checkpoint built on top of it.
It appears that the Demon Army also understands
the importance of this checkpoint, as they are
constantly dedicating forces to its defense.
The opening and closing of the checkpoint seem to
be synchronized with the gathering of the Demon
Army.

column3:
メガド城壁内、最奥に位置する広場
ドワーフオークが捕えた魔物に対して戦甲を
装着するために使われている。魔物は戦甲に
よって自らの意思を制御され、ドワーフオークに
使役される存在となる
column4:
Inside Megado Castle, at the very back, there is
a plaza where beasts captured by Dwarf Orcs are
dressed in battle armor.
The enemies are controlled by the battle armor,
making them subservient to the Dwarf Orcs.

column3:
フェルヤナ荒原の山壁側からメガドシス高地
中心部を繋ぐ通路。かつては頻繁に使われていたが
渓谷を渡る船や家畜を使っての山越えが主流となって
からは、たまに狩人らが利用するのみとなっていた
メガド周辺が魔軍に包囲された際、徒歩での脱出を
試みる者にはこの古道しか残されていなかった
column4:
From the mountain wall side of the Feryana
Wilderness to the center of the Megadosys Plateau,
there is a pathway.
It used to be frequently used, but now crossing
the mountains using livestock or ships to cross
the valley has become the mainstream.
Only occasionally do hunters use it now.
When the area around Megado was surrounded by the
Demon Army, those who attempted to escape on foot
had no choice but to use this ancient path.

column3:
大地の陥没からなる自然豊かな洞窟
目立たない場所に位置することと、陽の光が差し込む
構造から内部には緑が生い茂り、野生動物たちが棲む
今となっては、悪しき竜と魔軍の所業によって荒廃する
前の"アッカーシェランの自然"が残る貴重な場所
column4:
A natural and abundant cave formed by the
collapse of the surface.
Located in an inconspicuous place, it is filled
with greenery and inhabited by wild animals,
thanks to the structure that allows sunlight to
penetrate it.
It is now in a state of ruin due to the deeds of
the evil dragon and the demon army.
This is a precious place where the remnants of
the previous "Self" of Acre Selund remain.

column3: ニルビリス大橋からメガド居住層へと繋がる地下水路
column4:
From Nilviris Bridge, an underground waterway
leads to the Megado residential layer.

column3:
城塞都市メガド市民の生活を支える上水道
都市には無くてはならない設備だが、汚水を飲む
ことに慣れたドワーフオークたちは重要性を見出さず
魔軍の中継基地として使っている
column4:
Fortress City Megado's water supply supports the
lives of its citizens.
Although it is an essential facility for the
city, the Dwarf Orcs, who have become accustomed
to drinking sewage, fail to recognize its
importance and instead use it as a relay base for
the Demon Army.

column3:
メガド王宮層の周辺には王宮層を取り囲むように
複数の建造物が円形に立ち並び、それぞれ左右に
伸びた通路で繋がっている。元は回廊であったため
現在もそれらの建造物の総称として≪メガド回廊≫
という呼称が用いられている
column4:
Around the Megado Palace on the Megado Royal
Layer, multiple buildings are arranged in a
circle, connected by corridors extending left and
right.
Originally a corridor, they are still
collectively referred to as the "Megado Corridor."

column3:
城塞都市メガドの最上部に位置する王宮
王族とそれに連なる限られた者のみが居住する
ことを許された場所であり、厳重に守られている
一般市民がこの場を直に目にすることは
人生の中で恐らく一度も無いだろう
column4:
At the top of Fortress City Megado stands the
royal palace, a place allowed only to the royal
family and a select few.
It is heavily guarded and unlikely for ordinary
citizens to ever lay eyes upon in their lifetime.

column3:
メガド王宮層を囲むように建てられた建造物の内
聖堂として使われていた場所
王族の挙式や戴冠式の際は、大陸中から集まった
有力な貴族が一堂に会する
column4:
Within the buildings built around the Megado
Royal Palace Layer, a place that was used as a
cathedral.
During royal weddings and coronations, prominent
nobles from all over the continent would gather
together.

column3:
戦士の修行を目的とし、様々な種類の魔物が
わざと放たれている祠。以前は王族を護る者たちが
平時にあってもその腕を鈍らせないようにと鍛練に
励んでいた場所であるが、近年はひたすらに武を
誇る風潮が薄れたため使用されることも減り、内部の
魔物のみが取り残されている
column4:
The shrine, which is intentionally filled with
various types of enemies, serves as a training
ground for soldiers.
In the past, it was a place where those who
protected the royal family trained to keep their
skills sharp even during times of peace.
However, in recent years, the enthusiasm for
showcasing one's martial prowess has diminished,
resulting in a decrease in its usage.
As a result, only the monsters inside the shrine
remain.

column3:
ウルテカ山岳　西部、城塞都市メガドからは
北西にあたり、メガド離宮を通り抜けた先に
広がる一帯。周辺は火山地帯のため、緑が
少ないが、この一帯には珍しく草木が茂る様が
見られる
column4:
Located in the western region of the Urteca
Mountains, to the northwest of the fortress city
of Megado, it is an area that stretches beyond the
Megado Detached Palace.
Due to the volcanic nature of the surrounding
area, there is little greenery, but this area is
rare in that it is lush with vegetation.

column3:
城塞都市メガドからちょうど北側にあたる一帯
元々アンセスターオークの集落が多数存在しており
"悪しき竜"出現以前から危険な場所として
認識されていた。時折腕の立つハンターが
稀少な動植物を狙って立ち入るのみであり
人の手が殆ど入っていない
column4:
In the area just north of Fortress City Megado,
there were originally many settlements of Ancestor
Orcs.
It has long been recognized as a hazardous
location, even before the emergence of the "Evil
Dragon".
Occasionally, capable hunters enter only to
gather rare plants and animals, and there is
little human involvement.

column3:
城塞都市メガドの東側にあたる一帯
悪しき竜の影響により、炎を纏った数多の
命の残骸がさ迷い、徘徊している
悪しき竜の影響が色濃く出ている場所といえる
column4:
Located on the eastern side of the fortress city
Megado, this area is heavily influenced by the
evil dragon.
Numerous charred remains, engulfed in flames,
wander aimlessly, a testament to the dragon's
malevolence.

column3:
ウルテカの土地に焼きついた歴史の世界
悪しき竜の影響により、土地の持つ"記憶"
というべきものにも歪みが生じ、本来の
ウルテカの歴史とは異なった姿を見せる
column4:
The world of history engraved into the land of
Urteca.
Due to the influence of the Evil Dragon, even the
"memories" that the land possesses have become
distorted, showing a different appearance from the
true history of Urteca.

column3:
アッカーシェラン大陸の南部にアジトを構え
定住しつつ活動するベルタ盗賊団とは異なり
通称"北の盗賊"と呼ばれる彼らは、一定期間ごとに
アジトを変えて活動している。その姿勢からも
わかる通り、警戒心が強く、自らの存在を徹底的に
隠す傾向にある
column4:
Unlike Bertha's Bandit Group, who have a
stronghold in the southern part of Acre Selund,
they are known as "Northern Bandits" and change
their hideout at regular intervals.
They are very cautious and tend to conceal their
presence thoroughly, as can be seen from their
attitude.

column3:
《聖炎の参竜道》へと続く扉の前に
急きょ設営された野営地。厳しいウルテカ山岳の
環境に負けず、宿やよろず屋といった覚者隊のための
設備を維持すべく、王家に仕える兵のみならず
盗賊も手を貸している
column4:
In front of the door leading to the "Sacred Flame
Path," a temporary camp has been hastily set up.
Despite the harsh environment of the Urteca
Mountains, the facilities for the Arisen Corps,
such as inns and general shops, are being
maintained not only by the soldiers serving the
royal family, but also with the help of bandits.

column3:
小さな群れを作って生活するサラマンダーだが
繁殖のため、一時的に大きな群れを成して
生活することもある。外敵から身を隠すことができ
適度な湿度・温度に保たれる洞穴などは
そのような場所に選ばれやすい
column4:
Salamanders live in small groups, but for
breeding purposes, they occasionally form large
herds and live together.
They hide from predators in caves or other places
where the humidity and temperature are kept at an
appropriate level.

column3:
城塞都市メガドを臨み、振り返れば悠然たる
火垂れ山がよく見える眺望スポット。しかし今や
肉食動物や魔物が徘徊し、腐肉や死骸が
転がる殺伐とした広場となっている。メガドに
これほどまでに近い場所に魔物が現れるように
なったのはごく最近のことだ
column4:
Approaching the fortress city of Megado, when I
turned around, I saw a serene view of Firefall
Mountain.
Nowadays, it has become a grim plaza where
carnivorous animals and monsters roam, with
rotting flesh and corpses scattered around.
It is only recently that monsters have started to
appear in a place so close to Megado.

column3:
橋を渡り、王家の墓へと侵攻しようとする
ドワーフオークを、王家の兵士たちが命を賭して
食い止めてきた場所。兵士、ドワーフオーク両者の
亡骸が無造作に転がっており、静かな場所ながら
激戦の痕跡を残す
column4:
Crossing the bridge, soldiers of the royal family
risked their lives to stop the Dwarf Orcs from
invading the Royal Family Mausoleum.
The corpses of both soldiers and Dwarf Orcs lay
scattered haphazardly, leaving behind traces of a
fierce battle in this quiet place.

column3:
《王家の墓》付近にある小さな洞窟
これまでは注目されてこなかった場所だが
ドワーフオークが出入りする姿や、手勢の
魔獣を置いていく様子が確認されている
内部に何らかの秘密があるのかもしれない
column4:
Near the "Royal Family Mausoleum" is a small
cave, which has not attracted much attention until
now.
However, there have been sightings of Dwarf Orcs
coming in and out, as well as witnessing them
leaving their animals.
There may be some kind of secret inside.

column3:
アンセスターオークたちが棲息する、とても
原始的な拠点のようなもの。実際には集団で
生活しているだけの縄張りのようなものかと
思われているが、ヘルハウンドを家畜のように
飼い慣らしている節が見受けられる点には
今後も警戒が必要だろう
column4:
A primitive base-like habitat where Ancestor Orcs
dwell.
It is believed to be a territory where they
simply live in groups, but caution will be
necessary in the future, as there seems to be a
tendency to tame Hellhounds like livestock.

column3:
ウルテカ山岳　東部にある資材置き場
ここにあるものはメガド市街にて使用される資材
だが、資材をここに集約しているというよりかは
市街に持ち込むための検査を受けるための
一時的な保管所といった位置付けのものだ
column4:
Urteca Mountains' Eastern Materials Storage Area.
The items found here are materials used in the
city of Megado.
However, instead of being a centralized location
for materials, it serves as a temporary storage
facility for inspections before being brought into
the city.

column3:
ウルテカ山岳　北部は元よりアンセスターオークや
その他の魔獣が多く生息する一帯であったが
戦乱によってそれぞれの住処に変化が生じたようだ
ここでは特にアンセスターオークの群れが勢いを
持っている様子が報告され、要注意スポットである
column4:
In the north, there used to be home to many
Ancestor Orcs and other magical creatures.
Due to the ongoing conflict, there have been
changes in their respective habitats.
It has been reported that particularly in this
area, there is a strong presence of Ancestor Orc
herds, making it a spot that requires caution.

column3:
本来であれば、死して大地に還るはずの魂が
何らかの理由で炎をまとった影として徘徊する
ことがある。ここにはそのような魔物が集まりやすい
らしく、駆除しなければ集まる魔物の数は
増えるばかりだ
column4:
Souls that were supposed to return to the earth
in death sometimes wander as shadows clad in
flames for some reason.
It seems that such creatures tend to gather here,
and if they are not exterminated, the number of
creatures that gather only increases.

column3:
アッカーシェランでは竜は、すなわち、王でもある
離宮は竜となった王が人々と交流する神殿として
有史以前に造られた。以降、時々の王によって
改修、改装が行われて現在の姿になっている
column4:
In Acre Selund, the dragon is also the king.
The palace was built as a temple for the king who
became a dragon to interact with the people in
prehistoric times. Since then, it has been
renovated and refurbished by occasional kings and
has become its current form.

column3:
代々のアッカー家にて竜にならなかった者たちが
眠る墓地。アッカー家以外でも友好関係にあった
豪族も埋葬が許されている
かつては財宝の数々が死者を飾っていたが、ほとんどが
オークとゴブリンに持ち去られた。南北の盗賊団は
関与を否定してる。
column4:
The cemetery where those from the Acre family,
who did not become dragons, lie sleeping.
Even noble families who had a friendly
relationship with the Acre family are allowed to
be buried here.
Once, numerous treasures adorned the deceased,
but most were taken away by orcs and goblins.
The northern and southern bandits deny
involvement.

column3:
旅人たちの簡易宿としても使われていた経緯がある
自然洞窟。各地の宿が発達したこともあり、百年
ほど前には完全に放棄されている。現在は戦乱により
住処を追われた魔物が棲みついているようだ。魔物
同士は敵対することもなく静かに暮らしているようだが
侵入者とみなした人間には確実に襲い掛かるだろう
column4:
There is a history of a natural cave being used
as a simple accommodation for travelers.
Due to the development of accommodations in
various places, it was completely abandoned about
a hundred years ago. Currently, it seems that
monsters, driven from their homes by war, have
taken up residence there.
The monsters live quietly with no hostility
towards each other, but they will surely attack
anyone they consider an intruder.

column3:
小さなほこらの壁面が崩れ、その先に
謎の空間が確認できている。空間は奥に続いている
ため、不要になった貯蔵庫の類を埋めたものでは
ないようだ
column4:
The wall of a small shrine has collapsed,
revealing a mysterious space beyond.
The space continues further back, suggesting that
it is not simply filled with unused storage items.

column3:
民間人が竜への敬意を示すために参拝する寺院
大変古くからあるため、一見すると廃墟のようだが
アッカーシェランの人間にとっては憧れの場でもある
聖職者たちが参拝者への対応に当たっていたが
現在は魔物に乗っ取られてしまい、この場を守る
者たちも完全に退避している
column4:
Private individuals visit the temple to show
respect to the dragon.
Despite its appearance of being in ruins at first
glance, it is also a place of longing for the
people of Acre Selund.
Clergymen used to handle interactions with
visitors, but the place has now been taken over by
enemies.
Those who protect this place have completely
evacuated.

column3:
火竜が休息をとる火垂れ山内部へと至る道
基本的には王家の人間が稀に通るのみであり
細工の凝った巨大な門は、代々門番の家系である
バシアス、もしくは王家の人間にしか開門できない
column4:
The road leads to the interior of Firefall
Mountain, where the Fire Dragon rests.
Usually, only members of the royal family pass
through.
The intricately crafted enormous gate can only be
opened by the gatekeeper lineage, the Bacias, or
members of the royal family.

column3:
突如現れた不気味な竜族の魔物が巣食う広間
アッカーシェランではこれまでその姿を見た者や
存在を知る者は誰一人としておらず、恐らく
悪しき竜によって造り出されたか、召喚された魔物
だろうと推測される
column4:
A grand hall infested with creepy dragonkin
creatures that suddenly appeared.
No one in Acre Selund has ever seen or known of
their existence.
It is presumed that they were either created by
or summoned by the evil dragon.

column3:
地理的に《王家の墓》の反対側に位置する墓場
入り口は厳重に閉ざされ、その位置から
"王家ゆかりではあるが、正しく葬られる価値の無い
行き場の無い人物らの亡骸"を安置する場所で
あったのではないかと推測されている
column4:
Geographically located on the opposite side of
the Royal Tombs, the entrance is tightly closed,
and its location suggests that it may have been a
place where "the corpses of not worthy of a proper
burial, with nowhere else to go" were laid to
rest.

column3:
道理を外れた世界も、これで理の中に
戻るだろう
column4:
Mundos que se desviam da ordem, retornarão à
ordem com isso.

column3:
邪悪な気の流れ――
おまえたちも感ずることが
できればいいのだが――
column4:
O fluxo de energia maligna—Se vocês pudessem senti-lo...
Se ao menos vocês pudessem senti-lo também.

column3:
邪気が少しばかり薄らいだようだ
おかしい――
いや、息を潜めているつもりだろうか――
column4:
Parece que a aura maligna diminuiu um pouco.
Estranho... Não, talvez esteja apenas escondendo
sua presença...

column3:
鍛錬せよ
おまえたちは抜き身の刃――研がねば、朽ちる
column4:
Treine-se. Vocês são a
lâmina desembainhada—Afie ou apodreça.

column3:
黒い鎧の騎士――
正体の見極めを急いでくれ
column4:
O cavaleiro de armadura negra—Eu preciso que você se apresse
e descubra quem ele é.

column3: 黒き鎧の災いは――厄介だぞ
column4:
The curse of the black armor is troublesome,
indeed.

column3: （目を閉じ、何かを考えているようだ）
column4:
(With their eyes closed, they seem to be deep in
thought).

column3: ――感謝しなくてはなりませんね
column4: I have to say—thank you for that.

column3: 《ブラッドオーブ》がもっと手に入れば――
column4: If only I could get more Blood Orbs.

column3:
あなたは覚者です
苦難の道は――避けられません
column4:
Você é um Arisen. O caminho da provação
é inevitável.

column3:
いがみ合いが元気の源だという人もいるようですが
わたしにはまったく理解できません――
column4:
Some people seem to think that bickering is the
source of energy. I don't understand it at
all—I've never understood it.

column3:
いまは少し――心持ちが乱れています
お待ちを――
column4:
Estou um pouco... distraída no momento. Por favor,
seja paciente.

column3:
おかえりなさい
時に、皆さんとのご挨拶がまだでは？
column4:
Bem-vindo de volta. A propósito, eu já cumprimentei
todos?

column3:
お手伝いできてうれしく思っています
これで押しも押されもせぬ立派な覚者ですね
column4:
Estou feliz em ajudar. Agora você é um Arisen
conhecido!

column3: こんにちは、覚者さん

でも、白竜様に捧げられた命は
けして無駄にはなりません
column4:
Mas as vidas dedicadas ao Dragão Branco não
serão em vão.

column3:
もう、昔のようには戻れないのですか？
あなたはどんな印象を受けましたか？
column4:
Podemos voltar a ser como éramos antes? Que
impressão você teve?

column3:
わたしは契約のお手伝いをすることに
なっていますので、その時を楽しみにして
待っていますね
column4:
Eu devo ajudar com o contrato, então estou
ansiosa por esse momento.

column3:
アルヴァーには会えましたか？
早く契約までいけると良いですね
column4:
Você conseguiu conhecer Alvar? Espero que você
consiga chegar ao contrato logo.

column3: イリスのことを聞きましたが――

イリスの様子はやはり変ですね
わたしが話したがっていると伝えてくれますか？
column4:
Iris ainda está agindo estranho. Você pode dizer a ela
que eu quero conversar com ela?

column3: イリスは――心配ですね

エルフの仲間が面倒を見るということであれば
その方がメイリーフにとっては良いことなのかも
しれませんね――
column4:
Se isso significa que os amigos do elfo serão
cuidados, pode ser melhor para Mayleaf. Talvez—

column3:
オークの時のようにうまく想像できませんが
でも、白竜様が強い憎しみの気を放っている――
それだけはわかるのです
column4:
Eu não consigo imaginar tão bem quanto imaginei com
os orcs. Mas O Dragão Branco está irradiando uma
forte aura de ódio—isso eu sei!

column3:
オークの臭いがするなどと騒いだりして
ごめんなさい
あの臭いが恐ろしくてならないのです
column4:
Sinto muito por ter feito tanto barulho sobre o cheiro
de orcs. Sinto muito... Eu tenho medo desse cheiro.

column3:
メイリーフの素性を知ったのですか？
あの一族は、今や、このレスタニアの宝石です
column4:
Você ficou sabendo da verdadeira identidade de
Mayleaf? Essa família agora é a joia desta Lestania.

column3:
レオが白竜様を見つめていました
思い詰めているようでしたが――
column4:
Leo estava olhando para O Dragão Branco. Ele parecia
estar ponderando—

column3:
下の街の皆さんが安心して暮らせるように
どうかよろしくお願いしますね
column4:
Espero que todos na cidade abaixo possam viver em
paz. Por favor, nos ajude a fazer isso.

column3:
争いのない世を望みながらも、我らの手は
戦の血で汚れていく――虚しきことです
column4:
Esperamos por um mundo sem conflitos, mas nossas
mãos estão manchadas com o sangue da guerra - uma
coisa vã!

column3:
人は弱きもの――それゆえ
その力を紡ぎ、束ねんとするのです
column4:
Humanos são fracos—é por isso que nos entrelaçamos
e reunimos nossa força.

column3: 今後もこのようなことが起こるのでしょうか――
column4: Isso continuará a acontecer no futuro—?

column3:
信じましょう
白竜様の大いなる加護を
column4:
Acreditemos nas grandes bênçãos do
Dragão Branco.

column3:
大変な戦いだったと聞いています
断ち切られた人生も多かったと――
column4:
Eu ouvi dizer que foi uma luta difícil e muitas vidas
foram interrompidas—

column3:
少し、甘えてしまったかもしれません
これからは気をつけますね
column4:
Eu posso ter estragado um pouco. Serei cuidadosa
de agora em diante.

column3:
強く、澄み切った命でした
彼の命のあり方は素晴らしい
column4:
Foi uma vida forte e clara. A maneira como ele viveu
sua vida foi incrível.

column3:
心の水面が平らかならば
本来、誰にでも竜の心は伝わるのです
column4:
Se a superfície do coração estiver calma, então a
verdadeira essência do coração do dragão pode ser
compreendida por qualquer um.

column3:
持ち去ったエルフの命――
敵はいったいどうするつもりでしょう
column4:
A vida de um elfo levada... O que o
inimigo pretende fazer?

column3: 敵はディアマンテス――
無理をきいてくれてありがとうございました

白竜様がこっそりご加護をくださったのかも
しれませんね
column4:
Talvez o Dragão Branco tenha nos dado secretamente
uma bênção.

column3: 白竜様が回復される日までともに頑張りましょう
column4:
Até o dia em que o Dragão Branco for restaurado, vamos
fazer o nosso melhor juntos.

column3:
白竜様が空を飛ぶお姿――
いつか見たいものですね
column4:
Eu espero ver o Dragão Branco voando no
céu—um dia!

column3:
白竜様の回復にはまだ時間がかかるようです
これからもわたしたちでお守りしなくては――
column4:
Levará algum tempo para o Dragão Branco se
recuperar. Devemos continuar a protegê-lo—

column3:
白竜様の回復は一進一退――
特に石化の症状は油断がなりません
column4:
A recuperação do Dragão Branco tem sido um passo
na direção certa—Os sintomas de petrificação podem
ser especialmente complicados!

column3: 白竜様の言葉こそ、導（しるべ）の光――
column4:
As palavras do Dragão Branco são de fato a
luz que guia.

column3:
自由に振る舞う覚者が増えていますが
白竜様あっての覚者であることだけは
心に留めておいてください
column4:
Há mais Arisen se comportando livremente, mas por favor,
sempre tenha em mente que é graças ao Dragão
Branco que eles existem.

column3:
覚者になってまだ日が浅いのに
《ブラッドオーブ》を持ち帰るなんて――
column4:
Mesmo que tenha passado pouco tempo desde que
se tornou um Arisen, não acredito que você trouxe
uma "Orbe de Sangue".

column3:
語るべき何か――伝えるべき何か――
大切な言葉はいつも白竜様が教えてくれます
そう――わたし自身の言葉ではないのです
column4:
Algo para contar—algo para transmitir... As
palavras importantes são sempre ensinadas pelo
Dragão Branco. Sim—não são minhas próprias palavras.

column3:
迷った時は、耳をすませてください
白竜様の教えがあなたを導くでしょう
column4:
Quando estiver em dúvida, ouça e deixe os ensinamentos
do Dragão Branco guiá-lo!

column3:
顔色が、すぐれぬようですね
どうかご自愛を
column4: Você não parece bem. Por favor, cuide de si.

column3:
騎士団と覚者の揉め事に
巻き込まれてしまったと聞きました
大丈夫でしたか？
column4:
Eu ouvi dizer que você se envolveu em uma disputa
entre a ordem dos Cavaleiros e o Arisen. Você está
bem?

column3:
魔物たちの標的になっても不思議では
ありません
どうか、気にしてあげてくださいね
column4:
Não é de admirar que eles tenham sido o alvo de demônios. Por favor,
por favor, por favor, cuide deles!

column3:
――と前向きに考えることにするよ
これも処世術と言えないこともないね
column4:
--Eu vou tentar pensar positivamente e esta
é outra maneira de sobreviver, eu acho.

column3:
――！？　ああ、ごめんごめん
ちょっと考え事をね
column4:
—!? Ah, desculpe, desculpe. Eu estava apenas pensando sobre
algo.

column3:
"悪しき竜"は力だけを与えられた子供――
そんなふうに考えられないかな？
column4:
Não podemos considerar o "Dragão Maligno" como uma criança
que foi presenteada apenas com poder?

column3:
《ブラッドオーブ》のことは
常に気にしておくといいよ
見つけると確実に一目置かれるからね
column4:
É bom sempre ter em mente sobre a 《Orbe de Sangue》,
porque quando você a encontra, você certamente será
admirado.

column3:
ああ、ごめん
今は特に話すことはないよ
column4:
Ah, desculpe. Eu realmente não tenho nada para te contar
agora.

column3:
あのゲートはフィンダムの竜の力が
生み出したものだ
僕らの心意気だけじゃどうにもならないよ
column4:
Aquele portão é o resultado do poder do dragão de Phindym.
Não pode ser feito apenas com a nossa
determinação.

column3:
あははは――
こんなに神殿の近くが戦場になるなんて――
ああ、怖かった
column4:
Ahahaha— Who would have thought that the area
near the temple would turn into a battlefield— Oh,
how scary.

column3:
あやふやとはいえ、ロイグの方が色々と
覚えているからね
その情報だけでも、ありがたいと思わなくちゃ
column4:
Even if uncertain, Loeg remembers various things,
so I must be grateful for that information alone.

column3:
あれこれ書物に当たっているけど
こんな危機はかつてなくて
白竜様と僕たちが初めてのようだ
column4:
I'm hitting various books and such, but this
crisis is unprecedented. It feels like The White
Dragon and we are experiencing something for the
first time.

column3:
いささか――怖いね
でも、ほら、白竜様がお待ちだよ
column4:
It's a little scary— but look, The White Dragon
is waiting for you.

column3:
いつ襲撃されてもおかしくないから
四方八方、気を抜かないようにね
column4:
Since we could be attacked at any time, let's
stay on high alert in all directions.

column3:
いや、君にも心配かけたよね
迎えに来てくれてありがとう
本当に感謝しているよ
column4:
No, I caused you to worry too, didn't I? Thank
you for coming to pick me up. I really appreciate
it.

column3:
おかしいよ――
第一のアークの調査は僕が担当したんだ
column4:
That's strange—I was in charge of investigating
the first Ark.

column3:
おや、疲れたのかい？
覚者も無敵ってわけじゃないんだな
column4:
Oh, you're tired, aren't you? I guess even the
Arisen aren't invincible.

column3:
くれぐれも気をつけてくれよ
無事にここへ戻って来ると約束してほしい
君たちは歴史の証言者なんだからね
column4:
Please be careful and make sure to return here
safely. I want you to promise me that. You are
witnesses to history, after all.

column3:
ここでジッとしてはいられない
僕もメルゴダへ行く！　絶対行く！
column4:
I can't stay still here. I'm going to Mergoda!
I'm definitely going!

column3:
この世界は好きかい？
僕は好きだよ
知れば知るほど――もっと知りたくなる
column4:
Do you like this world? I do. The more you
know—the more you want to know.

column3:
これからフィンダムへの渡航者が増えるだろうね
もちろん僕も準備を進めているんだ
column4:
The number of travelers to Phindym is likely to
increase from now on, and of course, I am also
preparing for it.

column3: これは悪くない事だと思うよ
column4: I think this is not a bad thing.

column3:
これは王子なりによく考えた末の
行動だと思うよ
そうじゃないと、君たちから聞いていた
王子の印象と合わないからね
column4:
I think this is an action that the prince has
carefully considered. Otherwise, it wouldn't match
the impression of the prince that I have heard
from you.

column3:
ごめん！
アークの調査報告が最優先でね
あちこち気が回らないんだよ
column4:
Sorry! The Ark's investigation report is the top
priority. I can't focus on other things.

column3:
さあ、みんなが待ってるよ？
君がなんとかしてくれる――
そう思っている連中も多いはずさ
column4:
Come on, the guys are waiting for you, okay?
You'll handle it—I'm sure a lot of them think so.

column3: さあ、急いで

さびしいね――
仲良くなれそうな気がしたんだけど――
いや、仲良かったよね――
column4:
It's lonely, isn't it... I felt like we could
become close... No, we were close, right...

column3:
すまないけど、少し考えたいことがあるんだ
後で話そうよ
column4:
Sorry, I just have a few things to think about.
We can talk later.

column3:
ずっと考えているんだけど――
ディアマンテスは僕が跡を継ぎたがるって
本気で考えたのかな――
column4:
I keep thinking—that Diamantes wants me to follow
in his footsteps. Did he really think—?

column3:
そして、白竜様の回復を促す新しい方法も
見つかったみたいだ
これからも、もっと色々なことが
起こりそうな気がするよ
column4:
And it seems that a new method to encourage the
recovery of The White Dragon has been found. I
feel like more things are going to happen from now
on.

column3:
そして、良さそうなのがあれば
君たちにも伝えるからね
column4:
And if there is something good, I will also let
you guys know.

column3:
その心の暗い部分に黒騎士が
入り込んだ――か
column4:
Did the Black Knight enter the dark depths of
your heart?

column3:
その目的を果たしたあとは
どんな顔をして仲間のところへ戻る気で
いるんだろうね
あまり考えていないのかな
column4:
After achieving that goal, I wonder what
expression they will have when they return to
their comrades. I wonder if they haven't thought
about it much.

column3:
それなのに僕は――
悔やんでも悔やみきれないよ
column4: And yet, I can't help but regret and regret.

column3:
それにしてもあのロイグがね――
心根のいい奴に思えたけどなあ
僕の人を見る目もまだまだだね
column4:
That Loeg, though... He seemed like a
good-hearted guy. I still have a long way to go in
judging people.

column3:
そんなことしている場合じゃないと思うけど
時間をもらえるのはありがたいことだから
僕は僕で独自に調べようと思っている
column4:
I don't think this is the time for that, but it's
nice to have some time. I am thinking of
researching on my own.

column3:
だから僕は、こっち側の人たちと神殿の
架け橋になろうと思うんだ
column4:
That's why I want to become a bridge between the
people on this side and the temple.

column3:
だとしたら、哀れだね
出会ったばかりの僕しか後継者候補は
いないのか――ってさ
column4:
If that's the case, it's pitiful, isn't it? Are
there really no other candidates for the successor
besides me, someone you just met?

column3:
ちょうど君が覚者になった頃からこれまでとは
少し違う事件が起こるようになってきた
オークの活動が活発になったり――
ほら、アークの出現もそうだね
column4:
Since you became an Arisen, there have been
different incidents occurring from before until
now. The Orcs have become more active, and, well,
the appearance of the Ark, too.

column3:
でも、君が持ち帰った古文書は面白そうで――
まずいな――ジョゼフ様に叱られるよ
column4:
But, the old document you took home seems
interesting... Uh-oh... I'm going to get scolded
by Joseph, aren't I?

column3:
となると、レスタニアの混乱がこの程度で
済んでいるのは、とてつもなく運が
いいのかもしれないね
column4:
If that's the case, it might be incredibly lucky
that the chaos in Lestania has been settled to
this extent.

column3: とにもかくにも今はネド王子だね
column4: In any case, you are Prince Nedo now.

column3:
どうだい？
覚者の生活には慣れたかな？
column4:
How about it? Are you used to the life of an
Arisen?

column3:
ひとつだけわかったのは――
"悪しき竜"はすぐに君たちを亡き者に
するつもりはないということ
column4:
The only thing I understood is that the "Evil
Dragon" has no intention of taking you out
immediately.

column3: まあ、今は生きのびてくれることを祈ろう
column4: Well, let's pray that they'll survive.

column3: また何か起こりそうな気配だね
column4: It feels like something is about to happen again.

column3:
まだ正体はわからないんだけど
どこかに落ちたらしいんだ
うわさか何か聞いてないかい？
column4:
I still do not know what it truly is, but it
seems to have fallen somewhere. Have you heard any
rumors or something?

column3:
まだ読み切れていない古文書もあるし
ここまで実際に体験したことを
評価し直す必要があるかもしれない
column4:
There are some ancient documents that have not
yet been fully read, and I may need to reevaluate
what I've actually done so far.

column3:
まだ読んでいない書物、まだ試していない実験――
心残りがあるうちは、死ねないよ
column4:
Books you haven't read yet, experiments you
haven't tried yet—You can't die while you have
regrets.

column3:
もう友達をなくすのは絶対に嫌だから
思ったことは口にするつもりだよ
column4:
I absolutely don't want to lose any more friends,
so I intend to speak my mind.

column3:
もしかしたら、僕が覚者の力に
なれるのかもしれないな――
column4:
Perhaps, I may be able to become a powerful
Arisen...

column3:
やあ、新人さん
最初は誰彼かまわず顔を売っておくといいよ
column4:
Hello, new person. It's good to make yourself
known to everyone at first, regardless of who they
are.

column3:
やっぱり僕は生きているキースヒルトと
もっと話したかったよ――
column4:
I knew I wanted to talk more with Kieshildt. I
just wish I could have told you more—

column3:
よく考えると、このレスタニアでも
竜の不調は続いているわけだよね
column4:
When I think about it, even in this Lestania, the
dragon's condition continues to worsen, doesn't
it?

column3: ん？　どうしたんだい？

アッカーシェランか
自然環境はこっちとほぼ同じなんだね
つまり、理と竜の世界ということか
column4:
Is this Acre Selund? The natural environment here
is almost the same, right? In other words, it's a
world of order and dragons.

column3:
アッカーシェランで"悪しき竜"との
全面戦争が始まるのかな
column4:
Is a full-scale war against the "Evil Dragon"
about to begin in Acre Selund?

column3:
アッカーシェランとも、フィンダムのような
友好的な関係になれるといいね
column4:
I hope we can establish a friendly relationship
with Acre Selund, just like with Phindym.

column3:
アッカーシェランに灯った希望の火を
消してはいけないよ
column4:
Do not extinguish the flame of hope that has been
lit in Acre Selund!

column3:
アッカーシェランの状況は良くないみたいだけど
それでも君たちはレスタニアの代表なんだ
column4:
The situation in Acre Selund doesn't seem to be
good, but even so, you are representatives of
Lestania.

column3:
アーク調査の報告書がまだだというのに
古文書の解読まで――
column4:
Despite the fact that the report on the Ark
investigation is not yet complete, up until the
deciphering of the ancient documents—

column3:
イリスとは話したかい？
なんだか避けられているような気が
しないでもないんだけど――
column4:
Did you talk to Iris? I can't help but feel like
she's avoiding me.

column3: ガルドリンには特に強く言っておかないと
column4: I need to make sure to tell Gurdolin firmly.

column3:
ゲートの継続性について
もう少し確信が得られないと
僕は向こうへは行けないな
column4:
Regarding the sustainability of the gate, I
cannot go over there without a little more
certainty.

column3:
ジョゼフ様がまたなんか言ってるだろ？
人を疑うのが性分なんだね
column4:
Joseph is saying something again, right? It's in
his nature to suspect others.

column3:
ジョゼフ様の助手になって以来初めての
大仕事を仰せつかって、その計画をね――
ふふふ――
column4:
Since becoming Joseph's assistant, this is the
first big job I've been entrusted with, and I am
now tasked with the planning... hehehe...

column3:
ジョゼフ様の話を聞いていると
まるで僕たちがフィンダムへの侵略者のように
思えてくるよ
column4:
When listening to Joseph's story, it feels as if
we are invaders to Phindym.

column3:
セシリーは深手を負っている
致命傷がなければ命は助かるだろうけど
回復には長い時間がかかるよ
column4:
Cecily has suffered a serious injury. If there is
no fatal wound, she should survive, but recovery
will take a long time.

column3:
ディアマンテス――
イリスは確かにそう言ってたよね？
column4: Diamantes - Iris did say that, right?

column3:
ディアマンテスに対抗する錬金術師が
ちゃんといたことがうれしくてね
column4:
I am happy that there was an alchemist who could
oppose Diamantes.

column3:
ネド王子と解放軍が合流したんだ
敵の警戒も厳しくなるだろうね
column4:
Prince Nedo and the liberation army have joined
forces. Enemy vigilance will also intensify, I
suppose.

column3:
ネド王子はたしかにまだ子供だけど
聞く限り、無茶はしない印象だよ
column4:
Prince Nedo is certainly still a child, but from
what I hear, he gives the impression of not doing
anything reckless.

column3:
フィンダムで起こったことを記録して
後世に残そうと思っているんだけど――
column4:
I want to record what happened in Phindym and
leave it for future generations to see—

column3:
フィンダムを竜力が巡る仕組みは
こっちとは少し違うようだね
column4:
The mechanism of Dragon Force circulating around
Phindym seems to be a little different from here.

column3:
メイリーフを連れ出したフードの女って
やっぱり彼女だよな――
column4:
The woman in the hood who took Mayleaf out... I
knew it was her.

column3:
レオが匿っているという人と話せれば
もっと色々と分かるのだろうけど
今はそれよりも侵食魔退治だね
まったく、次から次へと――
column4:
If I could talk to the person Leo is hiding with,
I would probably understand more. But right now,
it's more about defeating the Corruption.
Seriously, it's one thing after another—

column3:
レスタニアの命運は尽きる寸前だった――
あはは――今になって脚が震えるよ
column4:
Lestania's fate was on the brink of
exhaustion—Ahaha—My legs are trembling now.

column3:
レスタニアは平和なものさ
気分転換に散歩でもどうだい？
column4:
Lestania is a peaceful place. How about taking a
walk for a change of mood?

column3:
レスタニア中の海図がこの神殿に
集まることになっているんだ
船乗りたちと一緒に、その海図とにらめっこさ
column4:
The charts of all of Lestania are to be gathered
here in this temple. I'll be poring over them with
the sailors.

column3:
ロイグが早くよくなることを祈るよ
まあ、ロイグのためというよりは
かなり利己的な理由だけどね
column4:
I hope Loeg gets better soon. Well, it's not so
much for Loeg's sake but rather for quite selfish
reasons.

column3:
ロイグはガラダ族長たちのことを
快く思っていなかった
いや、逆恨みしていたという感じかな？
column4:
Loeg did not have a favorable opinion of the
Gearóid tribal leaders. No, it's more like he held
a grudge against them, I guess?

column3:
不安と期待が入り交じるこの気持ち――
説明が難しいね
column4:
This feeling of mixed anxiety and
anticipation—It's hard to explain.

column3:
今のジョゼフ様は猜疑心の塊だよ
何を言い出しても驚かないことだね
column4:
Joseph is currently a bundle of suspicion. It's
not surprising no matter what he says.

column3:
今のジョゼフ様は猜疑心の塊だよ
何を言い出しても驚かないことだね
column4:
Joseph is currently a bundle of suspicion. It's
not surprising no matter what he says.

column3:
今は解放軍と一緒に王都奪回の戦いに
専念するのがいいと思うよ
column4:
I think it's best to focus on the battle to
recapture the Royal Capital with the Liberation
Army.

column3:
今度の調査だって僕が行けば前回との
比較ができたのに――
意見も全然聞いてもらえないし――はぁ
column4:
If I were to go on this investigation, I would
have been able to compare it to the last time—but
I don't get listened to at all—sigh.

column3:
今朝、ぶつけて爪が欠けてしまってね
嫌な予感がするんだ
column4:
I bumped it this morning and chipped a nail. I
have a bad feeling about this.

column3:
他の人も思いは同じだと思うよ
つまり――
僕が言いたいのは、レオの後任は大変だけど
頑張ってくれってことさ
column4:
I think other people feel the same way. In other
words— What I want to say is, it's tough to be
Leo's successor, but I hope you will do your best.

column3:
会議だなんて――
これは時間がかかるよ
column4: A meeting? Oh, this is going to take some time.

column3:
例の島をね、もっとよく調べようと思うんだ
戦いは一段落ついたのかもしれないけど
調査は何も終わってないからね
column4:
I think I'll continue to investigate that island
more thoroughly. Although the fighting may have
come to a halt, the investigation is far from
over.

column3:
僕のことはジョゼフ様が一番よく知っている
はずなのに――
column4:
You know me better than anyone, Joseph. I should
have known...

column3:
僕はね――もう後悔はしたくない
予兆には気づいていたのに――
遠慮する必要は何もなかったのに――
column4:
I don't—I don't want any more regrets. I knew the
signs were there. There was no need to hesitate...

column3:
僕は君たちの一歩先のことを考えるとしよう
それが僕の仕事だよね？
column4:
Let's say I'm one step ahead of you guys That's
my job, right?

column3:
僕は混乱の中で解決を模索するのが好きなんだ
つまり、この慌ただしさも僕の味方さ
column4:
I enjoy seeking solutions in the midst of
confusion. In other words, this busyness is also
on my side.

column3:
僕は確かに錬金術師の末裔さ
でも、だからなんだと言うんだろうね
column4:
I am indeed a descendant of an alchemist, but so
what?

column3:
僕も島に乗り込みたいと思っていたけど
まだ時期尚早のようだね
もう少し状況が落ち着くのを待つよ
column4:
I also wanted to join you on the island, but it
seems it's still too early. I'll wait a little
longer for the situation to settle down.

column3:
僕も調査に行きたいんだよね――
でもここで騒ぐと余計に面倒な立場に
なってしまいそうだから我慢しているんだ
column4:
I want to go investigate too—but I'm holding back
because making a fuss here might put me in an even
more troublesome position.

column3:
力だけで知識も経験も与えられなかったから
釣り合いが取れなくて――
いやいや、問題はそこじゃないか！
column4:
They gave no knowledge, no experience, just
power. There was no balance... No, no, no, that's
not the point!

column3:
反省しています――はい
ああ、君か――また叱られるのかと思ったよ
column4:
I'm reflecting on it—yes. Oh, it's you—I thought
I was going to be scolded again.

column3: 可能な限り、いい顔でたのむよ
column4: Please do it with a smile, if possible.

column3:
向こうとこっち――
立場は五分と五分――この考え方が
平和共存への道に繋がると思うんだ
column4:
Over there and here, The positions are evenly
split—I believe that this way of thinking Leads to
peaceful coexistence.

column3:
君たちを助けるセシリーの竜力は
あくまでも仮初めの力
そう長くは続かないと思うよ
column4:
Cecily's Dragon Force, which helps you, is merely
a temporary power. I don't think it will last
long.

column3:
君たち自身も希望なんだ
それを忘れないでくれ
column4:
You yourselves also have hope, Please do not
forget that.

column3:
君だって、不安だろう？
早いところ、行った方がいいよ
column4:
You're worried, too, aren't you? You'd better get
there as soon as possible.

column3:
君と雑談？
いいね！　よし、共通の話題を探そうよ
column4:
Having a little chat with you? Great! Okay, let's
find something we have in common.

column3:
君も協力してくれるよね？
もう結構長い付き合いだもの――
僕に野心がないことなんてわかってるだろ？
column4:
You'll also help me, right? We've been together
for quite a long time, after all... You know that
I don't have any ambitions, don't you?

column3:
命は白竜様の役に立ったとしても
キースヒルトが知っていた知識、知恵――
全部消えてしまった
column4:
Even if the life was useful to Master White
Dragon, the knowledge, the wisdom that Kieshildt
knew—it's all gone.

column3:
問題は、君とガルドリンが行ったという
島の場所だね
column4:
The problem is the location of the island you and
Gurdolin say you went to.

column3:
回り道はあったけど、いよいよだね
良い報告を待っているよ
column4:
There was a detour, but now it's time. I'll be
waiting for good news!

column3:
大海原に浮かぶ島を見つけるなんて
そう簡単じゃない
column4:
It's not easy to find an island floating in the
open sea.

column3:
奪回した城を拠点に力を蓄えて
"悪しき竜"の討伐を目指すのだよね？
column4:
Vamos reunir forças no castelo retomado
e partir para derrotar o Maldito Dragão.

column3:
姿を消したとなると、何か深い事情が
あるんだろうね
解決可能なことだといいけど――
column4:
Se ele sumiu, deve haver um motivo sério.
Tomara que ainda haja solução para isso.

column3:
将来の神官にふさわしいかどうか――
ノドから手が出るほど欲しい地位だったけど
今はどうかな――
column4:
Ser digno de virar sacerdote...
Antes eu queria isso com todas as forças,
mas agora... não sei mais.

column3:
島が見つかってホッとしているよ
肩の荷が下りたというかね
ここだけの話――
ジョゼフ様は僕を試しているね
column4:
Que alívio encontrar a ilha.
Foi como tirar um peso das costas.
Mas entre nós... o Mestre Joseph
claramente está me testando.

column3:
島に現れた魔物はこれまでの侵食魔とは
かなり様子が違うとか？
column4:
Dizem que os monstros da ilha
são bem diferentes dos corrompidos
que vimos até agora, né?

column3:
島の調査は引き続きやっているよ
いい報告ができればいいんだけど
少々魔物が多くてね
column4:
A investigação da ilha continua.
Tomara que tenhamos boas notícias,
mas há monstros demais por lá.

column3:
嵐の中を出かけていった騎士たちには
頭が下がるよ
column4:
Tiro o chapéu para os cavaleiros
que partiram em meio à tempestade.

column3:
常識にとらわれないこと
それが、平凡を非凡に変えるんだ
column4:
Pensar além do óbvio...
É isso que torna o comum em extraordinário.

column3:
思い立ったら、すぐに行動！
待っていても発見は無いからね
column4:
Teve uma ideia? Aja logo!
Esperar não vai levar a descobertas.

column3:
悔しいなあ
僕には知らないことがいっぱいある
それを思い知らされて――
ああ、悔しいよ
column4:
Que frustração...
Perceber o quanto ainda ignoro...
Dói mais do que esperava.

column3:
悪いね
ついついレオのことを考えてしまうんだ
こんな時にどうして留守なんだってね
column4:
Desculpe... fico pensando no Leo.
Por que ele tinha que sumir justo agora?

column3:
早くアッカーシェランへ向かった方がいいよ
状況は王子の動き次第で変わるんだから
column4:
Melhor seguir logo para Acca Sheran.
Tudo pode mudar com os passos do príncipe.

column3: 時は来た――だね
本格的な城攻めを前にしての休暇かな？
column4: Tirando folga antes do ataque ao castelo?

column3:
次は覚者の番だね
くれぐれも、気をつけて
column4:
Agora é a vez do Arisen.
Cuide-se bem, por favor.

column3:
気づいていたのに――
イリスは少し変わったなって
気づいていたんだ
column4:
Eu notei, sabia?
A Iris... ela mudou um pouco.

column3:
浄化は始まっているんだろう？
進捗状況が気になるところだね
column4:
A purificação já começou, certo?
Gostaria de saber como está indo.

column3: 火垂れ山は"悪しき竜"の住み処だよね
column4:
A Montanha Hotare é o lar
do Maldito Dragão, certo?

column3: 王子には何か目的があるのだろうけど――
column4: Acho que o príncipe tem um propósito...――

column3:
王都の戦いが終わらないと
落ち着かないよね
column4:
Enquanto a luta na capital não acabar,
fica difícil relaxar.

column3:
盗賊と言えば荒くれ者と相場が決まっている
本拠地に乗り込むんだから
言動には気をつけて
column4:
Ladrões são sempre brutais.
Vamos invadir o covil deles,
então cuidado com o que diz.

column3:
盗賊の次はオークの本拠地だって？
君たちはそっちの方が慣れているかな
column4:
Depois dos ladrões, agora orcs?
Talvez vocês já estejam acostumados.

column3: 空から降ってきた巨大な石碑――
column4: Um imenso monólito caiu do céu...

column3:
竜と樹が循環と浄化を分け合っているというか――
竜への異存が少ないということなのかなあ
column4:
O dragão e a árvore partilham
o ciclo e a purificação...?
Ou será que a dependência do dragão
está menor?

column3:
考え得る対策を書きだして
とにかく吟味する
column4:
Anote todas as soluções possíveis
e analise com cuidado.

column3:
聞くところによると、セシリーのお父さんは
戦士でもなんでもない、普通の人らしいね
column4:
Ouvi dizer que o pai da Cecily
não é guerreiro nem nada disso...
Apenas uma pessoa comum.

column3: 行ったり来たり、ご苦労だね
column4: Você tem ido e voltado bastante, hein?

column3:
覚悟はしていたけどね――
いやいや、挫けてなるものか！
column4:
Já esperava por isso――
mas não vou me abater!

column3:
覚者が一緒じゃないと戻ってこられないから
君たち、その時はよろしくたのむよ
column4:
Sem um Arisen eu não consigo voltar.
Conto com vocês, quando for a hora.

column3: 覚者じゃないこの身が恨めしいよ
column4: Detesto não ser um Arisen como vocês...

column3:
覚者と騎士団の反目に巻き込まれて
僕は処世術を学んだんだ
column4:
Fui pego no conflito entre Arisen
e a ordem dos cavaleiros...
Foi assim que aprendi a viver.

column3:
解放軍はここに来てずいぶん敵を
刺激したからね
反撃は覚悟しないと
column4:
A chegada do exército libertador
irritou bastante o inimigo...
É bom nos prepararmos pra um revide.

column3:
誰が与えたか――与えなかったのか――
考えるべきなのは背後にいたのは
誰かって話だよね
column4:
Quem deu... ou não deu?
O que importa mesmo é saber
quem estava por trás disso.

column3:
謎の騎士の話題で持ちきりだね
正体はどうあれ、強敵に違いないから
万事準備怠りなく、だよ？
column4:
Todos falam do tal cavaleiro misterioso.
Não sei quem é, mas é forte...
Então vamos nos preparar pra tudo, certo?

column3:
逐次攻略というか各個撃破というか
物事はひとつずつ解決するのが良策だと
主張する人もいるけどね――
column4:
Tem quem diga que o ideal
é resolver uma coisa de cada vez...
Talvez tenham razão――

column3:
道のりはまだまだありそうだから
じっくり行かないとね
column4:
Ainda temos um longo caminho...
É bom ir com calma.

column3:
適材適所って言うだろ？
そう、僕は武ではなく、知で攻めるのさ
column4:
Sabe o ditado 'cada um no seu lugar'?
Pois é, eu luto com sabedoria, não com armas.

column3:
頼むよ――
黒騎士の剣を取り戻して
column4:
Por favor... recupere a espada
do Cavaleiro Negro!

column3:
騎士団が時々掃討作戦を展開しているから
まあ、気長にね――
ああ気長！　僕たちの苦手なやつだよね
くう――
column4:
Os cavaleiros fazem patrulhas às vezes.
Então... vamos com calma.
Ah, paciência! Nossa velha inimiga.
Tsc...

column3:
黒騎士と魔物の関係という観点から見ると
新手の方が、より黒騎士に近い存在という
ことかなあ
column4:
Pensando na relação entre o Cavaleiro Negro
e os monstros... talvez os novos inimigos
sejam ainda mais próximos dele.

column3:
――うむ
これで各地のエリアとおまえの結び付きは
より強固なものとなるだろう
column4:
— Sim. Agora teus laços com cada região
se fortalecerão ainda mais.

column3:
――これで
アビリティは無事、解放されたようだぞ
column4:
— Muito bem.
As habilidades foram liberadas com sucesso.

column3:
――これで
転移の礎は無事、解放されたようだ
column4:
— Pronto.
A pedra de teleporte foi ativada.

column3:
――これはすまぬ
そのジョブには《「LV.80」成長の宝珠》は
効果が無いのだ
別のジョブで考え直してみてくれ
column4:
— Desculpe.
Esse Orbe de Crescimento LV.80
não funciona com essa classe.
Tente outra, sim?

column3: ――さて、この宝珠の力を解放するか？
column4:
Então... vamos liberar o poder
deste orbe agora?

column3:
――よろしい
無事、スキルが解放されたようだぞ
column4:
— Muito bem.
A habilidade foi desbloqueada com sucesso.

column3:
――よろしい
無事、レベルがあがったようだぞ
column4:
— Excelente.
O nível aumentou com sucesso.

column3:
――気付いているだろうが
このジョブはすでにLV.80に達しているな
レベルアップの効果が無駄になってしまうが
それでも宝珠を使うのか？
column4:
— Você notou, certo?
Essa classe já está no nível 80.
Usar o orbe seria inútil...
Mesmo assim quer usá-lo?

column3:
"悪しき竜"が絶望の大陸と呼んだ
アッカーシェランの状況は大いに変わった
column4:
O "Dragão Maligno" chamava Acca Sheran
de terra da desolação...
Mas agora, tudo mudou por lá.

column3:
"悪しき竜"といい黒い騎士といい
姿を見せずに我々を翻弄するとは――
なんと卑劣な者たちだ
column4:
"Dragão Maligno" e o cavaleiro negro, já que
tocamos no assunto,
Manipular-nos sem mostrar suas verdadeiras formas
Que indivíduos vis são esses.

column3:
"悪しき竜"の言葉を文字通りに信じても
良いのだろうか
column4:
Podemos acreditar literalmente nas palavras do
"Dragão Maligno"?
Não sei se acredito.

column3:
"悪しき竜"の言葉を文字通りに信じても
良いのだろうか
column4:
Podemos acreditar literalmente nas palavras do
"Dragão Maligno"?
Não sei se acredito.

column3:
"悪しき竜"の討伐が解放軍の目的とすれば
次はいかなる道を進むのか――
column4:
Se o objetivo do Exército de Libertação é derrotar
o "Dragão Maligno", que caminho ele tomará em
seguida?

column3:
"悪しき竜"め！
アッカーシェランの次はこのレスタニア――
column4:
"Dragão Maligno", tenha cuidado!
Depois de Acre Selund, é a vez de Lestania--

column3:
《<VAL>》
この宝珠の力を解放するか？
column4:
《<VAL>》
Você liberará o poder desta joia?

column3:
《<VAL>》
この宝珠の力を解放するか？
column4:
《<VAL>》
Você liberará o poder desta joia?

column3:
《原始の雫》の到着を座して待つのも
手持ちぶさただろう
さあ、フィンダムへ行って、手伝ってやりなさい
column4:
No entanto, a decisão ainda depende de você. Por
mais que eu possa esperar, só posso esperar.

column3:
《竜力の継承》には何の影響もないが
前途を祝して、宝珠の力を解放しておくか
力は大地を巡り、またいつの日か
おまえの元へ戻ろう
column4:

しのぎきれば未来は明るいぞ
column4:

If we endure, the future will be bright

column3:

ネド王子が行方不明なのだとか
しかも自分の意志で城を出たらしい
column4:
According to what Lise told me,
it seems that Prince Nedo is missing,
and furthermore, he seems to have left the castle
on his own accord.

今後のこととイリスの処遇を相談せねばならん
見かけたら、すぐここへ来るように言ってくれ
column4:
Is Leo here yet? We need to discuss future plans
and how to handle Iris. If you see him, tell him
to come here immediately.

おまえたちの活躍にかかっている

嫌な予感しかしないのだ
column4: Go and defeat the leader of the Arch-Corruption

なんとも無念ではあるが――
column4:
I heard about Loeg
It is truly regrettable but - -

column3:

早く助けてやりたいものだな
column4:
If Loeg's illness is what I think it is he must
be in a lot of pain I'm thinking of getting
involved personally.

column3:

セシリーを疎ましく思ったことを恥じて
回復を祈るばかりだ
column4:
Eliminating the core should disperse the

column4:
I would like to see him again and hear his true
intentions.

column3:

column4:

on preparing for the battle instead.

大きく影響するだろう

I am aware that there is dissatisfaction with the
length of the meeting. However, this matter will
greatly impact the future of Lestania.

column3: 何か心配事でも？

我々が当事者でなければ良いと思っていたが
案の定、焼け石を拾ってしまったようだ
column4:
Regardless of what may happen, we had hoped that
we wouldn't be involved, but sure enough, it seems
like we've picked up a burnt stone.

column3:
侵食魔どもめ――
奴らのせいでじっくり考える事もできん
column4:
Those invaders-- they're the reason I can't even
think straight.

column3:
協力を惜しむ必要はないが
レスタニアの利を忘れるなよ
column4:
There is no need to be stingy with collaboration,
but don't forget about the benefit of Lestania.

column3:
危険は避けられないとしても
無謀な行動は慎むのだぞ
column4:
Even though danger is inevitable,
you must refrain from reckless behavior.

column3:
問題は幾つもあるが
せめて侵食魔だけでも排除できないものだろうか
そうなれば人員配置が楽になるのだが
column4:
There are a number of problems, but can we at
least eliminate the Corruption demon? That would
make manpower allocation a lot easier.

column3:
奪われた《原始の雫》――
多少出過ぎた真似をしてもかまわんから
必ず取り戻すのだぞ
column4:
The Arisen must fight to protect the land. All we
can do is believe.

column3:
奪われた城を取り戻すという悲願の成就
解放軍の面々はさぞ喜んでいるだろう
column4:
The fulfillment of the long-held dream of
regaining the castle that was taken from us
I'm sure the liberation army is very happy to see
you.

column3:
宝珠の力を解放したぞ
本来の効果は得られずとも
解放した力は大地を巡り
またいつの日かおまえの元へ戻るだろう
column4:
I have unleashed the power of the Orb.
Even if the original effect cannot be obtained,
The unleashed power will traverse the land,
And one day, it will surely return to you.

column3:
宝珠の力を解放することで
各地とおまえの結び付きは
より強固なものとなるだろう
column4:
By releasing the power of the Orb,
your ties to the regions will
grow stronger.

column3:
宝珠の力を解放するには少し時間がかかる

パーティーメンバーを無暗に
待たせてしまうかもしれん

column4:

column3:
弱っているところをああも露骨に見せるのは
いかがなものかな――
column4:
Is it really necessary to make one's weaknesses
so obvious...

column3:
当面の目的であったネド王子の救出は
思惑通りに終わったわけだが――
column4:
The rescue mission of Prince Nedo, which was the
immediate objective, has ended as planned.

column3:
思えば、わたしの記憶の中の白竜は
いつも病み、苦しんでいた
しかし、これほど痛ましい状況は初めてだ
column4:
Looking back, the White Dragon in my memories
was always sick and suffering
However, this is the first time I have witnessed
such a painful situation.

column3:
悠々と、ただそこにある世界を前に――
我々はなんと小さく、稚拙な存在なのだろうな
column4:
In front of the serene and simply existing
world-- We are so small and immature, aren't we?

column3: 想像するとわたしまで頬が緩むわ
column4: I can't help but smile when I think about it.

column3: 慌てて結論に飛びついてはいかんのだ
column4: We shouldn't jump to conclusions in a hurry.

column3:
我々で迎えることができてうれしいよ
ああ、これは本心だ
column4:
Estou feliz que possamos recebê-lo aqui.
Ah, isso é sincero.

column3:
我々は常に己を律し、不測の事態に備えねばならん
わかってはいるが――なかなか、なぁ
column4:
Devemos sempre nos disciplinar e estar preparados
para circunstâncias imprevistas.
Eu entendo isso, mas... é bastante difícil.

column3: 指示や助言をしようにも情報が足りんわ
column4:
Mesmo que eu tente dar instruções ou conselhos,
não há informações suficientes.

column3: 敵の攻勢は予想通りだ
column4: A ofensiva do inimigo é previsível.

column3:
敵の砦に乗り込むと聞いている
くれぐれも気をつけてな
column4:
Ouvi dizer que você vai atacar uma
fortaleza inimiga.
Tenha cuidado.

column3:
日がな一日ここに立ち、竜を思い、政を思う
おまえたちを思う時間はほとんどないが、まあ許せ
column4:
Eu fico aqui o dia todo, pensando em dragões
e pensando na política.
Eu não tenho muito tempo para pensar em vocês,
mas, bem, é perdoável.

column3:
時に、ロイグの行方はまだわからんのか
もしや救いを求めているということはないか？
column4:
Às vezes, ainda não se sabe onde está Loeg.
Será que ele está buscando salvação?

column3: 時間を見つけて外へ出てみるんだな
column4: Arranje um tempo e saia para ver por si mesmo.

column3:
機先を制するには腰を据えた思索が
不可欠だというのに――
column4:
A fim de tomar a liderança,
é crucial se envolver em contemplação e reflexão
aprofundadas.

column3:
次から次へと――どうしてくれようか
オークどもの対処だけでも大変なのに
今度はアークだと？
column4:
De uma coisa para outra--como vamos lidar com isso?
Apenas lidar com os orcs já é difícil o suficiente,
e agora é a Arca?

column3: 次の動きが気になるところだな
column4: Eu estou curioso sobre o próximo movimento.

column3:
気になることがあるのなら
さっさと解決しておくことを薦めるよ
column4:
Se há algo em sua mente, eu recomendo
resolver isso prontamente.

column3:
無事LV.80になったようだぞ
さて、次はスキルだな
――もう一度目を閉じるがよい
column4:
Parece que eu alcancei o nível 80 com segurança.
Agora, é hora das habilidades.
Feche seus olhos mais uma vez.

column3:
状況が変われば考え方を変える
その柔軟さが美点だったが――
それすらも変わってしまったのだろうか
column4:
Se a situação muda, mude sua forma de pensar.
Essa flexibilidade era uma virtude, mas--Será que isso também mudou?

column3:
狙われるのはメイリーフだけではない、とな
自分の身勝手さに驚くしかなかったよ
column4:
Não era só Mayleaf que estava sendo visada.
Eu só pude me surpreender com meu próprio egoísmo.

column3: 理の外の世界――

異郷の地にひとり残るとは
エリオットの評価を改めねばならんな
column4:
Permanecer sozinho em uma terra estrangeira,
Eu terei que rever minha avaliação de Elliot.

column3: 異郷の姿、その目でしかと見届けよ
column4:
Mesmo que seja possível que os espíritos das
árvores jovens na floresta possam ser os espíritos de
sua cidade natal, acho que a única coisa que você pode fazer
agora é ter esperança e orar.

column3:
白竜の意思を完全に理解することは難しい
たとえ巫女でもな
column4:
É difícil entender completamente as
intenções do Dragão Branco, mesmo que alguém seja
uma sacerdotisa.

column3:
白竜はフィンダムの精霊竜ウィルミアに
語りかけようとしているがうまくいかないようだ
column4:
O resto-- essa é a responsabilidade do Dragão Branco
e a tarefa do Dragão Branco.

column3:
白竜様へはおまえから報告するといい
つもる話はそれからでも遅くはない
column4:
É melhor relatar ao Dragão Branco pessoalmente.
Não há mal nenhum em falar sobre isso mais tarde.

column3: 短期決戦と相成ればよいが
column4: Eu espero que seja uma guerra curta.

column3: 砦との往復は何度目だ？
column4: Quantas vezes você foi ao forte e voltou?

column3:
砦に限らず、あちこち自分の足で
行ってみることが大切だ
地図を眺めていても頭に入らんだろうからな
column4:
É importante ir e ver por si mesmo, não
apenas na fortaleza, mas também em vários lugares.
Mesmo que você olhe para o mapa,
isso não entrará na sua cabeça.

column3:
竜と竜力、そして大地の恵みが不可分で
ある以上、竜のいない大陸は
考えられない
column4:
Dragão e Força Dracônica,
junto com as bênçãos da terra, são inseparáveis.
Portanto, um continente sem dragões
é inimaginável.

column3:
竜の意志を紡ぐこと
それが我らを災いから救うのだ
column4:
Tecendo a vontade do dragão
É isso que nos salvará do desastre.

column3:
精神的な強い衝撃が人の記憶を奪うという
話は昔から知られている
column4:
A história de um forte impacto psicológico que
rouba as pessoas de sua memória é conhecida desde
os tempos antigos.

column3:
聞こえてくる話から想像するに
ネド王子の性根は悪くなさそうだ
友好的な関係を築いてくれよ
column4:
Pelas histórias que ouço, parece que o Príncipe
Nedo não é uma pessoa ruim no fundo.
Ele construiu relacionamentos amigáveis.

column3:
自分に言い聞かせようとしているが
なかなか――な
column4:
Estou tentando dizer isso a mim mesmo,
mas não é fácil de...

乙女という風情だが――
column4:

com um coração inocente...

column3:
覚者に力を与えたぶんだけ
白竜自身の回復が遅れる――
そう考えることもできる
column4:
Quanto mais poder o Arisen recebe,
mais lenta se torna a recuperação
do próprio Dragão Branco.

column3:
覚者のことは覚者に任せるしかない

column4:
Só os Arisen podem lidar entre si.
Observe-os com atenção.

column3:
覚者の本分は白竜の回復を助けることだ
――ゆめゆめ忘れるなよ
column4:
O dever do Arisen é auxiliar
na cura do Dragão Branco.
Jamais se esqueça disso.

column3:
覚者よ、頼んだぞ
おまえたちの働きが大勢を決める
column4:
Arisen, conto com você.
Suas ações decidirão o destino de muitos.

column3:
覚者を育てるのは、結局のところ経験だ
いや、これは覚者に限らないがな
column4:
O que molda um Arisen é a experiência.
Aliás, isso vale pra todos nós.

column3:
解放軍が勢い付いたことで
アッカーシェランの混乱はますます
拡大するだろう
column4:
Com o avanço do Exército da Libertação,
o caos em Akashalan tende a se agravar.

column3:
解決の方法も、何かあるのかもしれない

column4:
Talvez haja uma solução.
Descubra com jeitinho e ofereça ajuda.

column3:
言うまでもないことだろうが――
城の奪回はそう簡単なことではないだろう
column4:
Não preciso dizer, mas...
tomar o castelo de volta não será fácil.

column3: 誇り高き孤独な魂――

無為なことと断じるつもりもない
column4:
Não posso concordar,
mas também não direi que é inútil.

column3:
近々、ある調査団を派遣することになってな

column4:
Logo enviarei uma expedição
e estou ocupado escolhendo o time.

column3:
頼むぞ
レオとおまえの間にどんな絆が――

column4:
Por favor,
seja qual for seu laço com Leo—
ou qualquer rixa que haja,
ajude Cecily antes de tudo.

column3:
首尾はどうだ？
朗報を待っているぞ
column4:
E então, como foi?
Estou esperando boas notícias.

column3:
騎士団と覚者が力を合わせて戦えば
勝てぬ相手などおらん――
column4:
Se cavaleiros e Arisen lutarem juntos,
não haverá inimigo que nos vença.

column3:
いいのか――
俺たち覚者はこのままでいいのだろうか――
column4:
Será que está certo...
Será que nós, Arisen, devemos seguir assim...?

column3:
おまえは感じたことはないか？
自分の真ん中を貫く、熱いモノ――

column4:

e o medo de que ele se apague?

column3: この仕打ちは――なんだ――
column4:

Que tipo de provação é essa...?

column3:
ご苦労だったな
とりあえず今は何もない
column4:
Bom trabalho.
Por ora, não tenho nada para você.

column3:

column4:
Aquele homem enviou o Arco,
usou Zuhl para unir os orcs,
