column3: ご機嫌いかがかしら？
お互い、油断せずいきましょう
column4: Vamos ambos ser cuidadosos e não baixar a guarda.

column3:
覚者も騎士も、苦労は同じだと
思うのよね
column4:
Both the Arisen and the Knights face the same
hardships, I believe.

column3: あぁ、調子はどうだ？
魔物どもは増える一方だな
column4: The number of monsters is increasing.

column3: ん、何か用か？
column4: Hmm, what can I do for you?

column3: ――装備の点検はこまめにな
column4:
- The inspection of the equipment should be done
regularly.

column3: 準備はいつも整えておけよ
道具類はまさかの時に必要だぞ
column4: Tools are necessary in case of emergencies.

column3: ふう、まったくお互い大変そうね
column4:
Phew, both of us seem to be going through a tough
time, don't we?

column3:
魔物に食われるくらいなら
逃げるよ、わたしは
column4: I'd rather run away than be eaten by demons.

column3: さぁ、次はどうしようか
column4: So, what should we do next?

column3: 調子はどうだ？

装備はできるだけ軽くしておけよ
足の差はでかいぞ
column4:
Try to keep your equipment as light as possible.
The difference in mobility is significant.

column3:
大型魔物に登るときは、奴らの動きを
よく観察しろよ
column4:
When climbing on large monsters, observe their
movements well.

column3: うん、何？
ごめんね、今ちょっと話しかけないで
column4: I'm sorry, please don't talk to me right now

column3: 特に用はないんでしょ？
column4: You don't have any special purpose, right?

column3: ――ああ、なんだ？
どうした、何か聞きたいのか？
column4: O que foi, você quer perguntar alguma coisa?

column3: 敵はいつくるかわからんぞ
column4: Você nunca sabe quando o inimigo vai atacar.

column3: ご機嫌いかが？
ここには何しにきたの？
column4: O que você veio fazer aqui?

column3: さ、そろそろ別のところへいこうかな
column4: Bem, está na hora de ir para outro lugar.

column3: ふむ――なにかね？
近頃はなかなか厄介な事件が増えてきたな
column4:
Ultimamente, tem havido alguns incidentes bem
problemáticos.

column3: 魔物の活性を抑える術があればいいのだが
column4:
Se houvesse uma forma de suprimir a atividade do
inimigo, isso seria ótimo.

column3: あら、ご機嫌いかがですか？
column4: Oh, como você está se sentindo?

column3: 癒し手の需要は増える一方です
column4: A demanda por curandeiros continua aumentando.

column3: あなたの旅によき導きがありますように
column4: Que você tenha uma boa orientação em sua jornada

column3: あなたの旅によき導きがありますように
column4: Que você tenha uma boa orientação em sua jornada

column3: 今日があるのも、白竜さまのおかげでございます
column4:
A existência de hoje também é graças ao Dragão
Branco

column3: 任務、ご苦労様です覚者様
column4: Obrigado pelo seu trabalho duro, Arisen.

column3: あなたの旅によき導きがありますように
column4: Que você tenha uma boa orientação em sua jornada

column3: 今日があるのも、白竜さまのおかげですね
column4:
A existência de hoje também é graças ao Dragão
Branco, não é?

column3: お仕事頑張ってくださいませ、覚者様
column4: Boa sorte com seu trabalho, Arisen

column3: よし、その調子で修練を重ねろよ！

技は一日にしてならず！
ひとつひとつ身に付けていくんだ
column4:
Habilidade não vem em um dia! Você tem que aprender
cada um passo a passo.

column3:
訓練にやりすぎはないぞ
じっくり実戦前に稽古していけ！
column4:
Não existe treinamento em excesso. Dedique um
tempo e pratique antes da batalha real!

column3: おう、訓練について質問か？
column4: Oh, você tem alguma pergunta sobre o treinamento?

column3:
白竜に選ばれし覚者様――
古の武器についてであれば、お力になれるかと
column4:
Mestre Arisen, escolhido pelo Dragão Branco - Se
for sobre armas antigas, posso ser de ajuda.

column3:
人が武器を選ぶばかりではなく――
時として、武器が人を選ぶこともありましょう
column4:
Não são apenas humanos que escolhem armas -
Às vezes, as armas também escolhem seus portadores.

column3: どうか貴方様も、それをお忘れなく
column4: Por favor, não se esqueça disso

column3:
武器とは、討つべきものの数だけ
それに相応しき"かたち"があるもの――
column4:
Uma arma tem tantas formas quanto há coisas para
matar.

column3:
竜の敵となりうるおそろしき魔を退けるには
手に持つ刃もまた、特別でなければなりません
column4:
Para repelir os demônios temíveis que podem se tornar
inimigos do dragão, as lâminas que empunhamos
também devem ser especiais.

column3:
遠き古より流れ伝わる智――
覚者の、そしてポーンの民の――
column4:
Desde tempos remotos, a sabedoria que foi
transmitida continua a fluir— Dos Arisen e
do povo conhecido como Peões—

column3:
戦徒が、自ら主の剣となり鎧となるために
より良き剣や鎧を生まんとするは
必然ではないでしょうか――
column4:
Não seria natural que um Guerreiro buscasse
armas e armaduras melhores, para se tornar a espada e o escudo
de seu próprio Arisen?

column3: おう、調査の進捗はどうだ？
column4: E aí, como está o progresso da investigação?

column3:
辺りをぐるっと歩いてみたが
この島の生態系はレスタニアとは
えらく違うようだな
column4:
Dei uma volta por aí e o ecossistema desta ilha
parece ser bem diferente de Lestania.

column3:
いつ、どんな魔物が飛び出してくるかわからんぞ
とっさの状況にも対処できるよう
装備や持ち物は常に見直しておけよ
調査探索の基本だ！
column4:
Você nunca sabe quando e que tipo de criatura
vai aparecer. Sempre revise seu equipamento e
itens para estar pronto para qualquer situação.
É o básico da exploração e
investigação!

column3:
この魔赤島調査隊は精鋭揃いだ
難しい任務ではあるが、士気も高い
――俺か？　俺も久しぶりに勇み立ってるな！
column4:
Esta equipe de expedição da Ilha Rubra Demoníaca é formada
por membros de elite. Embora seja uma missão
difícil, o moral deles está alto. ――E quanto a mim? Eu também
estou sentindo uma onda de coragem depois de muito tempo!

column3:
前はグリッテン砦の防衛戦に参加していたんだが
モゴックの奴が墜ちてからは
いまいち張り合いが無くてな――
column4:
Eu costumava participar da defesa do Forte Gritten,
mas desde que aquele cara do Mogok caiu, eu
não tenho tido o mesmo nível de emoção--a
competição tem estado realmente fraca.

column3:
ここのエリアマスター就任の打診を受けた時は
これぞ、と思ったものだ！
column4:
Quando recebi a oferta para me tornar 
um Mestre de Área aqui, eu pensei, "É isso!"

column3:
見ての通り、この駐屯地は臨時のものだ
だが、調査のために必要なものについては
それなりの質のものを集めている
column4:
Como você pode ver, esta base é temporária, 
mas reunimos o equipamento necessário 
para a investigação.

column3:
質だけじゃなく、数もきっちり揃えてあるぞ！
お前の部下たちにも遠慮なく使うよう
言っておいてくれ
column4:
Não apenas a qualidade, mas também a quantidade é
meticulosa! Por favor, diga aos seus subordinados para usá-lo
sem hesitação.

column3:
おう、来たな！
あらためて自己紹介しておこうか
魔赤島調査隊、隊長のベルトランだ
この島のエリアマスターも兼任している
column4:
Oh, you've arrived! Let me introduce myself
again. I'm Bertrand, the captain of the Bloodbane
Isle research team. I'm also the Area Master of
this island.

column3:
エリアマスターとは言っても
こんな状況だ
まだ何一つわからんがな！
まずは拠点を一通り設営したところだ
column4:
Even though I say I'm an Area Master, the
situation is like this. I still don't understand
anything! First, I have to set up the base.

column3:
――そう不安そうな顔をするな！
島の全体像を早期に探るべく
身軽な人員を俺直属の斥候隊として
連れてきたから安心してくれ！
column4:
Don't look so worried! I've brought a team of
agile individuals as my direct reconnaissance unit
to swiftly explore the entire island. So, rest
assured!

column3:
彼らにはなるべく戦闘を避けさせ
島の地形や魔物の生息状況を
重点的に探らせていく予定だ
column4:
We'll have them avoid combat as much as possible,
and focus on exploring the island's terrain and
demonic inhabitants.

column3:
そして、斥候隊を始めとする
各部隊からの情報を統括したり
調査の方向性を監督するのが俺の仕事ってわけだ
column4:
And so, my job involves overseeing information
from various units, including the scout team, and
supervising the direction of the investigation.

column3:
監督といっても
お前たちはそれぞれの判断で
調査を進めてくれて構わん！
ジョゼフ様直々のお達しだ
column4:
Speaking of the overseer, each of you can proceed
with the investigation based on your own judgment!
This is a direct order from Joseph himself.

column3:
俺もこの拠点で大人しくしているつもりは無いぞ！
この未知の状況、己の実力を計るには
絶好のチャンスだ！　腕が鳴るな！
column4:
I don't intend to sit still at this base either!
In this unknown situation, it's the perfect
opportunity to test my abilities. I'm itching to
go!

column3:
調査の進捗はどうだ？
支援品を割り当てておいたから
持っていくといい
今後の働きに期待してるぞ！
column4:
How is the progress of the investigation? I have
allocated support items, so it would be good to
bring them along. I am expecting great work from
you in the future!

column3:
調査の成果が出始めているな
厳しい状況に変わりはないが
この調子で進めていこう
column4:
The results of the investigation are beginning to
show, but the situation remains severe. Let's
continue in this way.

column3:
お前の隊もいつも頑張ってくれている
支援品を少し大目に持っていくといい
今後も期待してるぞ！
column4:
Your squad always does a great job, too.
You can take a little extra support supplies with
you!
I'm looking forward to seeing more of you in the
future!

column3:
ふむ、この調査隊の中でも
ずば抜けた動きをしているのが
お前の隊だろう！
さすがはジョゼフ様のお墨付きだ！
column4:
Hmmm, of all these survey teams, the one that
stands out from the rest is yours!
That's what I'm talking about, Masters Joseph's
endorsement!

column3:
走り回ればそれだけ消耗もしているだろう
支援品の割り当てを増やしておくから
遠慮せずに持っていってくれ
column4:
If you keep running around, you'll exhaust
yourself even more.
I'll increase the allocation of support items, so
please don't hesitate to take them.

column3:
それにしても、拠点にできるような
状態の良い洞窟を早々に発見できたのは
本当に幸運だったな！
column4:
Regardless, being able to quickly discover a cave
in such a good condition, that could serve as a
base was truly fortunate!

column3:
島の南の方にある洞窟を知っているか？
調査隊内では《不浄の掃き溜め》と
呼んでいる洞窟だ
column4:
Do you know about the cave located in the
southern part of the island? Within our expedition
team, we refer to it as the "Cesspool of Filth".

column3:
実はあそこも、この洞窟と同時期に
発見していたんだが
ここと違って、内部が凄まじい状態でな
column4:
Actually, we also discovered that place around
the same time as this cave.
But unlike here, the interior is in a terrible
state.

column3:
何らかの肉食獣が棲みついていたのか
そこら辺に腐った死肉が散乱して――
臭いもそれはひどいもんだった！
column4:
Some kind of predator was living in the area.
There was rotting dead meat scattered around--
and the smell was terrible!

column3:
奥に肉食獣が潜伏しているのを予感して
早期に封鎖しておいたんだが、
お前の実力があれば探索できそうだ
column4:
I had a hunch there was a predator lurking in the
back,
so I sealed it off early.
I'm sure you could explore it if you're up to it.

column3:
もし臭いが気にならない性質なら
内部を探索しに行ってみてくれ
column4:
If it's in your nature to not mind the smell, go
and explore the interior.

column3:
そういえば、ここから西に行ったところに
開けた土地があるんだが知っているか？
調査隊では《滝を臨む蝕地》と呼んでいるが――
column4:
By the way, do you know that there is an open
piece of land if you go west from here? The survey
team calls it "Corrupted Ground Facing the
Waterfall".

column3:
あそこには以前から
侵食ゴブリンどもがうろついていたんだが
最近、数が増えて大きな群れになっているようだ
column4:
There have been corruptions, infected goblins
wandering around over there for a while, but
recently, their number has increased and they seem
to have formed a large herd.

column3:
元がゴブリンとはいえ
侵食の作用で凶暴化している上に
数がいると中々厄介だぞ
侮って痛い目を見ないよう気を付けてくれ
column4:
Even though they are goblins, they become even
more aggressive due to the corrupting effect, and
it can be troublesome when there are many of them.
Be careful not to underestimate them and suffer
the consequences.

column3:
ちょうどいいタイミングで来てくれた！
お前に頼みたいことがあってな
column4:
You came just in time!
I have a favor to ask you.

column3:
この拠点から南西の方角の海岸沿いに
古い地下聖堂のような場所が見つかってな
封鎖されていたが、先日ようやく開けることができた
column4:
From this base, a place resembling an old
underground cathedral was discovered along the
southwestern coast. It had been sealed off, but
was finally able to be opened the other day.

column3:
中は水が流れていて静かな雰囲気だ――
俺たちは《せせらぎの地下聖堂》と呼んでいる
まぁ、実際に聖堂として使われていたのかは
定かではないが――
column4:
Inside, water is flowing, creating a serene
atmosphere—
We call it the "Crypt of Murmurs."
Well, it's unclear whether it was actually used
as a sanctuary—
but it has a holy land-like ambiance.

column3:
この島には珍しく、文化的な造形物が
数多く残されているようだ
あそこを探ることで、何か得るものが
あるんじゃないかと思ってな
column4:
Unusually for this island, there seems to be a
great number of cultural structures that have been
preserved. I believe there may be something to
gain by exploring there.

column3:
だが、内部には危険度の高い
魔物が徘徊していて、
相応の戦力を持った者でないと
とても調査は任せられん
column4:
However, within, there are highly dangerous
enemies wandering around, and unless one possesses
sufficient fighting power, I cannot entrust the
investigation to them.

column3:
そこで、お前に頼みたいというわけだ
調査に向かうタイミングは任せよう
準備ができたら、また声をかけてくれ！
column4:
That's why I'm asking for your help. I'll leave
it to you to decide when to head out to
investigate. When you're ready, give me a call
again!

column3:
各隊員の尽力によって
この島の調査も進みつつあるな！
中でもお前の隊の働きは格別だ！
column4:
Thanks to the efforts of each team member,
the investigation of this island is progressing!
Your team's work, in particular, is exceptional!

column3:
この状況では中々報いてやることもできないが
せめて支援品の割り当てだけでも
増やせるように手配しておこう！
column4:
In this situation, it may not be possible to
retaliate right away, but let's at least make
arrangements to increase the allocation of aid
supplies!

column3:
この島に一つ、塔があるだろう
《聖遺の塔》と呼ばれているあそこだ
あの近くに古い井戸があってな
column4:
There should be one tower on this island, it's
called the "Sage Tower Ruins". There is an old
well near there.

column3:
井戸蓋の部分が錆び付いていて
開けられなかったんだが
この間、ようやくこじ開けることができた
column4:
The part of the well cover was rusted and
couldn't be opened, but recently, I was finally
able to pry it open.

column3:
中の探索までは中々手が回っていないが
もしお前の手が空いていたら
覗いてみても損は無いだろう
column4:
I haven't gotten around to exploring inside, but
if you're available, it wouldn't hurt to take a
peek.

column3:
北の方の沿岸に、肉食の魔物が集まりやすい
開けた土地があるのを知っているか？
獲物の死肉が溜め込まれている広場だ
column4:
Did you know that there is an open area of land
on the northern coast where carnivorous creatures
tend to congregate?
It's a square where the carcasses of their prey
are stored.

column3:
先日、あの広場に
新手のナイトメアが舞い降りたんだが
隊士を討伐に向かわせてみても、飛び回る上に
歌ったり叫んだりで手に負えんらしい
column4:
The other day, a new nightmare landed in that
plaza.
I sent a squad to take it down, but they were
flying around, singing and screaming and it was
too much for them to handle.

column3:
ナイトメアの声には
特殊な魔力が込められているからな
あの辺りに近づく時は注意してくれ
column4:
The voice of the Nightmare contains a special
kind of magic, so be cautious when getting close
to that area.

column3:
そうだ、お前にも話しておこう
この島に来て最初に調査することになった
《侵食魔の巣窟》の奥に
更なる空間が広がっていたのを覚えているか？
column4:
That's right, I should tell you too. When I first
came to this island, I was assigned to investigate
the depths of the "Infected Den". Do you remember
that there was a further expanse beyond it?

column3:
予想以上に侵食が進んでいたことから
一旦は俺の判断で封鎖していたんだが
島全体の調査も進んできたことを考えて
そろそろ封鎖を解こうと思ってな
column4:
The Corruption had progressed more than
anticipated, so I temporarily sealed it off based
on my judgment. However, considering that the
investigation of the entire island has also
progressed, I think it's about time to lift the
blockade.

column3:
奥は侵食が進み
特に強力な侵食魔が巣食っていることは
まず間違いないだろう
column4:
The depths have been corrupted, and there is no
doubt that a powerful infected demon is nesting
there.

column3:
調査に入る時は
くれぐれも警戒を怠らないように
抗侵薬の予備も豊富に用意して向かってくれ
column4:
When entering the investigation, please be
extremely cautious and do not neglect your
vigilance. Please also bring ample supplies of
Corruption Preventative with you.

column3:
ちょっとばかりマズい状況になってきてな
"侵食"の進行スピードがこちらの予想を
上回っているようだ――
column4:
The situation is becoming a bit troublesome. The
speed of Corruption seems to be surpassing our
expectations.

column3:
《翼風高原》に
侵食ゴアサイクロプスが現れたんだが
こいつがまた派手に侵食が進んだ個体だ
column4:
An "Infected Goreclops" has appeared in the Wing
Wind Plateau, and this individual's infection has
advanced quite dramatically.

column3:
"侵食核"って呼び名らしいが、とにかく頭に
イバラみたいなものを２本も生やしてやがる
あれは体に回りきった毒が
行き場を失って噴きだしたような状態だ
column4:
It's called the "Corruption Core," it's got two
thorny appendages sticking out of it. It's like
the poison in the body has run out of places to go
and started to burst out.

column3:
侵食が進んだ魔物は凶暴性が増すのは
前に説明した通りだが
あそこまで侵食が進んでしまうと
もう別種の魔物と考えた方がいいだろうな――
column4:
As I explained before, when a monster's
corruption advances, its aggressiveness increases.
However, when the corruption has progressed to
that extent, it might be better to consider it as
a different species of creature altogether.

column3:
ともかく、あれは並の隊士に任せるわけにはいかない
かと言って、調査の妨げになる恐れから
放置するのも気がかりだ
column4:
Anyway, leaving it to ordinary squad members
isn't an option, but at the same time, I'm
concerned that it might hinder the investigation.

column3:
頼めるのであれば、お前に討伐を
任せたいんだが――
引き受けてくれるのであれば
あらためて詳細を説明しよう
column4:
If it's possible to rely on you, I would like to
entrust the subjugation to you... If you are
willing to accept, let me explain the details
again.

column3:
お前の隊の目覚ましい働きには
まったく舌を巻くばかりだ！
さすがはレオの後任と期待されるだけあるな！
column4:
The remarkable work of your squad is absolutely
mind-blowing!
You are indeed the expected successor to Leo!

column3:
本当はもっときちんと報いてやりたいものだが
この島では手に入るものに限りがあるからな――
その中でも一際良い物が
お前の隊に回るよう手配しよう
column4:
I actually want to reward you more properly, but
there are limitations to what can be obtained on
this island. Among those, I will arrange for
something particularly good to be allocated to
your squad.

column3:
これからもその調子で調査を進めてくれ
頼りにしているぞ！
column4:
Keep up the good work and keep up the research.
I'm counting on you!

column3:
橋を渡ったところに大きな坑道跡があるのは
もう知っているか？
column4:
There is a large mine site across the bridge. Do
you already know about it?

column3:
古い坑道は崩落が怖いからな
安全確保のために今まで封鎖していたが
地盤もそう脆くはないようだから
封鎖を解くことにした
column4:
Because there is fear of collapse in the old
tunnels, We have been sealing them off for safety
measures. However, since the ground doesn't seem
to be too weak, We have decided to lift the seal.

column3:
お前には一足先に教えておこう
前人未踏の場所を探索してみたければ
今が絶好の機会だぞ！
column4:
Let me tell you in advance; If you want to
explore uncharted territory, now is a great
opportunity!

column3:
西の方に水量の多い洞窟があってな
恐らくあそこが辺り一帯の
水源になってるんだろう
column4:
There is a cave with a lot of water to the west.
It is likely that it is the source of water in
this area.

column3:
中に入ると四方八方から滝の音が聞こえて
方向感覚を失いそうになるくらいだ
調査隊では《滝鳴洞穴》と呼んでいる
column4:
Once inside, you can hear the sound of the
waterfall from all directions and almost lose your
sense of direction. The survey team calls it
"Echo Cascade Cavern
."

column3:
この島は全体的に水が豊富な印象だが
《滝鳴洞穴》は別格だぞ
column4:
I get the impression that water is plentiful on
this island as a whole, but Echo Cascade Cavern

is something else!

column3:
暗い洞窟内で流される危険性や
滝の存在を考慮して封鎖していたが、
お前にはそんな心配は要らんな
column4:
We had it sealed off due to the danger of being
swept away in the dark cave and the presence of
waterfalls, but you don't need to worry about
that.

column3:
封鎖を解いておこう
一度行ってみてくれ
column4:
Let's lift the blockade; Please go and see for
yourself.

column3:
ふむ――
最近は侵食のペースが以前にも増して
早まっているように思わないか？
column4:
Hmm... Don't you think that the rate of
corruption has been increasing recently?

column3:
この間、《菌糸の襲窟》と呼んでいる洞窟の
初期調査が終わったんだが
内部もかなり侵食が進んでいて
そこらへん菌胞だらけになってやがってな
column4:
Recently, we finished the initial investigation
of a cave known as the "Fungal Colony Caves," but
the interior is heavily corrupted. The place is
filled with fungal spores.

column3:
斥候に行った隊士も
あらかじめ抗侵薬を飲んでから向かったそうだ
column4:
Even the troopers who went scouting took
Corruption Preventative before they went.

column3:
実際はそこまでするほどではないんだが
気持ちはわからんでもない有様だ――
column4:
In reality, it might not be as bad as it seems,
but I can understand the concern about it.

column3:
当然、侵食魔もウヨウヨしている
お前も《菌糸の襲窟》に向かう時は
抗侵薬を忘れずに持っていくようにな
column4:
Of course, the infected creatures are also
crawling about. When you head towards the Fungal
Colony Caves, make sure to bring the
Corruption Preventative with you.

column3:
ううむ――
いや、少しばかり悩ましい事態になってな
column4:
Hmm... Well, it seems that things have become
somewhat troubling.

column3:
《菌糸の襲窟》の奥に、侵食ベヘモットが
潜んでいることがわかったんだが
こいつが厄介で――
すでに３人の隊士が負傷して帰ったほどだ
column4:
We discovered that a Corrupted Behemoth lurks in
the depths of the "Fungal Colony Caves", and it's
a troublesome one. Three squad members have
already returned injured because of it.

column3:
本来であれば俺が向かいたいところだが
ストックしてある医療物資が
底を尽きかけていることもあって、
物資の確保が何よりの急務になってしまった
column4:
Normally, I would have headed there myself, but
our stock of medical supplies is running out, and
securing supplies has become a matter of the
utmost urgency.

column3:
医療物資の確保も無しに
隊士を討伐に送り出したり、
まして一人討伐に飛び出したとなっては
間違いなくクラリッサに文句を言われるからな――
column4:
Sending squad members to face this threat without
securing medical supplies, let alone heading out
to face it alone, will definitely earn me a
scolding from Clarissa.

column3:
そうだ
お前、クラリッサに内緒で
あの侵食ベヘモットを
討伐してきてくれないか？
column4:
Yeah. Can you, without letting Clarissa know, go
and defeat that Corrupted Behemoth for us?

column3:
今までも大型の侵食魔を何体も
相手にしてきたお前なら、きっと倒せるはずだ！
こんな大物とやり合う機会もそう無いぞ！
どうだ？　気になったらあらためて声をかけてくれ
column4:
You've faced numerous large Corrupted Beasts in
the past, and I believe you can defeat it!
Opportunities to challenge such a formidable foe
are rare. So, what do you say? If you're
interested, let me know, and we can discuss it
further.

column3:
良いニュースがあるぞ！
調査が進んだことで
レスタニアからの物資を運ぶルートの整備も
ずいぶんと捗ってな！
column4:
Tenho boas notícias! Com o avanço da pesquisa, a
manutenção da rota para transportar suprimentos de
Lestania está progredindo muito bem!

column3:
今後はより良い支援物資が安定して
送られてくるそうだ
これで、お前の隊も少しは楽になるだろう
column4:
Eles vão enviar um fluxo constante de
melhores suprimentos de socorro a partir de agora.
Isso deve facilitar um pouco as coisas para o seu
esquadrão.

column3:
それにしても、お前がいなければ
今頃この島の調査もここまでは進んで
いなかっただろう！
column4:
Mesmo assim, sem você, não teríamos feito tanto
progresso em nossa pesquisa da ilha até agora!

column3:
魔赤島調査にかける熱意、そして実力――
どれをとっても抜きんでた働きだ！
今後も期待しているぞ！
column4:
A paixão e as habilidades dedicadas à
investigação da Ilha Sangrenta são excepcionais!
Estamos esperando grandes coisas no futuro!

column3:
俺のところに来るとはな――
話を聞こうじゃないか
column4:
Você veio me ver. Bem, vamos ouvir o que você
tem a dizer.

column3:
自分が無知であることを知るのは難しいことだ
「己の無知を知っている」と思うこと自体が
そうでないことの証明かも知れないだろう
column4:
É difícil saber que se é ignorante.
Pensar "Eu conheço minha própria ignorância" pode ser
uma prova de que não é assim.

column3:
世界は一つではない――
こう聞いた時、お前は何を思う？
column4:
Há mais de um mundo. O que você pensa quando
ouve isso?

column3:
自分の知らない国があるかも知れないと思うか？
それとも人々の相互理解の難しさを考えるか？
あるいは自分には見えない何かの存在を信じるか？
column4:
Você acha que pode haver países que você não
conhece? Ou você pensa na dificuldade de
entendimento mútuo entre as pessoas? Ou você
acredita na existência de algo que você não pode
ver?

column3:
お前の見ている世界と
俺の見ている世界は違うかもしれないぜ
column4: Então não hesite, venha aqui quando quiser.

column3:
それを見ている人間が違うんだから
目に映る世界自体が違うと言えなくもないだろう
column4:
Como a pessoa que está olhando para ele é diferente,
pode-se dizer que o próprio mundo que se reflete
nos olhos é diferente.

column3:
お前はもっとたくさんのことを
知るようになるだろう――
column4: Você virá a saber mais coisas.

column3:
知識が増える、といったことじゃない
お前の目はたくさんの世界を見ることになる――
そう、何かを追い求める限りな
column4:
Não se trata de ganhar conhecimento, Seus olhos verão
muitos mundos— Sim, desde que você persiga algo.

column3:
お前の身体はひとつだ――
いかな勇者とてそれは変わらない
column4: Seu corpo é um só - nenhuma bravura muda isso.

column3:
まずは、挑むべき試練に集中するべきだ
慌てる事はない
column4:
Primeiro, devemos nos concentrar nos desafios que
precisamos enfrentar. Não há necessidade de
entrar em pânico.

column3: これはこれは、レスタニアの覚者様

レスタニアの方の目には
フィンダムはどのように映るのですか？
column4: Como Phindym aparece aos olhos do povo de Lestania?

column3:
私はフィンダムが気に入っていますよ
いえ、他の地に赴いたことはありませんが――
column4:
Eu gosto de Phindym. Não, eu nunca estive em outro
país—

column3:
ここを離れることはおろか
フィンダム以外の地があることすら知りませんでした
私にとっての唯一の場所なのです
column4:
Não apenas deixando este lugar, mas eu nem sabia
que havia outros lugares além de Phindym. É o único
lugar para mim.

column3:
視線が気になりますか？
何せ我々はレスタニアの人々を初めて見るもので――
column4:
Você está preocupado com os olhares? Afinal, nós
estamos vendo o povo de Lestania pela primeira
vez.

column3: ん？　何か用かな？

レスタニア――
不思議な響きだな
新鮮な感じがするよ
column4: Lestania— Tem um som misterioso, parece fresco.

column3:
僕は旅好きでね
親には良い顔をされなかったけど
しばらくダナを離れて色んなところを回ったんだ
column4:
Eu adoro viajar, sabe. Embora meus pais não
aprovassem, eu viajei para vários lugares por um
tempo, deixando Dana para trás.

column3:
いつかレスタニアにも行ってみたいものだな
自分の知らない場所があると思うと
それだけでワクワクしてくるよ
column4:
Eu gostaria de visitar Lestania algum dia. Isso me
empolga só de pensar que existem lugares
desconhecidos.

column3:
いつか、レスタニアの話を
ゆっくり聞かせてくれ
君らの手が空いた時でいい
column4:
Um dia, quando você tiver um momento, por favor,
tome seu tempo para me contar sobre Lestania.

column3: あっ、レスタニアの覚者さん！

ボク、鳥を飼ってたんだ
でも連れてこられなくて――
元気にしてるかなぁ――
column4:
Eu costumava ter um pássaro, mas não pude trazê-lo
comigo... Eu me pergunto se ele está bem...

column3:
ボクもおばあちゃんも、別の村に住んでたんだ
侵食のせいで住めなくなっちゃって――
それでここに逃げてきたんだよ
column4:
Tanto eu quanto minha avó estávamos morando em
uma vila diferente. Não podíamos mais morar lá,
por causa da corrupção. Foi por isso que viemos
aqui para escapar.

column3:
おばあちゃんはいつか帰れるっていうけど
ホントかな――
column4:
Eles dizem que a vovó voltará para casa algum dia.
Será que é verdade?

column3:
角が珍しい？
触ってもいいよ
column4:
É incomum ter chifres? Você pode tocar se
quiser.

column3:
――レスタニアの人って
角が無くて困らないの？
何かスカスカした感じ、しない？

最近は変なことばかり――
これから一体どうなるんだろうね――
column4:
Ultimamente, só têm acontecido coisas estranhas -
Eu me pergunto o que acontecerá a partir de
agora.

column3:
おぞましい魔物が現れたり、
異世界の覚者が来たり――
一体どうなっているのやら
column4:
Monstros hediondos aparecem,
Arisen de outro mundo vêm--
O que está acontecendo?

column3:
いえ、あなた方を悪く言うつもりはなくてね
ただ、心配なだけで――
column4:
Não, eu não pretendo falar mal de vocês. Eu só
estou preocupada, só isso...

column3:
私はね、私の家族を守りたいんだよ
孫を守るためならなんだってするし
孫を連れてどこまでも逃げるよ
column4:
Eu, sabe, eu quero proteger minha família. Eu farei
qualquer coisa para proteger meus netos. Eu vou
fugir com meus netos para qualquer lugar.

column3:
心配性かも知れないけど、
何よりも孫が大切なんだ――
誰にだってそういうもの、あるだろ？
column4:
Eu posso ser ansiosa, mas acima de tudo, meus
netos são importantes— Todo mundo tem algo assim,
não tem?

column3:
大切なものを守りたいっていう気持ちは
誰にだってあるものさ
失ってしまったら自分がどうなるかわからない
そんな大切なものが――
column4:
O sentimento de querer proteger algo importante é
algo que todo mundo tem. Se fôssemos perdê-lo,
não saberíamos o que aconteceria conosco. É tão
precioso assim—

column3:
あら、レスタニアの方
河を渡りたいのかしら？
column4:
Oh, you're the one from Lestania. Want to cross
the river?

column3:
トレアサにはもうお会いになった？
彼女、少し人見知りなんだけど
本当はとっても良い人なのよ
真面目で、温厚で、仕事熱心で――
column4:
Have you met Treasa already? She's a bit shy,
but she's actually a very nice person. She's
diligent, gentle, and dedicated to her work.

column3:
ここ、エラン水林は
綺麗なところでしょう？
空気も清浄で――
column4:
Here; Elan Water Grove is a beautiful place,
right? The air is also clean――

column3:
やっぱり水が多いからなのかしら？
ね、船の上で深呼吸してみて
きっと気持ちがいいわ
column4:
Is it because there is a lot of water after all?
Well, try taking a deep breath on the boat. It
will surely feel good.

column3:
はぁ、何だかお腹減ってきちゃった――
結構力仕事なのよねぇ
column4:
Ugh, I'm starting to get hungry... It's quite a
physically demanding job, you know.

column3: 何か御用？

ミューセルお姉様は、その、ちょっと――
考え事や調べ物に熱中されがちだから
わたしができることはお手伝いしてるの
column4:
Sister Mucel tends to be a bit—absorbed in her
thoughts and research, so I try to help where I
can.

column3:
あまりミューセルお姉様の手を
煩わせることはしないでね
column4: Please don't bother Suster Muselle too much

column3:
わたしがミューセルお姉様の弟子なのかって？
違うわ
――そうなれたらいいんだけど
column4:
Am I Sister Mucel's disciple? No, that's not it.
――I wish I could be though.

column3:
狭いところだけど、旅人さん用の寝床もあるの
お代として<VAL PRICE_INN>もらうけど
いいかしら？
column4:
It's a small place, but there is a sleeping space
for travelers as well. I will take <VAL PRICE_INN>
as payment, is that okay with you?

column3: はい
いいえ

旅人さん用の寝床も
毎日ちゃんと整えてるのよ
泊まっていくの？
column4:
We also have a sleeping area for travelers and we
set it up properly every day.
Are you staying the night?

column3: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》、ね！
ミューセルお姉様に教えてもらったから
ちゃんとできるはず――！
お代は<VAL PRICE_WEAK>よ、どうする？
column4:
"Treat Weakness," right? I learned it from Miss
Mucel, so I should be able to do it properly!
It'll cost you <VAL PRICE_WEAK>. What do you say?

column3: はい
いいえ

うーん？
弱化してないみたいだけど――
気分が優れないなら
少し休んでいくのはどうかしら
column4:
Huh? It seems you're not weakened, but if you're
not feeling well, maybe taking a little rest would
be a good idea.

column3:
レスタニアの覚者か
どうかしたか？
column4:
Is it the Arisen of Lestania? Is there something
wrong?

column3:
レスタニアには覚者がたくさんいるって？
――レスタニアの竜は、覚者を一人に
選びきれなかったのか？
column4:
Are there many Arisen in Lestania? - The dragon
of Lestania couldn't choose just one Arisen?

column3:
俺は覚者ではないが、
精霊竜とフィンダムを守るための
鍛練は欠かしたことがない
column4:
I may not be an Arisen, but I've never neglected
my training to protect the Spirit Dragon and
Phindym.

column3:
覚者こそは竜に選ばれし者だが、
選ばれなくたって竜を敬う気持ちに
変わりはないからな
column4:
Arisen are the ones chosen by the dragons, But
even if you're not chosen, the feeling of
respecting the dragons does not change, you know.

column3:
何だ？　俺が珍しいのか？
ここではお前たちの方がよっぽど珍しいが――
column4:
What is it? I'm unusual? You're much rarer here
than I am, but...

column3: よぉ！　何か用かね？
column4: Yo!　What can I do for you?

column3:
フィンダムの飯はどうだ？
口に合うといいんだがな
column4:
How's the food in Phindym? I hope it suits your
taste.

column3: 腹減ったな――

ダナ村ってところがあってな、
そこらへんで採れる野菜は味が濃くてウマイ！
なんというか、力強い味だ
column4:
There is a place called Dana Village. The
vegetables that grow around there have a rich and
delicious taste! It's kind of like a strong and
powerful flavor.

column3:
腹いっぱい食ってこそ、
この筋肉も仕事する気になってくれるってもんよ
column4:
Only if you eat a full meal will these muscles be
willing to work!

column3: レスタニアの覚者か――

何か用か？
手合せしたいというなら、手加減はしない
column4:
Do you have any business? If you want to play, I
won't go easy.

column3:
魔物にできた腫れ物のような、
寄生植物のような――
あの気持ちが悪いものを見たか？
column4:
Did you see that grotesque, tumor-like thing? It
looks like a parasitic plant, resembling an enemy?

column3:
どうやら、ああなると正気を失ってしまうようだ
気を付けたいものだな
column4:
Apparently, you lose your mind when you get like
that. I'd watch out for that.

column3:
魔物を異形化させるアレ――
実は、我々もアレを発症する可能性があるらしい
あんな惨い姿にはなりたくないな――
column4:
That thing that deforms demons—Actually, I heard
that we can develop it too. I don't want to look
that miserable—

column3: あら、レスタニアの方ね？
column4: Oh, you're from Lestania, aren't you?

column3:
実は、侵食魔のあの腫れ物のようなアレ――
プリーストの祈りによって治らないか
試してみたことがあるのよ
column4:
Actually, I have tried to see if the swelling,
like a tumor caused by corruption, can be healed
by the prayers of a Priest. No luck there though.

column3: まぁ、治らなかったわね

侵食魔にばかり目をとられがちだけど
植物や土の状態もひどいものよ

侵食魔が噴き出しているあの"胞子"――
あまり吸い込まないようにした方がいいわ
column4:
Those "spores" of the corrupting demon are
erupting— It's better not to inhale them too much.

column3:
――レスタニアの覚者ですね
船に乗りたいのですか？
column4:
You're an Arisen of Lestania. Do you want to
board the ship?

column3:
モルは少し変わったところがあるでしょう？
人の話をあまり聞いていないように見えたり
なぜかいつもお腹を空かせていたり――
column4:
Moles are a little different, aren't they? It
seems like they don't listen to people's stories
much and they're always hungry for some reason—

column3:
良い子なんですけどね
あれで中々しっかりしているんですよ
column4:
Eles são boas crianças, embora. Eles são bem
confiáveis com isso.

column3:
――なんですか
あまりジロジロ見ても
いいことはないですよ
column4: --O que é? Olhar demais não vai te fazer bem.

column3:
川のそばだから、この辺りはひんやりするでしょう
涼むにはぴったりなんです
column4:
Por estar perto do rio, esta área deve ser fresca, certo?
É perfeito para se refrescar.

column3:
あっ、覚者さま！？
自分にご用でしょうか？
column4: Ah, Arisen! Você precisa de mim?

column3:
本日はお日柄もよく――
って、何を言っているんだ、俺は
column4:
O sol está brilhando hoje-- O que estou dizendo,
eu não estou...

column3:
い、いえいえ！
ちょっと緊張してしまいまして！
column4: N-não, não, não! Eu estava um pouco nervoso!

column3: すみません、何をお話すれば良いのやら――
column4: Me desculpe, eu não sei o que te dizer--

column3: ん？　ああ、覚者さまじゃないですか
column4: Hm? Ah, não é o Arisen?

column3:
アッカーシェランに力を貸してくださり
ありがとうございます
column4:
Obrigado por emprestar sua força a Acre
Selund.

column4: Phew, I can do it too if I try

column3:
少し休もうかしら
誰も手を貸してくれないんだもの
column4:
Maybe I should take a short rest. Since no one is
lending a hand.

column3: な、なんでしょう？

もう、命からがら逃げてきたんです
な、何も持ってませんよ
勘弁してください
column4:
Hey, I don't have anything. I've already escaped
with my life. Give me a break!

column3:
この体以外、何も手元に残りませんでした
せめて親父の形見くらいは
持ってきたかったんですけど――
column4:
I was left with nothing but this body.
I wanted to bring at least a memento of my dad's,
but--

column3:
腹も減ったし、喉も乾いてますよ
どこか落ち着ける場所を探さないと
column4:
I'm hungry and thirsty. I need to find a place to
settle down.

column3:
はぁ、少し休みたいわ
ここまで逃げてくるのに精一杯で――
column4:
Sigh, I want to rest a little. I'm exhausted from
running away this far.

column3:
どこか、わたしを
受け入れてくれる村は無いかしら
ねぇ、ご存じない――？
column4:
I wonder if there is a village somewhere that
would accept me.
Hey, do you know of any--?

column3:
とにかく少しだけ休みたいの
そうすれば、次に何をすればいいか
考えられそうだから
column4:
I just want to rest for a while. That way, I can
think about what to do next.

column3:
村のみんな
無事かしら――
column4: I hope everyone in the village is safe—

column3:
あ、はい――
何かご用、ですか？
column4: Ah, yes―― Do you need anything?

column3:
ぐすっ――
ここがどこか、わからないんです
column4: I don't know where this is.

column3:
前を向いて走るのに必死で―ー
後ろにいたお母さんがいつの間にか
いなくなってたのに気付かなかったんです
column4:
I was running desperately, facing forward, and I
didn't even realize when my mother, who was behind
me, disappeared.

column3:
どこに、行けばいいんでしょう
しくしく――
column4: Where should I go, sob sob...

column3: むぅ、なんだなんだ！？
column4: What is it, what is it!?

column3:
この剣は王家へ捧げたもの！
今に名を残す英雄のように
それは勇ましく振るってみせよう
column4:
This sword is dedicated to the royal family! Just
like the renowned hero who will be remembered,
let's swing it valiantly.

column3:
いつかは王都メガドの護衛に
選ばれるツワモノにと夢見てきたが
今は手の届く範囲で戦うのに必死！
――だが、それも悪くない
column4:
I once dreamt of being one of the elite chosen to
guard the capital, Megado. But now, I'm just
struggling to fight within my reach. But even that
isn't so bad.

column3:
ん？　この盾が気になるのですかな？
素晴らしいデザインでしょう
column4:
Hm? Are you interested in this shield?
It has a splendid design.

column3: うん、話なら聞くよ
column4: Yeah, I'll listen if you want to talk.

column3:
魔物は私たちよりも鼻が利くし
もちろん耳だっていい
――まぁ、だから人間を
甘くみてるところもあるんだろうね
column4:
Enemies have a better sense of smell than us, and
of course, their hearing is also good. Well,
that's why they might underestimate humans
sometimes.

column3:
臨機応変に対処できるってのが
人間の一番の強みなんじゃないかな
column4:
The ability to adapt to different situations is
probably the greatest strength of a human, don't
you think?

column3:
魔物を追う時は
マズい場所に誘いこまれてないか
気を付けた方がいいよ
column4:
When pursuing enemies, it's better to be careful
and make sure you're not being led into dangerous
places.

column3: ああ、少し話すか？
column4: Ah, would you like to talk for a bit?

column3:
もう少しいい装備が欲しいところだが
贅沢は言ってられないか
column4:
I would like to have better equipment, but I
can't afford to be extravagant.

column3:
――なんだって？
すまない、大砲の音のせいか
ここのところ耳が遠くなったみたいだ
column4:
— What did you say? I'm sorry, it might be
because of the sound of the cannons. I think I'm
going deaf these days.

column3:
ここのところ戦いに出る日が続いて
なかなか武具の手入れができないのが、な――
戦場で壊れでもしたら、終わりだ
column4:
Lately, I have been going out to battle for
consecutive days and it's been difficult to
maintain my equipment, ah— If it were to break on
the battlefield, it would be the end.

column3: はい、どうかしました？

あなたも、きっとお強いんでしょうね
私はまだまだで――
column4:
Tenho certeza de que você também deve ser muito forte.
Eu ainda não estou pronta...

column3:
もっとがんばらないといけませんね
今度こそ、人を支えられるように
なりたいんです
column4:
Eu tenho que me esforçar mais.
Desta vez, eu quero me tornar alguém que pode apoiar os outros.

column3:
解放軍には入ったばかりなんです
――元から剣を持っていた人たちとは
やっぱり実力の差を感じますね
column4:
Acabei de entrar para o Exército de Libertação. Comparado
com aqueles que já tinham espadas, eu definitivamente
sinto a diferença de habilidade.

column3: はっ、任務中ですので手短にお願いします！
column4: Uh, por favor, seja breve, pois estou em uma missão!

column3:
オークとの戦いに散った者も数知れず――
遺された家族のことを想うと
胸が潰れそうになります
column4:
Inúmeras pessoas se dispersaram
na batalha contra os orcs--
Meu coração se parte pelas famílias
que ficaram para trás.

column3:
オークは、仲間が死んでも
何とも思わないのでしょうか？
――それとも――
column4:
Os orcs não se importam quando seus amigos morrem?
Ou--ou eles se importam?

column3:
はっ、気弱になってはいけないと
自分に言い聞かせております
column4:
H-espere, eu não devo perder a coragem---
Eu continuo me lembrando.

column3: よう、元気か？

まぁ、お互い身構えずに行こうぜ
俺も盗賊になったばっかりだけど
君が腕の立つ人だってことは、見りゃわかるよ
column4:
Bem, vamos sem ficarmos muito cautelosos--
Eu me tornei um bandido agora. Mas eu sei que você é
habilidoso, só de olhar para você.

column3:
人生何が起こるかわからないものだよな
起こっちまってから「まさか」と思うんだよ
column4:
Você nunca sabe o que pode acontecer na vida--
Você pensa "isso não pode estar acontecendo," mas então acontece.

column3:
家族はいるのか？
はぁ、ポーンがいる――
なんか哲学的な答えだな
column4:
Você tem uma família? Huh, você tem um Peão--
Essa é uma resposta bem filosófica.

column3:
ん、なになに？
呼んだ？
column4: Hmm, o que é? Você me chamou?

column3: さーて、どうしよっかな
column4: Bem, o que eu devo fazer?

column3:
ねぇねぇ～
何かおいしい話、知らない？
column4: Ei, ei~ Você sabe de alguma história interessante?

column3:
あーあ
どっかにすんごいお宝、転がってないかなぁ
そしたらセルマの姐さんに見直してもらえるのに
column4:
Ah, meu Deus.
Será que não tem um tesouro incrível escondido em algum lugar?
Se tivesse, a Irmã Selma poderia dar uma olhada em mim.

column3: おお、どうかしたかい？

いやぁ、久しぶりに持つ剣は重いな
前はもうちょっと、こう――
column4:
Oh, it's been a while since I held a sword. It
feels heavy now. It used to be a little lighter,
like...

column3:
こう見えても俺、前に
剣士を目指したこともあるんだぜ！
まぁ、子供の頃の話だけど
column4:
You see, I once tried to become a swordsman!
Well, that was when I was a kid.

column3:
盾もずっと持ってると重いんだよな
もうちょっと軽い盾を買えばよかったかなぁ
column4:
Shields are also heavy when you hold them all the
time. I guess I should have bought a lighter one.

column3: ぬっ！？　何かご用でも――
column4: Huh!? Is there something you need—

column3:
己自身を見つめ直すため
戦に乱れた各地を行脚しておるのです
column4:
To reflect on oneself, I am wandering around
various places that have been disturbed by war.

column3:
荒廃した景色、それを見て己が心に
湧きあがるもの――
私はそれを見極めたい
column4:
The devastated landscape, what wells up in my
heart when I see it—I want to find out what it is.

column3:
一時は世を捨て、隠遁生活を送ったことも
ありますがね――そうしたところで
私には何も見えてこなかったのです
column4:
I even left the world for a time and went into
seclusion
- and I didn't see anything!

column3: 何？　じろじろ見ちゃって

面倒事はごめんよ
――そりゃ、義理や礼儀は通すけどさ
それ以外でってこと
column4:
I don't want to be a bother— that is, I'll be
polite and respectful, but other than that, I
mean.

column3:
どうしたの、誰か探してるの？
いえ、そんな風に見えたってだけなんだけど
column4:
What's wrong, are you looking for someone? No, it
only seemed that way.

column3:
――あたし、どうも面倒事に
まきこまれやすい気がするのよね
どうしてだろう
column4:
--I feel like I get into trouble a lot.
I don't know why.

column3: まあ、どうなさいました？

私でお力になれることなら
よろこんで手をお貸ししますわ
column4:
If there is anything I can assist you with, I
would be delighted to lend a hand.

column3:
私の故郷は離れていますし
小さいながらも守りの固い城に
住んでおりますから、家族も無事ですよ
column4:
My hometown is far away. And even though it is
small, it is a securely fortified castle, So my
family is safe.

column3:
このような時こそ
周りの方に手を差し伸べるべきだと――
そう思って、はるばるこちらへ参りましたの
column4:
It is at times like this that we should reach out
to those around us--
That's why I came all the way here!

column3:
《英霊眠りし道》についての伝承は多いのです
子供もおとぎ話を通して知っていますよ
column4:
There are many legends about the "Heroic Spirit
Sleeping Path," and even children are familiar
with it through fairy tales.

column3:
中は土砂で埋まっているので
いわゆる"墓場荒らし"もここにはやってきません
column4:
The inside is filled with earth and sand, so the
so-called "grave robbers" won't come here either!

column3:
王家ゆかりの地であるのに、番人が
自分一人なのはそのせいですね――
column4:
It's a place associated with the royal family,
but that's why there's only one guardian.

column3:
自分も中には何度か足を踏み入れています
管理のこともありますから――
まぁ、土砂が無いところまで覗く程度ですが
column4:
I've stepped inside a few times myself because of
the management-- Well, I've only peeked in to
where there's no sediment.

column3:
はっ、覚者様！
ようこそおいでくださいました
column4: Hah, Ser Arisen! Welcome, please come in

column3:
英霊眠りし道は普通のダンジョンとは異なります
ある程度の武具を揃えて挑まなければ
踏破は難しいのではと――
column4:
The Heroic Spirit Sleeping Path is different from
a normal dungeon. It may be difficult to conquer
without equipping a certain level of weapons and
armor.

column3:
また、内部は土砂で埋まっている通路もあります
もう土砂が流れ込むことはありませんから
一度でも撤去できればいいのですが
column4:
Furthermore, there are also passageways that are
filled with sediment internally. There will no
longer be any inflow of sediment, so it would be
good to remove it just once.

column3:
覚者様、お気をつけて――
危険を感じられたら
すぐに戻ってきてくださいね
column4:
Arisen, please be careful-- If you feel any
danger, Please come back immediately.

column3:
開拓後の場所から
再突入できるようになりましたよ！
これで内部の調査がより捗るかと
column4:
You can now re-enter from your pioneering
location! I thought this would help us make more
progress in our investigation of the interior.

column3: 開拓後の場所から再突入しますか？
column4:
Do you want to re-enter the place after
development?

column3: はい
いいえ

パーティーリーダーが行き先を
選ぶまで、少々お待ちください
column4:
Please wait a moment while the party leader
selects the destination.

column3:
パーティーリーダーが待っていらっしゃいますよ
《英霊眠りし道》へ突入しますか？
column4:
The party leader is waiting.
Will you enter the Heroic Spirit Sleeping Path?

column3: はい
いいえ

内部へ向かわれる際は十分に注意してください
まずは状況確認など、いかがでしょう？
column4:
Please be careful when heading inside.
How about a status check first?

column3: ダンジョンに入る
開拓状況確認
報酬取得状況確認
まさか、全ての道を拓かれるとは――！
column4:
I can't believe all the roads have been opened
up—!

column3:
実は――伝承では
全ての道を拓くことで
最後の試練が受けられると言われているんです
column4:
Actually, in the legend, it is said that by
opening up all paths, one can receive the final
trial.

column3:
覚者様が全ての道を拓いたと同時刻に、
開かずの扉に変化が起きました
まるで、共鳴するみたいにです
column4:
At the same time that the Arisen paved the way
for everything, a change occurred in the unopened
door, as if it were resonating!

column3:
最後の試練が待ち受けるのは
きっと開かずの扉の先なのでしょうね
――最後の試練に向かわれる時は
ぜひ声をかけてください
column4:
The final trial is surely waiting beyond the
sealed door. When you're ready to face the last
trial, please don't hesitate to contact me.

column3:
内部へ向かわれる際は十分に注意してください
まずは状況確認など、いかがでしょう？
column4:
Please be careful when heading inside.
How about a status check first?

column3: ダンジョンに入る
開拓状況確認
報酬取得状況確認
最後の試練に挑む

最後の試練に向かわれるのですね
それでは、扉の封印を解除しておきます
column4:
I see that you are heading for the final ordeal.
I will now unseal the door.

column3:
あの先には、今までより困難な試練が
待ち受けているかもしれません
column4:
Beyond that point, more difficult challenges than
ever before may await you!

column3:
心して向かってください
ご武運をお祈りします
――覚者様のお戻りを信じておりますので！
column4:
Please proceed with caution. We pray for your
success. We believe in the return of the Arisen!

column3:
覚者様、申し訳ありませんが
そのような武具で内部に進まれるのは
かなり危険かと――
column4:
Ser Arisen, I'm sorry but it is quite dangerous
to proceed inside with such weaponry.

column3:
番人として、覚者様をみすみす危険に
晒すわけにはいきません
武具を整えてから、もう一度いらしてください
column4:
As a guardian, I cannot simply expose the
esteemed Arisen to danger. Please come again after
preparing your equipment.

column3: やあ、あんたが白き竜の覚者さんか
column4: Hey, are you the Arisen of the White Dragon?

column3:
このほこらに分散している
私の力を集めて
ここまで持ってきてくれないかい？
column4:
Can you gather the power scattered at this shrine
and bring it here?

column3:
そうすれば、あんたに力を貸してやれる――
何せ今は何の力も無くってね
column4:
If you do that, then I can lend you my
strength—after all, I don't have any power right
now.

column3:
ありがとう、よく集めてきたね
おかげで何かといい感じだよ
column4:
Thanks, you've done a great job collecting them.
It's made me feel like I'm on to something.

column3:
見たところ、あんたなら
もっと深くまで潜ることもできそうだし――
column4:
From what I can see, you could probably delve
even deeper -

column3:
さぁ、見てな
土砂ごとき、力さえ戻ればこんなもんさ
column4:
Now, look here.
Just some earth and sand.
If only I regain my strength, it's nothing.

column3:
どうだい？
土砂をどけて、道を作っておいたよ
これで先に進めるだろう
column4:
How about it? I cleared away the debris and made
a path. You should be able to proceed now.

column3:
あんたほどの実力があるなら
この先に眠る宝物にもたどり着けるんじゃない？
column4:
If you're as good as you say you are,
you'll get to the treasures that lie ahead, won't
you?

column3:
期待してるよ――
ああ、久しぶりに楽しかった
column4:
I'm counting on you— Ah, I haven't had this much
fun in a while.

column3:
すまないけど、思ったより
土砂が詰まっててね
さすがに時間がかかってしまってるんだ
column4:
Sorry, it's more packed with sediment than I
thought. It's taking longer than expected.

column3:
もう少しだけ時間をくれない？
なに、目途は立ってるからさ
column4:
Can you give me a little more time? No, I've got
a plan.

column3:
ふふふ、そう怪訝な顔をしないで
あんたの力になりたいだけさ
column4:
Hahaha, don't make such a bewildered face. I just
want to support you.

column3:
まだ王子は幼いんだろ？
そうそう、ネド王子――
column4:
The prince is still young, right? Yes, Prince
Nedo—

column3:
そう気を遣わなくていいさ
私だってそんな大層な人間じゃないからさ
昔ね、腕っぷしが強かっただけだよ――ハハハ
column4:
You don't have to worry about it because I'm not
that extraordinary either. In the past, it was
just that I was strong physically - Hahaha.

column3:
あれ、あんたの仲間は
すでに道を拓いてるんじゃない？
column4:
Oh, your companions, aren't they already carving
their own path?

column3:
これなら仲間の力をたどって
一時的に道を開くことができそうだよ
column4:
If you follow the power of your companions
you may be able to temporarily open the path

column3: 通常開拓する
仲間の力をたどる
column4: Follow the power of your companion

column3:
ふふ、ごきげんよう
遠いところからやってきた覚者さん
column4:
Ah, good day. You, the Arisen who has come from a
distant place.

column3:
ねぇ、もうわかってるんでしょう？
この辺りに散らばった力を集めて
わたしにくれないかしら
column4:
Hey, you already know the answer to that, don't
you?
You're going to gather all the power scattered
around here and give it to me.

column3:
今のわたしたちは
こうして姿を現すだけで精一杯――
だけど、あなたに協力したいのよ
column4:
Right now we're doing our best just showing up
like this--
but we want to help you!

column3:
ありがとう、少しの間動くなら
これで十分よ
column4:
Thanks, if it works for a little while, this
should be enough.

column3:
さて、あなたにはもっと深くまで
行ってもらわないとね――
column4: Now, I need you to go deeper—

column3:
あなたに協力することが
王家のためになるはずですもの
さぁ、邪魔な土砂は吹っ飛ばしてしまいましょう
column4:
It should be beneficial for the royal family for
me to assist you. Now, let's blow away that
obstruction.

column3:
土砂を片付けたわよ
これなら通れるでしょう？
column4:
I've cleared away the debris. This should be
passable, right?

column3:
あなたの力を見込んで言うわ
もっと深くまで、諦めずに進んでね
column4:
I'll say this, counting on your strength, go
deeper without giving up.

column3:
エゴといわれても仕方ないけど――
まだ、この国の終わりをみたくは無いの
column4:
Call me egotistical, but-- I don't want to see
the end of this country just yet.

column3:
ごめんね、急いではいるんだけど
もう少しかかりそう――
column4:
I'm sorry, but I'm in a hurry, so it might take a
little longer...

column3:
だけど、きっとやり遂げるわ
あなたに協力することが
王家のためになるはずですもの
column4:
But I'm sure we'll get it done.
Helping you will be for the good of the royal
family.

column3:
わたしたちがこうしていられるのも
ようするに、この地に充満した
竜力みたいなモノのお陰――
そういう力が溜まりやすいのよね、ここって
column4:
The reason we can exist like this is essentially
because of the Dragon Force that pervades this
place. It's easy for that kind of power to
accumulate here.

column3:
出られるものなら、わたしたちだって
ここを飛び出して行くわ――
でも、ここでしか姿を保てないんですもの
column4:
If we could go, we would also venture out of
here— but we can only maintain our presence here.

column3:
わたしはイゼル――
あなたはきっと、私の名をご存じないだろうけど
column4: I am Isel-- You probably don't know my name.

column3:
この弓で何度、王家を狙う不届き者を射抜いたことか
でも、今はそうすることもできないのよね
歯がゆいわ
column4:
Worrying is not in my nature. Let me go where the
fighting is.

column3:
あら、あなたのお仲間さんは
もう道を拓いているようね
column4:
Oh, looks like your fellow is already blazing a
trail.

column3:
お仲間さんの力をたどって
一時的に道を開くこともできるわよ
どうする？

column4:
If you collect the
"Souls of Heroic Spirits" floating in this dust
and offer them to me,
I will lend you my power--

column3:
これだけの魂を、良く集めてきたな

column4:
You've done a great job collecting all these
souls.
Thanks to you, I seem to have my strength back

depths as well

column3:

この土砂をどけておくよ――（仮）
column4:
Give me a minute and I'll get this sediment out

column3: 土砂をどけて道を作っておいたよ――（仮）
column4: I cleared away the earth and made a path.

column3:

column3:
はっ、覚者様でしたか
何のご用でしょう？
column4: Oh, it's an Arisen. What brings you here?

column3:
そういえば、先日一人で歩いてる
子供を見かけまして――
声をかければよかったと、今でも後悔してるんです
column4:
You know, I saw a kid walking alone the other
day--
and I still regret that I did not call out to him!

column3:
少し腹が減りませんか？
ああ、温かいスープでも飲んで
一息つける場所でもあれば――
column4:
Hungry for a little something?
Oh, if only there was a place where you could
have a hot bowl of soup and
take a breather--

column3:
覚者様ほどの方でも
後悔されることって、あるんでしょうか？
column4:
Is it possible that even someone as wise as you
would regret it?

column3:
ちょっと、今忙しいんだけど――
手短になら話を聞こう
column4:
Hey, I'm kind of busy right now--
I'll talk to you if you'll be brief.

column3:
ん？
この程度の傷、舐めておけば治る
column4:
Hmm?
A wound like this, just lick it and it will heal.

column3:
私がこの大剣を振るうことで
ほんの少しでも状況が変われば
良いと思ってな
column4:
I hope my wielding of this great sword will
change things even a little.

column3:
その佇まい――
覚者殿はかなりの鍛練を積まれた方と見える
column4:
The way you look--
you seem to be a very well-trained person, Master
Arisen.

column3:
やらねばならないことが
たくさんありますから――
column4: There's a lot of work to be done, so--

column3:
解放軍もずいぶん減ってしまいましたから
いつも手一杯ですよ
でも、誰かがやらねば――
column4:
The Liberation Army has dwindled down so much
that we always have our hands full. But someone
has to—

column3:
――おっと、すみません
よそ見をしておりました
column4: --oops, sorry. I was looking at the stranger!

column3:
どこへ行ってもオークの臭いがするのは
気にしすぎなのでしょうか
column4:
Is it "too much" to worry about smelling Orcs
everywhere I go?

column3: どうかなさいましたか？

覚者さま！
お噂はかねがね――
column4: Ser Arisen! I have always heard rumors about you—

column3:
覚者さまの噂を耳にするたび
勇気付けられているんです
こうしてお会いできるなんて――
column4:
Whenever I hear rumors about the Arisen, I feel
encouraged. To be able to meet like this...

column3:
こうして今、わたしの命があるのも
覚者さまのお陰ですね
column4:
And so now, the reason I am alive is thanks to
the Arisen's grace.

column3: はい、何でしょう？

王家の方々のお役に立てるなら
――何でもします
column4:
If I can be of service to the royal family, I
will do anything.

column3:
一人の力は小さくとも
みなが力を合わせれば――！
column4:
Even though one's power may be small, if everyone
combines their strength――!

column3: 雑談は苦手でして――
column4: I'm not good at small talk---

column3: ご用でしょうか、覚者様
column4: May I help you, Master Arisen

column3:
すぐに状況が良くなるとは思っていません
明日、今日より悪くならないようにと
解放軍に加わったんです
column4:
I don't think the situation will improve
immediately, so I joined the Liberation Army to
ensure that tomorrow won't be worse than today.

column3:
私個人が覚者さまの
お役にたてそうなことは――
今のところ思い浮かびませんね
column4:
As for me personally, I can't think of anything
that I can do for Ser Arisen at the moment...

column3: オークどもめ――
ん？　今呼びました？
column4: Hm? Did you call for me just now?

column3:
いや、覚者さまに自分ごときが
声をかけられるなんて、と思いましてね
column4:
No, for someone like me to be approached by an
Arisen, I couldn't believe it.

column3:
あんまり雑談してると
後で叱られそうなんで、この辺で！
column4:
If we keep chatting too much, I might get scolded
later, so let's stop here!

column3: この戦争、いつ終わるんですかね――
column4: When will this war—when will it end?

column3: まったく、落ち着く暇もないわね
column4: Not a moment to relax at all.

column3:
なに？
特に話題も無いのに話しかけてこないで
column4:
What is it? Don't talk to me when there's nothing
to talk about.

column3:
少しでもいいから休憩したいのよ
足が棒みたいよ
column4:
I need a break, even just a little one. My legs
feel like sticks.

column3: はぁ――あんたも懲りないわよね
column4: Sigh... You never learn, do you?

column3: 何だ？
お前と個人的に話すような話題は無いな
column4:
There's no personal topic I would talk to you
about.

column3: 何か面白い話でもしてくれるってのか？
column4: Do you have any interesting stories to tell me?

column3: 楽して儲けられる話なら歓迎するがな
column4:
If it's a story that can make money easily, then
I welcome it.

column3: 王家に協力することになるとはな
column4:
I never thought I would be cooperating with the
royal family.

column3: 人生、何が起こるかわからんもんだ！
column4: You never know what will happen in life!

column3: ま、こういうのも悪くはないぜ
column4: Well, this isn't too bad either.

column3:
俺たちが今まで盗みを働いた件を
チャラにするって話には――ならないか
column4:
I'm not sure if you're talking about making
amends for all the times we've stolen from you...

column3: 話しかけてくるなんて珍しいね
column4:
It's rare for someone to come and talk to me like
this.

column3:
アンタ、覚者ってやつなんでしょ？
何かすごいことしてみせてよ
空を飛ぶとか――
column4:
You're one of those Arisen, right? Why don't you
show us something amazing, like flying in the sky
or something?

column3:
王家側も、まさかアタシたち盗賊に
協力を要請するようなことになるなんて
思わなかっただろうね
column4:
Even the royal family, never would have thought
they would end up asking for cooperation from us
bandits...

column3:
アタシとしても
国は平和な方がいいからさ
column4: For me too, I prefer the country to be peaceful.

column3: お呼びですか？
ううん、何か話をと言われましても――
column4: No, even if you ask me to talk about something -

column3:
そうそう、もしロスギルに行かれた際は
翡翠湖を眺めていってくださいね
観光の目玉ですから
column4:
Oh yes, if you happen to visit Rothgill, please
make sure to take a look at the view of Emerald
Lake. It's a popular tourist attraction.

column3:
困りましたねぇ
有益な情報でもお話できれば
良かったんですが――
column4:
I'm stumped. I wish I could share some useful
information with you.

column3: はい、なんでしょう？
あ、私語はちょっと――
column4: Oh, I'm sorry, I don't want to talk about—

column3: ここに来ているのは任務なので――
column4: I'm here on a mission, so...

column3: む、ええっと、雑談をお望みなので――？
column4:
Um, well, since you're looking for some small
talk...?

column3: はっ、ご用は何でしょうか
column4: Ha, what can I do for you?

column3:
申し訳ございませんが、私から
お伝えできる情報は無いのです
column4:
I'm sorry, but I don't have any information to
share with you.

column3: ロスギルはまだオークの襲撃を逃れていますよ
column4: Rothgill is still avoiding Orc attacks.

column3:
す、すみません
護衛としてまいりましたので
私は本当に何も知らないのです
column4:
Um, sorry. I came as a guard, so I really don't
know anything.

column3: チチッ！　チューッ！
キッ　キッ
（耳を静かに動かしている）
フゴッ　プギプギ
モォ～～～

フィョ？　キーッキーッ
コココ――
キュッ　ピィ！
プィ？
キャーーッ！

フィフィ？
クキュキュ――

ああ、覚者さんか
何だい？
column4: Ah, are you an Arisen? What's up?

column3:
ココだけの話、キャリーの飯って
とびきり美味いわけじゃないんだよな
column4:
Speaking confidentially, Carrie's cooking isn't
particularly delicious, you know.

column3:
でも、なんだか力が湧いてくる味なんだ
覚者さんもそう思わないか？
column4:
But, it somehow has a taste that gives me
strength. Don't you think so, Arisen?

column3:
出かけるんなら、キャリーに言って
何か包んでもらっていくといい
column4:
If you're going out, tell Carrie and have her
wrap something for you to take.

column3:
こんな状況だから、飯なんて
食えればいいと思ってたけど――
column4:
Because of this situation, I thought it would be
enough to just be able to eat dinner, but...

column3:
できたてのあったかいものを食べると
ほっとするんだよ
それが嬉しいんだ
column4:
When you eat something freshly made and warm, you
feel relieved. It makes you happy.

column3:
まぁ、こういう作業も
嫌いなわけじゃないよ
column4:
Well, it's not that I don't like this kind of
work.

column3:
人手不足だから色々とやることはあるんだが
なぜかここに足が向くんだよな
column4:
Because there is a shortage of manpower, there
are various things to do, but for some reason, my
feet always gravitate towards here.

column3:
別に、何か食べ物にありつけないかって魂胆で
ここら辺うろついてるわけじゃないんだ
column4:
I'm not wandering around here with the intention
of finding something to eat or anything like that.

column3:
これも縁ってやつだ
大食堂が完全に復旧するまで協力するよ
column4:
This is also fate. I'll help until the big dining
hall is fully restored.

column3:
なんていうかさ
"居場所"を見つけるとほっとするよな
column4:
You know, it's just like when you find your
"place to belong". It's such a relief, you know.

column3:
生きるために戦場を転々としてきたから
そんなもん探す余裕もなかったけど
column4:
I've been in so many battles to stay alive that I
didn't have time to look for that stuff.

column3:
さて――
まだまだやることはたくさん残ってるね
column4:
Well―― There are still plenty of things left to
do, right?

column3:
ここに来ると、なんというか――
ティネス砦を取り返したって実感が湧くよね
column4:
When you come here, it's like... you feel a sense
of accomplishment, right? Like, we've taken back
Fort Thines.

column3:
変な話だけど、ここってなぜだか
ゴブリンがウロウロしてるんだ
column4:
It's a strange story, but for some reason, there
are goblins wandering around here.

column3:
当のゴブリンが妙に楽しそうにしてるから
みんな何となく見て見ぬふりしてるよ
どうもキャリーに懐いてるみたいだし――
column4:
Since the Goblin seems oddly happy, everyone is
pretending not to see and just watching. It seems
like he's attached to Carrie, so...

column3:
覚者さんも時間があれば
座っていきなよ
column4:
If you have time, Master Arisen, please have a
seat

column3:
私もブラッドと一緒にここに残って
キャリーを手伝うことにしたよ
column4:
I've decided to stay here with Brad and help
Carrie.

column3:
これでもハンターとして
罠仕掛けたり弓扱ったり
手先は器用な方だしね
column4:
I'm still a hunter; setting traps, handling bows,
and I'm good with my hands.

column3:
キャリー見てるとさ
なんか不思議とこっちも"やらなきゃ"
って思えるんだよね
column4:
When I watch Carrie, it's strange, but I also
feel like I should do something.

column3:
ん？
覚者さんもそう思うのかい？
column4: Huh? Do you feel the same way, Arisen?

column3: この大食堂って、かなり期待されてるんだね
column4: This Cafeteria, it's been highly anticipated.

column3:
大食堂を直してる話をしたら
自分も手伝うって人が結構いてさ
column4:
When I told them I was fixing up the big dining
hall, there were a lot of people who wanted to
help out too.

column3:
あそこにいる二人もそうで
修理をお願いしてるところさ
column4: Those two over there are also asking for repairs.

column3:
ブラッドとは長い付き合いでね
ちょっと人にきつく当たることもあるけど
根はいいやつだよ
column4:
Brad and I have been together for a long time.
Sometimes he can be a bit harsh with people, but
deep down he's a good guy.

column3:
以前ここへ荷物を運ぶ途中
ゴブリンたちに襲われたときも
なんとか私を逃がそうとしてくれたし
column4:
Before, when I was on my way here to deliver the
package, even when I was attacked by goblins they
somehow managed to help me escape.

column3:
こんな世の中だけど
助け合って生きていく喜びを感じられるのは
唯一いいことだと思えるよ
column4:
Despite the way the world is, I believe that the
only good thing is being able to feel the joy of
helping each other and living together.

column3:
いつ戦いになるか分からないからね
弓の手入れは入念にやってるよ
column4:
You never know when you'll be in a fight. I'm
meticulous about taking care of my bow.

column3:
もしまたティネスに――
魔物が入り込んで来るようなことがあったら
全力でいくって決めてるんだ
column4:
If an enemy were to sneak into Fort Thines again,
I'm determined to go all out.

column3: はいはーい、何かご用？
column4: Yes, hello, can I help you?

column3:
さー、食べて飲んで
楽しくいきましょ！
column4: Well, let's eat and drink and have fun!

column3:
皆の楽しそうな顔を見てると
私も幸せな気持ちになってくるわ
こういう場があるって、大事だよね！
column4:
Seeing everyone's happy faces makes me happy too.
It's important to have a place like this!

column3:
キャリーちゃんのご飯、もう食べた？
元気の源、補充していってね！
column4:
Have you eaten Carrie's food yet?
Please replenish the source of your energy!

column3:
私は大食堂の元の姿を知ってるから――
初めて奪還後のココを見た時は
ちょっとショック受けちゃった
column4:
Because I know what the Cafeteria looked like in
its original form-- When I first saw this place
after it was recaptured, I was a little shocked.

column3:
大食堂の復旧、頑張ろうね！
ティネス砦の名物だったんだから
column4:
Let's do our best to restore the dining hall! It
was the pride of Fort Thines, after all.

column3:
ああ、早く人がいっぱいの
元通りの大食堂で働きたいな――
column4:
Oh, I can't wait to work in a Great Dining Hall full
of people, back to normal--

column3:
キャリーちゃん、無理してないかな
大丈夫かな――
column4:
Carrie, are you sure you're not pushing yourself
too hard? I hope you're okay--

column3: ふふ、どうかした？

美味しいものを楽しむのは
気分転換にぴったりよね
column4:
Enjoying delicious food is perfect for a change
of mood.

column3:
活気があるところって大好きなの
ティネス砦に来られて良かったわ
column4:
I love places with a lively atmosphere. I'm glad
I came to Fort Thines.

column3:
さぁ、覚者さんも何か食べましょうよ
それとも、飲みたい気分？
column4:
Now, let's get you something to eat, Arisen. Or
would you like something to drink?

column3:
ヘザーから聞いたんだけど
元の大食堂って、常に笑顔の人でいっぱい
だったんですって
column4:
Heather told me that the original diner was
always full of smiling people

column3: そんな光景、もうずっと見てないなって――
column4: I haven't seen anything like that in a long time.

column3:
まだまだやることはあるんでしょう？
くじけていられないわよね
column4:
There's still a lot to do, right? I can't afford
to be discouraged.

column3: さぁ、何でも手伝うわよ！

え？　踊りを見たいって――？
ふふ、後でね
column4:
Huh? You want to see me dance?
Hehe, maybe later

column3:
シッ――
あまり大きな声を出すな
誰かにつけられてはいないだろうな？
column4: You're not being followed by anyone, are you?

column3:
よぉ相棒
わざわざ足を運んでもらって、悪いな
column4:
Hey, partner. Sorry for making you come all this
way.

column3:
クルト家の今後は
まだどうなるか分からないんだ
<NPC 681>は家族をもうけなかったようでな
column4:
I'm not yet sure what the future holds for the
Kurt family. <NPC 681> didn't seem to have a
family of their own.

column3:
だが、次の当主がどんな人間でも
俺は支えていくつもりだ
それが――俺なりの、恩返しだと思ってさ
column4:
But I'm going to support the next head of the
family, no matter who he is. That's how I'm going
to repay him.

column3: 手短にな

メガドは、アッカー王家が直々に治める街だが
実質的に政治を動かしているのは
クルト侯爵家なんだ
column4:
Megado is a city ruled directly by the Acre Royal
Family, but in practice, the one wielding
political power is the Marquis Family, Kurt.

column3:
メガドの夜は、昼とは異なり
渾沌とした一面を持っている
――<NPC 681>が爵位を継いでから
行った政策のせいだ
column4:
The night in Megado is different from the day and
has a chaotic aspect
-- due to the policies that<NPC 681>has
implemented since he took over the knighthood.

column3:

column3: ようこそ、覚者さま

覚者よ！
今回の取り分はすでに受け取ったようだな！
次はさらに上を目指し、存分に暴れるがいい！
がははははは！！
column4:
Arisen!
Você já recebeu sua parte desta vez!
Da próxima vez, mire ainda mais alto e se liberte
o quanto quiser!
Ha-ha-ha-ha!

column3:
ああ、今回の取り分は送っておいたぞ！
保管ボックスを確認するといい
次の出航が今から楽しみだ！
なぁ、覚者よ、そうだろう！？
column4:
Ah, eu te enviei a recompensa desta vez!
Você deveria verificar a caixa de armazenamento.
Estou realmente ansioso pela próxima viagem!
Certo, meu Arisen, não é?

column3:
おお！　丁度、戦果の集計がついたところだ
勇敢なる覚者よ、その戦果を評して
秘蔵のアビリティを送ろうではないか！
胸を張って受け取るがいい！
column4:
Oh! Acabamos de apurar os resultados da guerra.
Em reconhecimento às suas conquistas de guerra, valente
Arisen, enviamos a você
uma habilidade secreta!
Receba-a com orgulho!

column3:
ふーむ、覚者よ
血気盛んなのは結構だが、他にエントリー中の
任務があるようだな
先にそちらにケリをつけてくるがいい！
column4:
Hmmm, Arisen,
Eu aprecio sua sede de sangue, mas vejo que você tem
outra
missão que você está entrando.
Você pode ir terminar essa primeiro!

column3:
おお――、勇敢なる覚者よ
すまないが前回の出撃で現在洋撃船は修理中だ
準備が整うまで、今しばらく待っていてくれ！
column4:
Oh--, bravo Arisen.
Desculpe, mas o navio de ataque ocidental está atualmente sendo
reparado após a última surtida.
Por favor, espere um pouco até que esteja pronto!

column3:
がはははは！　船はまだ準備中だ
そう急くな！
column4:
Hahaha! O navio ainda está sendo preparado.
Não se apresse!

column3:
沖合に浮かぶ孤島、《竜の巣》
別名、魔物のるつぼ
column4:
A ilha isolada flutuando na costa, conhecida como
"Ninho do Dragão".
Também conhecido como O Caldeirão dos Demônios

column3:
竜が死に、生まれいづる場所というが
本当の所は解らん
column4:
Dizem que é o lugar onde os dragões morrem e
nascem, mas ninguém sabe ao certo.

column3: なぁ、ロマンだろう？

海流が激しくなり、ヒュージブルが現れ
外洋調査はここ300年できない状態だ
column4:
As correntes se intensificaram, os fusíveis
apareceram
e a pesquisa em mar aberto não tem sido possível nos
últimos 300 anos.

column3:
だが、海の先にはさらに広大な
世界が広がっているように思わんか？
ロマンだろう！
column4:
Mas não parece que existe um mundo ainda mais
vasto
além do mar?
Romântico, não é?

column3:
おお、覚者よ！
今回の《竜の巣》調査は終了したぞ
あいにく今渡せる報酬はないが、機会など
またすぐ巡ってこよう。がははは！
column4:
Oh, Arisen!
Esta pesquisa do "Ninho do Dragão" acabou.
Infelizmente, não tenho uma recompensa para te dar
agora, mas te darei outra chance
em breve! Estarei de volta em breve!

column3:
《竜の巣》はただの魔物の巣だと考える
者もいるが、それだけとは思えんなぁ
column4:
Algumas pessoas consideram o "Ninho do Dragão" como
apenas um ninho de inimigos, mas não acho que seja
tão simples.

column3:
エルダードラゴンや、さらに巨大な竜の化石も
古い岩盤には残っているというではないか
column4:
Dizem que Elder Dragons e até os fósseis de dragões
gigantescos
permanecem no leito rochoso antigo.

column3:
レスタニアの大地の他、船で辿りつけるのは
つねに小さな孤島のみ
他にも大陸はあるのか、否か――謎だなぁ！
column4:
Além da terra de Lestania, o que se pode alcançar de navio
são sempre pequenas ilhas isoladas.
Se existem outros continentes ou
não... é um mistério!

column3:
あまりに身近で忘れてるかもしれんが
《竜の礎》や《リムストーン》なんかも
いつ誰が造ったものかは分かっていないだろう
column4:
Arisen estão muito familiarizados com a
《Marca do Dragão》 e
《Pedra da Fenda》. Me pergunto se vocês esqueceram quem
os fez.

column3:
がははは！　分からんことだらけだがともあれ
《竜の巣》探査が外洋遠征任務の
要ということだ！
column4:
Ha-ha-ha! Eu não sei muitas coisas, mas de qualquer forma,
a exploração do "Ninho do Dragão" é a
pedra angular da missão de expedição em mar aberto!

column3:
おお、よく来たな
勇敢なる覚者よ！
column4:
Oh, que bom que veio,
bravo Arisen!

column3:
どんな状況だろうと船は出してやる
あんたらの気持ち次第さ
column4:
Não importa qual seja a situação, eu enviarei o navio
dependendo dos seus sentimentos.

Uivante" a leste de Tell.

column4:
Parece que ele pegou vários "equipamentos de alto
nível" dos cavaleiros e Arisen que derrotou.

column3:
討伐できたなら、貴君がそれを

column4:
Se você conseguir subjugá-lo, também poderá

isso em mente.

column3:

column4:
Vou expressar minha gratidão em nome da vila.
Você é um herói para Tell.

column3:
これからもどうかよろしく頼む

column4:
Por favor, continue contando comigo. Vou tentar
encontrar o que posso fazer por você.

column4:

column4:

Abaixo do segundo subsolo do mausoléu, o

あの《開かずの路》で発見した手帳に

O caderno que encontrei naquela 《Estrada

column4:

column3:

column4:

column3:
いつもすまないな

column4:

do meu coração.

column3:
――そろそろ貴君にもあの件を伝えておこう

column4:
Acho que está na hora de eu te contar sobre aquele
assunto. Sobre Menvili, o homem que era padre na
famosa Igreja de Heidell.

村人から邪教崇拝の疑いをかけられて
追われ、失踪した
column4:
Há décadas, o sacerdote foi acusado pelos
aldeões de adoração pagã, perseguido e
desapareceu.

column3:
司祭の家の地下室から、多数の死体と

column4:
Porque vários cadáveres e um altar suspeito foram
encontrados no porão da casa de um padre.

column3:
――貴君も心当たりがあるだろう？

column4:
Talvez você também tenha uma ideia? Aquela casa
abandonada onde você exterminou os monstros antes...
Aquele lugar é nada menos que a residência do
Padre Menvili.

column3:

先代のエリアマスターから受け継いだ
column4:

lugar que deve ser selado, herdado do mestre de
área anterior.

column3:
わたしも中を調べるつもりだが

column4:

column3:

column4:

ver com a peste.

column3:

column4:

column4:

aquele grande lagarto ataque os aldeões e o
gado.

column4:

column4:
O cheiro estranho de vez em quando provavelmente
era por causa disso...

?

.

lado desse caso?

column4:

fiquei impressionado.

column4:

column4:

悩みの種はつきないものだ
column4:

貴君のことは頼りにさせてもらう

você.

column4:

column3:

効率の良い探索のためにも、ぜひ活用してくれ
column4:

atividades. Por favor, faça uso disso para uma busca
eficiente!

column4:

column4:

column4:

column4:

um pouco mais fáceis.

column4:

ナイトメアが巣食ってしまったの
column4:
Há uma única estrada que leva de Lynwood
às profundezas do Bosque Mysree.
Um pesadelo conhecido como "Maritia a Sequestradora"
se instalou ao longo dessa estrada.

column3:
ナイトメアの中でも凶悪な個体で
生半可な腕では近付くことすらできないのよ
お願い、貴方に退治を頼めないかしら
column4:
É o mais cruel dos pesadelos e,
com minha habilidade limitada, não consigo nem chegar perto
dele.
Por favor, você pode me ajudar a me livrar dele?

column3:
退治してくれるなら出発前に
私に話しかけてちょうだい
くわしく説明するわ
column4:
Se você quiser exterminá-los, fale comigo
antes de partir
e eu explicarei melhor.

column3:
そうそう、貴方に伝えようと思っていたことがあるの
森の中にある遺跡《ミスリウ古墳墓》の封鎖を
解くことにしたのよ
column4:
É verdade, eu queria te contar.
Decidi deslacrar aquelas ruínas na floresta,
o "Antigo Monte Funerário Mysree".

column3:
以前から歴史研究のために解放を
望む声があったんだけど、万が一のことを考えると
封鎖しておかざるをえなかったのよね
column4:
Houve contínuos pedidos
para liberá-lo para pesquisa histórica,
mas sem saber o que poderia ocorrer, tivemos que mantê-lo
selado.

column3:
けど、今は貴方という頼もしい覚者さんが
ミスリウに寄ってくれることだし
この機会にと思ってね！
column4:
Mas agora que um Arisen confiável como você
estará passando por Mysree,
eu não poderia perder esta oportunidade!

column3:
うーん、覚者さん――
ちょっと相談してもいいかしら
column4:
Hmmm, Arisen--
Posso falar com você por um momento?

column3:
実は、この前封鎖を解いた
《ミスリウ古墳墓》についてなんだけど
さっそく問題が起こっちゃって――
column4:
Na verdade, sobre o
Antigo Monte Funerário que foi deslacrado recentemente,
um problema ocorreu imediatamente...

column3:
あの古墳墓に入った歴史家が
魔物に襲われたらしいんだけど
どんな魔物なのかすらわからないの
column4:
Parece que o historiador que entrou naquele
antigo monte funerário foi atacado por
inimigos, mas
nós nem sabemos que tipo de inimigos eles são.

column3:
このままじゃ謎を抱えたまま
あの古墳墓をもう一度
封鎖しないといけなくなるわ
column4:
Se deixarmos assim,
teremos que selar aquele antigo monte funerário
novamente
enquanto ainda temos este mistério.

column3:

column4:

poder? Se eu puder pedir para você investigar,
explicarei em detalhes, então, por favor, fale comigo
novamente

column3:

この森の住人を代表してお礼を言うわ！
column4:
Obrigado por sempre ajudar Lynwood.
Agradeço em nome de todos os moradores
desta floresta!

column3:
私も、もっと貴方の力になりたいんだけど
物資での支援くらいしかできないから――
column4:
Eu também gostaria de ajudá-lo mais, mas só posso
ajudá-lo com suprimentos.

column3:
せめてもの気持ちとして、もっといいものを

column4:

column4:

column4:

Tenha cuidado especial em cavernas e perto da água!

column4:

リザードマンが多くて危険だから、

column4:
Há tantos Lizardmen que é perigoso,

column4:

a fechadura que eu estava usando era comercial

column3:
救援要請があってすぐ水路に向かったん

column4:

column4:

column4:

彼女は私の友人なんだけど

《ソーサラー》の師でもあるの
column4:
Ela é minha amiga,
mas na verdade também é uma mestra da vocação
《Feiticeiro》, embora de forma não oficial no templo.

column3:
私が見込みがあると思った覚者を
たまに紹介しているの
貴方なら、きっと魔術を良い事に使ってくれる
――そう思ってね
column4:
Às vezes apresento para ela Despertos que acho
promissores.
Acredito que você usaria a magia para o bem...
é nisso que aposto.

column3:
話は通しておくから、その気があれば
エメラダと会ってみて
彼女の家の場所が分からなければ
《スポット情報》で確認するといいわ
column4:
Já vou avisá-la, então, se tiver interesse,
procure encontrar a Emerada.
Se não souber onde fica a casa dela,
verifique em 《Informações de Local》.

column3:
ちょっとまずい状況になったの
森に、腐肉が散乱する廃屋がいくつか
あるのは知ってるかしら
column4:
Temos uma situação complicada.
Você sabia que há alguns casarões abandonados
na floresta, cheios de carne podre espalhada?

column3:
あそこはそれぞれ、凶暴なエイプ達の縄張りに
なっててね――
だいぶ前に追い払ったのだけど
いつの間にか戻ってきたらしいのよ
column4:
Cada um desses lugares virou território de
macacos selvagens e agressivos.
Nós os expulsamos há um bom tempo,
mas parece que voltaram sem que percebêssemos.

column3:
猿達は、それぞれ
《唸り猿》《裂き猿》《豚喰い猿》って
呼ばれてるわ
column4:

《Macaco Ressonante》, 《Macaco Dilacerador》 e
《Macaco Come-Porco》.

column3:
森に３か所ある廃屋が彼らのねぐらだから

村のみんなにも伝えなきゃ
column4:
As três casas abandonadas na floresta servem como
tocas para eles.
Tome cuidado ao passar por perto
e vamos avisar todos da vila.

column3:
――ちょっと聞いてくれる？

column4:
Pode me ouvir um instante?

o lugar mais profundo e perigoso desta floresta.

column3:
少し前からその周辺で、恐ろしい獣の
唸り声や地響きがするようになってね
column4:

rugidos de uma fera terrível e tremores de terra
naquela área.

column3:
調査に行ってくれた騎士団が
まだ戻らないのよ――
column4:
Os cavaleiros que foram investigar
ainda não voltaram...

column3:

手が回らないらしくて
column4:

mas a Companhia dos Despertos está ocupada
demais lidando com a guerra contra os orcs.

column3:

お願い――、力を貸してちょうだい
column4:

para investigar o local.
Por favor, empreste-me sua força.

column3:

column4:

graças a você.

column3:
私にできることなんてたかだか
知れてるだろうけど、何とか恩返しするわ

column4:

Comprei suprimentos extras para te apoiar!

column3:
今後ともよろしくね
ミスリウの勇者さん
column4:
Conto com você daqui pra frente,
valente de Misliu.

column3:
ナイトメアの中でも凶悪な個体で
生半可な腕では近付くことすらできないのよ
お願い、貴方に退治を頼めないかしら
column4:
É uma das mais cruéis Nightmares.
Com pouca habilidade, nem dá
para se aproximar. Por favor,
derrote-a.

column3:
退治してくれるなら出発前に
私に話しかけてちょうだい
くわしく説明するわ
column4:
Se for derrotá-la, fale comigo
antes de partir. Vou explicar
os detalhes.

column3:
そうそう、貴方に伝えようと思っていたことがあるの
森の中にある遺跡《ミスリウ古墳墓》の封鎖を
解くことにしたのよ
column4:
Ah, outra coisa: decidi retirar o
bloqueio das ruínas 《Túmulo
Antigo de Mysree》.

column3:
以前から歴史研究のために解放を
望む声があったんだけど、万が一のことを考えると
封鎖しておかざるをえなかったのよね
column4:
Já havia pedidos para abri-lo
para estudo histórico, mas por
precaução, manteve-se fechado.

column3:
けど、今は貴方という頼もしい覚者さんが
ミスリウに寄ってくれることだし
この機会にと思ってね！
column4:
Mas agora que um Arisen tão confiável
quanto você vem a Mysree,
achei que era a oportunidade certa!

column3:
うーん、覚者さん――
ちょっと相談してもいいかしら
column4:
Hmm, Arisen...
Posso pedir um conselho?

column3:
実は、この前封鎖を解いた
《ミスリウ古墳墓》についてなんだけど
さっそく問題が起こっちゃって――
column4:
Sobre o 《Túmulo Antigo de Mysree》,

column3:
あの古墳墓に入った歴史家が
魔物に襲われたらしいんだけど
どんな魔物なのかすらわからないの
column4:
Um historiador que entrou lá foi
atacado por monstros, mas nem
sabemos que criaturas eram.

column3:
このままじゃ謎を抱えたまま
あの古墳墓をもう一度
封鎖しないといけなくなるわ
column4:
Se continuar assim, teremos de
fechar o túmulo novamente,
sem resolver o mistério.

column3:
貴方の力で何とかならないかしら

説明するから、もう一度私に声をかけてね
column4:
Será que com sua força não dá
pra resolver? Se aceitar investigar,
fale comigo novamente e
eu explico tudo.

column3:
いつもリンウッドを助けてくれてありがとう

column3:

column3:

Espero que ajudem.

column3:
リンウッドの皆がこうしてられるのも
貴方のお陰よね
column4:
É graças a você que todos
em Lynwood podem viver assim.

column3:

知れてるだろうけど、何とか恩返しするわ！

column4:

Conte comigo daqui pra frente.

column3:

column4:

column3:
村の仕事を手伝ってくれて、ありがとう

column4:

column3:

column4:
Obrigada por vir!

column3: みんなからの、日ごろの感謝の印よ

column3:

迷わないように注意してね
特に道から外れた時はカンに頼らず
かならず地図を確認するのよ
column4:

白竜様の力が衰えてから

Desde que o poder do Grande
Dragão Branco enfraqueceu,

column3:

column4:

column3:

あなたのサポートができるよう

森小人の長、《緑鬼グリッガ》

column3:
良い所に来たわね！
《西ミスリウ橋》の修繕がようやく終わったの

column3:
これも、あなたが村の問題解決を

ポーン郷との行き来が楽になるんじゃないかしら

橋さえ通れれば、わざわざリム転移を

column3:

column4:

column4:

column3: 結局彼ら、どうなったのかしら――
column4:
O que terá acontecido com eles

column3:
貴方の活躍、噂になってるわよ！

column4:

Só consigo retribuir com suprimentos,

column3:
彼女は私の友人なんだけど

《ソーサラー》の師でもあるの
column4:

mas também é uma Mestra de

column3:
私が見込みがあると思った覚者を

ちょっとまずい状況になったの

column4:

column3:
あそこはそれぞれ、凶暴なエイプ達の縄張りに

だいぶ前に追い払ったのだけど

column4:
Cada uma delas é território de

Nós os expulsamos há muito tempo,
mas parece que voltaram.

column3:
猿達は、それぞれ

呼ばれてるわ
column4:
Chamamos esses macacos de
《Macaco Ressonante》,
《Macaco Dilacerador》 e
《Macaco Come-Porco》.

column3:
森に３か所ある廃屋が彼らのねぐらだから
近くを通る時は注意して
村のみんなにも伝えなきゃ
column4:
As três casas abandonadas da floresta
são os ninhos deles, então tenha cuidado
ao passar por perto
e avise o restante da vila.

column3:
――ちょっと聞いてくれる？
《ミスリウ鍾乳洞》っていう、この森で最も深く
危険な巨大洞窟があるんだけど
column4:
Ei, me escuta um instante.

column3:
少し前からその周辺で、恐ろしい獣の

column4:
Faz algum tempo que se ouvem,
nos arredores, os rugidos de uma fera terrível
e o chão tremendo.

column3:
調査に行ってくれた騎士団が
まだ戻らないのよ――
column4:
A ordem de cavaleiros que foi investigar
ainda não voltou...

column3:
神殿にも救援要請を出しているんだけど
覚者隊はオークとの戦いでなかなか
手が回らないらしくて
column4:
Também enviei um pedido de ajuda ao templo,

ocupado lutando contra os orcs.

column3:
そこで、相談なんだけど

お願い――、力を貸してちょうだい
column4:
Por isso, queria lhe pedir

Por favor... me ajude.

column3:
リンウッドの皆がこうしていられるのも
貴方のお陰よね
column4:
Todos em Lynwood só estão seguros assim

column3:
私にできることなんてたかだか

補給支援の仕入れ、張り込んだんだから！
column4:
Eu sei que o que posso fazer é limitado,

column3:
今後ともよろしくね
ミスリウの勇者さん
column4:

column4:
――《Antigo Local de Rituais》

column4:

鍛練は怠っていないぞ
column4:
I am also currently retired and enjoying a
leisurely life, but I have not neglected my
training.

column3:
――まずは身の証を立ててから
来るべきじゃないのか？
column4:
First, shouldn't we establish our credibility
before we come?

column3:
身の証を立てる前に
休息を取りたいというなら
そりゃ、かまわんが――
column4:
Before proving your innocence, if you wish to
take some rest,
Well then, it's fine...

column3:
ハーイ、色々揃えてるわよ
どうぞ見て行ってね
column4:
Yes, I have various things.
Please feel free to take a look!

column3:
ピサルとラザネイル、素敵でしょ？
ああいう夫婦が理想なのよね
column4:
Pisarr and Razanailt, aren't they wonderful?
That's the ideal kind of couple.

column3:
たくさん覚者がいたら
一人一人が受けられる竜力が少なくならない？
何人もの覚者より、強い覚者が一人いた方が
安心できると思うんだけど
column4:
If there were many Arisen, wouldn't the Dragon
Force that each one can receive be diminished?
I think it would be more reassuring to have one
strong Arisen than a number of Arisen.

column3: あれ？　何も買っていかないの？

あ――もしかして、騒ぎになってた
異国の覚者さん？
column4:
Oh, are you the Arisen from the foreign land that
caused all the commotion?

column3:
――まずは身の証を立ててから
買い物しに来てくれるとうれしいわ
ちょっと信用できないもの
column4:
--First, I would be happy if you could prove your
identity before shopping. I can't trust you that
easily.

column3:
や、やぁ――
クレストのことかな？
column4: Ah, um... Is it about Crests?

column3:
クレストっていうのは、装備に付けられる
特殊な力の結晶らしいよ
僕は管理を任されてるだけなんだけど――
column4:
Crests are apparently crystals that can be
attached to equipment, possessing special powers.
I'm just in charge of managing them...

column3:
僕は子供の頃から線が細くて
戦いでも狩りでも中々手柄を上げられなくて――
column4:
Since I was a child, I have always been frail,
unable to achieve any remarkable feats in battles
or hunts...

column3:
なんて、よそから来た人には
この気持ち、わからないよな
column4:
Oh, someone who comes from elsewhere would never
understand this feeling.

column3:
戦いよりもこういうことの方が向いてるだろうって
ピサルからこの仕事を任されたんだ
自分でもそう思うよ
column4:
I was entrusted with this job by Pisarr, who
believed that I was more suited for something like
this than for battle.
I think so too.

column3:
――だけど、イーヴィの好みは
"誰よりも強い男"なんだよなぁ
column4:
But Evey's preference is for a 'man stronger than
anyone else,' you know.

column3:
あの――
身の証を立ててから来てもらえないかな
こういうのって信用が大事だからさ
column4:
You know, it would be great if you could come
after proving yourself.
Because trust is important in situations like
this.

column3:
戦いに行くの？
パーティの編成なら私がお手伝いするわ！
column4:
Are you going to the battle?
If you need help with party formation, I can
assist you!

column3:
力強く、信頼できる仲間と集まることで
一人ひとりの戦士の働きもよくなるはずよ！
column4:
By gathering together strong and reliable
comrades, the efforts of each individual soldier
should also improve!

column3:
ポーンを呼ぶこともできるけど――
どうする？
column4:
You can also call for Pawns.
What will you do?

column3:
変わった衣装――
それがあなたたちの力を引き出す衣なのね
ううん、見慣れないだけで――素敵よ
column4:
Unusual costumes...
Those clothes bring out your power, don't they?
No, it's just because they're unfamiliar...
They're wonderful.

column3:
あっ――
えっと、異国の方――
身の証を立ててもいない怪しい人と喋ってたら
族長に怒られちゃうから――
column4:
Ah—
Um, traveler from a foreign land—
Talking to a suspicious person like me, who
hasn't even proven their identity might anger the
clan chief—

column3: ――何だ

この村を纏めているのは
壮健で誇り高き族長、ピサルだ
column4:
The one who leads this village is the robust and
proud chieftain, Pisarr.

column3: 異国の覚者、か――
column4: The Arisen from a foreign land, eh――

column3:
ほう、なるほど
中々鋭い目をしている
column4: Oh, I see. You have quite sharp eyes.

column3: まずは身の証を立てるんだな
おっ、何か用かよ？

武器の手入れはいつでも万全だ！
早いとこ戦いに出て手柄を立てたいぜ
column4:
I always ensure that my weapons are in perfect
condition!
I can't wait to go into battle and earn some
credit!

column3:
俺だってダナの戦士
狩りでもいい働きをしているはずだ！
column4:
I, too, am a soldier of Dana.
I should be able to contribute to the hunt!

column3:
族長が狩りに行く時にでも
同行させてもらえりゃ早いんだけどな――
中々アピールするタイミングが――
column4:
If I could just accompany the chief when they go
hunting, we could expedite things, you know――
It's just difficult to find the right timing to
make my appeal――

column3:
盾も剣も、毎日点検しては磨いてるんだぜ
もちろん鍛錬も欠かさねぇ！
column4:
I inspect and polish my shield and sword every
day, and of course, I never neglect my training!

column3:
てめぇ、まずは身の証を立ててからにしろよな
この村で怪しげなことしたら承知しねぇぞ
column4:
First, prove yourself before you speak.
I won't tolerate any suspicious activities in
this village.

column3: 私に用か？

村に外敵が侵入しないように
ここで見張っているのだ
column4:
I'm here to watch over this place and to ensure
no enemies invade the village.

column3:
ダナはフィンダムでも知られた勇猛な部族の村だが
子供や年寄り、戦いの苦手な者もいる
彼らを守ってこその部族だ
column4:
Dana is a village known all over Phindym for its
brave and fierce tribe, but it also has children,
elders, and those who are not skilled in combat.
Protecting them is what makes our tribe strong.

column3:
ずっと見張りをしていて疲れないのか、だと？
この程度どうということはない
column4:
Do you mean that you never get tired from keeping
watch? It's nothing to be concerned about.

column3:
私に構ってないで村に入ったらどうだ
大方、ピサルかラザネイルに会いに来たのだろう？
column4:
Why don't you enter the village instead of
ignoring me?
Most likely, you've come to meet Pisarr or
Razanailt, haven't you?

column3: すまないが、まずは身の証を立てるのが先だろう
column4:
I'm sorry, but first you should prove your
identity.

column3: はいはい、何の御用？
column4: Yes, yes. What can I help you with?

column3:
うちも育ち盛りの子が多いからね
山のように用意した食事が
あっという間に無くなるのは見てて気分いいもんさ
column4:
We also have many children who are in their
growing years, you know.
It's satisfying to see the meals we prepared like
a mountain disappear in no time.

column3:
アンタも覚者だったら戦いに出ること、あるんだろ？
この村でしっかり食べて、体を休めて
次の旅立ちに備えるんだよ
column4:
If you are also an Arisen, there must be
something you fight for, right?
Eat well and rest your body in this village, and
prepare yourself for the next journey.

column3:
ふぅ、洗濯物は済んだし
次は家畜の世話でもしに行こうかな
column4:
Phew, the laundry is done.
Now, should I go take care of the livestock?

column3:
あっ――
あんた、さっき表で騒いでた奴らの仲間だね？
column4:
Ah... Are you one of the people who were causing
a ruckus outside earlier?

column3:
本当に覚者だっていうんなら
さっさと身の証を立ててきちまいなよ
そしたらややこしいことも無くなるんだからさ
column4:
If you really claim to be an Arisen, then quickly
prove yourself and settle it.
That way, there won't be any more complications.

column3:
《武霊の庵》のそばにある物見台はサイコーなんだ！
フィンダム全体が見渡せるし
"芯なる樹"がすっごくキレイに見えるよ
column4:
The observation deck next to the Spirit Arts Hut
is awesome!
You can oversee the entire Phindym, and the Core
Tree looks incredibly beautiful.

column3: 何だよ？　ここはオレの場所だかんな！
column4: What's going on? This is my spot, you know!

column3:
ここからは村の中くらいなら見渡せるよ
でも、やっぱり村の外を眺めたいなぁ――
column4:
From here, you can see around the middle of the
village.
But, I still want to gaze at the outside of the
village...

column3:
村の入り口はワイニが守ってる
万が一魔物が村に入ってきたって
ダナは戦士の村だからへっちゃらだ！
column4:
The village entrance is guarded by Wine.
Even if monsters somehow get into the village,
it's no big deal because Dana is a warrior's
village!

column3:
一人前の戦士になったら
ワイニみたいに武器を持って村を守りたいんだ
column4:
Once I become a skilled warrior, I want to
protect the village like Wine does, wielding a
weapon.

column3: ――怪しい人とはあんまり喋っちゃダメなんだ
column4:
- You shouldn't talk too much with suspicious
people.

column3: なによ

これからは腕力だけじゃやってけないわ
知識よ、あらゆる状況に対応できる知識が必要なの！
みんなわかってないの！
column4:
From now on, it won't be enough to rely on arm
strength alone.
Knowledge, I need knowledge that can adapt to any
situation!
Everyone just doesn't understand!

column3:
属性がどうとか弱点がなんだとか
そういう知識だけじゃなくて！
もっと幅広い知識を身に付けたいの――
戦いの役に立つはずよ
column4:
It's not just about knowing attributes and
weaknesses.
I want to acquire a broader range of knowledge.
It should be useful in battle.

column3:
暇なの？
ボーッとしてないで、知識を蓄えるなり
身体を鍛えるなりした方がいいんじゃない？
column4:
Are you free?
Instead of spacing out, it would be better to
accumulate knowledge or train your body, wouldn't
it?

column3:
なんなの、怪しい人ね！
信用してほしいんなら、さっさと身の証を
立ててこればいいじゃない！
column4:
What's the matter? You're such a suspicious
person!
If you want me to trust you, then quickly provide
some proof and establish it!

column3: どうした？

何か面白い話は無いか、だと？
昔話でもすると思ったか
ヌムム――年寄り扱いしおって
column4:
Do you want to hear an interesting story or
something?
Did you think I was going to tell you an old
tale?
Gah, treating me like an old man.

column3:
昔話を聞いて喜ぶ暇があれば
将来のために何ができるかを考えるんだな
column4:
If you have time to rejoice in listening to old
tales, then ponder what you can do for the future.

column3:
ダナの村は戦士の村だ
強くあるからこそ、護るべきものを
支えることができるのだ
column4:
Dana's village is a village of Soldiers.
It is because they are strong that they can
