俺よくわかんねぇんだよな～
――あ、説明しないで
あんま聞く気ないんだわ
column4:
O que torna o Arisen tão incrível?
Eu realmente não entendo.
--Oh, não se preocupe em explicar.
Eu não tenho interesse em ouvir.

column3:
マリサと俺ってば運命で結ばれてっから
誰にも引き裂けないぜ
column4:
Marisa e eu estamos ligados pelo destino
e ninguém pode nos separar.

column3:
俺、本気で働いたら
ぜってー金持ちになると思うんだよな～！
結構そういう才能あるからさぁ
――ま、その気になればだけど
column4:
Se eu realmente me esforçasse e trabalhasse duro,
acho que poderia ficar rico, sabe~!
Eu tenho um talento para esse tipo de coisa.
Bem, se eu realmente me decidisse a isso.

column3: ん？　何か用？

覚者さんにゃ
常日頃から世話になってるね
column4:
Prezado Arisen,
Sou verdadeiramente grato
por seus constantes cuidados e assistência.

column3: まぁ必要なものがあれば買ってってくれ
column4:
Bem, se houver algo que você precise,
Eu vou vendê-lo de bom grado para você.

column3:
アクセサリーはつけているかい？
おっと、お洒落の話だけじゃないよ
column4:
Você está usando algum acessório?
Oh, desculpe, não é só sobre moda.

column3:
指輪やピアスを身に付ければ
心身にもいい影響がある
興味があれば見ていってくれ
column4:
Usar anéis e brincos,
pode ter um impacto positivo em sua mente e corpo.
Dê uma olhada, se quiser.

column3:
この神殿は人も物も集まるな
とくに重大任務が発布される時は
俺達商人にとっちゃ、かきいれ時さ
column4:
Este templo atrai pessoas e bens.
Duplamente quando uma missão importante é anunciada,
é um ótimo momento para nós, comerciantes!

column3:
おお、いらっしゃい！
ぜひ見ていってくれ
役に立つ商品を揃えているつもりだよ
column4:
Oh, bem-vindo!
Dê uma olhada, Ser.
Tenho certeza de que você encontrará algo útil.

column3:
珍しい物をお持ちでしたら
相応の逸品と交換してさしあげますよ？
――へっへへ
column4:
Se você tiver algum item raro,
Eu os trocarei de bom grado por tesouros dignos.
--Hehehe.

column3:
覚者さんは、世界のあちこちを旅されているとか
では、見聞が広い分、相当に貴重な品や武具も
お持ちなんでしょうなぁ――いやはや
column4:
Ser Arisen,
Ouvi dizer que você viajou por todo o mundo.
Com uma gama tão ampla de experiências,
Imagino que você deva possuir
itens e equipamentos bastante valiosos.
Oh, céus, que impressionante!

column3:
わたしはね、自分が扱う品には絶対の自信を
持っておりましてね――
鑑定交換に足る品をお持ちでしたら、ぜひお声掛けを
column4:
Tenho absoluta confiança nos itens que manuseio.
Se você tiver algo que valha a pena avaliar,
por favor, me avise.

column3:
へっへへ――
希少品、珍品の鑑定交換でしたらお任せを
column4:
Hehehe――
Se for uma troca por itens raros e exclusivos,
deixe comigo.

column3:
わたしは、《鑑定交換》を生業とする
グレゴリーと申す者――
へっへへ、しがない商人でございますよ
column4:
Eu sou Gregory, um comerciante especializado em
'Avaliação e Troca'.
Um humilde comerciante, se quiser.
Hehehe--

column3:
ええまぁしかし――
わたしが扱い、交換に応じるのは
希少品、珍品、もしくは興味を引かれた逸品のみ！
column4:
Bem, na verdade,
Eu só negocio itens raros, tesouros únicos,
ou itens que despertam meu interesse!

column3:
もしこのリストにある品をお持ちでしたら
それに相応しき価値ある品と
鑑定交換してさしあげましょう
column4:
Se você tiver um item nesta lista,
teremos prazer em trocá-lo
por um item de valor compatível.

column3:
ささ、いかがですかな？
――覚者様
column4:
Bem, o que você acha?
――Ser Arisen.

column3:
さてさて――ここに腰を落ち着けるか否か――
どんな方々に何を持ってきていただけるかで
へっへへ、考えるとしますかねぇ
column4:
Bem, bem—
se devo me estabelecer aqui ou não—
depende do tipo de coisas que aparecem.
Hehehe, terei que pensar sobre isso.

column4:
Os ingredientes que negociamos
também estão no menu da taverna.

column3: おいしい物を食べれば元気がでますよ！
column4: Comer comida deliciosa vai te dar energia!

column3:
体力をつけたい時はお肉
スタミナが足りない時はキノコ
体調を整えたければハーブ
column4:
Quando você quiser fortalecer sua saúde, coma carne.
Quando estiver sem resistência, coma cogumelos.
Se você quiser equilibrar sua condição, use ervas.

column3:
お肉、キノコ、それに飲み物やハーブ――
食材にはそれぞれ違った味わいがあって
体への影響も違うんです
column4:
Carne, cogumelos e até bebidas e ervas—
Cada ingrediente tem um sabor diferente
e também afeta o corpo de forma diferente.

column3: 偏食しちゃダメですよ！
column4: Você não deve ser um comedor exigente!

column3:
ポーン達もクラフトルームでは
お料理するという話ですね
column4: Ouvi dizer que os Peões também cozinham na sala de artesanato.

column3:
一流の料理レシピのいくつかは
彼らが作ったとも言われているんです
column4:
Diz-se que algumas das melhores receitas culinárias
foram criadas por eles.

column3:
最近は関所の取り締まりも厳しくなって
地方の方は大変だと聞きました
column4:
Recentemente, ouvi dizer que a fiscalização nos
postos de controle ficou mais rigorosa,
tornando difícil para as pessoas nas áreas rurais.

column3:
確かに、以前よりうちに仕入れにくる
商人の方も随分減った気がします
column4:
Certamente, parece que
há significativamente menos comerciantes
vindo à nossa loja para comprar mercadorias,
em comparação com antes.

column3:
手塩にかけて育てたっていうのに
あの子ったらちっとも言うこと聞かないで――
column4:
Mesmo tendo-o criado com tanto carinho,
aquele menino nunca ouve uma palavra que eu digo...

column3:
あ、息子のことなんだけどね
もういい年なのにいつまでも落ち着かないんだよ
column4:
Ah, é sobre meu filho.
Mesmo já tendo idade suficiente,
ele simplesmente não consegue se estabelecer.

column3:
うちの息子は無鉄砲なんだけど
運が強いのか、不思議なことに
何をやっても無事なんだよね
はぁ、でもその運もいつまでもつのやら――
column4:
Meu filho é imprudente, mas estranhamente,
ele consegue sair ileso
não importa o que faça.
Haah, eu me pergunto quanto tempo sua sorte vai durar...

column3:
若い頃って、ああいう女が
よく見えるものなのかねぇ――
いや、息子の話なんだけど、困ったもんで
column4:
Eu me pergunto se é porque quando você é jovem,
mulheres como essa tendem a chamar sua atenção.
Hmm... Não, é sobre meu filho,
mas é bem problemático.

column3: はぁ、心配ごとって尽きないわね――

何事も楽しまないと損！
それから、楽しませないと損よ！
column4:
Não perca a chance de aproveitar tudo!
E não deixe passar sem tornar agradável!

column3:
さぁ、今回もお祭りを楽しんじゃいましょ！
美味しいお菓子を集めて、交換して、食べる！
column4:
Agora, vamos aproveitar o festival de novo!
Reúna doces deliciosos,
troque-os e coma!

column3:
去年のキャンディとクッキーに負けず劣らず
今年のお菓子もキュートでおいしくて素敵なの！
column4:
Para não ficar atrás dos doces e biscoitos do ano passado,
os doces deste ano são fofos, deliciosos e maravilhosos!

column3:
そういえば、ハロウィンのお祭りって
みんな思い思いの仮装をしがちでしょ？
column4:
Pensando bem, as festividades de Halloween
permitem que todos se fantasiem como quiserem, certo?

column3:
もしかしたら、魔物の仮装をした人が
実は本物の魔物だったりして――
ふふ、冗談冗談！
column4:
Talvez, a pessoa vestida como um monstro
seja realmente um demônio――
Hehe, só brincando!

この衣装も、まさにこの日のために用意していたのだ
コレクション用にと思っていた女物の方は
シェリーちゃんに奪われてしまったが――
column4:
Hehee, o que você acha?
Eu tinha essa roupa preparada justamente para esta ocasião.
A versão feminina, que eu estava pensando
em guardar para minha coleção,
foi arrebatada por Shelly...

column3:
あっ、いや、シェリーちゃんは
俺のラッキーパワフルエンジェルだとも！
とってもよくお似合いだなぁ！
――キミもそう思うだろう！？
column4:
Ah, não,
Shelly também é meu Anjo Poderoso da Sorte!
Fica muito bem nela, não é!
Você também deve achar isso, certo?!

column3:
こういう季節の楽しみを
心から満喫する毎日は楽しいッ！
終わっても思い出で楽しいッ！
column4:
Aproveitar ao máximo os prazeres desta estação
torna cada dia agradável!
Mesmo depois que acaba, as memórias são alegres!

column3:
だからこそ、この日のためにだな
こそこそと準備を重ねてきたわけだよ
実は準備中もそれなりに楽しかったんだがね！
column4:
É por isso que, por causa deste dia,
temos nos preparado silenciosamente o tempo todo.
Para ser honesto, eu realmente me diverti bastante
durante os preparativos!

column3:
俺こそはレスタニアのお祭り男
その名もアンジェロ！
column4:
Eu sou o homem festivo de Lestânia.
Meu nome é Angelo!

column3:
今こそ俺が輝く時――！
限られたこの期間のために
ずっと準備してきていたんだからなッ！
そう、息を潜めてひっそりこっそりと――
column4:
Agora é a hora de eu brilhar!
Tenho me preparado para este período limitado!
Sim, silenciosamente e secretamente...

muito interessante.
Para você, é segredo.

Se fosse eu, com todo esse espaço,
transformaria metade do quarto em uma estufa.

Mandrágora—

いつでも歓迎よ！

Você é sempre bem-vindo para entrar em contato
comigo para discutir reformas de quartos e afins!

column3: 新しい家具、私も探してみようかな
column4: Eu me pergunto se eu também deveria procurar por móveis novos.

《Meu Quarto (temporário)》

column3:
ポーンとゆっくり過ごして日頃の疲れを
取っていってね
column4:
Passe um tempo com seu Peão
e descanse do seu cansaço diário!

column3: 《マイルーム》のことなら何でも相談してね！

column3:
ルキーノと一緒にいると面白いよ
何か、そういうさぁ、面白いことを
見つけるパワーがあるっていうか――
column4:
Estar com Luchino é sempre divertido.
Ele tem uma certa, você sabe,
habilidade para encontrar coisas interessantes—

column3:
ルキーノのママって超心配性なの
人生は限りがあるってのに
悩んでる時間ってムダヅカイよね～
column4:
A mãe de Luchino é super protetora, não é?
Nossas vidas são finitas,
o tempo gasto se preocupando é um desperdício, sabe~

column3:
ねぇねぇ、何か面白いことがあったら
あたしにも教えてよね
column4:
Ei, ei, se você encontrar algo interessante,
me diga também!

column3: 元気ィ？
覚者様、お部屋のインテリアを変えてみませんか？
column4: Arisen, gostaria de mudar o interior do seu quarto?

column3:
アチーブメントを達成すると
《家具レシピ》を入手できます
それを元に、ポーンにクラフトで作ってもらうんです
column4:
Quando você completar uma conquista,
você receberá uma 《Receita de Mobília》
e pedirá ao seu Peão para criá-la para você!

column3:
覚者様とポーンが協力して作り上げるお部屋――
きっと素敵なお部屋になるんでしょうね！
column4:
O quarto que Ser Arisen e Peão
estão trabalhando juntos para criar--
Tenho certeza de que será um quarto lindo!

column3:
覚者様のお部屋がどんな風に変わるのか
楽しみにしてます！
column4:
Estou ansioso para ver como o quarto
do prezado Arisen mudará!

column3:

プライベート空間です！
column4: O "Quarto do Arisen" é seu próprio espaço privado!

column3:
パートナーポーンとゆっくり過ごして
日頃の疲れを取っていってくださいね
column4:
Passe um tempo com seu Peão Parceiro
e descanse do seu cansaço diário!

column3:
《覚者の自室》のことなら
何でも私に相談してくださいね！
column4:
Se você tiver alguma dúvida sobre o 《Quarto do Arisen》,
entre em contato comigo para qualquer coisa que precisar!

現在こちらにいらっしゃった方は
別用にて不在です
column4:
Você está procurando por alguém?
A pessoa que você está procurando
está atualmente ausente por outro assunto.

column3: 時を改め、再度おいでください
column4: Por favor, volte em uma data posterior.

column3: おや、何かご用ですか？

ここで一汗かいて、自室でゆっくり風呂に入って
夕方になったら酒場に繰り出す――
そんな風に神殿の中で過ごす休日ってのも
中々いいんじゃないか？
column4:
Depois de suar um pouco aqui,
Tomarei um banho relaxante no meu quarto
e então irei ao bar à noite.
Passar os feriados assim no Templo...
Parece bom, não acha?

column3: 待たせたな、ようやくここも本始動だ！
column4:
Obrigado por esperar.
Finalmente, este lugar está começando a ganhar vida!

column3:
神殿内で武器を構えるのは禁止だろ？
でも、新しいスキルを好きに試して
みたいって時もあるじゃないか
column4:
Não é permitido empunhar uma arma
dentro do Templo, certo?
Mas há momentos
em que você só quer experimentar suas novas habilidades.

column3:
そんな時に思う存分暴れ回っても大丈夫なのが
この《鍛練の小部屋》だ！
思いっきり使っていってくれよ！
column4:
Em momentos como esse, o que permite
que você se enfureça livremente
à vontade é esta "Sala de Treinamento"!
Vá em frente e use-a à vontade!

column3:
スキルとスキルを上手く繋げられるか確認したりさ
他にも新しいジョブをじっくり試したい時とか――
結構使いどころは多いと思うぜ
column4:
Você pode confirmar se consegue conectar habilmente
habilidades,
ou se quiser experimentar novas vocações a fundo...
Acho que há muitas situações em que é útil!

column3:
ま、使い方は人それぞれだから
お前はお前のやり方で活用してくれればいいよ
column4:
Bem, a forma de usá-lo é com cada um,
Use-o da forma que te inspirar
e que traga sua criatividade à tona.

column3: こんにちは
この日があるのも白竜様のお陰ね
column4: Este dia existe graças ao Senhor Dragão Branco.

column3: いいお日和ね
調子はいかが？
うーん、こんなのどうしろっていうのさ――
column4: Bem, o que eu devo fazer com tudo isso--

column3:
私だけじゃちょっと厳しいかも――
頑張ればギリギリ、いける――？
column4:
Pode ser um pouco difícil só para mim--
Se eu me esforçar, consigo por pouco--?

column3: 誰かに見つかる前に何とかしないと――
column4: Preciso fazer algo antes que alguém descubra.

column3:
誰もが知るようになったお宝なんて
意味が無いんだよね――
何とかならないかな――
column4:
Não adianta ter um tesouro
que todo mundo conhece――
Não há alguma forma de fazer dar certo――

column4: Sim, o que posso fazer por você?

column4: Este dia existe graças ao Senhor Dragão Branco.

column3: いいお日和ね
調子はいかが？
こんにちは
この日があるのも白竜様のお陰ね
column4: Este dia existe graças ao Senhor Dragão Branco.

column3: いいお日和ね
調子はいかが？

く――、ままならんものだ
被造物に手を焼かされるなど――
column4:
Urgh, é um grande dilema.
Ter que lidar com criações problemáticas...

column3:
今となっては錬魔の存在自体が忌々しい！
道理を解せぬケダモノに
我々が脅かされるとはな
column4:
Hoje em dia,
a própria existência dos alquimistas é detestável!
Ser ameaçado por feras
que não conseguem compreender a razão,
tal coisa é inaceitável.

column3:
おのれ、錬魔の制御さえ取り戻すことが
できれば――！
column4:
Se ao menos eu pudesse recuperar o controle
sobre o Alquimizado...!

column3:
ああ、お前は地上から来た者だな
――何か用か？
column4:
Ah, então você é alguém
que veio da terra, não é?
... Você tem algum negócio aqui?

column3:
ああ、これほど狭くなったメルゴダだが
立ち入れぬ場所は多い
困ったものだよ
column4:
Ah, Mergoda se tornou tão pequena
com muitos lugares proibidos.
Muito problemático, de fato.

column3:
君たちがここへきてくれたことは
我々にとっても大きな変化だ
それが良いのか、悪いのかはまだ分からないが
column4:
O fato de todos vocês terem vindo para cá
é uma mudança significativa para nós também.
Se é bom ou ruim, ainda não sabemos.

column3:
少しでも資源を集め、錬魔を防がなければ――
居住区すらいつまでも安全とは限らないからね
column4:
Devemos reunir recursos, por escassos que sejam,
e evitar que o Alquimizado cause estragos.
Porque mesmo as áreas residenciais
não têm garantia de serem seguras para sempre.

column3: ああ、何か用かな？
column4: Oh, o que posso fazer por você?

column3:
ああ――
せめて安全に、メルゴダ内を歩くことが
できればいいのですが――
column4:
Oh--
Eu gostaria de poder pelo menos andar com segurança
por Mergoda...

column3:
居住区に住まうみなにとって、錬魔の脅威は
共通の問題なのです
自らが生みだした問題ですが、今となっては
解決する術もなく――皮肉なものですね
column4:
Para todos que vivem na área residencial,
a ameaça do Alquimizado é um problema comum.
É um problema que eles mesmos criaram,
mas agora parece não haver como resolvê-lo.
- Que irônico, não é?

column3:
地上の方も、散策する際は錬魔にご注意ください
いつどこから襲われるともしれませんので
column4:
Por favor, tenha cuidado com o Alquimizado
ao explorar o mundo da superfície.
Você nunca sabe quando ou onde eles atacarão.

column3: ご機嫌いかがですか？　地上の方
column4: Como você está se sentindo, habitante da terra?

column3:
エリクシルとは錬金の真髄
事象の本質を抽出し、凝縮し、そして
解放する――
錬金を学べば分かることですよ。ウフフ――
column4:
The Elixir is the essence of alchemy.
It extracts, condenses,
and liberates the essence of phenomena--
That's what you'll understand 
when you learn alchemy. Hehe--

column3:
あなた、地上から来た人ですね――？
だってその格好、見たことありませんから
column4:
You, are you someone who came from the ground--?
Because I've never seen that appearance before.

column3:
ああ、この次は何を錬成いたしましょう
あれか、これか――
悩ましいですね――ウフフ
column4:
Ah, what should I synthesize next?
Hmm, is it that... or this?
Perplexing... Ufufu.

column3: ――あら、私に何かご用でしょうか？
column4: --Oh, my dear, what can I do for you?

column3:
ああ、頭がくらくらしてきた――
でも、も、もうちょっとだけ――
column4:
Ah, my head is spinning...
But, just a little bit more...

column3:
いやぁ、もう頭までぽかぽか来ちゃって
ほんともう――
な、長湯しすぎかな
column4:
Aah, my head is all warm and fuzzy.
I've been soaking in the bath
for far too long, haven't I?

column3:
やぁ、調子はどうだい？
ここの温泉、すっごく効くよ
そりゃもう体力がじわじわ溢れ出すほどさ――
column4:
Hey, how fare thee?
The hot springs here are great.
They're so good that they'll slowly
flood your body with energy...

column3: ああ、え？　何か言った――？
column4: Ah, eh? Did you say something--?

column3: あまり無理はするなよ
冒険は順調か？
調子はどうだ？
ああ、何か用か？
column4: Aye, what can I do you for?

column3: こんにちは
この日があるのも白竜様のお陰ね
column4: This day exists thanks to the Lord White Dragon.

column3: いいお日和ね
調子はいかが？
こんにちは
この日があるのも白竜様のお陰ね
column4: This day exists thanks to the Lord White Dragon.

column3: いいお日和ね
調子はいかが？
ウギャ！
人間キライ！
ウガ、ウガ――
ぐぅおおおおお――
がぁあっは――
ぐおおおお！
あぁあああああ！！

スピリットランサーは自然の力を活かして戦う
大地、空気、水、木々や雷――
全ての力に感謝することを忘れるな
column4:
The Spirit Lancer fights 
by harnessing the power of nature.
The earth, air, water, trees, and lightning—
Never forget to give thanks to these forces.

column3:
異国の覚者がスピリットランサーを
志すということも、あるものなのだな
column4:
It is indeed possible for an Arisen
from a foreign land
to aspire to become a Spirit Lancer.

column3:
スピリットランサーを志し、同じ師を仰ぐ以上
我らは兄弟弟子ということになる――
不思議な感覚だが、悪くはない
column4:
As long as we aspire to be Spirit Lancers
and look up to the same master,
we are brothers and disciples--
An odd feeling, but not a bad one.

column3:
大いなる自然の加護を受けし者よ
さらに鋭き精霊槍を求めるならば
力添えしよう
column4:
O blessed one by the great forces of nature,
If you seek an even sharper Spirit Lance,
I shall assist you.

column3:
師であるアデルドナハには及ばぬが
俺も鍛練を積んだスピリットランサーだ
お前の修練くらい造作もない
column4:
While I may not reach the level of my master,
Adair Donnchadh, I am also a Spirit Lancer
who has undergone rigorous training. 
It's similar to your regimen, indeed.

column3:
最近は魔物もずいぶんと凶暴になってきてるわ
あなたも気を付けることね
column4:
Demons grow more ferocious these days.
You better watch out, too.

column3: あら、見慣れない方ね

ご機嫌よう――
今日もいい風ね

――私からは特に話すべきことは無いわ
あなたは？
column4:
--I don't have anything special to tell you.
What about you?

column3:
珍しいものと面白い話――
僕はそれらを追い求めることに人生を捧げたいんだ
column4:
Unusual things and interesting stories--
I want to dedicate my life to pursuing them.

column3:
毎日同じことを繰り返し、魔物に怯えて
そして疲れ果てて眠るだけの毎日なんて
まっぴらゴメンだね
column4:
Every day, repeating the same thing,
and living in fear of monsters.
Sorry, but I can't stand a life like that.
No way.

column3:
へ？　仕事をしてないように見えるって？
僕が面白い話を探して旅をするだろ
その道中で色んな――面白くはない話も――聞くだろ
で、その話を聞くために金を払うヤツは多いのさ
column4:
Huh? You think I don't look like I'm working?
I travel in search of interesting stories.
Along the way, I'll hear various—
even uninteresting— stories.
And there are many people who pay money
just to hear those stories.

column3:
情報を売ってる、っていうのかな
その金でまた旅に出られるわけ――
正直な話、金には困ってないよ
column4:
I'm selling information, I guess you could say.
That money will get me on the road again--
I'm not hurting for money, to be honest.

column3: よぅ、何か面白いものでも持ってるのか？
column4: Yo, got something interesting for me?

column3:
はぁ――ワクワクするものが欲しい――
君も、何かこれぞというものを見つけたら
ぜひ教えてくれよ
column4:
Haah... I long to feel exhilaration.
If you happen to find something
that truly captures that feeling,
let me know about it!

column3:
歩いて渡るのは危険だ
たとえ覚者であろうと――
――俺としては勧められないな
column4:
It is dangerous to cross on foot,
even if you are an Arisen――
――I cannot recommend it.

column3:
川を渡りたいのなら
船を出そうか？
column4:
If you want to cross the river,
I can take you there by boat.

column3:
あまり増水すると船も出せない
ここ最近は水量が安定していて助かる
column4:
If the water rises too high,
we can't even launch the boat.
Thank goodness the level is stable these days.

column3:
水の流れに逆らわず利用することで
体力を節約しながら漕げるんだ
column4:
By going with the flow of the water,
you can save energy while rowing.

column3: 外、歩くのタノシイ――
column4: It's so nice to walk outside.

column3:
オレ、あやしくない
お前気にしなくていい
column4:
I'm not faking it.
You don't have to worry about it.

column3: ヌ、なんだ？

オレの村、遠いとこ
ここらへん、マダ慣れてない――
column4:
My village, far away.
Not used to here, this place--

column3:
あなたに授けられる《復活力》の加護は
1度に3回分まで――
お忘れなきよう
column4:
The "Revival Power" blessing you will receive 
is limited to three at a time--
Don't forget that.

column3:
必要とあらば、貴方のために
貴方を加護する竜へと祈りを捧げましょう
それが、私の役目であるようです
column4:
If necessary, I shall offer a prayer
to the Dragon that protects you.
This is also my task.

column3:
異なる竜に仕える覚者よ
私の祈りが必要でしょうか？
column4:
Oh, Arisen who serves a different Dragon,
have you need of my prayers?

column3:
この者が仕える竜よ、《復活力》のご加護を――
あなたの覚者が、三たび倒れども
立ち上がることができますよう――
column4:
Lord Dragon, upon this individual may you bestow
your Divine Protection of "Revival Power"
so that your Arisen may rise again,
even if they fall thrice--
and stand once more.

column3:
――おや、あなたは既に本日《復活力》の加護を
受けられたご様子
加護を受けられるのは日に１度です
わかっておいででしょう？
column4:
Oh, it seems you have already received
the divine protection of Revival Power today.
Please note that you can only receive
this protection once a day.

column3:
おや、異なる竜に仕える方よ
既に《復活力》の加護で満たされていますね
column4:
O servant of another Dragon,
you are already filled with the Divine Protection
of "Revival Power."

column3:
加護を失いし時にこそ、私をお訪ねください
どうか良き旅を
column4:
When you have lost the Divine Protection,
come visit me.
Good travels, Ser.

column3:
おや、まだ《復活力》の加護に
守られておいでですね
残っている復活力を捨て、新たな復活力を
授かりますか？
column4:
Oh, my,
you are still under the Divine Protection
of "Revival Power."
Will you discard the remaining revivals
and receive a new blessing?

column3: はい
いいえ

では、今日も大いなる竜のご加護が
あらんことを――
column4:
May the great Divine Protection
of the Dragon be with us today as well...

column3:
私は本来、精霊竜様とその覚者様をお助けするため
《芯なる樹》にいたのですが
このような状況となり、ダナへと参りました――
column4:
I originally resided within the Core Tree,
assisting the Spirit Dragon
and its Arisen in their endeavors.
However, due to the current circumstances,
I have come to Dana—

column3:
私はこの場に居るべきだと感じたのです
――それがこのフィンダムのためになる
今も、そう信じています
column4:
I felt that I should be here.
―― It will benefit Phindym.
Even now, I believe so.

column3: 大いなる竜の加護は、常に貴方と共に――
column4:
May the blessings of the Dragon Protection
always be with you.

column3:
あら――
私はわかっていますよ
貴方は竜に仕える覚者でしょう
column4:
Oh... I understand.
You must be an Arisen who serves the Dragon.

column3:
――やることがあるんだ
用が無いなら、放っておいてくれ
column4:
There are things to do――
If you've no business with me,
please leave me alone.

column3:
まったく――
私なんかより、無駄話が好きな奴らに
声をかけた方が楽しいんじゃないか
column4:
I mean--
Wouldn't it be more enjoyable
to approach people who,
unlike someone like me,
actually enjoy idle chatter?

column3: ――何か用でも？

君は外にいる時も
そんな大声で話すのか？
獲物が逃げるから、静かにした方がいい
column4:
Do you talk that loud when you're outside too?
You'd better be quiet
or your game will run away.

column3: ホッホッホ、メリークリスマス！

ホッホッホ！
順調に幸せの挨拶が
広まっているようでなにより――
column4:
Ho-ho-ho!
It's heartwarming to see these happy greetings
spreading so widely――

column3:
ん？　この笑い声かね？
実はわしは声が大きい方らしくて――
大口を開けて笑うと、子供たちが怖がってしまう
そこで口をすぼめて笑っているのだ
column4:
Huh? This laughter?
Actually, I seem to have a loud voice—
When I laugh loudly, children get scared,
so I put on a big smile instead.

column3:
従者たちも、わしの任務には大賛成だ
それぞれ楽しみながら勤めてくれている
column4:
My attendants are also wholeheartedly
in favor of my duties.
Each one diligently fulfills their tasks
while thoroughly enjoying themselves.

column3:
人の笑顔を見ることほど楽しく、嬉しいことはない
もうずいぶんと生きているが
これは変わらんものだなぁ
column4:
There is nothing more fun and joyful
than seeing people smile.
I've been alive for a long time now,
and this is something that will never change.

column3: メリークリスマス、覚者様

神殿に季節の幸せを広める
お手伝いができたならば
この恰好をした甲斐もあったというものです――
column4:
If I can help spread seasonal joy in the temple,
it will have been worth it to dress up like this--

column3:
主いわく、今年の私の装いのテーマは
「可愛さ、親しみやすさ」だそうです
ミーアとも"お揃い"なのだそうで――
column4:
According to the master,
this year's theme for my attire
is "cuteness & approachability."
It seems I'll be "matching" with Mia as well—

column3:
皆さんが「メリークリスマス」と口にされる度
そのお声を聞いている我々にも
幸せを分けていただいているような気がします
column4:
Every time you all say "Merry Christmas,"
it feels like you're sharing happiness with us
just by hearing your voices.

column3:
あら、覚者さま
それではご一緒に！
メリークリスマース！
column4:
Oh, Master Arisen!
Well, join us then!
Merry Christmas!

column3:
あたしの話し方ですか？
こういう風にしているとですね
例えば、ちょっとシャイな子供でも
お友達になってくれるんですよ
column4:
Is it the way I talk?
If you do it this way, for example,
even a shy child will become your friend!

column3:
主がそれを望まれているから
あたしはそのようにするのです！
column4:
Because my master wants it,
that's what I'll do!

column3:
この恰好で寒くないのか、ですか？
だーいじょうぶ！
心はいつもホッカホカです！
column4:
Am I cold in this outfit, you say?
I'm doing great!
My heart is always warm!

column3:
それに、主のお傍にいると
何となく温かいんですよね！
これ、あたしが主のポーンだからって
わけじゃないと思うんですけど
column4:
Besides, when I am by Master's side,
I feel warm somehow!
I don't think this is because
I'm my Master's Pawn, though.

column3:
幸せの挨拶、続けてますか？
さっ、今年も高らかに！
メリークリスマース！
column4:
Spreading joyful cheer?
Now, let's proclaim it loudly again this year!
Merry Christmas!

column3: ああ、ジフール砦の件だな？
column4: Ah, is this about the Jifule Fortress incident?

column3:
ここ《フェルヤナ荒原》にあるジフール砦――
幾度となくオーク達に占領されてきたが
その度に取り返してきた
column4:
The Jifule Fortress,
located here in the Feryana Wilderness,
has been occupied by the Orcs numerous times,
but we have always managed to reclaim it.

column3:
そこに異国の覚者の力が加われば
怖いものなしだな！
――本当に、頼りになる存在だよ、お前たちは
column4:
If the power of foreign Arisen is added there,
there will be nothing to fear!
Truly, you lot are all reliable fellows.

column3:
お前たちの姿を見るだけで
勇気づけられるという者も多いんだ
column4:
Many of us are encouraged
by the mere sight of you.

column3:
ダクレイム砦の奪還は鮮やかだったな！
――今回も頼りにしてるぞ
column4:
The recapture of Dacreim Fortress was brilliant!
- I'm counting on you again this time.

column3:
ジフール砦に出撃する前に
少し休んでいきたいということか
俺の顔で安く泊まれるように案内しよう
<VAL PRICE_INN>はかかるが、それでいいか？
column4:
Before heading out to Jifule Fortress,
you want to rest a bit, huh?
Let me guide you to a place
where you can stay cheaply using my connections.
It will cost <VAL PRICE_INN>, is that okay?

column3: はい
いいえ

疲れが溜まると本来の力を発揮できなくなる
お前がそうなると困ることばかりだ！
休みたいならそこらで好きに休憩していってくれ
誰にも文句は言わせないからさ
column4:
If you grow weary,
you won't be able to unleash your true power.
Brings only trouble if you end up like that!
If you want to rest,
feel free to take a break wherever you like.
I won't let anyone complain, so go ahead.

column3: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》か
もちろん出撃前には大切なことだよな
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>くらいでどうだ？
column4:
Need to "Treat Weakness," huh?
Of course, it's important to do that
before going into battle, right?
How about <VAL PRICE_WEAK>?

column3: はい
いいえ

――んん？
どこら辺が《弱化》してるんだ――？
すまないが、よくわからんな
column4:
--Hmm?
In what manner are you "Weakened"?
I'm sorry, I don't understand.

column3:
おいおい、既に別のミッションを
受注しているじゃないか
column4:
Hey now,
you've already taken on another mission.

column3:
こちらのミッションへ出撃する場合は、
今受注しているミッションを解散してから
改めて尋ねてきてくれ
column4:
If you are going to sortie on this mission,
please dissolve the mission
you are currently undertaking and then ask again.

column3: はい、戦技の付け替えでしょうか？
column4: Yes, is it about changing combat skills?

column3:
強敵に挑む時や
効率よく敵を薙ぎ払う必要がある時――
戦技を付け替えるのは、非常に重要なことです
column4:
When facing formidable enemies,
or when efficiently dispatching foes—
it is crucial to change your combat skills.

column3:
敵や状況に合わせて
スキルやアビリティを付け替える――
一見手間なように思えますが
実は効率化への重要なポイントなんですよ
column4:
Depending on the enemy and the situation,
you can change your skills and abilities--
It may seem like a hassle at first glance,
but it's actually a key point to efficiency!

column3:
装備も戦技も、磨いてこそ
そして状況に合わせてこそ、です
column4:
Both equipment and combat skills
must be honed and adapted to the situation.

column3: よく来てくれた、異国の覚者よ
column4: Welcome, Arisen from a foreign land.

column3:
ダクレイム砦はこのエリアの第一線の１つだ
悪しき竜軍が支配するか、
我々解放軍が制圧するか――
この戦いの要となるだろう
column4:
Dacreim Fortress is at the frontline.
Whether it will be conquered
by the forces of the Evil Dragon
or reclaimed by our Liberation Army...
It will surely be the key to this battle.

column3:
解放軍には、元々兵士でもなんでもなく
ただ必要に駆られて所属している者も多い――
column4:
In the Liberation Army,
there are many who are not originally soldiers,
but rather individuals who have been compelled
to join out of necessity.

column3:
貴方が協力してくれるのは
戦力的にも、精神的な支えとしても
とてもありがたいことだ
column4:
It is truly appreciated
that you are willing to cooperate,
both in terms of combat strength
and a source of emotional support.

column3:
異国の竜の加護を受けながら
アッカーシェランに力を貸してくれる覚者よ
貴方の武運を祈ろう
column4:
While receiving the Divine Protection of Dragons
from a faraway foreign land,
O Arisen who lends power to Acre Selund,
I pray for your good fortune in battle.

column3:
他ミッションへエントリーしている最中だろう
ウォーミッションへ出撃する際は、
今エントリーしているミッションの参加予定を
取り消して来てくれ
column4:
You must be in the middle
of entering another mission.
When you sortie for a War Mission,
please cancel your participation
in the previously accepted mission and try again.

column3:
ああ、カトブレパスに乗る時は
ちょっとしたコツがいるんですよ
お手伝いしましょうか？
column4:
Ah, when riding a Catoblepas,
there are a few tips you need to know.
Shall I assist you?

column3:
こうして大人しくしている間は
可愛いとすら思えるんですけどねぇ
column4:
As long as she's quiet like this,
I even think she's cute!

column3:
そりゃぁ、普段の扱いにも
細心の注意を払ってますよ！
馬や牛とは違いますから
column4:
That's because we are very careful 
in our daily handling!
They are not like horses or cows.

column3:
あ、防護してありますけど
万が一カトブレパスの涙が漏れていたときには
絶対に触らないでくださいね！
絶対にですよ！
column4:
Ah, there are protective measures,
but just in case Catoblepas tears are leaking,
please absolutely do not touch it, okay?
Absolutely, I mean it!

column3: やあ、あんたが白き竜の覚者さんか
column4: Hey, are you the Arisen of the White Dragon?

column3:
このほこらに漂っている
《英霊の魂》を集めて
私に捧げてくれないかい？
column4:
Would you collect the《Souls of Heroic Spirits》
that float in this dust and offer them to me?

column3:
そうすれば、あんたに力を貸してやれる――
何せ今は何の力も無くってね
column4:
If you do that, then I can lend you my strength—
after all, I don't have any power right now.

column3:
これだけの《英霊の魂》、よく集めてきたね
おかげで何かと良い感じだよ
column4:
You've done an amazing job
collecting all these Souls of Heroic Spirits.
Thanks to that, things have been going well.

column3:
見たところ、あんたなら
もっと深くまで潜ることもできそうだし――
column4:
From what I can see,
you could probably delve even deeper...

column3:
少しだけ時間をくれたら
この土砂をどけておくよ、約束する
column4:
If you give me some time,
I promise to clear away this sediment.

column3:
どうだい？
土砂をどけて、道を作っておいたよ
これで先に進めるだろう
column4:
How about it?
I cleared away the debris and made a path.
You should be able to proceed now.

column3:
あんたほどの実力があるなら
この先に眠る宝物にもたどり着けるんじゃない？
column4:
If the Arisen as good as they say you are,
you'll find those treasures that lie ahead,
won't you, Ser?

column3:
期待してるよ――
ああ、久しぶりに楽しかった
column4:
I'll be waiting—
Ah, I haven't had this much fun in a while.

column3:
すまないけど、思ったより
土砂が詰まっててね
さすがに時間がかかってしまってるんだ
column4:
Sorry, Ser.
It's more packed with sediment than I thought.
It's taking longer than expected.

column3:
もう少しだけ時間をくれない？
なに、目途は立ってるからさ
column4: Can you give me a little more time? No, I've got a plan.

column3: はい、ご用はなんでしょうか
column4: Yes, what can I do for you?

column3:
地熱には恩恵を受けることも
逆に困らされることもあります
column4:
Both benefits and drawbacks can be derived 
from geothermal energy.

column3:
ここで、この装備で――
暑くないといえば嘘になりますが
ある程度は慣れました
column4:
Here, with this equipment...
It would be a lie to say it's not hot,
but I've gotten somewhat used to it.

column3: ご武運を祈っております
column4: I wish you the best of luck.

column3:
いや、うちの姐さんがたは
人使いが荒いのなんのって
column4:
No, my sisters...
They're very rough with people.

column3:
おっといけねぇ
聴こえちまうとこだった
column4:
Whoops, that was close.
Almost heard that.

column3:
いろいろと世話になりやしたね
キャリーの姐さんには
感謝してます
column4:
I have been greatly indebted to you in many ways,
Lady Carrie.
I am truly grateful to you.

column3:
おっと！
もちろん覚者さんにも！
column4:
Oops!
Of course, even to you, Ser Arisen!

column3:
復活した大食堂の噂
俺ら盗賊団でも話題ですぜ
さっそく食べに行ったやつもいるほどで
column4:
The rumor of the resurrected Great Dining Hall
has even become a topic among our band of bandits.
Some of us have already gone to eat there.

column3:
一度くらい顔出したいとこなんですがね
あいにく、用事を山ほど言いつけられちまって
column4:
I would like to show my face at least once, 
but unfortunately, 
I've been given a mountain of tasks to do.

column3:
本当は直接言いたいところですが――
キャリーの姐さんに
よろしく言っておいてくだせぇ
column4:
I would like to say it directly, but... 
Please give my regards to Carrie, Ser.

column3:
盗賊の武器はやっぱり
"あし"だと思うんでさ
column4:
I think the best weapon of a bandit is 
definitely their "legs".

column3:
"速く――静かに――いつの間にか"
これが俺のモットーでして
column4:
"Fast--quiet--before you know it."
That's my motto.

column3:
当然、"履物"にも
並々ならぬこだわりを持ってやしてね
column4: Naturally, we are also very particular about our "footwear".

column3: 「軽くて楽で履きやすい」

なんと言っても
これに尽きるってもんです
column4:
What can I say?
It all comes down to this!

column3:
戦技の付け替えでしたら
ぜひ、お手伝いさせてください
column4:
If it's about changing combat skills,
please let me assist you.

column3:
そうだ――スキルだけでなく
アビリティもこまめに見直してみてください
column4:
That's right - not just skills, 
make sure to regularly review your augments.

column3:
アビリティは一度付けたら
そのままにされる方も多いようですが
状況に応じて付け替えてこそ
真価を発揮するものなのです
column4:
Many people seem to leave their augments as they 
are once they are equipped, but it is when they 
are switched according to the situation that 
they truly demonstrate their worth.

column3:
スキルのような見た目の派手さはありませんが
アビリティのレベルも
上げれば上げるほど強力になりますよ
column4:
While it may not have the flashy appearance of 
skills, as you increase the level of your 
abilities, they will become more powerful.

column3:
これはこれは、いらっしゃいませ！
王都メガドで商うこと150年
由緒ある我が店でどうぞお買いものを！
column4:
Bem-vindo, bem-vindo! Nós temos negociado na
capital real de Megado por 150 anos.
Por favor, sinta-se à vontade para fazer compras em nossa estimada loja!

column3:
ええ、当店は代々メガドで
商いをさせていただいておりますよ
メガドでのお買い物といえば当店！
自信をもってお勧めする品の数々！
column4:
Sim, nossa loja tem feito negócios em Megado
por gerações.
Quando se trata de fazer compras em Megado,
é nossa loja!
Nós recomendamos com confiança uma variedade de produtos!

column3:
――え？　ロスギルのエルセン商会？
確かに私と名前こそ似ておりますが
血縁などではございませんよ
column4:
Oh? A Companhia de Comércio Rothgill, você diz?
Embora seja verdade que nossos nomes são semelhantes,
nós não somos relacionados de forma alguma, mmm.

column3:
あんな田舎のケチな商売人たちと
一緒にしないでいただきたいですねぇ
column4:
Eu agradeceria se você não me juntasse
com aqueles comerciantes mesquinhos de
uma área tão rural, mmm.

column3:
ささ、覚者さま
本日はどのような物をお探しで？
column4:
Saudações, Mestre Arisen.
Que tipo de item você está procurando hoje?

column3:
いらっしゃいませ、覚者さま！
王都メガドでのお買いものなら
《滅びの渦》にも負けない当店で！
column4:
Bem-vindo, Mestre Arisen!
Para suas compras na Capital Real de Megado,
escolha nossa loja que não perderá
para o Vórtice da Estagnação!

column3:
何があろうと、そう
私の命が尽きる瞬間まで
店は開けると心に決めたのです
column4:
Não importa o que aconteça,
até o momento em que minha vida chegar ao fim,
Eu decidi em meu coração manter a loja aberta.

column3:
覚者さま、物資については
ご心配なさらず！
当店はいつでも、覚者さまをサポートいたします！
column4:
Mestre Arisen,
Por favor, não se preocupe com os suprimentos!
Nossa loja sempre apoiará você,
Mestre Arisen, a qualquer momento!

column3:
この世界が滅びるというのであれば
私は"メガドの商人"として
終わりを迎えてやろうと思いましてね
column4:
Se este mundo está indo morrer,
Eu serei o "Comerciante de Megado"
até o fim.

column3:
バザーでの売買をお考えでしょうか
より良い取引のため、精一杯お手伝いいたします
column4:
Considerando comprar e vender no Bazar?
Faremos o nosso melhor para ajudá-lo
para uma transação melhor.

column3:
小さなお店ですけど
バザーの取引には問題ありませんよ
安心してご利用くださいね
column4:
É uma loja pequena, mas não há problemas com
transações de bazar.
Por favor, sinta-se à vontade para usá-la com tranquilidade.

column3:
遅くまで働くのは大変です
でも、まだ小さな弟もいますから――
column4:
Trabalhar até tarde é difícil
Mas eu ainda tenho um irmãozinho, então...

column3:
家族を失う人も多いなか、弟を
育てられるのは幸せなことだと思います
column4:
Entre as muitas pessoas que
perderam suas famílias, eu acho que é uma sorte
que eu seja capaz de criar meu irmão mais novo.

column3:
本当は行き場の無い子供たちの面倒も
見てあげたいんですけど――
うちも食べるだけで精一杯ですから――
column4:
Eu realmente quero cuidar das crianças que
não têm para onde ir...
Mas nós estamos mal conseguindo nos alimentar, então...

column3:
はい、バザーは今日も行われていますよ
お取引のお手伝いならお任せください
column4:
Sim, o bazar está sendo realizado hoje também.
Se você precisar de ajuda com suas transações,
por favor, deixe comigo.

column3:
かわいそうに
親を失った子供たちは
今頃どれほど不安な思いをしているか――
column4:
Que pena.
As crianças que perderam seus pais,
quanta ansiedade elas devem estar sentindo agora...

column3:
弟が、空の渦を怖がるので
ずっと家の窓を閉めているんです
まだ幼いながら、大変なことが起こっていると
わかるのでしょうね
column4:
Meu irmão mais novo tem medo do vórtice no céu,
então tenho mantido as janelas de
nossa casa fechadas o tempo todo.
Mesmo sendo ainda jovem, ele deve entender
que algo terrível está acontecendo, certo?

column3:
本当はずっと弟についていたいんです
でも、お店を開かないと
明日、そして明後日に食べる物が――
こうしている瞬間にも、迷うことばかり――
column4:
Eu quero ficar com meu irmão mais novo para sempre.
Mas se eu não abrir a loja,
não haverá nada para comer amanhã,
e depois de amanhã--
Mesmo em momentos como este,
estou constantemente cheio de dúvidas--

column3:
さぁさぁ、お疲れでしょう
メガドでお休みならうちへどうぞ！
column4:
Venha, venha, você deve estar cansado.
Se você quiser descansar em Megado, venha 
para o nosso lugar!

column3:
覚者さまのためなら
一番いいお部屋を<VAL PRICE_INN>で
ご用意いたしますよ！
寝心地も眺めも最高なんですから！
column4:
Para nosso estimado Mestre Arisen,
Vamos preparar o melhor quarto para você
pelo preço de <VAL PRICE_INN>!
Tanto o conforto quanto a vista
são simplesmente excelentes!

column3: はい
いいえ

いえいえ、他ならぬ覚者さまですから
無料でご案内いたしますとも！
もちろんお休みになりますよね？
column4:
Não, não, já que é ninguém menos que Mestre Arisen,
Eu vou te guiar até lá de graça, é claro!
Você vai fazer uma pausa, certo?

column3: はい
いいえ

まぁー、弱化なさっているなんて
お辛いことでしょう
《弱化の治療》は<VAL PRICE_WEAK>ですよ
早速取り掛かってもよろしいでしょうか？
column4:
Oh meu, eu não posso acreditar que você foi enfraquecido.
Sinto muito que você esteja sentindo dor.
A cura para o enfraquecimento é <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
Podemos começar imediatamente?

column3: はい
いいえ

あらあら、ここにいらっしゃるまでに
治ってしまわれたみたい――
さすがは覚者さまですね！
column4:
Oh meu, parece que você já foi curado
antes de vir aqui.
Verdadeiramente, você é um Arisen notável!

column3:
うちはメガドでいっちばん古くからある
宿屋なんですよ！
古くて狭そうに見える？
――それが"味"ってものじゃないですか
column4:
Nossa pousada é a mais antiga de Megado!
Parece velha e apertada?
—Mas é isso que lhe dá charme, não é?

column3:
長くやっている宿屋ですから
かつてはお忍びで居住層に遊びにいらした
王族もお泊りになったとか、ならないとか――
column4:
Como somos uma pousada de longa data,
diz-se que a realeza costumava vir e ficar aqui
incógnito para visitar a Camada Residencial.

column3:
戦いに出る方は、宿でついでに
戦技を見直されることも多いんでしょう？
だから、戦技補佐ができる人に
いてもらうことにしたんですよ
column4:
Para aqueles que vão para a batalha, é bem comum
que também aproveitem a oportunidade para reavaliar
suas habilidades de combate na pousada, certo?
É por isso que eu decidi ter alguém que possa
fornecer suporte técnico lá também.

column3:
ええ、ええ
宿は営業していますとも！
どうぞごゆっくりお休みくださいね
column4:
Sim, sim.
A pousada está definitivamente aberta para negócios!
Por favor, sinta-se à vontade para descansar e relaxar.

column3:
覚者さまも何かとお疲れでしょう
せっかくアッカーシェランに
来ていただいているのですから
やわらかなベッドくらいご用意しなければね
column4:
Mestre Arisen, você deve estar cansado de suas atividades.
Já que você veio até Acre Selund,
nós devemos preparar uma cama macia para você.

column3:
オークがメガドに攻め入ってきた時は
これ以上酷いことなんて無いと
思ったものですけどね――
column4:
Quando os orcs invadiram Megado,
Eu pensei que não poderia haver nada pior do que
isso, mas bem...

column3:
覚者さま、ぜひ疲れを取ってから
ご出発くださいね
わたしたちには、このくらいしか
できないものですから
column4:
Mestre Arisen, por favor, descanse e se recupere
antes de partir.
Nós só podemos fazer muito por você, afinal.

column3:
王子がさ、わたしやメイロワ将軍にも
休みが必要だからって
そんなこと、気にしなくていいのに
column4:
O príncipe diz que até eu e o General Meirova
precisamos de uma folga.
Não se preocupe com isso, honestamente.

column3:
ああ、この水着？
ええと、背の低い――
そう、キャメロンって子が貸してくれたんだ
column4:
Ah, este traje de banho?
Hmm, a baixinha...
Sim, Cameron me emprestou.

column3:
きれいなデザインだよね
紐や飾りなんかも繊細で――
平和な場所じゃないと、着られない
column4:
É um design bonito, não é?
Até mesmo as cordas e decorações são delicadas...
Você só pode usá-lo em um lugar tranquilo.

column3:
やっぱりレスタニアでは落ち着く？
いつもよりのびのびして見える
――いいね、そういう顔も
column4:
Is it calming in Lestania after all?
You seem more relaxed than usual—
It suits you.

column3:
このサングラス、可愛いでしょー？
キャメロンって子が水着と合わせて
コーディネートしてくれたんだ！
いい子だよね、あの子！
column4:
These sunglasses, aren't they cute?
That girl Cameron coordinated it with a swimsuit!
She's such a good girl, that one!

column3:
海、きれいだねぇ！
魚もいっぱい泳いでたよ
万が一の時には、あたしが捌いてあげるからね！
column4:
The sea is so beautiful!
There were lots of fish swimming around.
If by any chance something happens, 
I'll handle it for you!

column3:
ねぇねぇ、そこら辺に転がってるスイカって――
あっ、やっぱ食べちゃダメだよね！
飾りだよね、アレは
column4:
Hey, hey, those watermelons lying around--
Oh, you shouldn't eat them, right?
It's just for decoration.

column3: やぁ、素敵なビーチへご招待ありがとう
column4: Hey, thanks for inviting us to your lovely beach!

column3:
それが君の"夏の装い"か
なるほど、良いと思うよ
普段とは違った魅力がある
column4:
Is that your "summer attire"?
I see, I think it looks good.
It has a different charm than usual.

column3:
それにしても美しい海だ
透き通っていて、いくら見ていても飽きない
風も柔らかくて気持ちいいしね
column4:
That being said, it is a beautiful sea.
It is so clear, 
and no matter how much you look at it, 
you never get tired.
The breeze is also nice and soft.

column3:
私も、厳密にはもう"ハイセプター"ではないから――
そうだな――もう少し年を取ったら
異国を巡る旅に出るのもいいかもしれない
column4:
I, too, am no longer strictly a "High Scepter" now
--Well, when I get a little older,
It might be nice to embark on a journey 
to foreign lands.

column3:
さっき、君の訓練官に会ったよ
「夏は開放的な気分になるから」と大騒ぎしていたな
――君もそうかい？
column4:
I met your trainer earlier.
They were making a big fuss, 
saying, "Summer feels so liberating."
Are you feeling the same way?

column3:
ここには専属の警備の者たちがいるそうだ
精霊槍の持ち込みも遠慮してくれと
言われてしまった――
column4:
I heard there are exclusive security guards here. 
They even asked me to refrain from 
bringing my Spirit Lance...

column3:
この平穏なる光景、白竜の慈しみによって
維持されているということを忘れるな
column4:
Do not forget that this peaceful scene is 
maintained by the benevolence of the White Dragon.

column3:
――ただ波の音に耳を傾け
無心に己の精神と向き合ってみるのも良いな
どうだ、貴様もそこに座って
少し心を落ち着けていくか
column4:
—Just listen to the sound of the waves,
and try facing your own mind without distraction.
How about it? Sit there too,
and let your heart calm down for a bit.

column3:
わははは！
このビーチではわしのことを知る者なぞ
そう居るまい！
久しぶりに、全力で遊ぶとするかな
column4:
Wahaha! 
On this beach, 
there'll be no one who knows of my existence! 
It's been a while, so I'll play with all my might.

column3:
ここだけの話だがな
――ジリアンに悪い虫が近付かぬよう
こっそり見張っているのだ
column4:
Just between you and me
--I'm quietly keeping an eye out
so no pesky bugs come near Gillian.

column3:
翡翠湖の深い色合いも美しいが
空の色を映したようなここの海もまた美しい
心が洗われるようだ！
column4:
The deep hues of Emerald Lake are beautiful,
But this sea here, 
reflecting the colors of the sky, 
is also beautiful.
It feels as though my heart is being cleansed!

column3:
覚者よ、夏だな！
その恰好を見るに、泳ぐ準備は万端か
column4:
Arisen, it's summer!
And judging by your attire, you're ready for a swim.

column3:
去年のにぎわいを見て
俺も今年は水着を用意したんだ
――たまにはこういった
非日常を楽しむのいいものだな
column4:
Looking at the excitement of last year,
I also prepared a swimsuit for this year.
It's nice to occasionally enjoy
such extraordinary experiences.

column3:
レンテンはあのサングラスが気に入ったようだ
神殿でも、目を離すと付けたり外したりしていた
気分の切替えはしてほしいものだが――
まぁ、大目に見よう
column4:
Renton seems to have taken a liking 
to those sunglasses.
Even in the temple, he would put them on and 
take them off when no one was looking.
It would be nice if he could change his 
mood a bit, though...
Well, I'll let it slide.

column3:
せっかくのビーチだ！
最新の水着にサングラスで
ばっちりキメてきたぜ！
column4:
It's finally the beach! 
I've dressed up perfectly in the 
latest swimsuit and sunglasses!

column3:
さて、一泳ぎしてこようかな
あんたも一緒に行こうよ
これも訓練の一環だって！
column4:
Well, I think I'll go for a swim.
You can come with me too.
It's part of the training!

column3:
え？　仕事？
アーチボルトさんだって来てるんだから
ちょっとくらいいいだろ
まぁ、ちょこちょこ様子は見に戻るからさ
column4:
Huh? Work? 
Even Archibald is here, so it should be 
fine to take a little break, right?
Well, I'll go back and check on things from time to time.

column3:
さぁ、ハロウィン！
仮装とお菓子で盛り上がりましょ！
column4:
Come on, Halloween!
Let's have fun with costumes and sweets!

column3:
今年のお菓子はふんわりパクパク食べられる
プチマフィンと、濃厚な味を楽しめるヌガーよ
どう？　食べたくなってきた？
column4:
This year's snacks are soft and crunchy 
petite muffins and richly flavored nougat.
What do you think?　Are you getting a craving?

column3:
お祭りのために白竜神殿に来るのを
アンジェロも私もとっても楽しみにしてるの！
だから念入りに準備してるんだけど――
column4:
Angelo and I are very much looking forward to 
coming to the White Dragon Temple 
for the festivities!
So we've been preparing for it very carefully...

column3:
お祭りが終わった後でも
お菓子を食べると元気になるのは
きっと楽しい記憶を思い出すからよね
column4:
Even after the festival is over,
eating sweets and becoming energized
must be because it brings back joyful memories.

column3:
だからお祭りっていうのは
目いっぱい楽しくなきゃダメなのよ！
良い「楽しさ」っていうのは
その時だけのものじゃないの
column4:
That's why festivals have to be full of fun!
Good "fun" is not just for the moment!

column3: アノ　オカシ――

オナカ　ヘタ
ズト　ズト――
ミナイデ
ママ　ママ――

見つかっちまったか
この変装は失敗だな
column4:
Spotted.
This disguise is a disaster.

column3:
何じろじろ見てやがる
言っとくが、こりゃあ私服じゃねぇぞ
column4:
Why are you staring at me like that? 
Just so you know, this ain't civilian clothing.

column3:
あ？　何か文句でもあんのか？
商人の服っつったら
やっぱりこれだろうが
column4:
Huh? You got a problem or somethin'? 
When it comes to a merchant's attire, 
this is definitely it, right?

column3:
最初は神官の服を渡されたんだけどよ
あんなもんぜってぇ着るかって
辛気臭え気分になっちまう
column4:
At first they gave me a priest's uniform, 
but I'd never wear such a thing, 
it makes me feel like a psycho.

column3:
ここら辺はまだ神殿の近くだ
見つかるのも無理はねぇな
"祝いの品"も小出しでいいだろ
column4:
This area is still near the temple.
It's not impossible to find something.
"Celebration gifts" can be small.

column3:
ああ！？
お前こんなとこまで
追いかけてきやがったのか！？
column4:
Ah!?
Did you really chase after me
all the way here!?

column3:
気分転換にフンパツして
《豊穣の湯》まで来たってのに――
なんだってお前の顔見ながら
湯に浸からないといけねぇんだか
column4:
I came all the way to the "Abundance Springs" 
for a change of mood, and yet... 
why do I have to soak in the hot water while 
looking at your face?

column3:
リズやらエリオットを
引き連れて来てないだけまだマシか
あいつらがいると、一人頭で
10倍は騒がしくなるからな
column4:
It's still better that I didn't bring 
Lise and Elliot along. 
With them around, 
it would be ten times more chaotic.

column3:
はぁ――
ま、その行動力っつうか
突き進む信念みてぇなのがお前の持ち味だもんな
"祝いの品"受け取れよ、この湯に免じて多めに渡すぜ
column4:
Haah...
Well, I guess your strong sense of determination 
or, shall I say, forward-thinking, 
is your strong suit.
Accept this "congratulatory gift", and I'll give 
you a little extra in honor of this hot spring.

column3:
おいおいおい
こんな場所で、こんな変装までしてるのに
なんで追いかけて来られるんだ！？
column4:
Oi oi oi,
Even in a place like this, and even in disguise,
Why are they able to chase after me?!

column3:
なんだってこう見つかっちまうんだ？
背筋が薄ら寒くなってきやがった
column4:
How the hell did they find us?
I'm getting chills down my spine.

column3:
ま、これからもよろしく頼むわ
お前みたいなやつが味方で良かったぜ
――敵になったら最悪の気分だったろうな
column4:
Well, keep up the good work.
I'm glad to have a guy like you on my side.
--I would have felt terrible if you were my enemy.

column3:
ったく、何が「一番見つかりにくい場所と変装」だ
クラウスのやつ、適当なこと言いやがって
column4:
Jeez, what's with this 
"most inconspicuous hiding spot and disguise"?
That Klaus guy just says whatever he wants.

column3:
実は、ジョゼフともう一つ賭けてたんだよな
ここにいるのを見つけられなきゃ
"祝いの品"の大部分は
俺の物ってことになってたんだが――
column4:
Actually, I had made another bet with Joseph.
If they couldn't find you here,
the majority of the "celebratory gift"
would have become mine--

column3:
しかたねぇ、俺の負けだ！
ああ、負けだ！
ドカッと渡すからありがたく受け取れよ！
column4:
There's no helping it, I've lost!
Ah, it's a defeat!
Here you are, take it all!

column3:
よう、まぁちょっと
話でも聞いていけや
column4: Well, um, why don't you listen to the story for a bit?

column3:
よう、三周年だってな
おめでとうさん
column4:
Hey, it's our third anniversary.
Congratulations!

column3:
で、だ――
突然だけどよ、これから俺はレスタニアの
あちこちに隠れることになった
column4: So, listen up. I suddenly have to hide in various places in Lestania from now on.

column3:
俺を３か所で見つけることができたら
"祝いの品"ってやつをプレゼントっつうわけだ
まぁ気張って探し回ってくれや
column4:
If you can find me in three places,
I'll give you a "celebration gift."
Well, keep your eyes peeled.

column3:
――はぁ？　誰が好きでこんなことするか
ジョゼフのジジイとの
ちょっとした賭けに負けちまって
この役割を押しつけられたのよ
column4:
Huh? Who would willingly do something like this?
I lost a small bet with Joseph's old man 
and got stuck with this role.

column3:
クソッ、勝てたらだいぶと
ウマい内容だったんだがな――
あのジジイ、ほとんど魔物みてぇなもんだ
賭けの誘いになんて乗るんじゃなかったぜ
column4:
Damn, it would have been a lot better if I won.
It was a good one--
The old man was almost like a demon,
I should never have taken that betting offer.

column3:
よしッ！
気合を入れていこう！

どんな衣装を着ても
新たな魅力を振りまいてくれるのが
そう、シェリーちゃんだ！
小悪魔系から清楚ガールまでただ一人で完全網羅！
column4:
No matter what outfit she wears,
Shelly always radiates a new charm.
Yes, it's Ms. Shelly!
She's the one who can perfectly cover everything, 
from devilish to innocent girl!

column3:
その微笑みで何度でも新鮮な感動をくれる！
むしろ、隣に立っている姿が視界に入るだけで
驚くほど感動してしまう――わかるだろう？
column4:
That smile gives me a fresh sense of wonder 
again and again! 
In fact, 
just the sight of her standing next to you is
amazingly inspiring - you know what I mean?

column3:
シェリーちゃんの今回の衣装、どうかね？
カワイイだろう？　最高だろう？
うむうむ、わかるとも
column4:
What do you think of Ms. Shellys outfit this time? 
Isn't it cute? Isn't it the best? 
Mmm, mmm, I understand.

column3:
実は水色の衣装も用意していたのだが
今回は白でいきたくてね――個人的に
column4:
Actually, 
I had prepared a light blue outfit as well,
but 
this time I wanted to go with white personally.

column3:
今度のプレゼントはすごいぞ
ココだけの話、喜ばれる自信が――ある！
なんといっても"女心"について
これでもかと本を読んで勉強してきたからねッ！
column4:
The present this time is amazing, you know.
Just between us, 
I have confidence that it will be well-received!
After all, I've studied and read books about 
"a woman's heart", extensively!

column3:
ハァイ、バレンタインぶりね
とってもワクワクしてるわ！
column4:
Hi, it's been a while since Valentine's Day.
I'm feeling really excited!

column3:
このスカートのボリューム！
すっきりした上半身とのコンビネーションが
今の気分にジャストなの
コンパクトさがキュートな靴も見てほしいポイントよ
column4:
The volume of this skirt!
The combination with the clean upper body
is just what I'm in the mood for right now.
Also, pay attention to the cute 
compactness of the shoes.

column3:
あのね、アンジェロと一緒にいると
楽しいと感じることや次にやりたいことが
お互いにどんどん湧いてくるの
column4:
You know, when I'm with Angelo, 
I feel so happy and we both constantly come up 
with things we want to do next.

column3:
毎日新鮮で、なのに全然疲れないっていうか
――何ていうか――ううん――ー
アンジェロってとびきり不思議な人なのよ
column4:
Every day, it's fresh, 
and yet I don't get tired at all, or rather, 
how should I put it... 
hmm... 
Angelo is a truly mysterious person.

column3:
ねぇ、今回のアンジェロったら
とってもかっこいいと思わない！？
ロングジャケットの紳士なシルエット――
最高にエスコートされたくなっちゃう
column4:
Hey, don't you think Angelo looks 
really cool this time?
With his gentlemanly silhouette in a long jacket..
I can't help but want to be escorted by him, 
it's the best.

column3: なんだ、やけに楽しそうな顔してるな
column4: You look like you're having a great time.

column3:
ったく、あいつらが神殿に来ると毎回大騒ぎだな
浮かれることしか頭に無いペアってやつか
ま、お似合いなんじゃねぇの
column4:
Geez, every time those guys come to the temple, 
it's always a big fuss. 
They're a pair who only care to have fun, huh? 
Well, I guess they suit each other.

column3:
「誰か一人に一つだけ」ってのも
悪くはねぇんだけどよ
俺はやっぱ数で勝負っつぅのが
わかりやすくて好きだわ
column4:
Having 'one for each person' isn't necessarily a 
bad idea. 
But personally, I prefer competing with numbers. 
It's just more straightforward.

column3:
こりゃまた、騎士団の奴らが
悔しがりそうなメンツだな
column4:
Well, well, this looks like a lineup that would 
make the knights really envious.

column3:
今回は食い物じゃなさそうだな
柔らかい何か――開けてみるとするか
column4:
Doesn't look like food this time.
Something soft-- let's open it up.

column3:
――ソファカバーか！
さてはこの間、俺が
家具職人を呼んだのを見てただろ
column4:
Oh, a sofa cover, huh? 
You must have seen when I called the furniture 
craftsman the other day.

column3:
ったく、粋なことしてくれるじゃねぇか
大きさもちょうど良さそうだ
一瞬、何を持ってきたのかと思ったが
こういうのなら悪かねぇ
column4:
Jeez, you're doing something pretty cool.
The size seems just right too.
For a moment, 
I thought what you brought was something else,
but this is pretty good.

column3:
やたらブワブワした感触なのは――
まぁ、冬だからありっちゃありだな
column4:
The sensation of bubbling is quite strong—
well, I guess it's to be expected in winter.

column3:
今晩家に帰る楽しみができたわ
ありがたくいただいとくぜ！
column4:
Now I have something to look forward to when 
I get home tonight.
I'll take it!

column3:
あっ！　隊長じゃないか
キミもそこに座りなよ
column4:
Ah! It's the captain. 
Why don't you sit there too?

column3:
ちょっとちょっと
メイロワ将軍もいるなんて聞いてないぞ
いや、別にいたからどうってワケでもないけど
column4:
Wait a minute, wait a minute!
I didn't hear that General Meirova would be here too.
Well, I don't mind him being here, but...

column3:
バレたらマズいことが
いくつかあるってだけさ！
column4:
It's just that there are a few things
that would be bad if they were found out!

column3:
いや～、異国にお呼ばれするなんて
軍師やっててよかったよ、ホント！
観光ついでに色々勉強させてもらおうかな
column4:
Being invited to a foreign country like this...
I'm glad I became a strategist, really!
Maybe I should... 
I'm sure I'll learn a lot while I'm sightseeing.

column3:
さっき聞いたんだけど、なんでも
力が湧いてくる温泉があるんだって？
気になるなぁ、ぜひとも行ってみたいなぁ
案内してくれる人がいればなぁ～
column4:
I just heard that there's a hot spring where 
everything comes to life with power?
I'm curious... I'd love to go there.
If only I had someone to show me around!

column3:
ここの酒場ってツマミ以外もあるのかな？
できればシチュー的な物で温まりたいよ
column4:
Does this tavern have anything other than snacks? 
If possible, 
I'd like something like stew to warm up.

column3:
待ちくたびれたよ――
でも、キミが何かくれるはずだと思って
ずっと待ってたんだ
column4:
I've been waiting for ages――
But I've been waiting all this time, 
thinking you'd give me something.

column3:
さぁ、早速だけど見せておくれよ！
その"特別"ってやつを！
column4:
Let's see what you've got!
Let's see what's so "special" about it!

column3: ああ、コレはアレだね！

アレ――テーブルに飾る布！
テーブルセンターっていうんだっけな
ずいぶんオシャレな物をくれるじゃないか！
隊長、ありがとう！
column4:
That thing - a cloth to decorate the table!
I think it's called a table centerpiece!
You've given me something very stylish!
Thank you, Captain!

column3:
知ってるかもしれないけど
ほら、僕の持ち物ときたら
大体どこかへ逃げだすのが得意だからさ
column4:
You might know this already, but my belongings, 
you know, have a knack for running off somewhere.

column3:
これはなくならないように
家にある一番大きなテーブルの
一番広くて良い場所に敷いておかないとだ！
column4:
To ensure that this doesn't disappear,
it must be put on the largest table in the house,
in the widest and best spot!

column3:
ああ、そうそう
これが無くなってしまっていないか
隊長が様子を見にきてくれてもいいんだよ
――ほんとにいつでも、見にきてくれていいから！
column4:
Ah, yes, that's right.
I wonder if it's still here.
It would be nice if the captain could come and 
check on it.
-Really, anytime is fine, so please come and look!

column3: 今年もこの季節が来ましたね！
column4: It's that time of year again!

column3:
こうして、隊長と楽しめる催しに
また呼んでもらえて――光栄です！
column4:
I am honored to be invited back for another event 
that I can enjoy with my captain!

column3:
気になっていることがあるんです
あの二人が、一体どこでアッカーシェランの
人たちを知ったのかって――
column4:
There is something I'm curious about. 
Where exactly did those two learn about the 
people of Acre Selund?

column3:
ジョゼフ様に相談したのか、それとも
実は偵察能力がすごかったりするんでしょうか
――前者は考えにくいですよね
column4:
Did you consult with Mr. Joseph, or
actually have great detective skills?
--The former is unlikely, isn't it?

column3:
酒場の雰囲気、結構好きなんですよ
次の休み、みんなで何か食べに来ませんか
もちろんリズも誘って
column4:
I really like the atmosphere of the tavern. 
How about coming to eat something together on our 
next day off? Of course, let's invite Lise too.

column3:
神殿でゆっくりすることって
最近あんまり無い気がして
column4:
I feel like there hasn't been much time to 
relax at the temple recently.

column3:
あっ、ありがとうございます！！
やったッ！
隊長からのプレゼント、嬉しいです！
column4:
Oh, thank you!
Yay!
I'm so happy to receive this gift from you!

column3:
この色、隊長が選んでくださったんですよね？
すごく素敵です
いえ、もともと好きな色なんですけど！
大好きな色になりました
column4:
Did the captain choose this color for me?
It's really wonderful.
No, it's actually a color I've always liked!
It has become my favorite color.

column3:
あの――これ、俺が隊長の右腕として
直々に認められた証だって
思っていてもいいですか？
column4:
Can I think of this as proof that I have been 
personally recognized as the right hand of the 
captain?

column3:
そうだと思うと、神殿から
どんな勲章をもらうよりも
ずっと誇らしい気持ちに――
何よりも、明日への励みになりますから
column4:
When I think of that, I feel much more proud
than when I receive any medal from the Temple--
because, more than anything else, 
it encourages me for tomorrow!

column3:
――ということで
しばらくは額に入れて飾っておきます！
敷物として使うなんて勿体ないですしね
覚悟ができたらちゃんと使いますよ！
column4:
-- so
I'm going to frame it and display it for a while!
It would be a shame to use it as a rug.
I'll use it properly when I'm ready!

column3:
ああ、覚者
レスタニアの"祭り"だそうだな
にぎわってるじゃないか
column4:
Oh, Arisen,
I hear it's a "festival" in Lestania.
It's a lively place.

column3:
席についていると話しかけられるだろう
俺はここにいるくらいでちょうどいい
column4:
I will probably be approached while seated.
It's just right for me to be here.

column3:
ああ、コレは――レスタニアでなら
顔を隠す必要も無いかと思ったが
何となく落ち着かなくてな
column4:
Ah, in Lestania, I thought there would be no need 
to hide my face, but for some reason, 
I can't seem to calm down.

column3:
相棒、後で一杯飲みに行かないか？
レスタニアの酒の味をみてみたいんだ
静かな店を知ってたら、連れていってくれ
column4:
Hey partner, maybe we can grab a drink later?
I'd like to see what the drinks taste like 
in Lestania.
If you know a quiet place, take me there.

column3:
クク――いや、よく考えたら
お前が俺のところに持ってきたって
驚くようなことじゃなかったな
付き合いの深さは、時間の長さじゃ計れない
column4:
Kukuh... Well, now that I think about it,
it wasn't really surprising that you 
brought me here.
The depth of our connection cannot be 
measured by the length of time.

column3:
この布は――ストールか
ちょうどいい
これからの季節、アッカーシェランでも
夜は冷え込むんだ
column4:
Is this cloth... a stole?
It's just right.
In this season, even in Acre Selund,
the nights get cold.

column3:
家に帰ったら羽織ってみることにしよう
セムやジャンにも見せてやりたい
きっとお前に会いたがるだろうよ
column4:
When I get home, I'll try putting it on and show it to Shem and Jan. 
They would definitely want to see you.

column3:
さて――帰る前に、相棒
一杯飲みに行かないか？
レスタニアの酒の味をみてみたいんだ
静かな店を知ってたら、連れていってくれ
column4:
Now then, before we go back, partner,
how about going for a drink?
I'd like to taste the alcohol in Lestania.
If you know a quiet tavern, please take me there.

column3:
今度メガドに来るときに
隠れた名店を教えてやるから
交換条件といこう
column4:
Next time you come to Megado,
I'll show you some hidden gems.
Let's call it an exchange.

column3: お招きいただき感謝する！

酒場が明るく賑わうのは
良い町の証拠だ！
さすがは白竜様のお膝元といったところだな
column4:
The fact that the bars are bright and bustling is
evidence of a good town!
That's what you'd expect from 
the White Dragon's hometown.

column3:
気分転換になにかしたいと思っていたところだ
そこへ異国の祭りとはうってつけだ！
column4:
I've been looking for something to do for a change
and an exotic festival is just the thing!

column3:
もう少し落ち着いたらば
アッカーシェランでも、何か
みなで楽しめる催しを考えてみるか
column4:
Once things have calmed down a bit,
How about we think of some event
that everyone can enjoy,
even in Acre Selund?

column3:
おおっ！？
本当にわしがもらってもよいものなのか？
――では、ありがたくちょうだいしよう
column4:
Oh?!
Is this really something I can have?
--Well, I'll take it gratefully.

column3:
膝掛けか！
使いやすそうな大きさではないか
それに、触っているとなんとも楽しくなる手触りだ
column4:
A lap blanket!
It's an easy size to use,
and what a fun texture to touch!

column3:
アッカーシェランに帰っても
これに触れれば今日のことを思いだすだろう
column4:
Even when I return to Acre Selund, if I touch 
this, it will surely remind me of today.

column3:
異国の祭りに呼んでいただいただけでなく
おぬしから贈り物までもらえるとは
いや、長生きもしてみるものだな！
column4:
To be invited to a festival in a foreign land
and even receive gifts from you—
Well, long living has its perks!

column3:
ワハハ、いやー楽しい日だ
よし！　せっかく酒場にいるのだ
今日はおぬしも共に飲もうではないか！
朝まで飲み明かすという手もあるぞ！
column4:
Wahaha, what a fun day! Alright then! 
Since we're already in the tavern, 
let's drink together, shall we? 
We could even drink until morning!

column3:
隊長！　こんにちは
ふふ、どうかしましたか？
column4:
Captain! Hello.
Hehe, what's the matter?

column3:
お招きいただき、ありがとうございます
とても嬉しいです
みなさんとの時間を持つことができて――
column4:
Thank you for inviting me.
I'm so glad to have time with you all--

column3:
わたしがここに来られるなんて
白竜さまの導きによるものでしょうか
column4:
I can't believe I'm here.
I wonder if it's because of the 
White Dragon's guidance?

column3:
こうしたお祭りはないけれど
フィンダムの若者も、想いを伝えるために
贈り物をするんですよ
column4:
While we don't have such festivals,
even the Phindym youth give gifts to 
convey their feelings.

column3:
部族によっても違いがありますが
花やアクセサリーを贈る人が多いみたいです
モルフォールでは本も人気だと聞きますね
column4:
It varies from tribe to tribe.
Many people give flowers and accessories.
I hear that books are also popular in Morfaul.

column3:
レスタニアにはまた来てみたいと思ってたんです
それが叶うなんて！
今目の前に広がっている光景――夢のようです
column4:
I had been thinking that I wanted to come 
back to Lestania.
To think that it would actually come true!
The scenery unfolding before my eyes right now... 
it feels like a dream.

column3:
これを、わたしに？
ありがとうございます！
column4:
Is this for me?
Thank you very much!

column3:
きれいな手紙ですね
紙も、文字も凝っていて
特別なものなんだって一目でわかります
column4:
It's a beautiful letter.
Both the paper and the writing are elaborate,
and I can tell at first glance 
that it's something special.

column3:
隊長、わたし――
みなさんと出会って
たくさんのことを知りました
column4:
Captain, with you--
I have learned many things
since meeting everyone.

column3:
今、また新しく知ることができて
本当に幸せなんです
こんなにあたたかな気持ち、いつぶりでしょう
column4:
Now, I am able to learn something new again.
I am truly happy.
How long has it been since I felt such warmth?

column3:
あと少しだけ、ここにいてもいいですか？
隊長と過ごせる時間が楽しくて、夢みたいで――
こんな夢なら、もう少し
見ていたいと思ってしまうんです
column4:
Can I stay here for a little while longer?
I'm enjoying the time I get to spend with the captain, it's like a dream--
If it's a dream like this, 
I'd like to watch it a little longer!

column3:
わたしなら楽しんでるよ
心配しないで
column4:
If it were me, I would be enjoying myself.
Don't worry.

column3:
この酒場はいいね
海と空、両方を眺められる
それに楽しげな人がたくさんいるし
column4:
This tavern is nice.
You can enjoy the view of the sea and the sky.
And there are many cheerful people here.

column3:
この夏、レスタニアの海に招待してもらったけど
神殿に来るのは初めて
column4:
I was invited to the beach in Lestania this summer, 
but this is the first time I've been to the
temple.

column3:
アッカーシェランとは
似ているところも多いけど、やっぱり
違うところもたくさんあるみたいだ
column4:
There are a lot of similarities with Acre Selund, 
but it seems there are still a lot of differences.

column3:
この前、メイロワ将軍が招待されたらしいけど
どんな様子だった？
ううん、ちょっと気になるだけ
column4:
I heard General Meirova was invited the other day.
How did he look?
No, just wondering.

column3:
待って
それ、わたしが受け取ってもいいもの？
"特別な贈り物"だって聞いてたけど
column4:
Wait.
Can I take that?
I heard it's a "special gift," but...

column3:
違う？　わたしのために用意してくれたの？
――それじゃあ、もらっておくよ
ありがとう
column4:
Is that not so?　Did you get it for me?
--I'll take it then.
Thank you.

column3:
変わった紙に、絵みたいな文字
見慣れない様式だけど――きれいな手紙だ
これ、アッカーシェランまで大事に
持って帰りたいな
column4:
On this peculiar paper, 
there are characters that look like drawings.
It's an unfamiliar style, 
but it's a beautiful letter.
I want to take good care of it 
and bring it back to Acre Selund.

column3:
ここのところ、伝令の持ってくる
書類ばっかり見てたから
何だか緊張するよ
column4:
Lately, I've been feeling nervous because I've 
been constantly looking at the documents brought 
by the messengers.

column3:
――あのさ、変なこと聞くけど
こういう贈り物ってどう返事したらいい？
突然慣れないことばっかりで――
column4:
- Um, hey, I know this is a strange question, but
how should I respond to this kind of gift?
Everything is so unfamiliar and sudden...

column3:
えっと――そうだ
今度こっちに来るときにでも
神殿を案内してほしいんだけど
あなたに
column4:
Let's see-- yes,
next time you're here,
I'd like you to show me around the temple.

column3: 隊長！　今回も楽しもうね！
column4: Captain!　Let's have fun again this time!

column3:
戦ってばかりは疲れちゃうから
こういうお祭りがもっとあるといいな
column4:
I'm tired of fighting all the time.
I wish there were more festivals like this.

column3:
ねぇねぇ、シェリーの着てる服
とっても可愛いよね！
今回の服もアンジェロが選んだんだって！
column4:
Hey, hey, what Shelley is wearing
is very cute!
Angelo picked out her outfit this time too!

column3:
それにしても、二人とも白くて豪華な服だし――
何かを連想しちゃわない？
そういうつもりじゃないのかなぁ
column4:
That being said, 
both of them are wearing elegant white clothes...
Doesn't it make you think of something?
I wonder if they didn't intend it that way...

column3:
先月はガルドリンとエリオットが
ここに呼ばれてたでしょ？
羨ましかったんだ～
column4:
Last month, 
Gurdolin and Elliot were called here, right? 
I was so jealous~

column3:
やったぁ！　そうこなくっちゃ！
なになに――？
わぁ、手紙――？
column4:
Yay! I did it! That's how it should be done!
What's this...?
Oh, a letter...?

column3:
うーん
何か良い感じのことが書いてあるのは
わかるんだけど――
言い回しが難しいっていうか――
column4:
Hmm, I can understand that there's something 
written here that has a good feeling to it, but... 
it's hard to put it in the right way...

column3:
あ、でも字が凝ってて素敵だね！
紙も綺麗な色だし、このまま飾っても
良さそうなくらいお洒落だよ
この感じ、わたし好きだな～
column4:
Ah, but the lettering is so intricate and lovely!
The paper has such beautiful colors, 
it's stylish enough to be displayed just as it is.
I really like this feeling~

column3:
なんでだろう
最初はよくわからないと思ったのに
見てるとどんどん嬉しくなっちゃう
column4:
I wonder why...
At first, I didn't really understand,
but the more I look, the happier I become.

column3:
――あ、そっか、隊長からもらったから嬉しいんだ！
この手紙、大切にするね
隊長、ありがと！
column4:
- Ah, I see. 
I'm happy because I received it from the Captain! 
I'll treasure this letter.
Captain, thank you!

column3: うん、何かな？

レスタニア、君が護るべき国だね
一度この目で見てみたかった
招待、感謝するよ
column4:
Lestania, the country you're supposed to protect.
I've always wanted to see it with my own eyes.
Thank you for the invitation.

column3:
こうしてたくさんの人と話したり
誰かと共にテーブルにつくのは久しぶりじゃないかな
ここが異国だからか、気分転換にもなるよ
column4:
It's been a while since I've talked to 
so many people, or sat at a table with someone.
Maybe it's because this is a foreign land, 
but it's refreshing.

column3:
火山が無いと、空はここまで透き通って見えるのか
どちらの空が良いというわけではないけど
私はやっぱり、アッカーシェランの
人間なんだなと思って――
column4:
Is it because there are no volcanoes that the sky 
looks so clear here?
I'm not saying that one sky is better 
than the other, but I guess I'm still an 
Acre Selund woman, after all.

column3:
一度受け取ったら
もう返せないけど――
ありがたくいただいてしまおうか
column4:
Once I take it,
I can never return it――
then I'll take it gratefully.

column3:
手紙――
ああ、この紙も普通の物じゃないね
手触りが独特だし、少し変わった香りもする
column4:
Letter--
Yeah, this paper is no ordinary one either.
It has a unique texture and an unusual scent.

column3:
――紙も、言葉も、文字のデザインも
これだけ揃えるのは大変だったろう
column4:
-- the paper, the words, the lettering design...
It must have been hard to get all this together!

column3:
このひとひらの中に
君が私のためにと考えてくれたものが
詰まっているんだね
column4:
Within this petal,
you've packed something
that you've thought of for me, haven't you?

column3:
まいったな
この素晴らしい贈り物への返礼として
渡せるものが、今の私には何もない――
column4:
I'm in trouble.
I have nothing to offer as a return 
for this wonderful gift...

column3:
そうだ――今度、お茶しに来ないかい
最近ようやく、とある焼き菓子を
それらしく作れるようになったんだ
ぜひ君に感想を聞かせてほしい
column4:
That's right―― 
How about coming over for tea next time? 
I've finally managed to make a certain type of 
baked confectionery that looks the part. 
I really want to hear your thoughts on it, 
so please come and try it.

column3: ふふふ、何かしら

舞台にいる彼――
あたくしの住まいに来た瞬間に
ひれ伏さんばかりだったの
よっぽど怖かったのかしら
column4:
He, on stage――
The moment he entered my abode,
He was about to prostrate himself.
I wonder if he was that scared.

column3:
《パッションパピルス》で作った紙のこと？
もちろん知っているわぁ
かなり前に流行した品ね
column4:
You mean the paper made from Passion Papyrus?
Of course I know what it is.
It was all the rage a long time ago.

column3:
したためられた想いを
より強く相手の心に届けると言われているわ
column4:
It is said to make your thoughts and feelings
reach the other person's heart more strongly.

column3:
もっとも、それは魔術を扱える者が作ったもののみ
町の人が興味本位で作った紙に
そんな力は無いから、すぐに廃れてしまったの
column4:
However, only those who can wield magic 
can create such things. 
The paper made by the townspeople out of 
curiosity had no such power, 
so it quickly fell into obscurity.

column3:
まだ少し風が冷たいでしょう
薄着の子たちには、ほんの短い間だけ
暖かい空気をまとえるようにしてあげる
column4:
The wind is still a little chilly, isn't it?
For the lightly dressed children,
let's give them a brief moment
to be wrapped in warm air.

column3:
《パッションパピルス》の手紙――
あたくしにこの手紙を渡すなんて
勇気があるのね？
column4:
Letter from 《Passion Papyrus》 --
You have a lot of courage to give me this letter,
don't you?

column3:
紙や文字はさておいて
――なんてかわいらしい詩なの
嬉しいわ、この詩は
あたくしのためだけに編まれてここにあるのね
column4:
Setting aside paper and words—
what a lovely poem.
I'm delighted; this poem
was crafted solely for me, here.

column3:
まだまだつたないところもあるけれど
手に余る技術を駆使するよりも
素直な感性こそが響くというもの――
ふふ、よくわかっているじゃない
column4:
There may still be some imperfections, 
but it's the genuine emotion that resonates,
more than any overwhelming technique――
Oh, you understand very well.

column3:
でも、もっと上手に歌いたいのなら
あたくしが手ほどきをしてあげてもよくってよ
column4:
But if you want to sing better,
I can teach you.

column3:
美しいさえずりは
その翼をもより良く見せるのですもの
羽ばたきの日まで、楽しませてちょうだい
column4:
A beautiful chirp makes even its wings look better.
Let me enjoy it until the day it takes flight!

column3: こんにちは、ご機嫌いかが？

こういう日の、特別な空気もだいすき
後で思い出しても楽しい気持ちになるから
column4:
I really love the special atmosphere of days like 
this, because even when I remember it later, 
it brings back delightful feelings.

column3:
今回も、レスタニアとは違う大陸からの
お客さんが来てるんだね！
仲良くなれたらいいなぁ
column4:
Again, I see you have guests from a different 
continent than Lestania!
I hope we can get to know each other.

column3:
お祭りの時だけここに来るあの二人――
旅をしているって言ってたけど
どのくらい遠くまで行ったことがあるのかしら
column4:
Those two who only come here during the festival..
They said they were traveling, 
but I wonder how far they have actually been.

column3:
わぁ、ありがとう！
すてきなお手紙――
column4:
Wow, thank you!
What a wonderful letter--

column3:
このお手紙、いい香りがするね
なんだか懐かしいような、ずっと前から
知ってるような香り
column4:
This letter has a nice scent, doesn't it?
It somehow feels nostalgic, 
as if from a long time ago.
A familiar scent that I seem to know.

column3:
今晩から枕の下にこのお手紙を入れてみようかな
香りで今日のことを思い返して
ワクワクした気持ちで眠れそう
column4:
Shall I put this letter 
under my pillow from tonight?
With its scent, I can reminisce about today
and sleep with an excited feeling.

column3:
あのね、生きていくなかで
わたしが大切にできる物は
きっと限られているのだと思うけど――
column4:
You know, in the midst of living,
I think there are only a few things
that I can truly cherish.

column3:
このお手紙は、ずっと大切にする！
約束するね！
わたしと覚者様が仲良しだっていう証だもの
column4:
I will treasure this letter forever!
I promise!
It's proof that you and I, Ser Arisen, 
are good friends.

column3: 何か言いたいことでもあるのか？
column4: Is there something you want to say?

column3:
さっきマンドラゴラの姿を見た
あれはここで飼われているものか？
フィンダムで見るものとは違う姿をしていたようだが
column4:
I saw the appearance of a Mandragora earlier. 
Is that one of the creatures kept here? 
It seemed to have a different appearance from 
what I usually see in Phindym.

column3:
どうも"シェリーちゃん"なる魔物が
気にかかる
column4: I can't help but be concerned about this "Shelly-chan" monster.

column3:
貴様ほどの者が護る神殿に
そう何度も侵入を試みるとは
俺の想像を超える強力な魔物なのだろう
column4:
For someone like you to repeatedly attempt
to infiltrate the temple I protect,
the creature "Shelly-chan" must be a powerful foe
beyond my imagination.

column3:
白竜とも、精霊竜とも違う竜力を感じる
アッカーシェランの竜か？
それにしては――
column4:
I can feel a dragon power different from both 
the White Dragon and the Spirit Dragon. 
Is this the Dragon Force of Acre Selund? 
But even so...

column3:
毛玉――？
いや、布か
こういった感触の布は珍しい
ほう――こうして首に巻くのか――
column4:
A furball?
No, it's a cloth.
It's rare to find a cloth with this kind of feel.
Oh, so this is how you wrap it around your neck...

column3:
なるほど、これは暖かいな
この寒さになるレスタニアならではの物だろう
column4:
I see, this is warm.
It must be something unique to Lestania, 
where it gets this cold.

column3:
フィンダムに戻れば首を温める必要はない
庵を彩る飾りにはなりそうだが
column4:
There is no need to warm your neck if back in 
Phindym.
It might become a decoration that adorns the 
hermitage.

column3:
ふむ――
レスタニアに来るのはこれで何度目かになる
だが、貴様とこの地を歩いたことは無かったな
column4:
Hmm...
This must be my umpteenth time coming to Lestania.
But I have never walked this land with you.

column3:
この祭りが終わったら
神殿の外を少し見て回ろうと思っている
時間があれば、共に来るがいい
column4:
After this festival,
I'm going to take a little look around 
outside the temple.
If you have time, come along.

column3:
――レスタニアの魔物との戦いに
興味が湧いただけだ
ついでに、長稽古を付けてやる
腕がなまっていないかの確認としてな
column4:
I was just interested in fighting the monsters 
of Lestania. 
As a bonus, I'll give you some intense training 
to make sure your skills haven't gotten rusty.

column3:
ま、貰いっぱなしってのも
なんだからな
column4:
Bem, não posso simplesmente continuar recebendo
sem dar nada em troca.

column3:
エリオットのやつが妙に
はりきっちまってよ
あいつ、意外と行動力あるみたいだぜ
column4:
Elliot parece estranhamente enérgico ultimamente.
Surpreendentemente, ele é bastante proativo.

column3:
ここに立つのも慣れたってわけじゃねぇが――
いや、慣れたのか、これは
column4:
Ficar aqui não significa que eu me acostumei—
Não, talvez eu tenha me acostumado.

column3:
こういうイベントごとってのも
刺激ではあるな
そう考えると、悪くはねぇ
column4:
Eventos como este podem ser bastante estimulantes.
Quando penso sobre isso, não é uma coisa ruim.

column3:
やたらとお前から欲しがってるやつらが
並んでるってのに、俺に渡していいのか？
――ま、ありがたく受け取っとくぜ
column4:
Há tantas pessoas na fila para pedir isso
de você, você tem certeza de que quer me dar?
――Bem, eu vou aceitar de bom grado, então.

column3:
もし、誰がお前から貰えるかって
賭けがあったら、俺は大穴だったろうな
column4:
Se houvesse uma aposta sobre quem poderia receber algo
de você, eu seria uma aposta muito arriscada.

column3:
なんだ、思わせぶりだな
――別に欲しいわけじゃねえけどよ
column4:
O quê, me provocando, hein?
—Não é como se eu quisesse ou algo assim.

column3:
あ？　お前、さっき別のやつに
渡してなかったか？
よくわからんが、一人にしか
渡せないルールなんだってよ
column4:
Huh? Você não deu isso para outra pessoa antes?
Eu realmente não entendo, mas aparentemente há
uma regra de que só pode ser dado a uma pessoa.

column3:
ありがたく受け取っとくぜ
また作った時は俺んとこに持って来いよ
旅の最中に軽くつまむのに良さそうだからな
column4:
Eu vou aceitar isso como um agradecimento.
Se você fizer de novo, traga para mim.
Parece uma boa maneira de pegar
uma refeição rápida durante a viagem.

column3:
せっかくのお祭りです
楽しみましょう、隊長！
column4:
É um festival.
Vamos nos divertir, Capitão!

column3:
俺たちからのお返し――
かなり悩んだんですけど、きっと隊長に
喜んでもらえるものになったはずです
column4:
Nosso presente de volta para você, Capitão...
Eu realmente lutei com isso, mas tenho certeza de que se tornou
algo que vai te fazer feliz.

column3:
リズとメイリーフからのお返しは
何でしたか？
聞いてみたけど、教えてくれなかったんです
column4:
What was the return gift from Lise and Mayleaf?
I asked, but they didn't tell me.

column3:
チョコレートをたくさんの人から貰うと
お返しも大変になりますね
あ、でも、隊長へのお返しは特別ですよ！
column4:
When you get chocolates from so many people,
it can be hard to give back.
Oh, but giving back to the captain is special!

column3:
俺にくれるんですか？
ですよね！　嬉しいです！
column4:
You're giving it to me?
Yes, right?　I'm so glad!

column3:
これは隊長からの信頼が形になったものだと思うと
すぐに食べるのは勿体ないような――
少し飾ってから食べちゃダメですか？
column4:
Thinking that this is something that represents 
the trust from the Captain,
it feels like a waste to eat it right away--
Is it not allowed to decorate it a little first?

column3: 待ってる間、変に緊張してしまいました――
column4: I got strangely nervous while waiting--

column3:
次は俺にくれるって信じて待ってました！
――え、最初に渡した人にしか渡せないルールが！？
そ、そんな――
column4:
I've been waiting, 
believing that you would give it to me next!
- Eh, there's a rule that it can only be given to 
the person it was originally handed to!?
Th-That's...

column3:
隊長、ありがとうございます！
信頼の証をこんなに――
じわじわと嬉しさが増していくようで
もう、何個でも欲しくなります
column4:
Thank you so much, Captain!
So much proof of trust--
I'm slowly getting happier and happier,
I want more and more of them already!

column3: やぁ、今日もにぎわってるね

まさか、またこのステージに
立つなんて――
まぁ、慣れたもんだよ
column4:
I never thought I would stand on 
this stage again...
Well, I guess I've gotten used to it.

column3:
決まった日に贈り物をもらって、それにお返しを
するっていうのも不思議なお祭りだよね
要するに、親密さを確かめ合ってるのかな
column4:
Receiving gifts on a designated day and then 
returning them, it's such a strange festival, 
isn't it? 
In other words, 
it's like confirming our intimacy with each other.

column3:
そういえば、前回のお祭りの時に
ジョゼフ様にチョコレートをあげてみたんだ
喜んでもらえたのは確かだと思うんだけど
なぜか未だに食べずに置いてあるんだよね
column4:
By the way, 
I remember that during the last festival, 
I tried giving Master Joseph some chocolate. 
I'm pretty sure he was happy about it, 
but for some reason, 
he still hasn't eaten it, it's just sitting there.

column3:
へぇ、いい香りだ――
それにすごく甘くておいしい！
確かに、これは珍しくて良いモノだね
ありがとう！
column4:
Wow, it smells so good...
And it's incredibly sweet and delicious!
Indeed, this is something rare and wonderful.
Thank you!

column3: どうしたんだい、ゴソゴソして
column4: What's wrong? Why are you fidgeting?

column3:
一度誰かにあげたら、他の人には
あげられないっていうルールらしいよ
――何か理由があるのかな
column4:
I heard the rule is that once you give it to 
someone, you can't give it to anyone else.
--I wonder if there's a reason for that.

column3:
またくれるのかい、ありがとう！
甘いものは結構好きなんだ
考え事をしている時や本を読む合間に食べると
いい気分転換になるからね
column4:
Are you giving it to me again? Thank you! 
I actually quite like sweet things. 
When I'm thinking or in between reading books, 
eating them helps me feel refreshed.

column3:
ふふ、またみんなで集まれて
嬉しいな
column4:
Hehe, 
it's nice to be able to gather together 
with everyone again. I'm glad.

column3:
お返し、リズと一緒に準備したの
何がいいかなって考えるの、とっても
楽しかったよ
column4:
The return gift, I prepared it together with Lise.
I had a lot of fun thinking up what would be good.

column3:
やっぱり、みんながニコニコしてると
幸せな気持ちになって
わたしもニコニコしちゃう
column4:
After all, when everyone is smiling,
I can't help but feel happy too,
and I start smiling as well.

column3:
この前のお祭りの時、わたしも
パメラと一緒にチョコを作ったの
ちゃんと上手にできたんだよ
column4:
At the last festival, I also made chocolates with 
Pamela and we were really good at it!

column3:
わたしがもらっていいの？
――ん、滑らかで濃厚！
すごい、こんなお菓子は初めて！
ありがとう、とっても美味しいよ
column4:
Can I have some? 
Hmm, it's smooth and rich! 
Wow, I've never had a snack like this before! 
Thank you, it's really delicious!

column3: どうしたの？　何か探し物？
column4: What's wrong? Are you looking for something?

column3:
《特製チョコレート》は誰か一人にしか
あげられないんだって
――八方美人はよくないからって
シェリーが言ってたよ
column4:
I heard that the "Special Chocolate" can only 
be given to one person.
—Shelly said that being two-faced isn't good.

column3:
わぁ、嬉しい！
ほんとはもっと欲しいなって思ってたの
美味しくて、さっきのはすぐ食べちゃった
column4:
Wow, I'm so happy!
I was really hoping to get more.
They were so good, 
I ate the ones I had earlier right away!

column3: 隊長、目いっぱい楽しんでる！？
column4: Captain, are you enjoying yourself to the fullest?

column3:
メイリーフと二人でお返しの準備したんだ
隊長のために一生懸命考えたからね！
column4:
Mayleaf and I prepared the return gift together.
We thought very hard for the captain, you know!

column3:
もしもこの前、隊長がここに立ってたら
きっと今頃レスタニア中の人に
"お返し"することになってたよね！
column4:
If the captain had been standing here the other 
day, I'm sure they would be "giving back" to 
all of Lestania by now!

column3:
二人一組でお返しを用意したんだけど
クラウスが一人になっちゃったんだよね
本人は気にしてないみたいだったけど――
ちゃんと用意できたか心配だよ
column4:
We prepared the return gifts in pairs, 
but Klaus ended up being alone. 
He doesn't seem to mind, 
but I'm worried if we were able to 
prepare them properly.

column3:
やった！　さすが隊長、見る目あるよね！
それじゃ、いただきまーす
――わ、美味しい！　とろける！
隊長はコレ、もう食べた？
column4:
Yes! Well done, Captain! 
You really have a good eye! 
Alright then, let's dig in. 
-Oh, this is delicious! It's melting in my mouth! 
Captain, have you already tried this?

column3: えー、何か貰えると思ったのにな～
column4: Oh, I thought I would receive something...

column3:
あ、隊長！
お祭りのルールで、八方美人はダメなんだって
うう――わたしとしては欲しいんだけど――
column4:
Ah, Captain!
According to the festival rules, you can't have it all ways.
Ugh--I'd love to have it--but...

column3:
ラッキー！　じゃなくて、ありがとう！
もっと食べたいと思ってたところだったんだ
隊長から貰ったものだと思うと
美味しさがさらに増すよ
column4:
Lucky! No, thank you! 
I was just thinking that I wanted to eat more. 
When I think that it's something I received from 
the captain, the deliciousness increases!

column3: 夏、楽しんでるかい？

えっ、夏だっていうのにビーチに
行かない手があるっていうのか？！
――ありえない！
山は秋に行けばいいさ
column4:
What?! 
Are you saying that there's no way we can go to 
the beach even though it's summer?! 
That's impossible! 
We can go to the mountains in autumn.

column3:
ビーチで何をするのかって？
肌を焼いたり、水辺で遊んだり
陽の光を浴びながら友と語らったり
海の幸を楽しんだり――挙げきれないな！
column4:
What do you do at the beach?
Well, you can sunbathe, play in the water,
have conversations with friends while basking in 
the sunlight, enjoy the bounty of the sea... 
the list goes on!

column3:
ああ、水着を着ていても
水に触れるのは浅瀬だけにしておいた方がいい
この時期、ヒュージブルだけじゃなく
サメもいるから、さ
column4:
Ah, even if you're wearing a swimsuit, it's 
better to only touch the water in the shallows.
During this season, there are not only the Brine,
but also sharks, so...

column3:
どーお？
夏、輝いてるぅ？

夏のギラギラした太陽って素敵でしょ？
私たちもそれに負けないように
ビカビカに輝かなくっちゃね～
column4:
Isn't the scorching summer sun wonderful?
We must also burn brightly,
so we won't be outshone~

column3:
夏は一年のうちで今だけ！
そして、今年の夏は人生で一度きり
輝かないで終われる？
column4:
Summer is only once in the year!
And this summer is only once in a lifetime.
Will you let it end without shining?

column3:
いい感じの水着はすぐに試すことにしてるの
コレ、なかなかでしょぉ？
column4:
I've made it a habit to try on nice 
swimsuits right away.
This one, isn't it quite nice?

column3:
ここで話すのか？
いつ巨人が来るかわからない
手短に頼むよ
column4:
Are we going to talk here?
I don't know when the Giants will come.
Please keep it brief.

column3:
レスタニア区ローテス？
全く聞いたこともない地名だ
column4:
Lestanian District Rotes?
I've never heard of that place at all.

column3:
ここ、妙な臭いがしないか？
肌も少しべたべたするし――
空気に何か含まれてる気がするんだが
column4:
Do you smell something strange here?
My skin feels a bit sticky...
I feel like there's something in the air.

column3: 早く本隊に合流しないと――
column4: If we don't join up with the main group soon--

column3:
今回の催しは、遠方からも客人を招いているそうだ
万が一のことがあってはならん
いつでも動けるよう備えておかねばな
column4:
It seems that this event has invited guests 
from afar.
We must be prepared in case anything 
unexpected happens.

column3:
いつもと違う雰囲気に呑まれ
沖まで出ようとする者が出るやもしれん
事故が無いよう、見張っているのだ
column4:
The unusual atmosphere may cause some of them 
to try to go out to sea.
We are on the lookout for accidents.

column3:
この辺りの海岸は遠浅になっている
柵があるところまではヒュージブルも出ないが――
そら、沖を見てみろ
column4:
The coastline around here becomes shallow. 
Until you reach the area with fences, 
there won't be any Brine, but... 
Look, try looking out to sea.

column3:
柵を越えると
ヒュージブルだけでなく鮫もうろついている
貴殿も沖へは出ないことだ
column4:
When crossing the fence, 
it's not only the Brine but also lurking sharks.
It is advised that you do not venture out to sea.

column3:
しかし暑いな
おまけに日中は照り返しもある
――あとで一泳ぎしてくるとしよう
column4:
But it's hot and the sun is shining.
--I'll go for a swim later!

column3:
言うな――
ゲルト騎士団長の水着のセンスが
少し若々しいことくらい、何だというのだ
column4:
Don't say that--
What's wrong with Commander Gerd's slightly 
youthful sense of style when 
it comes to swimsuits?

column3:
あまりハメを外し過ぎないでくれ
柵や門の向こうは会場外だ
column4:
Please don't go too wild and let loose too much.
Beyond the fence and gate is outside the venue.

column3:
規則は規則だからな
越えようとするなら、例えあんたでも
引っ張り戻さないといけなくなる
column4:
Rules are rules,
and if you try to cross them, even if it's you,
I'll have to pull you back.

column3:
突然このビーチへの招待状が届いたんだ
――興味は無かったが、部下たちに
どうしても息抜きすべきだと主張されてな
column4:
I got an invitation to this beach out of the blue.
-- I wasn't interested, but my guys insisted
that I should really take a break.

column3:
ここには魔物も、ましてやオークもいない
一時的なものだが絵に描いたような平和だな
column4:
There are no demons here, much less orcs.
It's temporary, but it's picture-perfect peace.

column3:
だが、戦うわたしたちの
背後に何があるか、誰がいるか――
そんなものを再認識させてくれる
column4:
But it reminds us of what lies behind us, 
of who stands with us, as we fight.

column3:
わたしがここにいるのが珍しいか？
――まぁ、適当にすごして
すぐに戻るつもりだ
column4:
Is it unusual for me to be here?
--Well, I'll just hang out and get back soon.

column3:
ここはわたしの居場所ではない――
おまえも、本当はそう思っているのではないか？
column4:
This is no place for me--
You really think so too, don't you?

column3:
ふふ、その顔を見ればわかる
――また最前線で会おう
column4:
Hehe, just by looking at that face, I can tell
―― Let's meet again on the front lines.

column3:
俺も《黄金ヤシの繊維》を集めて
取引きに使おうかとも思ったが――
column4:
I thought about collecting some 
"Golden Palm Fibers" too
and using them to make a deal, but--

column3:
やめたよ
今日は休業だ
ひたすらのんびり過ごしてやろうと思ってね
column4:
I quit.
Today is a day off.
I plan to spend it leisurely.

column3:
せっかくのビーチだ
ポーンにも水着を選んでやるといい
column4:
It's a rare opportunity to be at the beach. 
It would be nice to choose a swimsuit for 
the Pawns as well.

column3:
――よかったら、コーネリアにも
会っていってくれ
なかなか良い色の水着が手に入ったんだ
column4:
—If you'd like, please go meet Cornelia too.
I managed to get a really nice-colored swimsuit.

column3:
ほらな
覚者になったって、楽しもうと思えば
いくらでも楽しめるんだ
column4:
